title: 小灣水壩
summary: 小灣案例將高拱壩傳力與兩岸岩體變形放入同一分析脈絡，探討卸荷、地下水、溫度和地震慣性如何改變原先假設。另以季節調蓄、下游變流及密度分層連接水庫運轉，讓學員分辨結構極限、量測殘差與環境控制是不同層次的判斷。
summaryEn: The Xiaowan case combines high-arch load transfer with abutment deformation, examining how unloading, groundwater, temperature and seismic inertia alter assumptions. Seasonal storage, downstream flow changes and stratification connect the structure to operation. Learners distinguish structural limits, monitoring residuals and environmental controls as different levels of assessment rather than one interchangeable score.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「方向剛度與傳力」及「岩楔有效正向力」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain；第二組為 F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Elastic rebound after excavation, then compare the controlling variables in Directional stiffness and load transfer and Rock wedge effective normal force. The first calculation is dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain; the second is F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖卸荷彈性回復」與「方向剛度與傳力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic rebound after excavation" and "Directional stiffness and load transfer": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic rebound after excavation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖卸荷彈性回復」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic rebound after excavation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深谷壩肩開挖改變原先岩體應力，部分變形是彈性回復，部分可能來自節理張開或損傷。先以應力變化除彈性模數估計一維應變尺度，便於檢查量測大小；但岩體模數須與方向、尺度及卸載路徑相符，不能拿完整岩芯數值代表全部邊坡。 卸載曲線與初次載入曲線未必一致，回復應變應使用相符的路徑模數，才能保留不可逆變形的意義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖卸荷彈性回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Abutment excavation changes the original rock stress, producing elastic rebound as well as possible joint opening or damage. Stress change divided by modulus provides a one-dimensional strain scale for checking observations. Rock-mass modulus must match direction, scale and unloading path rather than being replaced indiscriminately by an intact-core value. Unloading and first-loading curves need not coincide; rebound strain requires a path-appropriate modulus so that irreversible deformation remains distinguishable from elastic recovery. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic rebound after excavation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic rebound after excavation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復
knowledge.text: 深谷壩肩開挖改變原先岩體應力，部分變形是彈性回復，部分可能來自節理張開或損傷。先以應力變化除彈性模數估計一維應變尺度，便於檢查量測大小；但岩體模數須與方向、尺度及卸載路徑相符，不能拿完整岩芯數值代表全部邊坡。
knowledge.textEn: Abutment excavation changes the original rock stress, producing elastic rebound as well as possible joint opening or damage. Stress change divided by modulus provides a one-dimensional strain scale for checking observations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖卸荷彈性回復」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic rebound after excavation" is correct?
options: 完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡
深谷壩肩開挖改變原先岩體應力，部分變形是彈性回復，部分可能來自節理張開或損傷。
拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度
optionsEn: An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope.
Abutment excavation changes the original rock stress, producing elastic rebound as well as possible joint opening or damage.
Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 深谷壩肩開挖改變原先岩體應力，部分變形是彈性回復，部分可能來自節理張開或損傷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Abutment excavation changes the original rock stress, producing elastic rebound as well as possible joint opening or damage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic rebound after excavation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic rebound after excavation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。模型邊界：一維線彈性卸載應變幅度，未含節理張開及塑性損傷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain. Model boundary: one-dimensional linear elastic unloading strain magnitude, excluding joint opening and plastic damage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。模型邊界：一維線彈性卸載應變幅度，未含節理張開及塑性損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain. Model boundary: one-dimensional linear elastic unloading strain magnitude, excluding joint opening and plastic damage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elastic rebound after excavation", which statement holds?
options: 水庫水位下降時岸坡孔壓必定同步下降
混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。

Concrete at a high current temperature must be in thermal tension.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic rebound after excavation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖卸荷彈性回復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic rebound after excavation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。若持續位移在停工後仍增長，應查節理水壓或漸進破壞，不以單次彈性模數任意擬合所有時段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement. Growth during a pause calls for investigating joint pressure or progressive deformation rather than fitting every interval by arbitrarily changing one elastic modulus in the simple unloading model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將卸載模數減半重算應變，再把假想伸縮計長度換成位移，畫出即時彈性及持續變形兩種時間曲線並提出區分證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve unloading modulus and recompute strain, convert it to movement over an assumed extensometer length, and draw immediate elastic and continuing-deformation histories with observations that distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：開挖擾動可能形成方向性鬆弛帶，若仍用開挖前模數會低估位移；測點支架受爆破振動鬆動也可能造成跳值，需用深部與地表量測互相確認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excavation can produce a directional loosened zone, making the pre-excavation modulus underpredict movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。若持續位移在停工後仍增長，應查節理水壓或漸進破壞，不以單次彈性模數任意擬合所有時段。
knowledge.textEn: Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement. Growth during a pause calls for investigating joint pressure or progressive deformation rather than fitting every interval by arbitrarily changing one elastic modulus in the simple unloading model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將卸載模數減半重算應變，再把假想伸縮計長度換成位移，畫出即時彈性及持續變形兩種時間曲線並提出區分證據。
knowledge.textEn: Halve unloading modulus and recompute strain, convert it to movement over an assumed extensometer length, and draw immediate elastic and continuing-deformation histories with observations that distinguish them.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖卸荷彈性回復」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elastic rebound after excavation"?
options: 將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
洪水波速必定等於水粒子的平均流速
optionsEn: Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A release-wave celerity always equals mean water-particle velocity.
quiz.explanation: 將開挖步序、伸縮計與地表位移時間對齊，分辨每次卸荷後的即時反應與持續變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align excavation stages with extensometer and surface-displacement records, separating immediate rebound from continuing movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elastic rebound after excavation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖卸荷彈性回復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic rebound after excavation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 開挖擾動可能形成方向性鬆弛帶，若仍用開挖前模數會低估位移；測點支架受爆破振動鬆動也可能造成跳值，需用深部與地表量測互相確認。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation can produce a directional loosened zone, making the pre-excavation modulus underpredict movement. Blast-induced loosening of a sensor mounting can also cause a jump, requiring comparison of deep and surface measurements before attributing it to rock response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：卸載曲線與初次載入曲線未必一致，回復應變應使用相符的路徑模數，才能保留不可逆變形的意義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unloading and first-loading curves need not coincide; rebound strain requires a path-appropriate modulus so that irreversible deformation remains distinguishable from elastic recovery.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 開挖擾動可能形成方向性鬆弛帶，若仍用開挖前模數會低估位移；測點支架受爆破振動鬆動也可能造成跳值，需用深部與地表量測互相確認。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation can produce a directional loosened zone, making the pre-excavation modulus underpredict movement. Blast-induced loosening of a sensor mounting can also cause a jump, requiring comparison of deep and surface measurements before attributing it to rock response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開挖卸荷彈性回復」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elastic rebound after excavation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
開挖擾動可能形成方向性鬆弛帶，若仍用開挖前模數會低估位移；測點支架受爆破振動鬆動也可能造成跳值，需用深部與地表量測互相確認。
拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Excavation can produce a directional loosened zone, making the pre-excavation modulus underpredict movement.
Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness.

steps.title: 方向剛度與傳力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Directional stiffness and load transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向剛度與傳力」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Directional stiffness and load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高拱壩向岩體傳力時，節理方向會使不同方向的等效剛度不同。教材以一個受壓岩柱的軸向變形建立尺度，不將岩柱當成實際三維拱座。受力面積與傳力長度是模型假設，需要地質與位移場支持；方向性被忽略時，總變形可能吻合而局部反力錯誤。 等效面積代表模型傳力範圍而非任意外觀面積，需與荷載方向和觀察尺度一起定義，才可比較剛度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向剛度與傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint orientation gives an abutment different effective stiffness in different directions. An axially loaded rock prism establishes a deformation scale without representing the actual three-dimensional support. Loaded area and transfer length are assumptions requiring geological and displacement evidence. Ignoring anisotropy can match overall motion while assigning incorrect local reactions. Effective area represents the modeled load-transfer region, not an arbitrary visible surface; define it with load direction and observation scale before comparing stiffness estimates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Directional stiffness and load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向剛度與傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Directional stiffness and load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 方向剛度與傳力

knowledge.textEn: Joint orientation gives an abutment different effective stiffness in different directions. An axially loaded rock prism establishes a deformation scale without representing the actual three-dimensional support.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「方向剛度與傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Directional stiffness and load transfer" is correct?
options: 拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度

高拱壩向岩體傳力時，節理方向會使不同方向的等效剛度不同。
optionsEn: Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness.
Total wedge weight can directly be used as effective normal force on the sliding plane.
Joint orientation gives an abutment different effective stiffness in different directions.
quiz.explanation: 高拱壩向岩體傳力時，節理方向會使不同方向的等效剛度不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint orientation gives an abutment different effective stiffness in different directions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 方向剛度與傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Directional stiffness and load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向剛度與傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Directional stiffness and load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。模型邊界：均質線彈性岩柱沿單一軸向受力，不含拱座三維剪切。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm. Model boundary: homogeneous linear elastic prism loaded along one axis, excluding three-dimensional abutment shear. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同方向的現地載重或波速資料辨認方向差，再用多點位移場檢查所選傳力長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=90 MN; L=12 m; E=18000 MPa; A=12 m2; u=F*1e6*L/(E*1e6*A)*1000=5 mm。模型邊界：均質線彈性岩柱沿單一軸向受力，不含拱座三維剪切。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 方向剛度與傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Directional stiffness and load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向剛度與傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Directional stiffness and load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同方向的現地載重或波速資料辨認方向差，再用多點位移場檢查所選傳力長度。若一方向模型需要不合理模數才能擬合，應研究幾何及節理控制，而不是只調大有效面積壓低位移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field. If one direction needs an implausible modulus, investigate geometry and joint control rather than merely enlarging the effective area to suppress movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別把模數與面積減半重算位移，說明相同數值結果可能對應不同物理原因，再設計三個測點以辨別變形方向及轉動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve modulus and area in separate cases and recompute displacement. Explain why equal numerical results may have different physical causes, then place three sensors to distinguish directional deformation and rotation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同方向的現地載重或波速資料辨認方向差，再用多點位移場檢查所選傳力長度。若一方向模型需要不合理模數才能擬合，應研究幾何及節理控制，而不是只調大有效面積壓低位移。
knowledge.textEn: Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field. If one direction needs an implausible modulus, investigate geometry and joint control rather than merely enlarging the effective area to suppress movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別把模數與面積減半重算位移，說明相同數值結果可能對應不同物理原因，再設計三個測點以辨別變形方向及轉動。
knowledge.textEn: Halve modulus and area in separate cases and recompute displacement. Explain why equal numerical results may have different physical causes, then place three sensors to distinguish directional deformation and rotation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「方向剛度與傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Directional stiffness and load transfer"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以不同方向的現地載重或波速資料辨認方向差，再用多點位移場檢查所選傳力長度。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field.

quiz.explanationEn: Use directional field loading or wave-speed observations to identify anisotropy, then check transfer length against a multipoint displacement field. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 方向剛度與傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Directional stiffness and load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向剛度與傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Directional stiffness and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions. One displacement point cannot distinguish translation from local rotation and may conceal a change in the contact conditions supporting the arch. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等效面積代表模型傳力範圍而非任意外觀面積，需與荷載方向和觀察尺度一起定義，才可比較剛度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Effective area represents the modeled load-transfer region, not an arbitrary visible surface; define it with load direction and observation scale before comparing stiffness estimates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。
knowledge.textEn: Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions. One displacement point cannot distinguish translation from local rotation and may conceal a change in the contact conditions supporting the arch.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「方向剛度與傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Directional stiffness and load transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岩楔總重量可直接當作滑面有效正向力
某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Total wedge weight can directly be used as effective normal force on the sliding plane.
Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions.
quiz.explanation: 某組節理剪切滑動會破壞單軸連續體假設，使反力重新分配；單點位移不足以分辨整體平移與局部轉動，可能掩蓋拱座接觸條件改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sliding on a joint set invalidates the continuous uniaxial model and redistributes reactions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩楔有效正向力」與「降水位孔壓滯後」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rock wedge effective normal force" and "Pore pressure lag during drawdown": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩楔有效正向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock wedge effective normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩楔有效正向力」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock wedge effective normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 邊坡岩楔沿既有面滑動時，水壓會降低有效正向力而削弱摩擦抗力。教材把已解析到滑面的正向、切向及黏聚合力分開，避免把岩楔總重量直接當成正向力。真實三維岩楔可能沿兩個面共同運動，仍需節理方位與出口條件判斷運動學可行性。 若水壓大到使接觸面張開，摩擦抗力不能繼續按負有效正向力延伸，必須改變接觸狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩楔有效正向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure reduces effective normal force on a potential rock-wedge sliding surface and weakens frictional resistance. Separate resolved normal force, driving shear and cohesive resultant rather than treating total weight as normal force. Real three-dimensional wedges may move along two planes and require orientation and daylighting checks before force balance is meaningful. If pressure opens the contact, friction cannot be extrapolated using a negative effective normal force; the model must change its contact state and load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock wedge effective normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=20 MN; U=4 MN; mu=0.65 (dimensionless); C=2 MN; Tdrive=9 MN; FS=(mu*(N-U)+C)/Tdrive=1.377777778.

steps.title: 岩楔有效正向力：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 用節理測繪確認滑面方向及出露，再把降雨、孔壓與位移對齊檢查水壓假說。將剪力與正向力的解析方向畫在自由體圖上，若計算抗力大但位移持續，應研究峰值強度是否已退化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm orientation and daylighting through joint mapping, then align rainfall, pressure and movement. Show resolved shear and normal directions on a free-body diagram. Continued movement despite a large calculated resistance requires investigating whether peak strength has already degraded or the assumed surface is incorrect. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將水壓合力加倍並去除黏聚合力，分別計算抗滑力比，列出哪些情境需要殘餘強度試驗，以及如何確認假想滑面是否出露。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the water-pressure resultant and remove cohesion in separate cases. Calculate the force ratios, identify situations requiring residual-strength tests, and explain how to confirm that the assumed sliding plane daylights.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水失效會提高滑面水壓並降低摩擦，抗力未必隨總重量增加而等量增加；若使用峰值黏聚力描述已滑動面，會把殘餘強度問題隱藏在漂亮的力比中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drain failure raises plane pressure and reduces friction, so resistance does not necessarily increase in proportion to total weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 排水失效會提高滑面水壓並降低摩擦，抗力未必隨總重量增加而等量增加；若使用峰值黏聚力描述已滑動面，會把殘餘強度問題隱藏在漂亮的力比中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drain failure raises plane pressure and reduces friction, so resistance does not necessarily increase in proportion to total weight. Using peak cohesion on an already displaced surface hides a residual-strength problem behind an apparently favorable force ratio. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 水庫下降後，岸坡內孔壓可能因排水速度有限而仍偏高，外部水體支撐卻已減少。單一指數模型用來表示一個假想鬆弛時間，幫助比較降水位速度與內部反應；裂隙多路徑及飽和帶移動可能產生多個時間尺度，不能把擬合常數當成土性常數。 鬆弛時間描述系統幾何與排水路徑的綜合反應，增設排水後需要重新識別，不能直接沿用處理前數值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「降水位孔壓滯後」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：h0=10 m; t=24 h; tau=24 h; hExcess=h0*exp(-t/tau)=3.678794412 m。模型邊界：線性單一鬆弛模型的超額水頭，不是完整暫態滲流解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: h0=10 m; t=24 h; tau=24 h; hExcess=h0*exp(-t/tau)=3.678794412 m. Model boundary: excess head in a linear single-relaxation model, not a full transient seepage solution. steps.observation: 如何核對：同步紀錄庫水位及不同深度孔壓，以水位階段性變化檢查延遲，並比較上升與下降路徑。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 降水位孔壓滯後：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure lag during drawdown: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「降水位孔壓滯後」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure lag during drawdown” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步紀錄庫水位及不同深度孔壓，以水位階段性變化檢查延遲，並比較上升與下降路徑。若深淺測點時間常數不同，應保留分層或裂隙效應，不把所有訊號平均成一條假想同步曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record reservoir level and pore pressure at several depths, using staged changes to examine lag and comparing rising and falling paths. Different deep and shallow response times require retaining layering or fracture effects rather than averaging every signal into one artificial synchronous curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩種鬆弛時間畫出一天內超額水頭衰減，與同一降水位曲線比較，指出何處可能出現最大內外水頭差及所需補測深度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot one-day excess-head decay for two relaxation times and compare them with the same drawdown curve. Identify the possible maximum internal-external head difference and the additional depths that should be monitored.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Different deep and shallow response times require retaining layering or fracture effects rather than averaging every signal into one artificial synchronous curve.

steps.title: 降水位孔壓滯後：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure lag during drawdown: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「降水位孔壓滯後」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure lag during drawdown” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions. A blocked piezometer can imitate a long lag, so instrument response must be verified before attributing the entire delay to slope drainage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鬆弛時間描述系統幾何與排水路徑的綜合反應，增設排水後需要重新識別，不能直接沿用處理前數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relaxation time combines geometry and drainage pathways; adding drains changes that system, so the parameter must be identified again rather than inherited unchanged from earlier conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫水位下降時岸坡孔壓必定同步下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slope pore pressure always falls simultaneously with reservoir level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions. A blocked piezometer can imitate a long lag, so instrument response must be verified before attributing the entire delay to slope drainage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「降水位孔壓滯後」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure lag during drawdown" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。
等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions.
A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode.
quiz.explanation: 快速降水位可能在內部高孔壓尚未消散時移除外部支撐，使岸坡有效應力與受力條件不利；但測壓管堵塞也會假造長滯後，需先驗證儀器反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid drawdown can remove external support before internal pressure dissipates, creating unfavorable effective-stress conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震慣性力尺度」與「受約束溫升應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic inertia force scale" and "Restrained heating stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震慣性力尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia force scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震慣性力尺度」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic inertia force scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震加速度對質量產生慣性力，但高拱壩、岩體與水庫形成耦合振動，不能把整體都當成一個剛性質點。教材先算一個假想等效質量的慣性尺度，再辨認方向、模態及水體附加作用。靜力等效算值不含頻率內容與相位，不能代替動力分析。 等效質量須說明對應方向與模態參與程度，壩體總質量不一定等於單一反應模態可使用的有效質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震慣性力尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground acceleration generates inertia, while a high arch, rock supports and reservoir form a coupled dynamic system rather than one rigid particle. Calculate inertia for one assumed equivalent mass, then identify direction, modes and hydrodynamic contributions. A static-equivalent number contains neither frequency content nor phase and cannot replace dynamic analysis. An equivalent mass needs a direction and modal participation definition; total structural mass is not automatically the effective mass appropriate for one response mode. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic inertia force scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：m=120000000 kg; ah=0.15 (dimensionless); g=9.81 m/s2; F=m*ah*g/1e6=176.58 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: m=120000000 kg; ah=0.15 (dimensionless); g=9.81 m/s2; F=m*ah*g/1e6=176.58 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震慣性力尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seismic inertia force scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震慣性力尺度

knowledge.textEn: Ground acceleration generates inertia, while a high arch, rock supports and reservoir form a coupled dynamic system rather than one rigid particle. Calculate inertia for one assumed equivalent mass, then identify direction, modes and hydrodynamic contributions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震慣性力尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic inertia force scale" is correct?
options: 等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守
混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力
地震加速度對質量產生慣性力，但高拱壩、岩體與水庫形成耦合振動，不能把整體都當成一個剛性質點。
optionsEn: A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode.
Concrete at a high current temperature must be in thermal tension.
Ground acceleration generates inertia, while a high arch, rock supports and reservoir form a coupled dynamic system rather than one rigid particle.
quiz.explanation: 地震加速度對質量產生慣性力，但高拱壩、岩體與水庫形成耦合振動，不能把整體都當成一個剛性質點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 地震慣性力尺度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seismic inertia force scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照加速度計方向、時間同步與基線修正，並比較壩頂及基礎頻譜以觀察放大。若反應包含多個模態，應以分布質量及阻尼模型處理，不把峰值位移除以一個靜力直接反算全壩剛度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check accelerometer orientation, synchronization and baseline correction, comparing crest and foundation spectra for amplification. Multiple response modes require distributed mass and damping models; peak displacement divided into one static force does not reliably identify stiffness of the entire dam. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定加速度比較兩個等效質量，並畫出兩種頻率不同但峰值相同的輸入波，說明為何慣性尺度相同仍可能產生不同位移反應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare two equivalent masses at fixed acceleration, then draw inputs with equal peaks but different frequencies. Explain why an equal inertia scale can still produce different displacement responses in the coupled system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同方向地震分量的峰值未必同時發生，任意相加可能扭曲載重組合；忽略庫水與基礎互制也會錯估頻率，表面上保守的力值不保證反應保守。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Peaks of different earthquake components need not coincide, so arbitrary addition distorts combinations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 不同方向地震分量的峰值未必同時發生，任意相加可能扭曲載重組合；忽略庫水與基礎互制也會錯估頻率，表面上保守的力值不保證反應保守。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Peaks of different earthquake components need not coincide, so arbitrary addition distorts combinations. Omitting reservoir and foundation interaction can also misplace natural frequencies; an apparently conservative force does not guarantee conservative dynamic response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：等效質量須說明對應方向與模態參與程度，壩體總質量不一定等於單一反應模態可使用的有效質量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An equivalent mass needs a direction and modal participation definition; total structural mass is not automatically the effective mass appropriate for one response mode.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「等效靜力較大就保證所有動力反應保守」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger equivalent static force guarantees conservative dynamic response in every mode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 受約束溫升應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restrained heating stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「受約束溫升應力」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained heating stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土升溫希望自由膨脹，若沿一方向完全受約束，就會產生與自由熱應變相反的機械應變。教材用彈性模數乘熱應變估算壓應力幅度，並明確限制為單軸完全約束。實際早齡期材料會徐變，接縫也可能開合，必須避免把理想上界直接當成現場應力。 完全約束的總應變為零，但自由熱應變與機械應變各自非零，這個分解是辨認應力符號的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「受約束溫升應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heating concrete creates free thermal expansion; complete restraint along one direction requires an opposing mechanical strain. Modulus times thermal strain estimates the compressive stress magnitude under a uniaxial fully restrained assumption. Early-age creep and joint movement alter real stress, so this idealized bound is not a field stress measurement. Total strain is zero under complete restraint, while thermal and mechanical strains are individually nonzero; their decomposition is essential for assigning the correct stress sign. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained heating stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: E=25000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigmaC=E*alpha*dT=3 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「受約束溫升應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate heating and cooling from one stress-free reference, showing stress signs. Halve the restraint fraction and explain what displacement or connection evidence would support that partially restrained assumption.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把升溫壓應力的符號誤作拉應力會顛倒開裂判斷，而冷卻受約束可能產生拉應力；若未追蹤應力自由溫度，單看當前溫度也無法決定應力方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reversing the sign of heating stress reverses the cracking interpretation, while restrained cooling can create tension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以混凝土齡期試驗取得模數與熱膨脹係數，將埋入溫度和應變計讀值配對，並分離自由熱應變。若實測壓應變小於完全約束模型，應研究徐變與接縫釋放，不應直接認定感測器低估。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain age-specific modulus and expansion coefficients, pair embedded temperature and strain readings, and separate free thermal strain. Lower measured compressive response than the fully restrained estimate calls for investigating creep and joint release rather than immediately assuming sensor under-reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「受約束溫升應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restrained heating stress"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
岩楔總重量可直接當作滑面有效正向力
以混凝土齡期試驗取得模數與熱膨脹係數，將埋入溫度和應變計讀值配對，並分離自由熱應變。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Total wedge weight can directly be used as effective normal force on the sliding plane.
Obtain age-specific modulus and expansion coefficients, pair embedded temperature and strain readings, and separate free thermal strain.

quiz.explanationEn: Obtain age-specific modulus and expansion coefficients, pair embedded temperature and strain readings, and separate free thermal strain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 受約束溫升應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restrained heating stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受約束溫升應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained heating stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把升溫壓應力的符號誤作拉應力會顛倒開裂判斷，而冷卻受約束可能產生拉應力；若未追蹤應力自由溫度，單看當前溫度也無法決定應力方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing the sign of heating stress reverses the cracking interpretation, while restrained cooling can create tension. Without tracking the stress-free temperature, current temperature alone cannot determine whether the mechanical stress is tensile or compressive. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：完全約束的總應變為零，但自由熱應變與機械應變各自非零，這個分解是辨認應力符號的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Total strain is zero under complete restraint, while thermal and mechanical strains are individually nonzero; their decomposition is essential for assigning the correct stress sign.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete at a high current temperature must be in thermal tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「受約束溫升應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restrained heating stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把升溫壓應力的符號誤作拉應力會顛倒開裂判斷，而冷卻受約束可能產生拉應力；若未追蹤應力自由溫度，單看當前溫度也無法決定應力方向。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
月底水量平衡就保證月內沒有庫容限制
optionsEn: Reversing the sign of heating stress reverses the cracking interpretation, while restrained cooling can create tension.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A month-end water balance guarantees no capacity constraint within the month.
quiz.explanation: 把升溫壓應力的符號誤作拉應力會顛倒開裂判斷，而冷卻受約束可能產生拉應力；若未追蹤應力自由溫度，單看當前溫度也無法決定應力方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reversing the sign of heating stress reverses the cracking interpretation, while restrained cooling can create tension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「季節調蓄水量」與「梯級變流到達」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seasonal storage water balance" and "Cascade release wave arrival": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 季節調蓄水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seasonal storage water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「季節調蓄水量」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seasonal storage water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 季節性調蓄把豐水期來水延後使用，但可移轉水量受庫容、蒸發、環境流量與下游需求共同限制。教材先以平均入出流差積分一個月，建立可檢核的水量尺度；月平均不能描述月內洪峰，故仍要保留較短時段的操作與水位約束。 入出流平均值的採樣方法應一致，不等間隔觀測需要時間加權，否則算術平均可能偏向密集觀測的洪峰時段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「季節調蓄水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seasonal regulation shifts water use from wet periods, subject to storage, evaporation, environmental releases and downstream demand. Integrate mean inflow minus outflow over one month as an auditable volume scale. A monthly average does not represent within-month flood peaks, so shorter-interval level and release constraints remain necessary. Inflow and outflow averaging must be consistent; irregular observations require time weights or an arithmetic mean can overrepresent flood peaks sampled more densely than other periods. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seasonal storage water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「月底水量平衡就保證月內沒有庫容限制」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A month-end water balance guarantees no capacity constraint within the month." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「季節調蓄水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seasonal storage water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 季節調蓄水量
knowledge.text: 季節性調蓄把豐水期來水延後使用，但可移轉水量受庫容、蒸發、環境流量與下游需求共同限制。教材先以平均入出流差積分一個月，建立可檢核的水量尺度；月平均不能描述月內洪峰，故仍要保留較短時段的操作與水位約束。
knowledge.textEn: Seasonal regulation shifts water use from wet periods, subject to storage, evaporation, environmental releases and downstream demand. Integrate mean inflow minus outflow over one month as an auditable volume scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：月底水量平衡就保證月內沒有庫容限制 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A month-end water balance guarantees no capacity constraint within the month. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「季節調蓄水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seasonal storage water balance" is correct?
options: 月底水量平衡就保證月內沒有庫容限制
季節性調蓄把豐水期來水延後使用，但可移轉水量受庫容、蒸發、環境流量與下游需求共同限制。
洪水波速必定等於水粒子的平均流速
optionsEn: A month-end water balance guarantees no capacity constraint within the month.
Seasonal regulation shifts water use from wet periods, subject to storage, evaporation, environmental releases and downstream demand.
A release-wave celerity always equals mean water-particle velocity.
quiz.explanation: 季節性調蓄把豐水期來水延後使用，但可移轉水量受庫容、蒸發、環境流量與下游需求共同限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seasonal regulation shifts water use from wet periods, subject to storage, evaporation, environmental releases and downstream demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 季節調蓄水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seasonal storage water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「季節調蓄水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seasonal storage water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3。模型邊界：固定月平均流量且忽略蒸發取水，未驗證可用庫容。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3. Model boundary: constant monthly mean flows with evaporation and withdrawals omitted; available capacity is not verified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每日入出流與水位庫容變化比較，再核對月底帳本，保留日內最大水位而非只有月末值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare daily flow balances with stage-storage changes and reconcile the month-end account, retaining maximum levels rather than only final values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3。模型邊界：固定月平均流量且忽略蒸發取水，未驗證可用庫容。

Model boundary: constant monthly mean flows with evaporation and withdrawals omitted; available capacity is not verified.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「季節調蓄水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seasonal storage water balance", which statement holds?
options: 任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期
拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度

steps.title: 季節調蓄水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seasonal storage water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「季節調蓄水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seasonal storage water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每日入出流與水位庫容變化比較，再核對月底帳本，保留日內最大水位而非只有月末值。若月總量閉合但日間頻繁超出假定空間，表示平均尺度掩蓋限制，需要重做逐時或逐日調度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare daily flow balances with stage-storage changes and reconcile the month-end account, retaining maximum levels rather than only final values. A closing monthly total with repeated short-term space exceedances means averaging has hidden constraints and finer scheduling is required. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計相同月總入流但不同洪峰集中度的兩條日曲線，逐日計算儲量，指出哪一條需要旁通放流，並比較其期末可用水量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct two daily inflow sequences with equal monthly volume but different peak concentration. Calculate storage daily, identify which requires bypass release, and compare usable water remaining at the end of the month.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將月平均餘水全部當成可儲水量，會忽略洪水期間空間已滿的可能；水庫面積隨水位增加又使蒸發量變動，固定損失比例未必適合整季。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all average surplus as storable ignores periods when flood storage is already full. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「季節調蓄水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seasonal storage water balance"?
options: 將每日入出流與水位庫容變化比較，再核對月底帳本，保留日內最大水位而非只有月末值。

steps.instruction: 將月平均餘水全部當成可儲水量，會忽略洪水期間空間已滿的可能；水庫面積隨水位增加又使蒸發量變動，固定損失比例未必適合整季。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 上游電站改變出流後，下游收到的是沿河傳播並被地形調制的水位流量波，不是整團水瞬間移動。教材用假定波速估算訊息到達時間，並區分波速與水粒子平均流速。分岔、回水與儲存會展寬波形，因此到達時間不能直接代表可用調節容量。 到達時間應區分波前、峰值與整體波形中心，三者在展寬河段可能不同，需先界定調度需要哪種時標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梯級變流到達」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：L=80000 m; c=2 m/s; t=L/c/3600=11.11111111 h。模型邊界：固定波速的單一路徑估算，不含衰減及反射。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: L=80000 m; c=2 m/s; t=L/c/3600=11.11111111 h.
