quiz.explanation: 把平均流速當波速可能錯配下游調度時機，忽略支流洪峰又可能讓波形疊加；若只看最高水位時間，會漏掉較早開始的流量變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using mean particle velocity as celerity can mistime downstream coordination, while ignoring a tributary peak can miss superposition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度界面流態」與「岸坡位移速率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Density interface flow regime" and "Abutment slope movement rate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度界面流態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density interface flow regime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度界面流態」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density interface flow regime” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫分層使界面恢復力取決於密度差而非完整重力加速度。密度福祿數比較流速與內部重力波尺度，可幫助判斷取水或入流對界面的擾動，但實際捲吸受剪切、混合及幾何控制。教材不把某個比值當成所有水庫通用的分層破壞界線。 密度差符號反映穩定或不穩定排列，若重水在上則原先穩定內波尺度不適用，需改研究翻轉混合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度界面流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir stratification gives an interface a restoring force based on density contrast rather than full gravity. A densimetric Froude number compares flow speed with an internal-wave scale and helps characterize disturbance, while entrainment depends on shear, mixing and geometry. No single ratio is treated as a universal interface-breakdown threshold. The density-contrast sign identifies stable or unstable layering; dense water above light water invalidates the stable internal-wave scale and calls for an overturning analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density interface flow regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分層界面恢復力一律使用完整重力加速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The restoring force at a stratified interface always uses full gravity without density contrast." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度界面流態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density interface flow regime”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度界面流態
knowledge.text: 水庫分層使界面恢復力取決於密度差而非完整重力加速度。密度福祿數比較流速與內部重力波尺度，可幫助判斷取水或入流對界面的擾動，但實際捲吸受剪切、混合及幾何控制。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir stratification gives an interface a restoring force based on density contrast rather than full gravity. A densimetric Froude number compares flow speed with an internal-wave scale and helps characterize disturbance, while entrainment depends on shear, mixing and geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分層界面恢復力一律使用完整重力加速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The restoring force at a stratified interface always uses full gravity without density contrast. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度界面流態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density interface flow regime" is correct?
options: 水庫分層使界面恢復力取決於密度差而非完整重力加速度。
分層界面恢復力一律使用完整重力加速度
任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期
optionsEn: Reservoir stratification gives an interface a restoring force based on density contrast rather than full gravity.
The restoring force at a stratified interface always uses full gravity without density contrast.
Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure.
quiz.explanation: 水庫分層使界面恢復力取決於密度差而非完整重力加速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir stratification gives an interface a restoring force based on density contrast rather than full gravity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度界面流態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Density interface flow regime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度界面流態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density interface flow regime” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。模型邊界：雙層近似與已假定厚度尺度，未描述連續密度剖面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777. Model boundary: two-layer approximation with an assumed thickness scale, not a continuous density profile. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。模型邊界：雙層近似與已假定厚度尺度，未描述連續密度剖面。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777. Model boundary: two-layer approximation with an assumed thickness scale, not a continuous density profile.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密度界面流態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Density interface flow regime", which statement holds?
options: 拱座各方向都可使用相同等效剛度
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。
水庫水位下降時岸坡孔壓必定同步下降
optionsEn: Every abutment direction can use the same effective stiffness.
Original hypothetical example.
Slope pore pressure always falls simultaneously with reservoir level.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: v=0.2 m/s; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; h=8 m; Fr=v/(g*drho/rho*h)**0.5=0.504818777. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密度界面流態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Density interface flow regime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度界面流態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density interface flow regime” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。若界面模糊或存在多層，應改用更完整剖面分析，不把所有密度差集中在單一界面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles. Define which layer the thickness represents. A diffuse or multilayer interface requires fuller profile analysis rather than concentrating the entire density contrast into one artificial surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持流速與厚度不變，把密度差減半重算比值，畫出兩種剖面並說明需增加哪些垂向測點，才能檢查雙層近似。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve density contrast at fixed speed and thickness and recalculate the ratio. Draw both profiles and identify additional vertical sampling points needed to test whether the two-layer approximation remains reasonable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。若界面模糊或存在多層，應改用更完整剖面分析，不把所有密度差集中在單一界面。
knowledge.textEn: Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles. Define which layer the thickness represents. A diffuse or multilayer interface requires fuller profile analysis rather than concentrating the entire density contrast into one artificial surface.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持流速與厚度不變，把密度差減半重算比值，畫出兩種剖面並說明需增加哪些垂向測點，才能檢查雙層近似。
knowledge.textEn: Halve density contrast at fixed speed and thickness and recalculate the ratio. Draw both profiles and identify additional vertical sampling points needed to test whether the two-layer approximation remains reasonable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密度界面流態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Density interface flow regime"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土目前溫度高就必定承受拉應力
量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Concrete at a high current temperature must be in thermal tension.
Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles.
quiz.explanation: 量測溫度與必要的溶質資料以換算密度剖面，再配合流速垂向分布，確認所選厚度代表哪一水層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure temperature and relevant dissolved constituents to estimate density, paired with vertical velocity profiles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度界面流態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density interface flow regime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度界面流態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density interface flow regime” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction. Coarse vertical sampling can also miss a thin interface and distort the inferred internal-wave speed and mixing interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：密度差符號反映穩定或不穩定排列，若重水在上則原先穩定內波尺度不適用，需改研究翻轉混合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The density-contrast sign identifies stable or unstable layering; dense water above light water invalidates the stable internal-wave scale and calls for an overturning analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分層界面恢復力一律使用完整重力加速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The restoring force at a stratified interface always uses full gravity without density contrast." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。
knowledge.textEn: Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction. Coarse vertical sampling can also miss a thin interface and distort the inferred internal-wave speed and mixing interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度界面流態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Density interface flow regime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期
optionsEn: Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure.
quiz.explanation: 僅以溫度推估密度而忽略含砂或溶質，可能把重流方向判錯；感測垂向間距過大則會漏掉薄界面，使內部波速與混合判斷失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimating density from temperature alone can miss sediment or dissolved-material effects and misidentify density-current direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岸坡位移速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment slope movement rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岸坡位移速率」如何影響小灣水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment slope movement rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiaowan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 邊坡位移速率由相鄰觀測差除時間取得，必須保留方向與正負號。較短時間窗能顯示快速變化，卻也放大量測噪音；較長時間窗則可能掩蓋加速。課程先算平均速率，再要求與降雨、孔壓及施工事件配對，避免把一個斜率直接當成通用失穩預報。 速率差分的兩次位移若有共同基準誤差，部分偏差可能相消，但不同日期的基準跳動反而會放大假速率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸坡位移速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement rate is displacement change divided by elapsed time with direction and sign retained. Short windows reveal rapid change but amplify noise, while long windows can conceal acceleration. Calculate the mean rate, then compare rainfall, pressure and construction events rather than treating one slope of a time series as a universal instability forecast. A shared reference bias can partly cancel in displacement differencing, while a reference jump between dates can create a large false rate; distinguish the two errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment slope movement rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岸坡位移速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment slope movement rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岸坡位移速率
knowledge.text: 邊坡位移速率由相鄰觀測差除時間取得，必須保留方向與正負號。較短時間窗能顯示快速變化，卻也放大量測噪音；較長時間窗則可能掩蓋加速。
knowledge.textEn: Movement rate is displacement change divided by elapsed time with direction and sign retained. Short windows reveal rapid change but amplify noise, while long windows can conceal acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岸坡位移速率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment slope movement rate" is correct?
options: 任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期

完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡
optionsEn: Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure.
Movement rate is displacement change divided by elapsed time with direction and sign retained.
An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope.
quiz.explanation: 邊坡位移速率由相鄰觀測差除時間取得，必須保留方向與正負號。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Movement rate is displacement change divided by elapsed time with direction and sign retained. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岸坡位移速率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment slope movement rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岸坡位移速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment slope movement rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day。模型邊界：單方向區間平均速率，不是警戒門檻或破壞時間預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day. Model boundary: single-direction interval mean rate, not an alarm threshold or failure-time prediction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每次量測的基準穩定性與時間戳，將原始位移、速率及不確定度共同作圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check reference stability and timestamps, plotting displacement, rate and uncertainty together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岸坡位移速率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment slope movement rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岸坡位移速率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Abutment slope movement rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每次量測的基準穩定性與時間戳，將原始位移、速率及不確定度共同作圖。若速率增加只來自單次跳值，先查儀器；若多種獨立量測都持續加速，再研究水壓與岩體機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check reference stability and timestamps, plotting displacement, rate and uncertainty together. An apparent increase caused by one jump calls for instrument checks. Sustained acceleration across independent measurements justifies investigating pore pressure and rock-mass mechanisms rather than relying on a single processed channel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同起訖位移製作等速與後期加速兩條曲線，比較八日平均及兩日速率，說明需要何種量測精度才可辨識其差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create constant-rate and late-accelerating histories with identical endpoints. Compare eight-day and two-day rates and determine what measurement precision is required to distinguish the two movement patterns.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將長時間平均速率外推會漏掉近期加速，過度平滑也可能延後辨識；反之，差分噪音能製造假加速度，必須用原始位移及獨立測點支持解釋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Sustained acceleration across independent measurements justifies investigating pore pressure and rock-mass mechanisms rather than relying on a single processed channel.

knowledge.textEn: Create constant-rate and late-accelerating histories with identical endpoints. Compare eight-day and two-day rates and determine what measurement precision is required to distinguish the two movement patterns.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岸坡位移速率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 岸坡位移速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abutment slope movement rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岸坡位移速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abutment slope movement rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將長時間平均速率外推會漏掉近期加速，過度平滑也可能延後辨識；反之，差分噪音能製造假加速度，必須用原始位移及獨立測點支持解釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition. Conversely, differencing noise creates false acceleration, requiring raw displacement and independent observation points to support the interpreted change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速率差分的兩次位移若有共同基準誤差，部分偏差可能相消，但不同日期的基準跳動反而會放大假速率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A shared reference bias can partly cancel in displacement differencing, while a reference jump between dates can create a large false rate; distinguish the two errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何正位移速率都能直接推算破壞日期」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any positive movement rate can directly predict the date of failure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition. Conversely, differencing noise creates false acceleration, requiring raw displacement and independent observation points to support the interpreted change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岸坡位移速率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abutment slope movement rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將長時間平均速率外推會漏掉近期加速，過度平滑也可能延後辨識；反之，差分噪音能製造假加速度，必須用原始位移及獨立測點支持解釋。
完整岩芯彈性模數可直接代表整座岩坡
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition.
An intact-core modulus directly represents the entire rock slope.
quiz.explanation: 將長時間平均速率外推會漏掉近期加速，過度平滑也可能延後辨識；反之，差分噪音能製造假加速度，必須用原始位移及獨立測點支持解釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolating a long-term mean can miss recent acceleration, and heavy smoothing can delay recognition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 錦屏一級水壩
summary: 錦屏一級案例從拱座幾何與岩體路徑開始，逐步處理水壓合力、預應力、地震慣性、噴流水舌與熱變形。水庫端再加入季節儲存和取水溫度的守恆，強調結構、消能與生態證據不可互相替代。所有模型保留量綱並列出需要三維分析的缺項。
summaryEn: The Jinping I case begins with abutment geometry and rock load paths, then addresses water-force resultants, prestress, seismic inertia, spillway jets and thermal movement. Seasonal storage and withdrawal-temperature balances extend the reservoir boundary. Structural, dissipation and ecological evidence cannot substitute for one another, and every dimensional model identifies questions requiring three-dimensional analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「高壩水壓投影」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「薄拱圈膜力尺度」及「雙滑面岩楔抗力」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 gamma=9.81 kN/m3; h=260 m; w=1 m; F=0.5*gamma*h*h*w=331578 kN；第二組為 p=2 MPa; R=180 m; t=12 m; sigma=p*R/t=30 MPa。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for High dam pressure projection, then compare the controlling variables in Thin arch ring membrane scale and Two plane wedge resistance. The first calculation is gamma=9.81 kN/m3; h=260 m; w=1 m; F=0.5*gamma*h*h*w=331578 kN; the second is p=2 MPa; R=180 m; t=12 m; sigma=p*R/t=30 MPa. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高壩水壓投影」與「薄拱圈膜力尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High dam pressure projection" and "Thin arch ring membrane scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高壩水壓投影：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High dam pressure projection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高壩水壓投影」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High dam pressure projection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜水壓隨水深增加，沿垂直投影積分可得每單位壩長的水平合力，作用點位於壓力三角形形心。這是外力帳，並未說明拱壩如何把力傳向兩岸。實際雙曲面上的法向壓力需向量積分，不能把投影條帶合力直接當成每條拱圈的反力。 合力作用點由壓力一階矩決定，不是幾何深度中點；分段壓力圖改變時，力與力矩都需重新積分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高壩水壓投影」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure increases with depth, and integration over a vertical projection gives horizontal force per unit dam length at the triangular pressure centroid. This accounts for external load, not arch transfer to the banks. Normal pressure on a double-curved surface requires vector integration; a projected strip is not an individual arch reaction. The resultant location follows the first pressure moment, not the geometric midpoint; changing a piecewise pressure diagram requires recalculating both force and moment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High dam pressure projection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：gamma=9.81 kN/m3; h=260 m; w=1 m; F=0.5*gamma*h*h*w=331578 kN。模型邊界：垂直矩形投影條帶的靜水合力，不含尾水與動水壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: gamma=9.81 kN/m3; h=260 m; w=1 m; F=0.5*gamma*h*h*w=331578 kN. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 先標出水面與投影面幾何，確認壓力深度不等於海拔高程，再以分層矩形積分接近三角形結果。將外力方向與拱圈傳力圖分開繪製，若兩者合力不平衡，應查漏列尾水或幾何投影。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the water surface and projected geometry, ensuring depth is not confused with elevation, then refine rectangular pressure integration toward the triangular result. Draw external loading separately from arch transfer. An unbalanced resultant calls for checking omitted tailwater or projection geometry rather than adjusting support reactions arbitrarily. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將水深降低一成，重算合力與作用點並比較非線性變化，再畫出有尾水時的差壓圖，說明哪些力尚未進入投影條帶模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce depth by ten percent, recalculate resultant and location, and compare the nonlinear change. Draw a differential-pressure diagram with tailwater and identify forces still absent from the projected-strip model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用壩頂高程代替水深會把基準誤差平方放大，造成外力嚴重失真；忽略曲面法向分量也可能漏掉垂直作用，不能由水平投影帳宣稱全壩荷載已完整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting crest elevation for depth squares a datum error in the load estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High dam pressure projection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用壩頂高程代替水深會把基準誤差平方放大，造成外力嚴重失真；忽略曲面法向分量也可能漏掉垂直作用，不能由水平投影帳宣稱全壩荷載已完整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Ignoring curved-surface normal components can also omit vertical action, so a horizontal projected-force account does not constitute the complete loading of the dam. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin arch ring membrane scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想圓拱圈在均勻徑向壓力下可藉膜壓縮傳力，壓力乘半徑再除厚度提供一個應力尺度。雙曲拱壩還有豎向懸臂、扭曲及不同剛度拱座，不能當成孤立薄圓環。教材特意保留薄度與荷載假設，讓學員指出何處需要三維殼或實體分析。 膜應力尺度不含外壓失穩與局部缺陷效應，即使材料壓縮強度足夠，也不能由這一式排除所有失效機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄拱圈膜力尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ideal circular ring under uniform radial pressure carries membrane compression, with pressure times radius divided by thickness giving a stress scale. A double-curvature dam also has vertical cantilever action, distortion and unequal abutment stiffness, unlike an isolated thin ring. State slenderness and loading assumptions before identifying questions requiring shell or solid analysis. The membrane scale omits external-pressure instability and local defects; adequate compressive material strength therefore does not exclude every failure mechanism through this one equation. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：p=2 MPa; R=180 m; t=12 m; sigma=p*R/t=30 MPa。模型邊界：理想薄圓環均勻徑向壓力，R/t=15；僅教學膜壓應力尺度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: p=2 MPa; R=180 m; t=12 m; sigma=p*R/t=30 MPa. Model boundary: ideal thin circular ring under uniform radial pressure with R/t=15; a teaching membrane-compression scale only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查半徑與厚度定義及其比例，畫出截開半環的平衡圖，再以粗細網格比較理想模型。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 薄拱圈膜力尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin arch ring membrane scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄拱圈膜力尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thin arch ring membrane scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查半徑與厚度定義及其比例，畫出截開半環的平衡圖，再以粗細網格比較理想模型。若加入不對稱支承後出現彎矩，應承認膜力近似缺項，不用調整半徑把彎曲反應硬塞回公式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check radius, thickness and their ratio, draw equilibrium of a cut half-ring, and compare mesh refinements of the ideal model. Bending after introducing asymmetric supports identifies a missing mechanism; changing the radius to force agreement does not repair the membrane approximation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將厚度增加兩成重算膜應力，再加入概念性的拱座轉角，指出哪些新內力無法由原式得到，並規劃三維模型需輸入的邊界資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase thickness by twenty percent and recompute membrane stress. Introduce an abutment rotation conceptually, identify internal forces missing from the formula, and list boundary data required for a three-dimensional model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拱座變形不相容會引入彎曲與局部拉應力，平均膜壓縮仍可能很大；所以正的平均壓應力不能排除接縫張開，也不能代替混凝土與岩體接觸檢核。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incompatible abutment movement introduces bending and local tension while mean membrane compression remains large. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 薄拱圈膜力尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thin arch ring membrane scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄拱圈膜力尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thin arch ring membrane scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拱座變形不相容會引入彎曲與局部拉應力，平均膜壓縮仍可能很大；所以正的平均壓應力不能排除接縫張開，也不能代替混凝土與岩體接觸檢核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incompatible abutment movement introduces bending and local tension while mean membrane compression remains large. A positive average compressive stress therefore does not exclude joint opening or replace checks of concrete-rock contact and local stress distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：膜應力尺度不含外壓失穩與局部缺陷效應，即使材料壓縮強度足夠，也不能由這一式排除所有失效機制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The membrane scale omits external-pressure instability and local defects; adequate compressive material strength therefore does not exclude every failure mechanism through this one equation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均膜壓縮很大就不可能出現局部拉應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Large mean membrane compression makes local tensile stress impossible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拱座變形不相容會引入彎曲與局部拉應力，平均膜壓縮仍可能很大；所以正的平均壓應力不能排除接縫張開，也不能代替混凝土與岩體接觸檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Incompatible abutment movement introduces bending and local tension while mean membrane compression remains large. A positive average compressive stress therefore does not exclude joint opening or replace checks of concrete-rock contact and local stress distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄拱圈膜力尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thin arch ring membrane scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩滑面反力可以一律把總重量平分
拱座變形不相容會引入彎曲與局部拉應力，平均膜壓縮仍可能很大；所以正的平均壓應力不能排除接縫張開，也不能代替混凝土與岩體接觸檢核。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reactions on two sliding planes can always be obtained by dividing weight equally.
Incompatible abutment movement introduces bending and local tension while mean membrane compression remains large.
quiz.explanation: 拱座變形不相容會引入彎曲與局部拉應力，平均膜壓縮仍可能很大；所以正的平均壓應力不能排除接縫張開，也不能代替混凝土與岩體接觸檢核。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incompatible abutment movement introduces bending and local tension while mean membrane compression remains large. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙滑面岩楔抗力」與「錨索長期力保留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Two plane wedge resistance" and "Long term anchor force retention": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙滑面岩楔抗力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two plane wedge resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙滑面岩楔抗力」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two plane wedge resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深谷岩楔可能同時受兩組節理面約束，各面的有效正向力與摩擦係數都會影響可用抗力。教材在已給定法向反力的前提下加總沿假想運動方向的摩擦，避免用單一坡角代表全部三維幾何。真正反力須由向量平衡求得，不能憑重量任意平均分配。 兩面抗力在真實空間須按向量合成，本例同方向相加是額外假設，不能直接轉用到不同交線方位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙滑面岩楔抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A canyon wedge may be constrained by two joint planes, each with its own effective normal force and friction. Given resolved reactions, sum the assumed friction contributions along a movement direction rather than representing all geometry by one slope angle. Actual reactions must follow vector equilibrium, not arbitrary equal division of wedge weight. Resistance contributions require vector combination in real space; adding them along one direction is an extra assumption here and cannot transfer unchanged to other intersection geometries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two plane wedge resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N1=30 MN; U1=6 MN; mu1=0.6 (dimensionless); N2=20 MN; U2=4 MN; mu2=0.5 (dimensionless); R=mu1*(N1-U1)+mu2*(N2-U2)=22.4 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N1=30 MN; U1=6 MN; mu1=0.6 (dimensionless); N2=20 MN; U2=4 MN; mu2=0.5 (dimensionless); R=mu1*(N1-U1)+mu2*(N2-U2)=22.4 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩滑面反力可以一律把總重量平分」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reactions on two sliding planes can always be obtained by dividing weight equally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙滑面岩楔抗力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Two plane wedge resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙滑面岩楔抗力
knowledge.text: 深谷岩楔可能同時受兩組節理面約束，各面的有效正向力與摩擦係數都會影響可用抗力。教材在已給定法向反力的前提下加總沿假想運動方向的摩擦，避免用單一坡角代表全部三維幾何。
knowledge.textEn: A canyon wedge may be constrained by two joint planes, each with its own effective normal force and friction. Given resolved reactions, sum the assumed friction contributions along a movement direction rather than representing all geometry by one slope angle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩滑面反力可以一律把總重量平分 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reactions on two sliding planes can always be obtained by dividing weight equally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙滑面岩楔抗力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Two plane wedge resistance" is correct?
options: 深谷岩楔可能同時受兩組節理面約束，各面的有效正向力與摩擦係數都會影響可用抗力。

optionsEn: A canyon wedge may be constrained by two joint planes, each with its own effective normal force and friction.
Reactions on two sliding planes can always be obtained by dividing weight equally.
All anchor-loss percentages can be added without checking their reference states.
quiz.explanation: 深谷岩楔可能同時受兩組節理面約束，各面的有效正向力與摩擦係數都會影響可用抗力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A canyon wedge may be constrained by two joint planes, each with its own effective normal force and friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙滑面岩楔抗力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two plane wedge resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙滑面岩楔抗力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two plane wedge resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N1=30 MN; U1=6 MN; mu1=0.6 (dimensionless); N2=20 MN; U2=4 MN; mu2=0.5 (dimensionless); R=mu1*(N1-U1)+mu2*(N2-U2)=22.4 MN。模型邊界：兩面摩擦皆沿同一假想抗滑方向且正向力已知，無黏聚及錨索。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N1=30 MN; U1=6 MN; mu1=0.6 (dimensionless); N2=20 MN; U2=4 MN; mu2=0.5 (dimensionless); R=mu1*(N1-U1)+mu2*(N2-U2)=22.4 MN. Model boundary: both friction contributions act along one assumed resistance direction with known normal forces, no cohesion or anchors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a three-dimensional joint diagram to establish intersection and daylighting, then show pressure and reaction on each plane.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 雙滑面岩楔抗力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two plane wedge resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙滑面岩楔抗力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two plane wedge resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用立體節理圖先確認共同交線與出露條件，再將每面水壓與反力方向畫出。比較乾季和雨季的孔壓變化，若只有一面明顯反應，應保留兩面差異，不用平均水壓抹平主導失效路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a three-dimensional joint diagram to establish intersection and daylighting, then show pressure and reaction on each plane. Compare seasonal pressures; if one plane responds strongly, retain that distinction rather than averaging pressure and concealing the controlling resistance path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別提高第一面與第二面水壓，計算抗力變化並比較敏感度，再畫出一面失去接觸時原模型需要刪除及重新求解的項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase water pressure on each plane separately and compare resistance sensitivity. Draw the case where one plane loses contact and identify terms that must be removed or solved again in the revised model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一面節理連通高水壓會重新分配接觸反力，原先固定反力假設可能失效；若某面脫開，其摩擦不能繼續按原正向力計入，需重新求運動學與平衡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High pressure connected to one plane can redistribute contact reactions and invalidate their assumed fixed values. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two plane wedge resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一面節理連通高水壓會重新分配接觸反力，原先固定反力假設可能失效；若某面脫開，其摩擦不能繼續按原正向力計入，需重新求運動學與平衡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High pressure connected to one plane can redistribute contact reactions and invalidate their assumed fixed values. If a plane separates, its previous friction contribution cannot remain in the account; kinematics and equilibrium must be recalculated for the changed contact state. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩面抗力在真實空間須按向量合成，本例同方向相加是額外假設，不能直接轉用到不同交線方位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Resistance contributions require vector combination in real space; adding them along one direction is an extra assumption here and cannot transfer unchanged to other intersection geometries.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩滑面反力可以一律把總重量平分」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reactions on two sliding planes can always be obtained by dividing weight equally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long term anchor force retention” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預應力錨索鎖定後可能因鋼材鬆弛、岩體變形及接頭就位而損失拉力，各效應的參考狀態必須說清楚。若後一比例作用於已減少的力，應連乘而非把百分率任意相加。教材只建立保留力帳，實際錨固區承載及防蝕完整性仍要獨立評估。 保留力與可承受最大力不同，前者描述目前預應力，後者還需要鋼材截面、錨頭與岩體黏結能力等證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨索長期力保留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After lock-off, anchor force can decrease through steel relaxation, rock movement and seating, with each loss needing a stated reference state. If a later percentage acts on the remaining force, multiply retention factors rather than casually adding percentages. This account does not establish anchorage capacity or the integrity of corrosion protection. Retained force describes current prestress rather than maximum capacity; capacity additionally needs evidence about steel section, anchor head and rock-bond resistance along the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long term anchor force retention” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 將張拉、鎖定與後續量測的時間及溫度分別記錄，對照載重計校準與重新提離試驗。若多支同時下降，先查共同岩體位移或溫度；若單支突變，則需檢查接頭滑移及儀器。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record stressing, lock-off and later readings with times and temperatures, checking load-cell calibration against lift-off testing. A coherent decline across anchors suggests shared rock movement or temperature, while one abrupt change requires investigation of connection slip or measurement failure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較依序損失與兩項皆以初始力為基準的算法，算出差值，再列出鎖定力、提離力與載重計讀值各自的測試邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare sequential losses with two losses both referenced to initial force and calculate the difference. Define the distinct measurement boundaries of lock-off force, lift-off force and load-cell readings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭滑移可能造成突降而非平滑比例衰減，鏽蝕斷絲又可能在平均拉力變化不大時削弱冗餘；只追蹤一條力曲線不能證明錨固系統完整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Connection slip can cause a sudden drop rather than smooth proportional decay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A coherent decline across anchors suggests shared rock movement or temperature, while one abrupt change requires investigation of connection slip or measurement failure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨索長期力保留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long term anchor force retention"?
options: 將張拉、鎖定與後續量測的時間及溫度分別記錄，對照載重計校準與重新提離試驗。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
壩頂海拔可直接代替壓力積分水深
optionsEn: Record stressing, lock-off and later readings with times and temperatures, checking load-cell calibration against lift-off testing.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Crest elevation above sea level can directly replace water depth in pressure integration.
quiz.explanation: 將張拉、鎖定與後續量測的時間及溫度分別記錄，對照載重計校準與重新提離試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record stressing, lock-off and later readings with times and temperatures, checking load-cell calibration against lift-off testing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨索長期力保留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long term anchor force retention: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨索長期力保留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long term anchor force retention” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭滑移可能造成突降而非平滑比例衰減，鏽蝕斷絲又可能在平均拉力變化不大時削弱冗餘；只追蹤一條力曲線不能證明錨固系統完整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Connection slip can cause a sudden drop rather than smooth proportional decay. Corroded wire breaks can reduce redundancy without a large change in mean measured force, so one force history cannot demonstrate integrity of the complete anchoring system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：保留力與可承受最大力不同，前者描述目前預應力，後者還需要鋼材截面、錨頭與岩體黏結能力等證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retained force describes current prestress rather than maximum capacity; capacity additionally needs evidence about steel section, anchor head and rock-bond resistance along the system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有錨索損失百分率都可不看基準直接相加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All anchor-loss percentages can be added without checking their reference states." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭滑移可能造成突降而非平滑比例衰減，鏽蝕斷絲又可能在平均拉力變化不大時削弱冗餘；只追蹤一條力曲線不能證明錨固系統完整。
knowledge.textEn: Connection slip can cause a sudden drop rather than smooth proportional decay. Corroded wire breaks can reduce redundancy without a large change in mean measured force, so one force history cannot demonstrate integrity of the complete anchoring system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨索長期力保留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long term anchor force retention" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接頭滑移可能造成突降而非平滑比例衰減，鏽蝕斷絲又可能在平均拉力變化不大時削弱冗餘；只追蹤一條力曲線不能證明錨固系統完整。
理想拋體落點就是實際沖刷坑中心
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Connection slip can cause a sudden drop rather than smooth proportional decay.
The ideal projectile landing point is the actual center of the scour hole.
quiz.explanation: 接頭滑移可能造成突降而非平滑比例衰減，鏽蝕斷絲又可能在平均拉力變化不大時削弱冗餘；只追蹤一條力曲線不能證明錨固系統完整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Connection slip can cause a sudden drop rather than smooth proportional decay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挑流水舌射程」與「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ski jump jet travel" and "Jet impact pressure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挑流水舌射程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ski jump jet travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「挑流水舌射程」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ski jump jet travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 挑流水舌離開鼻坎後同時具有水平及垂直速度，重力使其軌跡彎曲。教材使用水平射出的拋體模型估算射程，只用來檢查尺度及方向；真實水舌會含氣、破碎並受尾水與風影響，不能以理想落點直接決定沖刷坑位置或岩體穩定。 水平射出時下落時間由高差決定，但若鼻坎提供向上速度，需解完整垂向方程，不能沿用相同飛行時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「挑流水舌射程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A ski-jump jet has horizontal and vertical velocity components and follows a gravity-curved trajectory. A horizontally launched projectile estimates travel scale and direction only. Real jets aerate, break up and interact with wind and tailwater, so an ideal impact point does not directly locate scour or establish rock stability. For horizontal launch, drop determines flight time; an upward launch component requires the full vertical equation and cannot retain the same time of flight. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ski jump jet travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想拋體落點就是實際沖刷坑中心」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ideal projectile landing point is the actual center of the scour hole." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「挑流水舌射程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ski jump jet travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 挑流水舌射程
knowledge.text: 挑流水舌離開鼻坎後同時具有水平及垂直速度，重力使其軌跡彎曲。教材使用水平射出的拋體模型估算射程，只用來檢查尺度及方向；真實水舌會含氣、破碎並受尾水與風影響，不能以理想落點直接決定沖刷坑位置或岩體穩定。
knowledge.textEn: A ski-jump jet has horizontal and vertical velocity components and follows a gravity-curved trajectory. A horizontally launched projectile estimates travel scale and direction only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想拋體落點就是實際沖刷坑中心 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The ideal projectile landing point is the actual center of the scour hole. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「挑流水舌射程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ski jump jet travel" is correct?
options: 理想拋體落點就是實際沖刷坑中心
所有測點最大壓力可直接同時相加
挑流水舌離開鼻坎後同時具有水平及垂直速度，重力使其軌跡彎曲。
optionsEn: The ideal projectile landing point is the actual center of the scour hole.
Maximum pressures from all sensors can always be added as simultaneous loads.
A ski-jump jet has horizontal and vertical velocity components and follows a gravity-curved trajectory.
quiz.explanation: 挑流水舌離開鼻坎後同時具有水平及垂直速度，重力使其軌跡彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A ski-jump jet has horizontal and vertical velocity components and follows a gravity-curved trajectory. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 挑流水舌射程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ski jump jet travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「挑流水舌射程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ski jump jet travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m。模型邊界：水平初速且初始垂直速度為零的真空拋體，忽略水舌破碎。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m. Model boundary: horizontal launch with zero initial vertical velocity in a drag-free projectile model, excluding jet breakup. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以影像追蹤水舌外緣與中心線，核對出射角及速度範圍，再比較不同流量的落水帶寬度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track the jet envelope and centerline with imagery, checking launch angle and velocity range, then compare impact-zone width at different discharges.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m。模型邊界：水平初速且初始垂直速度為零的真空拋體，忽略水舌破碎。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m. Model boundary: horizontal launch with zero initial vertical velocity in a drag-free projectile model, excluding jet breakup.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「挑流水舌射程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ski jump jet travel", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m。
出口溫度改變就證明全庫分層消失
兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m.
A changed outlet temperature proves that stratification has disappeared throughout the reservoir.
Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: vx=25 m/s; drop=120 m; g=9.81 m/s2; x=vx*(2*drop/g)**0.5=123.6548417 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 挑流水舌射程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ski jump jet travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「挑流水舌射程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ski jump jet travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以影像追蹤水舌外緣與中心線，核對出射角及速度範圍，再比較不同流量的落水帶寬度。若落點展寬而中心位置近似不變，應研究破碎與含氣，不能只調整平均出射速度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track the jet envelope and centerline with imagery, checking launch angle and velocity range, then compare impact-zone width at different discharges. A wider landing band with a similar center suggests breakup or aeration rather than merely a change in average launch speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩個水平速度計算射程，再加入向上出射的概念軌跡，說明需要哪些影像及尾水資料才能從教材拋體轉向實際水舌分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate range at two horizontal speeds, then sketch an upward-launched case. Identify image and tailwater data needed to progress from the teaching projectile to analysis of a real spillway jet.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出射角或流束不均會使局部水舌偏向邊坡，即使平均射程符合估算仍有側向衝擊；忽略尾水淹沒也會錯估真正能量耗散區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven flow or launch angle can direct part of the jet toward a slope even when mean range matches the calculation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以影像追蹤水舌外緣與中心線，核對出射角及速度範圍，再比較不同流量的落水帶寬度。若落點展寬而中心位置近似不變，應研究破碎與含氣，不能只調整平均出射速度。
knowledge.textEn: Track the jet envelope and centerline with imagery, checking launch angle and velocity range, then compare impact-zone width at different discharges. A wider landing band with a similar center suggests breakup or aeration rather than merely a change in average launch speed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以兩個水平速度計算射程，再加入向上出射的概念軌跡，說明需要哪些影像及尾水資料才能從教材拋體轉向實際水舌分析。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate range at two horizontal speeds, then sketch an upward-launched case. Identify image and tailwater data needed to progress from the teaching projectile to analysis of a real spillway jet.

quiz.question: 要驗證「挑流水舌射程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ski jump jet travel"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以影像追蹤水舌外緣與中心線，核對出射角及速度範圍，再比較不同流量的落水帶寬度。
平均膜壓縮很大就不可能出現局部拉應力
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Track the jet envelope and centerline with imagery, checking launch angle and velocity range, then compare impact-zone width at different discharges.
Large mean membrane compression makes local tensile stress impossible.
quiz.explanation: 以影像追蹤水舌外緣與中心線，核對出射角及速度範圍，再比較不同流量的落水帶寬度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track the jet envelope and centerline with imagery, checking launch angle and velocity range, then compare impact-zone width at different discharges. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 挑流水舌射程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ski jump jet travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「挑流水舌射程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ski jump jet travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出射角或流束不均會使局部水舌偏向邊坡，即使平均射程符合估算仍有側向衝擊；忽略尾水淹沒也會錯估真正能量耗散區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven flow or launch angle can direct part of the jet toward a slope even when mean range matches the calculation. Ignoring tailwater submergence additionally misidentifies where the jet actually dissipates its energy and transfers momentum. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水平射出時下落時間由高差決定，但若鼻坎提供向上速度，需解完整垂向方程，不能沿用相同飛行時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For horizontal launch, drop determines flight time; an upward launch component requires the full vertical equation and cannot retain the same time of flight.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「理想拋體落點就是實際沖刷坑中心」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The ideal projectile landing point is the actual center of the scour hole." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「挑流水舌射程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ski jump jet travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
所有測點最大壓力可直接同時相加

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Maximum pressures from all sensors can always be added as simultaneous loads.

steps.title: 水舌衝擊壓力尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet impact pressure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet impact pressure scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水舌速度在撞擊區轉成壓力與湍流，動壓提供一個能量密度尺度，但瞬時壓力分布取決於水舌破碎、尾水深度和岩面形狀。動壓不是整片底床均勻承受的壓力，亦不能直接乘任意面積得到設計合力。需同時掌握受力面積與時間統計。 動壓的帕斯卡與每立方米焦耳量綱相同，代表能量密度而非總能量，乘體積或面積後才得到不同物理量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet velocity is converted into pressure and turbulence at impact. Dynamic pressure supplies an energy-density scale, while instantaneous distribution depends on breakup, tailwater depth and bed geometry. It is not uniform over the whole bed and cannot be multiplied by an arbitrary area to obtain a design resultant without spatial and temporal evidence. Pascals share dimensions with joules per cubic metre, expressing energy density rather than total energy; multiplying by volume or area produces different physical quantities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet impact pressure scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; v=35 m/s; q=0.5*rho*v*v/1000=612.5 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; v=35 m/s; q=0.5*rho*v*v/1000=612.5 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有測點最大壓力可直接同時相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum pressures from all sensors can always be added as simultaneous loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet impact pressure scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening.

steps.title: 水舌衝擊壓力尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Jet impact pressure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jet impact pressure scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; v=35 m/s; q=0.5*rho*v*v/1000=612.5 kPa。模型邊界：單相速度的動壓尺度，不是沖刷坑底實測峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; v=35 m/s; q=0.5*rho*v*v/1000=612.5 kPa. Model boundary: dynamic-pressure scale for single-phase velocity, not a measured plunge-pool bottom peak. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在模型或合適量測資料中比較不同位置的平均、峰值與相關性，核對感測器頻寬及通氣影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare mean pressure, peaks and spatial correlation using model or suitable measured data, checking sensor bandwidth and aeration effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水舌衝擊壓力尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Jet impact pressure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jet impact pressure scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在模型或合適量測資料中比較不同位置的平均、峰值與相關性，核對感測器頻寬及通氣影響。若鄰近測點峰值不同時發生，不能把各點最大值同時相加成總力，需保留同步壓力場。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare mean pressure, peaks and spatial correlation using model or suitable measured data, checking sensor bandwidth and aeration effects. Peaks at neighboring locations that occur at different times cannot simply be added into one total force; retain synchronized pressure fields for integration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將速度提高一成計算動壓變化，再建立兩個不同相位的壓力時序，對比逐點最大值總和與同步積分最大值的差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase velocity by ten percent and recalculate dynamic pressure. Create two out-of-phase pressure histories and compare the sum of individual maxima with the maximum of their synchronized integral.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岩節理中的壓力脈動可能向內傳播並抬動岩塊，即使表面平均壓力不高；含氣改變可壓縮性與脈動傳遞，因此清水動壓尺度無法單獨描述剝離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pressure fluctuations can penetrate rock joints and lift blocks despite modest mean surface pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
