knowledge.textEn: Pressure fluctuations can penetrate rock joints and lift blocks despite modest mean surface pressure. Aeration changes compressibility and fluctuation transmission, so a clear-water dynamic-pressure scale alone cannot describe block removal or the progression of scour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水舌衝擊壓力尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Jet impact pressure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 岩節理中的壓力脈動可能向內傳播並抬動岩塊，即使表面平均壓力不高；含氣改變可壓縮性與脈動傳遞，因此清水動壓尺度無法單獨描述剝離。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度
optionsEn: Pressure fluctuations can penetrate rock joints and lift blocks despite modest mean surface pressure.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening.
quiz.explanation: 岩節理中的壓力脈動可能向內傳播並抬動岩塊，即使表面平均壓力不高；含氣改變可壓縮性與脈動傳遞，因此清水動壓尺度無法單獨描述剝離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure fluctuations can penetrate rock joints and lift blocks despite modest mean surface pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壩塊自由收縮」與「分層交換位能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dam block free contraction" and "Stratified exchange potential energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壩塊自由收縮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dam block free contraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壩塊自由收縮」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dam block free contraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高壩混凝土塊體降溫會產生自由收縮，但拱圈閉合、岩體約束及灌漿時機會決定實際縫寬與應力。教材先算一段假想塊體的自由長度減少，明確以幅度表示；不能把它直接當接縫開度，因相鄰塊體也在變形且整體幾何可能限制位移。 相鄰塊體各自的無應力溫度未必相同，接縫灌漿年代及材料齡期會改變後續收縮的參考狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壩塊自由收縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling a high-dam concrete block creates free contraction, while arch closure, rock restraint and grouting timing determine actual joint opening and stress. Compute the magnitude of free shortening in an assumed block first. It is not directly the joint opening because neighboring blocks deform and the overall geometry can restrain movement. Neighboring blocks may have different stress-free temperatures; grouting history and material age change the reference state from which subsequent contraction and restraint develop. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dam block free contraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壩塊自由收縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dam block free contraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壩塊自由收縮
knowledge.text: 高壩混凝土塊體降溫會產生自由收縮，但拱圈閉合、岩體約束及灌漿時機會決定實際縫寬與應力。教材先算一段假想塊體的自由長度減少，明確以幅度表示；不能把它直接當接縫開度，因相鄰塊體也在變形且整體幾何可能限制位移。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling a high-dam concrete block creates free contraction, while arch closure, rock restraint and grouting timing determine actual joint opening and stress. Compute the magnitude of free shortening in an assumed block first.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壩塊自由收縮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dam block free contraction" is correct?
options: 單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度
高壩混凝土塊體降溫會產生自由收縮，但拱圈閉合、岩體約束及灌漿時機會決定實際縫寬與應力。
出口溫度改變就證明全庫分層消失
optionsEn: Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening.
Cooling a high-dam concrete block creates free contraction, while arch closure, rock restraint and grouting timing determine actual joint opening and stress.
A changed outlet temperature proves that stratification has disappeared throughout the reservoir.
quiz.explanation: 高壩混凝土塊體降溫會產生自由收縮，但拱圈閉合、岩體約束及灌漿時機會決定實際縫寬與應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling a high-dam concrete block creates free contraction, while arch closure, rock restraint and grouting timing determine actual joint opening and stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壩塊自由收縮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dam block free contraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壩塊自由收縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dam block free contraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm。模型邊界：均勻降溫的自由收縮幅度，不含相鄰塊體與約束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm. Model boundary: free-shortening magnitude for uniform cooling, excluding neighboring blocks and restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時比較塊內溫度剖面與接縫兩側位移，核對降溫是否均勻及量測正向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare internal temperature profiles with displacement on both sides of the joint, checking uniformity and sign conventions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm。模型邊界：均勻降溫的自由收縮幅度，不含相鄰塊體與約束。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm. Model boundary: free-shortening magnitude for uniform cooling, excluding neighboring blocks and restraint.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壩塊自由收縮」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dam block free contraction", which statement holds?
options: 兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據
平均膜壓縮很大就不可能出現局部拉應力
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm。
optionsEn: Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly.
Large mean membrane compression makes local tensile stress impossible.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壩塊自由收縮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dam block free contraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壩塊自由收縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dam block free contraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時比較塊內溫度剖面與接縫兩側位移，核對降溫是否均勻及量測正向。若兩側都朝同方向移動，接縫差值可能很小但整體位移不小，應分別呈現絕對與相對運動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare internal temperature profiles with displacement on both sides of the joint, checking uniformity and sign conventions. If both sides move in the same direction, relative opening may be small despite substantial overall movement, so present absolute and relative components separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩個相鄰塊體設定不同降溫，計算各自自由收縮，再畫共同平移與相對開縫兩種位移場，指出需要哪些量測才能區分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign different cooling changes to two neighboring blocks and calculate free shortening. Draw common translation and relative opening fields, identifying the measurements needed to distinguish them rather than relying on one gauge.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用單側位移當縫寬會把整體平移誤算為開裂，溫度梯度又可能造成彎曲而非純收縮；若只保存平均溫度，將失去辨認兩種機制的關鍵資訊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using one-side displacement as joint width mistakes translation for opening, while a temperature gradient can produce bending rather than pure shortening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時比較塊內溫度剖面與接縫兩側位移，核對降溫是否均勻及量測正向。若兩側都朝同方向移動，接縫差值可能很小但整體位移不小，應分別呈現絕對與相對運動。
knowledge.textEn: Compare internal temperature profiles with displacement on both sides of the joint, checking uniformity and sign conventions. If both sides move in the same direction, relative opening may be small despite substantial overall movement, so present absolute and relative components separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩個相鄰塊體設定不同降溫，計算各自自由收縮，再畫共同平移與相對開縫兩種位移場，指出需要哪些量測才能區分。
knowledge.textEn: Assign different cooling changes to two neighboring blocks and calculate free shortening. Draw common translation and relative opening fields, identifying the measurements needed to distinguish them rather than relying on one gauge.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壩塊自由收縮」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dam block free contraction"?
options: 同時比較塊內溫度剖面與接縫兩側位移，核對降溫是否均勻及量測正向。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
所有錨索損失百分率都可不看基準直接相加
optionsEn: Compare internal temperature profiles with displacement on both sides of the joint, checking uniformity and sign conventions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All anchor-loss percentages can be added without checking their reference states.
quiz.explanation: 同時比較塊內溫度剖面與接縫兩側位移，核對降溫是否均勻及量測正向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare internal temperature profiles with displacement on both sides of the joint, checking uniformity and sign conventions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壩塊自由收縮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dam block free contraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壩塊自由收縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dam block free contraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用單側位移當縫寬會把整體平移誤算為開裂，溫度梯度又可能造成彎曲而非純收縮；若只保存平均溫度，將失去辨認兩種機制的關鍵資訊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using one-side displacement as joint width mistakes translation for opening, while a temperature gradient can produce bending rather than pure shortening. Retaining only average temperature removes information needed to distinguish those mechanisms in the observed movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相鄰塊體各自的無應力溫度未必相同，接縫灌漿年代及材料齡期會改變後續收縮的參考狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Neighboring blocks may have different stress-free temperatures; grouting history and material age change the reference state from which subsequent contraction and restraint develop.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 用單側位移當縫寬會把整體平移誤算為開裂，溫度梯度又可能造成彎曲而非純收縮；若只保存平均溫度，將失去辨認兩種機制的關鍵資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Using one-side displacement as joint width mistakes translation for opening, while a temperature gradient can produce bending rather than pure shortening. Retaining only average temperature removes information needed to distinguish those mechanisms in the observed movement.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Dam block free contraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
用單側位移當縫寬會把整體平移誤算為開裂，溫度梯度又可能造成彎曲而非純收縮；若只保存平均溫度，將失去辨認兩種機制的關鍵資訊。
出口溫度改變就證明全庫分層消失
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using one-side displacement as joint width mistakes translation for opening, while a temperature gradient can produce bending rather than pure shortening.
A changed outlet temperature proves that stratification has disappeared throughout the reservoir.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stratified exchange potential energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分層水庫上下層交換需要克服密度差產生的浮力恢復作用。教材以兩等體積水團交換高程的位能差說明密度影響，不把此值當成實際混合所需總功。湍流耗散、界面厚度及連續剖面會改變能量路徑，取水溫度控制仍需觀察真正吸入水層。 兩水團交換時各自有位能變化，將兩者相加才留下密度差項，不能把完整水密度直接代入浮力差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層交換位能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exchanging upper and lower reservoir layers works against buoyancy associated with density contrast. The potential-energy change for equal exchanged volumes illustrates that effect but is not the total work required for actual mixing. Turbulent dissipation, interface thickness and continuous density profiles alter the energy pathway and withdrawal behavior. Both exchanged parcels change potential energy; adding their contributions leaves the density-contrast term, rather than permitting full water density to represent the buoyancy difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stratified exchange potential energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A changed outlet temperature proves that stratification has disappeared throughout the reservoir." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 分層交換位能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stratified exchange potential energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層交換位能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stratified exchange potential energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：drho=2 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=1000000 m3; dz=20 m; dE=drho*g*V*dz/1e6=392.4 MJ。模型邊界：上輕下重兩等體積水團交換位置的位能增加，忽略混合耗散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: drho=2 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=1000000 m3; dz=20 m; dE=drho*g*V*dz/1e6=392.4 MJ. Model boundary: potential-energy increase from swapping equal light-upper and dense-lower volumes, excluding mixing dissipation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以密度剖面確認上下層排列，核對水團體積及高程差定義，再將取水前後剖面比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the upper-light lower-dense arrangement using density profiles, define exchanged volume and elevation difference, and compare profiles before and after withdrawal.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: potential-energy increase from swapping equal light-upper and dense-lower volumes, excluding mixing dissipation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 分層交換位能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stratified exchange potential energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層交換位能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stratified exchange potential energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以密度剖面確認上下層排列，核對水團體積及高程差定義，再將取水前後剖面比較。若溫度改變但密度界面仍存在，不能宣稱整庫已混合；需分辨局部置換、捲吸與全深混合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the upper-light lower-dense arrangement using density profiles, define exchanged volume and elevation difference, and compare profiles before and after withdrawal. Changed outlet temperature with an intact interface does not demonstrate complete reservoir mixing; distinguish local replacement, entrainment and full-depth mixing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將密度差減半重算交換位能，保持總熱量相同卻改變垂向分布，說明何種剖面量測可辨認不同浮力結構及取水反應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve density contrast and recalculate exchange energy. Keep total heat unchanged while altering its vertical distribution, and identify profile measurements that distinguish buoyancy structures and withdrawal responses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅用出口溫度判斷分層消失，可能漏掉深層冷水仍被隔離的情況；含砂入流也可改變密度而非單純改變溫度，使熱量與浮力的推論分歧。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet temperature alone can conceal an isolated cold deep layer and falsely suggest lost stratification. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Changed outlet temperature with an intact interface does not demonstrate complete reservoir mixing; distinguish local replacement, entrainment and full-depth mixing.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stratified exchange potential energy"?

Verify the upper-light lower-dense arrangement using density profiles, define exchanged volume and elevation difference, and compare profiles before and after withdrawal.

steps.title: 分層交換位能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stratified exchange potential energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層交換位能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stratified exchange potential energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅用出口溫度判斷分層消失，可能漏掉深層冷水仍被隔離的情況；含砂入流也可改變密度而非單純改變溫度，使熱量與浮力的推論分歧。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet temperature alone can conceal an isolated cold deep layer and falsely suggest lost stratification. Sediment-laden inflow can also change density without an equivalent temperature change, separating thermal interpretation from the actual buoyancy structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩水團交換時各自有位能變化，將兩者相加才留下密度差項，不能把完整水密度直接代入浮力差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both exchanged parcels change potential energy; adding their contributions leaves the density-contrast term, rather than permitting full water density to represent the buoyancy difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口溫度改變就證明全庫分層消失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A changed outlet temperature proves that stratification has disappeared throughout the reservoir." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Outlet temperature alone can conceal an isolated cold deep layer and falsely suggest lost stratification. Sediment-laden inflow can also change density without an equivalent temperature change, separating thermal interpretation from the actual buoyancy structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「調蓄水的能量尺度」與「相關監測聯合殘差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stored water energy scale" and "Correlated monitoring residuals": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調蓄水的能量尺度」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stored water energy scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲水的可發電能量取決於放水時的淨水頭及效率，並非單由庫容決定。以固定水頭近似可先估算一小段水量的能量尺度，但大量放水會改變上下游水位，需沿儲量積分。水體還可能有灌溉與環境用途，所以潛在電能不等於可全部出售的電量。 能量換算需從焦耳轉為瓦時再轉為吉瓦時，忽略每小時秒數會造成巨大單位錯誤，應逐級檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調蓄水的能量尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stored-water generation depends on net head and efficiency during release, not storage volume alone. Constant head estimates the energy scale of a limited volume, while major drawdown requires integrating changing head with storage. Other water uses further distinguish potential electrical energy from energy actually available for sale. Energy conversion must connect joules to watt-hours and then gigawatt-hours; omitting seconds per hour causes a major unit error that dimensional steps should expose. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stored water energy scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同庫容在任何水頭下都代表相同電能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal storage volume represents equal electrical energy at every head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「調蓄水的能量尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stored water energy scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度
knowledge.text: 儲水的可發電能量取決於放水時的淨水頭及效率，並非單由庫容決定。以固定水頭近似可先估算一小段水量的能量尺度，但大量放水會改變上下游水位，需沿儲量積分。
knowledge.textEn: Stored-water generation depends on net head and efficiency during release, not storage volume alone. Constant head estimates the energy scale of a limited volume, while major drawdown requires integrating changing head with storage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同庫容在任何水頭下都代表相同電能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal storage volume represents equal electrical energy at every head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「調蓄水的能量尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stored water energy scale" is correct?
options: 儲水的可發電能量取決於放水時的淨水頭及效率，並非單由庫容決定。
相同庫容在任何水頭下都代表相同電能
兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據
optionsEn: Stored-water generation depends on net head and efficiency during release, not storage volume alone.
Equal storage volume represents equal electrical energy at every head.
Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly.
quiz.explanation: 儲水的可發電能量取決於放水時的淨水頭及效率，並非單由庫容決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stored-water generation depends on net head and efficiency during release, not storage volume alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調蓄水的能量尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stored water energy scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh。模型邊界：固定淨水頭效率且假設全量經機組，不含其他用途與時序限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh. Model boundary: fixed net head and efficiency with all water passing through turbines, excluding other uses and timing constraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調蓄水的能量尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stored water energy scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。若庫水位下降明顯，應縮小分段以檢查收斂，不把最初最高水頭用於全部水量來高估能量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals. When level changes substantially, refine the segments and check convergence rather than applying the initial maximum head to every unit of water. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水量分成兩段並給不同淨水頭，重算總電能，與固定平均及初始水頭兩種近似比較，再列出水庫用途約束對可用量的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Split release into two volumes with different net heads and calculate total energy. Compare fixed-average and initial-head approximations, then explain how water-use constraints alter the volume available for generation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尾水隨出流上升會進一步降低淨水頭，僅考慮庫水位下降仍可能高估能量；若用總庫容替代可調節庫容，也會把不能利用的水列入電量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調蓄水的能量尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stored water energy scale"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
所有測點最大壓力可直接同時相加
以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Maximum pressures from all sensors can always be added as simultaneous loads.
Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals.
quiz.explanation: 以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調蓄水的能量尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stored water energy scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尾水隨出流上升會進一步降低淨水頭，僅考慮庫水位下降仍可能高估能量；若用總庫容替代可調節庫容，也會把不能利用的水列入電量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy. Using total rather than usable storage can also include water that cannot be allocated to the assumed generating sequence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量換算需從焦耳轉為瓦時再轉為吉瓦時，忽略每小時秒數會造成巨大單位錯誤，應逐級檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Energy conversion must connect joules to watt-hours and then gigawatt-hours; omitting seconds per hour causes a major unit error that dimensional steps should expose.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同庫容在任何水頭下都代表相同電能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal storage volume represents equal electrical energy at every head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調蓄水的能量尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stored water energy scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 尾水隨出流上升會進一步降低淨水頭，僅考慮庫水位下降仍可能高估能量；若用總庫容替代可調節庫容，也會把不能利用的水列入電量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly.

quiz.explanationEn: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相關監測聯合殘差」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Correlated monitoring residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體相鄰量測常因同一水位或溫度作用而相關，不能把每個偏離都當成獨立證據。教材以兩個標準化殘差與相關係數建立聯合距離，說明共同變動與相反變動具有不同意義。統計距離仍須依有效基線與物理機制解讀，不能直接當成安全分數。 相關係數接近一時矩陣可能病態，小量測差異會被大幅放大，應檢查基線品質與數值穩定性再解讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相關監測聯合殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nearby dam observations often correlate through shared level or temperature effects and cannot each be counted as independent evidence. A two-residual distance with correlation distinguishes common movement from opposing movement. Its interpretation still depends on a valid baseline and physical mechanism; the statistical distance is not a direct safety score. A correlation near one makes the covariance matrix ill-conditioned and can amplify small differences; assess baseline quality and numerical stability before interpreting the joint distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Correlated monitoring residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相關監測聯合殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：z1=2 (dimensionless); z2=2 (dimensionless); r=0.8 (dimensionless); D2=(z1*z1-2*r*z1*z2+z2*z2)/(1-r*r)=4.444444444。模型邊界：兩個無因次標準化殘差及固定相關係數；只示範平方距離，未給警報門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Model boundary: two dimensionless standardized residuals with fixed correlation; squared-distance illustration without an alarm threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相關監測聯合殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Correlated monitoring residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。若相關結構本身改變，應重查共同水力或溫度原因，而不是沿用舊矩陣把新反應自動判成正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles. A changing correlation structure requires examining shared hydraulic or thermal causes rather than automatically classifying new behavior with an outdated covariance model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持兩個殘差大小但反轉其中一個符號，重算聯合距離並比較，提出一項可區分共同基準漂移與相反結構變形的獨立觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep residual magnitudes fixed but reverse one sign, recompute the joint distance and compare. Propose an independent observation that distinguishes common reference drift from opposing structural movements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相關監測聯合殘差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Correlated monitoring residuals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. A drifting shared reference can also create high correlation between instruments without providing evidence of consistent structural behavior across the monitored locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相關係數接近一時矩陣可能病態，小量測差異會被大幅放大，應檢查基線品質與數值穩定性再解讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A correlation near one makes the covariance matrix ill-conditioned and can amplify small differences; assess baseline quality and numerical stability before interpreting the joint distance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 白鶴灘水壩
summary: 白鶴灘案例連結柱狀節理岩體、低熱混凝土與大型水輪發電機，從局部剛度及熱量一路推到轉矩、視在功率、冷卻和調速介面。課程刻意分開實際裝機規模與假想材料參數，並要求學員對每個簡化模型提出可驗證觀察及升級分析條件。
summaryEn: The Baihetan case connects jointed rock, low-heat concrete and large turbine-generators, moving from local stiffness and thermal energy to torque, apparent power, cooling and governor interfaces. Actual installed scale is separated from assumed material parameters. Each simplified model requires an observable verification method and a stated condition for more advanced analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」及「巨型機組軸轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m；第二組為 binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Columnar joint series compliance, then compare the controlling variables in Low heat cement adiabatic rise and Gigawatt unit shaft torque. The first calculation is kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m; the second is binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱狀節理串聯柔度」與「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Columnar joint series compliance" and "Low heat cement adiabatic rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Columnar joint series compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。這種尺度分析幫助理解很薄的弱介面為何可能主導整體變形，但不代表真實三維節理網絡。 串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱狀節理串聯柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness. A thin weak interface can dominate deformation, though the model does not represent a three-dimensional joint network. Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Columnar joint series compliance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Columnar joint series compliance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度
knowledge.text: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。
knowledge.textEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱狀節理串聯柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Columnar joint series compliance" is correct?
options: 串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
optionsEn: Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip.
Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.
quiz.explanation: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Columnar joint series compliance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。模型邊界：單一串聯線彈性載重路徑，兩元件同力且不滑移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m. Model boundary: one linear elastic series path with equal force in both elements and no sliding. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Columnar joint series compliance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。若主要變形集中在界面，應優先辨認節理閉合；若卸載後殘留位移大，串聯彈簧需改為非線性接觸模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Interface-dominated movement points toward joint closure, while substantial residual movement after unloading requires nonlinear contact behavior rather than two purely elastic series springs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將節理剛度提高一倍重算等效剛度，再比較只提高岩塊剛度的效果，指出試驗與處理資源應優先釐清哪一個變形來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double joint stiffness and recompute the equivalent value, then compare doubling only block stiffness. Identify which deformation source should receive priority in testing and in evaluating a proposed treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Columnar joint series compliance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
knowledge.textEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱狀節理串聯柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Columnar joint series compliance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness.
Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.
quiz.explanation: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低熱水泥減少或延緩水化放熱，但大體積混凝土仍可能累積顯著溫升。教材以膠結料用量乘單位放熱量，再除混凝土體積熱容量估算絕熱上升尺度。放熱隨齡期改變，骨材與摻料也影響熱容量，因此材料名稱本身不能替代實測溫升曲線。 單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-heat cement reduces or delays hydration heat, but mass concrete can still accumulate a substantial temperature rise. Binder content times specific heat release divided by concrete volumetric heat capacity estimates an adiabatic scale. Age-dependent hydration, aggregates and supplementary materials alter the response, so a material name cannot replace a measured temperature-rise curve. Specific binder heat release requires an age; mixing early and final heat values erases the delayed-release behavior that matters when comparing low-heat materials. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low heat cement adiabatic rise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常

Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對實際配比做絕熱或半絕熱試驗，核對試件齡期、初溫與摻料比例，再與現場核心溫度及冷卻帳比較。若現場峰值較低，應查散熱與放熱時間，而非直接宣稱水泥單位放熱量不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the actual mix adiabatically or semi-adiabatically, matching age, starting temperature and supplementary materials, then compare core temperatures and cooling accounts. A lower field peak calls for examining heat exchange and timing before concluding that the cement specific heat release has changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變膠結料用量與比熱各一成，分別重算溫升，建立敏感度表，再列出要從絕熱尺度轉成現地溫度歷程所需的邊界條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change binder content and heat capacity by ten percent separately, recalculate rise and build a sensitivity table. List boundary conditions needed to convert the adiabatic scale into a field temperature history.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. Rapid surface cooling can increase gradients, so a reduced total heat release alone cannot guarantee the absence of thermal cracking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Specific binder heat release requires an age; mixing early and final heat values erases the delayed-release behavior that matters when comparing low-heat materials.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. Rapid surface cooling can increase gradients, so a reduced total heat release alone cannot guarantee the absence of thermal cracking.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「巨型機組軸轉矩」與「發電端電流尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gigawatt unit shaft torque" and "Generator terminal current scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「巨型機組軸轉矩」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 百萬千瓦級機組的低速軸系需傳遞很大的轉矩，機械功率與電端功率要先分清楚。教材把指定軸功率除以角速度，得到平均扭矩，再討論法蘭、軸承與轉輪連接的載重路徑。平均扭矩不能表示扭振峰值，也不能由單機容量推論材料應力。 若功率以兆瓦輸入而角速度以每秒計，所得扭矩自然是兆牛頓米，但弧度的無因次慣例仍需說明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「巨型機組軸轉矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-speed gigawatt-class shaft transmits large torque, and mechanical power must be distinguished from terminal electrical power. Divide specified shaft power by angular speed for mean torque, then trace loads through flanges, bearings and runner connections. Mean torque does not describe torsional peaks or determine material stress from unit capacity alone. With megawatts and angular speed per second, torque is naturally in meganewton-metres; the dimensionless-radian convention should still be understood when checking the units. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「巨型機組軸轉矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gigawatt unit shaft torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A low-speed gigawatt-class shaft transmits large torque, and mechanical power must be distinguished from terminal electrical power. Divide specified shaft power by angular speed for mean torque, then trace loads through flanges, bearings and runner connections.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「巨型機組軸轉矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m。模型邊界：假想恆速軸端功率，未含載重拒絕與扭振。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m. Model boundary: hypothetical constant-speed shaft power, excluding load rejection and torsional oscillation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照軸速、電端功率及損失估計，先確認功率邊界一致，再把扭振頻譜與平均轉矩分開報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align shaft speed, terminal power and loss estimates to a common boundary, reporting torsional spectra separately from mean torque.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generator terminal current scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。教材在平衡正弦條件下計算線電流，並辨認線電壓與相電壓的差異。導體溫升、短路力及局部放電需另行驗證。 每相電流與線電流是否相等取決於接線方式，本例使用平衡系統的線量關係，不可未確認就套入繞組損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電端電流尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-generator current depends on three-phase active power, line voltage and power factor. Raising voltage lowers current at fixed power but introduces insulation and fault considerations. Calculate line current for balanced sinusoidal operation while distinguishing line from phase voltage; conductor heating, short-circuit forces and partial discharge remain separate assessments. Whether phase and line current match depends on connection; this example uses balanced-system line quantities and cannot enter winding-loss calculations without checking that distinction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generator terminal current scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電端電流尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 固定電壓和實功，對三種功率因數計算電流及電流平方比例，再說明為何銅損比較仍需導體溫度下的電阻資料。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed voltage and active power, calculate current and current-squared ratios for three power factors. Explain why comparing copper loss still requires resistance measured at the relevant conductor temperature.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發電端電流尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Generator terminal current scale"?
options: 校驗三相電壓電流相量與功率因數定義，核對電流互感器比值及相序，再比較總實功與三相分量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
optionsEn: Verify three-phase phasors, power-factor convention, current-transformer ratio and phase sequence, then compare total power with individual phases.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
quiz.explanation: 校驗三相電壓電流相量與功率因數定義，核對電流互感器比值及相序，再比較總實功與三相分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify three-phase phasors, power-factor convention, current-transformer ratio and phase sequence, then compare total power with individual phases. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 發電端電流尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Generator terminal current scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「發電端電流尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Generator terminal current scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. Ignoring these effects understates conductor loading and cooling demand even at an unchanged generating output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每相電流與線電流是否相等取決於接線方式，本例使用平衡系統的線量關係，不可未確認就套入繞組損失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Whether phase and line current match depends on connection; this example uses balanced-system line quantities and cannot enter winding-loss calculations without checking that distinction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. Ignoring these effects understates conductor loading and cooling demand even at an unchanged generating output.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發電端電流尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Generator terminal current scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。
相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power.
Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
