quiz.explanationEn: Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱體積流」與「調速下垂靜態尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling volume flow" and "Governor droop static scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風散熱體積流」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling volume flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。海拔、溫度和壓力會改變密度，因此相同風量不一定帶走相同熱量。教材求理想需求流量後，還要檢查風路分配、壓降與局部熱點，不能只看風機銘牌。 空氣密度應對應量測斷面的壓力與溫度，標準風量和實際風量需要換算後才能放進同一熱量帳。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱體積流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. Altitude, temperature and pressure change density, so equal volume flow may remove different heat. After estimating ideal demand, examine distribution, pressure drop and hotspots rather than relying on a fan nameplate alone. Air density must match pressure and temperature at the measurement section; standard and actual volume flows require conversion before they belong in one thermal account. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling volume flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風散熱體積流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation cooling volume flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風散熱體積流
knowledge.text: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。海拔、溫度和壓力會改變密度，因此相同風量不一定帶走相同熱量。
knowledge.textEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. Altitude, temperature and pressure change density, so equal volume flow may remove different heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風散熱體積流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation cooling volume flow" is correct?
options: 相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力
下垂公式算出的增功率會瞬間全部到位
以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。
optionsEn: Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously.
Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise.
quiz.explanation: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風散熱體積流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling volume flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且全部熱由此氣流帶走，不含旁通與漏風。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s. Model boundary: steady complete mixing with all heat carried by this airflow, excluding bypass and leakage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且全部熱由此氣流帶走，不含旁通與漏風。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s. Model boundary: steady complete mixing with all heat carried by this airflow, excluding bypass and leakage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風散熱體積流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation cooling volume flow", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。
入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率
加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example.
The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風散熱體積流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation cooling volume flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。若總熱量帳吻合但局部繞組過熱，應查分流及死區；若風機功率增加而有效風量不增，則查阻力及漏風。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity. A closing total heat account with hot windings indicates flow maldistribution. Greater fan power without more effective flow calls for checking resistance and leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將空氣密度降低一成重算需求風量，再加入兩條不均等風路，說明哪些測點能確認熱源真正得到冷卻，而非只看到總風量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower air density by ten percent and recalculate required volume flow. Add two unequal airflow paths and identify measurements that verify cooling at the heat source rather than only total delivered airflow.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風道旁通可讓量測總風量正常卻繞過熱源，局部堵塞也可能在平均溫升不高時形成熱點；若沿用標準密度，則會把高溫空氣的熱容量估高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bypass can preserve measured total airflow while avoiding the heat source, and local blockage can create hotspots despite modest mean temperature rise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。若總熱量帳吻合但局部繞組過熱，應查分流及死區；若風機功率增加而有效風量不增，則查阻力及漏風。
knowledge.textEn: Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity. A closing total heat account with hot windings indicates flow maldistribution. Greater fan power without more effective flow calls for checking resistance and leakage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將空氣密度降低一成重算需求風量，再加入兩條不均等風路，說明哪些測點能確認熱源真正得到冷卻，而非只看到總風量。
knowledge.textEn: Lower air density by ten percent and recalculate required volume flow. Add two unequal airflow paths and identify measurements that verify cooling at the heat source rather than only total delivered airflow.

steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風散熱體積流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation cooling volume flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風道旁通可讓量測總風量正常卻繞過熱源，局部堵塞也可能在平均溫升不高時形成熱點；若沿用標準密度，則會把高溫空氣的熱容量估高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 調速下垂使頻率降低時機組增加功率，但其靜態斜率不等於瞬時能提供的響應。導葉速度、水錘、轉動慣量及保護限制決定暫態過程。教材以無因次下垂和頻率偏差估算理想增功率，要求另查機組餘裕，避免在已滿載時仍假設無限調節能力。 下垂係數的百分比是頻率相對變化與額定功率相對變化之比，若把赫茲直接除百分數會失去量綱一致性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調速下垂靜態尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW。模型邊界：無死區及飽和的靜態下垂關係，未含水力暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW. Model boundary: static droop without deadband or saturation, excluding hydraulic transients. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高頻訊號混疊」與「摻氣體積分率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High frequency signal aliasing" and "Aeration volume fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高頻訊號混疊」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High frequency signal aliasing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。取樣理論需與類比防混疊濾波共同考慮，單純增加資料點顯示密度不會恢復已遺失資訊。教材計算一個折返頻率，再要求用原始取樣與濾波規格驗證。 取樣前的類比濾波與取樣後數位濾波作用不同，前者防止折返進入資料，後者只能處理已記錄頻帶。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高頻訊號混疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures. Sampling must be considered with analog anti-alias filtering; plotting more interpolated points cannot restore lost information. Calculate one alias frequency and verify it against the original acquisition and filtering specifications before diagnosing machinery. Analog filtering before sampling and digital filtering afterward serve different roles: the former prevents folding, while the latter only processes frequencies already represented in the record. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High frequency signal aliasing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高頻訊號混疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High frequency signal aliasing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高頻訊號混疊
knowledge.text: 大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。取樣理論需與類比防混疊濾波共同考慮，單純增加資料點顯示密度不會恢復已遺失資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures. Sampling must be considered with analog anti-alias filtering; plotting more interpolated points cannot restore lost information.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高頻訊號混疊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High frequency signal aliasing" is correct?
options: 取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊
大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。
入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率
optionsEn: Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing.
Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures.
The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
quiz.explanation: 大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高頻訊號混疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High frequency signal aliasing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。模型邊界：此頻率位於第一個折返區間且無有效防混疊濾波，非一般多區間公式。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz. Model boundary: this signal lies in the first folding interval without effective anti-alias filtering; not a general multi-band formula. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。模型邊界：此頻率位於第一個折返區間且無有效防混疊濾波，非一般多區間公式。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高頻訊號混疊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High frequency signal aliasing", which statement holds?
options: 加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度

optionsEn: Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias.
Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高頻訊號混疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High frequency signal aliasing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。若低頻峰隨取樣率改變而移動，支持混疊而非機械模態；若峰保持物理頻率，仍需結合轉速與相位判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate. A low-frequency peak moving with sample rate supports aliasing rather than a mechanical mode; a stable physical frequency still needs speed and phase evidence for interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩個取樣率計算同一真實頻率的顯示位置，畫出頻譜折返，再提出類比濾波與取樣設定，說明為何僅改圖表解析度無效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate the apparent frequency of one real signal at two sampling rates and sketch folding. Propose analog filtering and acquisition settings and explain why changing chart resolution alone cannot correct the data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。若低頻峰隨取樣率改變而移動，支持混疊而非機械模態；若峰保持物理頻率，仍需結合轉速與相位判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate. A low-frequency peak moving with sample rate supports aliasing rather than a mechanical mode; a stable physical frequency still needs speed and phase evidence for interpretation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對兩個取樣率計算同一真實頻率的顯示位置，畫出頻譜折返，再提出類比濾波與取樣設定，說明為何僅改圖表解析度無效。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate the apparent frequency of one real signal at two sampling rates and sketch folding. Propose analog filtering and acquisition settings and explain why changing chart resolution alone cannot correct the data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高頻訊號混疊」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High frequency signal aliasing"?
options: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流
optionsEn: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed.
quiz.explanation: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高頻訊號混疊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High frequency signal aliasing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. Acting on such a spectrum can lead to attempts to fix a low-frequency excitation that does not physically exist. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：取樣前的類比濾波與取樣後數位濾波作用不同，前者防止折返進入資料，後者只能處理已記錄頻帶。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Analog filtering before sampling and digital filtering afterward serve different roles: the former prevents folding, while the latter only processes frequencies already represented in the record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。
knowledge.textEn: A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. Acting on such a spectrum can lead to attempts to fix a low-frequency excitation that does not physically exist.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高頻訊號混疊」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High frequency signal aliasing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。
入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information.
The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
quiz.explanation: 軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 摻氣體積分率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aeration volume fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「摻氣體積分率」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aeration volume fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洩洪摻氣使水氣混合流的密度與可壓縮性改變，空氣體積流量必須附壓力和溫度條件。以同一位置的氣水體積流量求表觀體積分率，可作供氣尺度帳，但氣液滑移會讓局部空隙率不同。不能把入口空氣比例直接當成底板表面的保護效果。 氣液滑移意味兩相停留時間不同，流量比例與瞬時體積占比因此可能不同，應先定義所需含氣指標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「摻氣體積分率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aeration changes mixture density and compressibility, and air volume flow needs a pressure-temperature reference. Gas and liquid volume rates at one location give a superficial fraction for supply accounting, while phase slip can produce a different local void fraction. Inlet air proportion does not directly establish protective conditions at the floor. Phase slip gives gas and liquid different residence times, so flow-rate fraction can differ from instantaneous occupied-volume fraction; define the required aeration measure first. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aeration volume fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「摻氣體積分率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aeration volume fraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 摻氣體積分率
knowledge.text: 洩洪摻氣使水氣混合流的密度與可壓縮性改變，空氣體積流量必須附壓力和溫度條件。以同一位置的氣水體積流量求表觀體積分率，可作供氣尺度帳，但氣液滑移會讓局部空隙率不同。
knowledge.textEn: Aeration changes mixture density and compressibility, and air volume flow needs a pressure-temperature reference. Gas and liquid volume rates at one location give a superficial fraction for supply accounting, while phase slip can produce a different local void fraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「摻氣體積分率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aeration volume fraction" is correct?
options: 入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率
福祿相似會自動保證所有水力現象相似
洩洪摻氣使水氣混合流的密度與可壓縮性改變，空氣體積流量必須附壓力和溫度條件。
optionsEn: The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
Froude similarity automatically preserves every hydraulic phenomenon.
Aeration changes mixture density and compressibility, and air volume flow needs a pressure-temperature reference.
quiz.explanation: 洩洪摻氣使水氣混合流的密度與可壓縮性改變，空氣體積流量必須附壓力和溫度條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aeration changes mixture density and compressibility, and air volume flow needs a pressure-temperature reference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 摻氣體積分率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aeration volume fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「摻氣體積分率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aeration volume fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15。模型邊界：氣水流量在同一壓力溫度截面，表觀流量分率而非局部空隙率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qa=90 m3/s; Qw=510 m3/s; beta=Qa/(Qa+Qw)=0.15. Model boundary: gas and water rates at the same pressure-temperature section; superficial flow fraction rather than local void fraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對空氣流量計的標準狀態換算，再量測不同深度的含氣分布與底板壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check standard-state conversion of the air meter and measure depth-dependent air content with floor pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 摻氣體積分率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aeration volume fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「摻氣體積分率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aeration volume fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對空氣流量計的標準狀態換算，再量測不同深度的含氣分布與底板壓力。若總供氣量正常但近壁空氣不足，應研究滑移及再分布；不能只用供氣管的單一數字宣稱表面保護充分。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check standard-state conversion of the air meter and measure depth-dependent air content with floor pressure. Normal total supply with inadequate near-wall air calls for examining slip and redistribution rather than declaring protection sufficient from one reading in the air-supply pipe. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將空氣流量換成另一壓力狀態後重算分率，再設計兩個相同平均含氣量但近壁分布不同的剖面，指出需要哪種量測區分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert air flow to another pressure condition and recalculate the fraction. Construct profiles with equal mean air content but different near-wall distributions and identify the measurements needed to distinguish them.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：氣管壓力升高會壓縮空氣而改變體積流率，若不換算就會錯估分率；水氣相對速度不同又可能使高平均含氣量與低近壁含氣量同時存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing air-line pressure compresses gas and changes volume rate, distorting the fraction if no conversion is made. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「摻氣體積分率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aeration volume fraction"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對空氣流量計的標準狀態換算，再量測不同深度的含氣分布與底板壓力。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check standard-state conversion of the air meter and measure depth-dependent air content with floor pressure.
Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.

steps.title: 摻氣體積分率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aeration volume fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「摻氣體積分率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aeration volume fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 氣管壓力升高會壓縮空氣而改變體積流率，若不換算就會錯估分率；水氣相對速度不同又可能使高平均含氣量與低近壁含氣量同時存在。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing air-line pressure compresses gas and changes volume rate, distorting the fraction if no conversion is made. Different phase velocities can also allow high average air content to coexist with inadequate air close to the solid boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣液滑移意味兩相停留時間不同，流量比例與瞬時體積占比因此可能不同，應先定義所需含氣指標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Phase slip gives gas and liquid different residence times, so flow-rate fraction can differ from instantaneous occupied-volume fraction; define the required aeration measure first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 氣管壓力升高會壓縮空氣而改變體積流率，若不換算就會錯估分率；水氣相對速度不同又可能使高平均含氣量與低近壁含氣量同時存在。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing air-line pressure compresses gas and changes volume rate, distorting the fraction if no conversion is made. Different phase velocities can also allow high average air content to coexist with inadequate air close to the solid boundary.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

氣管壓力升高會壓縮空氣而改變體積流率，若不換算就會錯估分率；水氣相對速度不同又可能使高平均含氣量與低近壁含氣量同時存在。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Froude similarity automatically preserves every hydraulic phenomenon.
Increasing air-line pressure compresses gas and changes volume rate, distorting the fraction if no conversion is made.

steps.title: 水工模型尺度律：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic model scaling law: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水工模型尺度律」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic model scaling law” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力主導的自由水面模型常以福祿相似配對流速與長度，流量尺度因此是長度比的二分之五次方，而非線性放大。模型能呈現某些水面與慣性作用，卻未必同時保持雷諾數、表面張力及汽蝕相似。每項結論應對應其被保留的物理機制。 福祿尺度下時間比為長度比平方根，影像播放速度若未換算，會錯判原型水舌波動與閘門變動的時序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水工模型尺度律」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface models often preserve Froude similarity, linking velocity and length and giving discharge a length-ratio exponent of five halves. Such a model can represent selected surface and inertial behavior without simultaneously preserving Reynolds, surface-tension or cavitation similarity. Every interpretation should identify the physical mechanism actually preserved. Under Froude scaling, time ratio is the square root of length ratio; unconverted video speed can misrepresent prototype jet fluctuations and gate-motion timing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic model scaling law” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：lambdaL=40 (dimensionless); Qm=0.12 m3/s; Qp=Qm*lambdaL**2.5=1214.3146215 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: lambdaL=40 (dimensionless); Qm=0.12 m3/s; Qp=Qm*lambdaL**2.5=1214.3146215 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「福祿相似會自動保證所有水力現象相似」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Froude similarity automatically preserves every hydraulic phenomenon." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水工模型尺度律」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Verify geometric scale and sensor positions, then cross-check velocity, depth and discharge scaling. Compare aeration and surface behavior in different model sizes. Size-dependent results require identifying scale effects rather than treating more detailed photographs as inherently more accurate prototype predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：小模型表面張力及黏性可能相對放大，含氣與小尺度破碎不再保持相似；直接把模型汽穴或侵蝕量按幾何比例放大，會超出福祿相似能支持的結論。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface tension and viscosity can be relatively stronger in a small model, preventing similarity of aeration and fine breakup. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.titleEn: Independent measurement weighted estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立量測加權估計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent measurement weighted estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩筆量測同時加入相同偏差，重算融合值並比較差值是否改變，再提出可揭露共同漂移的第三種獨立觀測與基準設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。
knowledge.textEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對兩筆量測同時加入相同偏差，重算融合值並比較差值是否改變，再提出可揭露共同漂移的第三種獨立觀測與基準設計。
knowledge.textEn: Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.

quiz.question: 要驗證「獨立量測加權估計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent measurement weighted estimate"?
options: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊
optionsEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing.
quiz.explanation: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 獨立量測加權估計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent measurement weighted estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立量測加權估計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent measurement weighted estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Unsynchronized observations can also turn a genuine reservoir-response change into an apparent disagreement between instruments observing the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：權重由標準差平方的倒數取得，而非標準差本身的倒數；兩者混用會讓低精度資料取得過大影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weights use inverse variance, not inverse standard deviation; confusing the two gives the less precise observation too much influence in the combined displacement estimate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。
knowledge.textEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Unsynchronized observations can also turn a genuine reservoir-response change into an apparent disagreement between instruments observing the structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「獨立量測加權估計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent measurement weighted estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。
串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate.
Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
quiz.explanation: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 溪洛渡水壩
summary: 溪洛渡案例從發電機視在功率與實功區分開始，接續冷卻、轉速、轉矩與振動，再回到拱壩變形、水力消能及梯級調度。學員須追蹤每筆資料的量測邊界，說明同一數值在設備銘牌、瞬時測試和年度電量中具有不同意義，避免由規模推定性能。
summaryEn: The Xiluodu case starts by distinguishing apparent and active generator power, then studies cooling, speed, torque and vibration before returning to arch deformation, dissipation and cascade scheduling. Learners track measurement boundaries and explain why a number on a rating plate, during a test and in annual energy accounting means different things.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「視在容量與無功」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「轉子旋轉儲能」及「風機轉速與耗能」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar；第二組為 J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Apparent capacity and reactive power, then compare the controlling variables in Rotor rotational stored energy and Fan speed and power. The first calculation is S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar; the second is J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「視在容量與無功」與「轉子旋轉儲能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Apparent capacity and reactive power" and "Rotor rotational stored energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Apparent capacity and reactive power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「視在容量與無功」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Apparent capacity and reactive power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。功率三角形以平方和關聯三者，不能把視在功率減實功當無功。教材只在平衡正弦穩態下求尺度，實際勵磁、定子電流及端部發熱限制需要能力曲線。 功率三角形的無功大小仍需配合符號慣例，供應與吸收可有相同幅值，卻對電壓控制造成不同作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「視在容量與無功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power. Their power triangle uses a sum of squares; reactive power is not apparent power minus active power. The calculation applies to balanced sinusoidal steady state, while excitation, stator current and end-region heating require an actual capability curve. Reactive magnitude from the triangle still needs a sign convention; supply and absorption can share magnitude while having different consequences for voltage control at the connection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Apparent capacity and reactive power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「無功等於視在功率直接減去實功」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「視在容量與無功」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Apparent capacity and reactive power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 視在容量與無功
knowledge.text: 溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。功率三角形以平方和關聯三者，不能把視在功率減實功當無功。
knowledge.textEn: The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power. Their power triangle uses a sum of squares; reactive power is not apparent power minus active power.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：無功等於視在功率直接減去實功 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「視在容量與無功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Apparent capacity and reactive power" is correct?
options: 無功等於視在功率直接減去實功
溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。
轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出
optionsEn: Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power.
The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power.
All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed.
quiz.explanation: 溪洛渡供應商資料中的兆伏安額定值提醒學員，發電機電流容量同時支援實功與無功。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The supplier MVA rating illustrates that generator current capacity supports both active and reactive power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Apparent capacity and reactive power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「視在容量與無功」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Apparent capacity and reactive power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。模型邊界：平衡正弦條件的功率三角形，未區分超前滯後無功符號。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar. Model boundary: power triangle under balanced sinusoidal conditions, without assigning leading or lagging reactive sign. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。模型邊界：平衡正弦條件的功率三角形，未區分超前滯後無功符號。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar. Model boundary: power triangle under balanced sinusoidal conditions, without assigning leading or lagging reactive sign.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「視在容量與無功」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Apparent capacity and reactive power", which statement holds?
options: 三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失
谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。
optionsEn: Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator.
Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Apparent capacity and reactive power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「視在容量與無功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Apparent capacity and reactive power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。若低實功時電流仍高，應檢查無功輸出與諧波，而不能只憑發電兆瓦較低判斷設備熱負擔較低。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram. High current at low active power calls for checking reactive output and harmonics rather than assuming that lower generated megawatts imply lower thermal loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定視在容量並增加實功，計算剩餘無功尺度，畫出兩個工作點，再說明為何真正可用無功仍可能受勵磁或冷卻限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase active power at fixed apparent capacity and calculate the remaining reactive scale. Plot both operating points and explain why actual reactive capability may still be constrained by excitation or cooling.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。若低實功時電流仍高，應檢查無功輸出與諧波，而不能只憑發電兆瓦較低判斷設備熱負擔較低。
knowledge.textEn: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram. High current at low active power calls for checking reactive output and harmonics rather than assuming that lower generated megawatts imply lower thermal loading.
