knowledge.text: 固定視在容量並增加實功，計算剩餘無功尺度，畫出兩個工作點，再說明為何真正可用無功仍可能受勵磁或冷卻限制。
knowledge.textEn: Increase active power at fixed apparent capacity and calculate the remaining reactive scale. Plot both operating points and explain why actual reactive capability may still be constrained by excitation or cooling.

quiz.question: 要驗證「視在容量與無功」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Apparent capacity and reactive power"?
options: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升
optionsEn: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
quiz.explanation: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Apparent capacity and reactive power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「視在容量與無功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Apparent capacity and reactive power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. Significant harmonics can also make the simple triangle inadequate, requiring explicit distinction between fundamental-frequency and total-power definitions before interpreting the result. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：功率三角形的無功大小仍需配合符號慣例，供應與吸收可有相同幅值，卻對電壓控制造成不同作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reactive magnitude from the triangle still needs a sign convention; supply and absorption can share magnitude while having different consequences for voltage control at the connection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「無功等於視在功率直接減去實功」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。
knowledge.textEn: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. Significant harmonics can also make the simple triangle inadequate, requiring explicit distinction between fundamental-frequency and total-power definitions before interpreting the result.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視在容量與無功」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Apparent capacity and reactive power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。
轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity.
All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed.
quiz.explanation: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉子旋轉儲能」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor rotational stored energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。轉動慣量乘角速度平方的一半給出動能，若轉速變化小，能量變化仍與初始速度有關。教材用整體等效慣量建立尺度，不推定實際機組慣量常數。 可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉子旋轉儲能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. Half the inertia times angular speed squared gives stored energy, with small energy changes still dependent on initial speed. An assumed equivalent inertia establishes scale without claiming the actual machine inertia constant or allowable speed excursion. Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotor rotational stored energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉子旋轉儲能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotor rotational stored energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉子旋轉儲能
knowledge.text: 水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。轉動慣量乘角速度平方的一半給出動能，若轉速變化小，能量變化仍與初始速度有關。
knowledge.textEn: Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. Half the inertia times angular speed squared gives stored energy, with small energy changes still dependent on initial speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉子旋轉儲能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rotor rotational stored energy" is correct?
options: 轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出
風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能
水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。
optionsEn: All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed.
A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation.
quiz.explanation: 水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子旋轉儲能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor rotational stored energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。模型邊界：剛性等效轉子且慣量固定，未計水柱動能與控制作用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Model boundary: rigid equivalent rotor with fixed inertia, excluding water-column energy and controls. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。模型邊界：剛性等效轉子且慣量固定，未計水柱動能與控制作用。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Model boundary: rigid equivalent rotor with fixed inertia, excluding water-column energy and controls.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉子旋轉儲能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rotor rotational stored energy", which statement holds?
options: 油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ.
Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉子旋轉儲能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotor rotational stored energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。若動能差不閉合，應查水力轉矩、控制延遲及損失，不任意調慣量使每次事件都符合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. If kinetic-energy change does not close, investigate hydraulic torque, control delay and losses rather than retuning inertia separately to fit every event recorded by the system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將轉速降低百分之一，計算可釋出的動能而非總動能，再除以假想功率缺口估算短時尺度，列出此估算忽略的控制作用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce speed by one percent and calculate released rather than total kinetic energy. Divide it by an assumed power deficit to estimate a short time scale and list the control actions omitted by that estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。若動能差不閉合，應查水力轉矩、控制延遲及損失，不任意調慣量使每次事件都符合。
knowledge.textEn: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. If kinetic-energy change does not close, investigate hydraulic torque, control delay and losses rather than retuning inertia separately to fit every event recorded by the system.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將轉速降低百分之一，計算可釋出的動能而非總動能，再除以假想功率缺口估算短時尺度，列出此估算忽略的控制作用。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce speed by one percent and calculate released rather than total kinetic energy. Divide it by an assumed power deficit to estimate a short time scale and list the control actions omitted by that estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉子旋轉儲能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotor rotational stored energy"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。
同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance.
Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.
quiz.explanation: 查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉子旋轉儲能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotor rotational stored energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A flexible shaft can also distribute energy into torsional modes, making mean rotational speed insufficient to describe local dynamics during an electrical or hydraulic disturbance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A flexible shaft can also distribute energy into torsional modes, making mean rotational speed insufficient to describe local dynamics during an electrical or hydraulic disturbance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉子旋轉儲能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotor rotational stored energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能
把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range.
quiz.explanation: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風機轉速與耗能」與「定子銅損邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fan speed and power" and "Stator copper loss boundary": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風機轉速與耗能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fan speed and power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風機轉速與耗能」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fan speed and power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。功率對轉速約呈三次方，因此小幅提速可能增加顯著輔機耗能。相似律需配合系統阻力曲線，風道變更、失速或密度改變都可能破壞簡化比例。 風機功率相似通常指軸端，變頻器與馬達損失要另列，才能與電端輔機耗電建立一致比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風機轉速與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. Power varies approximately with the cube of speed, so a modest increase can raise auxiliary demand substantially. System resistance must also be considered; duct changes, stall and density variation can invalidate the simplified ratio. Fan power similarity usually refers to shaft power; converter and motor losses need separate terms before comparison with electrical auxiliary demand is physically consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fan speed and power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風機轉速與耗能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fan speed and power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風機轉速與耗能

knowledge.textEn: Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. Power varies approximately with the cube of speed, so a modest increase can raise auxiliary demand substantially.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風機轉速與耗能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fan speed and power" is correct?
options: 發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。
風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能
三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失
optionsEn: Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions.
A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator.
quiz.explanation: 發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風機轉速與耗能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fan speed and power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風機轉速與耗能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fan speed and power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。模型邊界：同幾何同密度且效率近似固定的相似工作點，非任意風道工況。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW. Model boundary: similar operating points with unchanged geometry, density and approximate efficiency, not arbitrary duct conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測風機轉速、壓差、有效風量及電功率，將工作點放到風機與系統曲線交會處。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure speed, pressure difference, effective airflow and electrical power together, locating the operating point on fan and system curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。模型邊界：同幾何同密度且效率近似固定的相似工作點，非任意風道工況。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW. Model boundary: similar operating points with unchanged geometry, density and approximate efficiency, not arbitrary duct conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「風機轉速與耗能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fan speed and power", which statement holds?
options: 谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。
單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升
optionsEn: Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 風機轉速與耗能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fan speed and power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風機轉速與耗能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fan speed and power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測風機轉速、壓差、有效風量及電功率，將工作點放到風機與系統曲線交會處。若提速後壓差升高但風量變化很小，應查阻塞或工作區域，不能只靠三次方律推定冷卻改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure speed, pressure difference, effective airflow and electrical power together, locating the operating point on fan and system curves. If speed raises pressure with little added flow, investigate obstruction or operating region rather than inferring improved cooling solely from the affinity-law estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對三種轉速比例計算功率及理想風量比例，畫出耗能增幅，並指出若系統阻力增加時需要重新量測哪個工作點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate power and ideal airflow ratios for three speed ratios and plot the demand increase. Identify the operating point that must be remeasured if system resistance changes after maintenance or duct modification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在失速區增加轉速可能提高噪音與耗能卻不改善均勻通風；若馬達效率隨負載變化，軸功率相似也不會直接等於電端功率比例，需要分別量測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing speed in a stalled region can raise noise and demand without improving uniform ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時量測風機轉速、壓差、有效風量及電功率，將工作點放到風機與系統曲線交會處。若提速後壓差升高但風量變化很小，應查阻塞或工作區域，不能只靠三次方律推定冷卻改善。
knowledge.textEn: Measure speed, pressure difference, effective airflow and electrical power together, locating the operating point on fan and system curves. If speed raises pressure with little added flow, investigate obstruction or operating region rather than inferring improved cooling solely from the affinity-law estimate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對三種轉速比例計算功率及理想風量比例，畫出耗能增幅，並指出若系統阻力增加時需要重新量測哪個工作點。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate power and ideal airflow ratios for three speed ratios and plot the demand increase. Identify the operating point that must be remeasured if system resistance changes after maintenance or duct modification.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fan speed and power"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「定子銅損邊界」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stator copper loss boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定子繞組的電阻損失與電流平方成正比，且電阻會隨溫度上升。教材以每相有效電阻與相電流計算三相損失，必須先辨認接法及所給電流定義。交流附加損失、鐵損與機械損失不在此式中，不能將三相銅損誤當成發電機全部損失。 每相有效電阻需和電流頻率及溫度相符，直流電阻只提供部分基礎，不能自動涵蓋所有交流附加效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定子銅損邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stator resistive loss scales with current squared and resistance increases with temperature. Calculate three-phase loss using effective per-phase resistance and phase current, first identifying winding connection and current definition. Additional AC, iron and mechanical losses remain outside this equation, so copper loss is not the entire generator loss account. Effective per-phase resistance must match temperature and frequency; a DC resistance measurement supplies only part of the basis and does not automatically include all AC effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stator copper loss boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「定子銅損邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stator copper loss boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定子銅損邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stator copper loss boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW。模型邊界：三相相同相電流與每相運轉溫度電阻，未含其他損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW. Model boundary: equal phase currents and per-phase resistance at operating temperature, excluding other losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測繞組電阻時記錄溫度並轉換到比較條件，核對相電流及接線方式，再將銅損估算與冷卻熱量比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record winding temperature during resistance measurement and convert to comparable conditions, checking phase current and connection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW。模型邊界：三相相同相電流與每相運轉溫度電阻，未含其他損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW. Model boundary: equal phase currents and per-phase resistance at operating temperature, excluding other losses.

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stator copper loss boundary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「定子銅損邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stator copper loss boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測繞組電阻時記錄溫度並轉換到比較條件，核對相電流及接線方式，再將銅損估算與冷卻熱量比較。若總熱量高於銅損，應補列鐵損及其他熱源，而非把差額全歸於電阻量錯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record winding temperature during resistance measurement and convert to comparable conditions, checking phase current and connection. Compare copper-loss estimates with cooling heat. Heat greater than calculated copper loss requires other loss terms rather than assigning the entire difference to an incorrect resistance measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定電阻把電流提高兩成，重算銅損，再增加熱態電阻比例，分別比較兩項效應並列出現地熱量帳還缺少的損失來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase current by twenty percent at fixed resistance and recalculate copper loss. Then increase hot resistance, compare both effects separately and list the remaining loss sources required by a field heat account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare copper-loss estimates with cooling heat. Heat greater than calculated copper loss requires other loss terms rather than assigning the entire difference to an incorrect resistance measurement.

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定子銅損邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stator copper loss boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. A high-resistance local joint can concentrate heat even when the mean per-phase value appears reasonable for the winding as a whole. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。以油量、比熱與溫升估算顯熱可幫助檢查短時能量帳，但循環中的熱交換器、軸承金屬及管路也會儲熱。單一混合槽模型只代表平均油溫，不能推定軸瓦接觸面的最高溫度。 熱容量只改變升溫時間尺度，長時間穩態仍需足夠散熱能力，增加油量不能永久抵消持續熱負荷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承油熱容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. Oil mass, heat capacity and rise estimate sensible storage, while exchangers, bearing metal and piping also store heat. A mixed-tank model describes mean oil temperature rather than the maximum temperature at the bearing contact. Heat capacity changes the heating time scale, while long-term steady operation still needs adequate heat removal; adding oil cannot indefinitely offset a continuous thermal load. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing oil thermal storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸承油熱容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bearing oil thermal storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。模型邊界：固定油量比熱的均勻溫升，不含金屬熱容量及散熱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ. Model boundary: uniform rise of a fixed oil mass with constant heat capacity, excluding metal storage and heat loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸承油熱容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing oil thermal storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。若槽溫反應慢而軸瓦溫度迅速上升，應查局部供油與接觸熱點，不能用油槽平均溫度證明潤滑正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state. Rapid bearing-metal heating despite a slowly changing tank temperature calls for local supply and contact checks rather than declaring lubrication normal from the tank average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在相同熱輸入下比較兩種油量的初期升溫速率，再加入金屬熱容量，說明需哪些溫度測點才能區分儲熱與散熱不足。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare initial heating rates for two oil inventories under equal heat input, then add metal heat capacity. Identify temperature measurements that distinguish thermal storage from inadequate heat removal in the system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Rapid bearing-metal heating despite a slowly changing tank temperature calls for local supply and contact checks rather than declaring lubrication normal from the tank average.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軸承油熱容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bearing oil thermal storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A steady-state temperature difference alone may therefore miss a brief interruption of supply to the bearing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「谷幅變形基準」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Valley closure reference geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。教材把兩點間距變化除初始距離表示平均幾何應變尺度，不把它當成岩體各處的局部應變。需保留左右岸絕對位移與方向，才能把谷幅反應連結到拱座相容條件。 兩點距離只提供沿連線方向的投影，垂直於連線的共同位移可能幾乎看不到，需要完整三維控制網。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「谷幅變形基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. Distance change divided by initial separation gives a mean geometric strain scale, not local strain everywhere in the rock. Absolute movement and direction on each side are needed to connect closure to abutment compatibility. Two-point distance supplies a projection along the line; shared movement perpendicular to it can remain almost invisible, requiring a complete three-dimensional control network. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Valley closure reference geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「谷幅變形基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「谷幅變形基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Valley closure reference geometry" is correct?
options: 蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。
谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference.
Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「谷幅變形基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Valley closure reference geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。模型邊界：正值表示兩點距離縮短的平均尺度，不代表均勻岩體應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain. Model boundary: positive value denotes a mean two-point closure scale, not uniform rock strain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「谷幅變形基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Valley closure reference geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。若谷幅縮短但單側位移占多數，模型應保留不對稱，不把一半變形平均分配給兩岸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes. Closure dominated by one bank requires an asymmetric model rather than allocating half the measured distance change to each side by assumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作相同谷幅變化但左右岸位移分配不同的兩個情境，畫位移向量，說明對拱座相容的影響，以及需哪些外部控制點才能辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create two cases with equal closure but different bank displacement shares. Draw their vectors, explain effects on abutment compatibility and identify external controls needed to distinguish the cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes. Closure dominated by one bank requires an asymmetric model rather than allocating half the measured distance change to each side by assumption.

knowledge.text: 製作相同谷幅變化但左右岸位移分配不同的兩個情境，畫位移向量，說明對拱座相容的影響，以及需哪些外部控制點才能辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Create two cases with equal closure but different bank displacement shares. Draw their vectors, explain effects on abutment compatibility and identify external controls needed to distinguish the cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「谷幅變形基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Valley closure reference geometry"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能
以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes.
quiz.explanation: 以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「谷幅變形基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Valley closure reference geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. Seasonal atmospheric refraction can also imitate terrain deformation correlated with reservoir level unless corrected through an independent control and observation strategy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩點距離只提供沿連線方向的投影，垂直於連線的共同位移可能幾乎看不到，需要完整三維控制網。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two-point distance supplies a projection along the line; shared movement perpendicular to it can remain almost invisible, requiring a complete three-dimensional control network.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。
knowledge.textEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. Seasonal atmospheric refraction can also imitate terrain deformation correlated with reservoir level unless corrected through an independent control and observation strategy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「谷幅變形基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Valley closure reference geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂隙開度與滲流」與「通風局部阻力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fracture aperture and flow" and "Ventilation local resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙開度與滲流」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fracture aperture and flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。教材使用光滑固定開度及牛頓流體，將壓差、黏度與流路長度列明；天然裂隙粗糙、接觸及網絡分岔會改變此關係，不能用流量唯一反推幾何。 流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙開度與滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length. Roughness, contacts and network branching alter natural fractures, so measured flow does not uniquely determine the physical aperture of a real seepage path. Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fracture aperture and flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂隙開度與滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fracture aperture and flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length.

quiz.question: 關於「裂隙開度與滲流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fracture aperture and flow" is correct?
options: 滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙開度與滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fracture aperture and flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。模型邊界：光滑平行板穩態層流且開度固定，不含裂隙網絡與紊流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s. Model boundary: steady laminar flow between smooth parallel plates at fixed aperture, excluding networks and turbulence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂隙開度與滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture aperture and flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。若流量與壓差非線性，應先辨識變形或流況，不直接以三次方律推算裂縫已增加多少。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability. Nonlinearity requires investigating deformation or flow regime before using the cubic law to claim a particular increase in physical crack opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將開度提高兩成重算流量，再只降低黏度作比較，展示兩種增流原因，並設計能區分幾何變化與流體性質變化的量測組合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase aperture by twenty percent and recompute flow, then compare a change in viscosity alone. Show the two causes of increased discharge and design measurements that distinguish geometry from fluid-property changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Nonlinearity requires investigating deformation or flow regime before using the cubic law to claim a particular increase in physical crack opening.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙開度與滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fracture aperture and flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Warming can also lower viscosity and increase flow, so every rise in seepage cannot be assigned to fracture enlargement without temperature and pressure evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.

quiz.explanationEn: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風局部阻力」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation local resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下廠房及廊道通風包含彎頭、格柵和分支等局部阻力，壓損與動壓及阻力係數相關。教材以一個已知係數估算局部壓損，提醒學員係數的參考速度必須明確。這只是正常通風能量帳，不代表火災煙控、逃生條件或所有分支風量均已驗證。 阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風局部阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underground powerhouse ventilation includes local losses at bends, screens and branches, related to dynamic pressure and a loss coefficient. One assumed coefficient estimates local pressure loss, with its reference velocity explicitly stated. This normal-ventilation account does not verify smoke control, escape conditions or flow distribution through every branch of the network. Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation local resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation local resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在構件前後設壓力測點，避開強烈旋流區並量測截面速度分布，再核對所用係數的參考面積。若多個支路同時調整，須重算風網，不能把一支路壓損直接當整個風機所需壓升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure before and after the fitting away from strong swirl, map section velocity and verify the coefficient reference area. Simultaneous branch changes require a network recalculation; one branch loss cannot simply be treated as the pressure rise required from the entire fan system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定風道面積提高風量兩成，重算局部壓損，再加入一個並聯支路，說明為何分支流量必須由共同壓差及各自阻力一起求解。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase flow by twenty percent at fixed duct area and recalculate local loss. Add a parallel branch and explain why branch flows must be solved from the shared pressure difference and their individual resistances.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：格柵堵塞或風門位置偏差會改變係數，舊調試值未必適用；若壓力測點位於回流區，也可能產生非代表讀值，導致錯判風機能力不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風局部阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation local resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 格柵堵塞或風門位置偏差會改變係數，舊調試值未必適用；若壓力測點位於回流區，也可能產生非代表讀值，導致錯判風機能力不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values. A tap inside a recirculation zone can also give an unrepresentative reading and falsely suggest inadequate fan capability in the ventilation network. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.
A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梯級重複用水發電」與「增流邊際功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cascade reuse of release water" and "Marginal power from added flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「梯級重複用水發電」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cascade reuse of release water” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。教材以同一流量乘各段淨水頭效率相加求總功率，先確認兩段高程落差不重疊。實際河道傳播、支流與水庫儲存會使兩站瞬時流量不同。 上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梯級重複用水發電」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. Sum each net-head and efficiency contribution at a common assumed discharge, confirming that the elevation intervals do not overlap. Routing, tributaries and storage can make actual instantaneous discharges differ between plants. Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cascade reuse of release water” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「梯級重複用水發電」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cascade reuse of release water”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 梯級重複用水發電
knowledge.text: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。教材以同一流量乘各段淨水頭效率相加求總功率，先確認兩段高程落差不重疊。
knowledge.textEn: The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. Sum each net-head and efficiency contribution at a common assumed discharge, confirming that the elevation intervals do not overlap.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「梯級重複用水發電」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cascade reuse of release water" is correct?
options: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。
同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能
平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率
optionsEn: The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice.
Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.
Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.
quiz.explanation: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梯級重複用水發電」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cascade reuse of release water” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW。模型邊界：相同穩態流量與不重疊淨水頭，忽略中間取水及儲量變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW. Model boundary: equal steady flow through nonoverlapping net heads, omitting intermediate withdrawals and storage changes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以河段高程圖標明兩段淨水頭及尾水控制，再核對上下游流量時間對齊與中間儲量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark both net heads and tailwater controls on an elevation profile and reconcile flow timing and intermediate storage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW。模型邊界：相同穩態流量與不重疊淨水頭，忽略中間取水及儲量變化。

Model boundary: equal steady flow through nonoverlapping net heads, omitting intermediate withdrawals and storage changes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梯級重複用水發電」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cascade reuse of release water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以河段高程圖標明兩段淨水頭及尾水控制，再核對上下游流量時間對齊與中間儲量。若同時流量不同，先做河段水量帳與傳播分析，不把差值直接列為漏水或發電效率損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark both net heads and tailwater controls on an elevation profile and reconcile flow timing and intermediate storage. Different simultaneous discharges require reach water accounting and routing before the difference is labeled leakage or a generating-efficiency loss between the two plants. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將總落差固定而改變兩站分配及效率，計算總功率差，再加入一段中間取水，說明何時相同流量假設失效及應如何修正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold total drop fixed while changing its allocation and the two efficiencies, then calculate total power. Introduce an intermediate withdrawal and explain when the equal-flow assumption fails and how the account must change.
