steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梯級重複用水發電」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cascade reuse of release water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將上游總落差再次列入下游水頭會重複計算位能，忽略流量延遲又會使逐時能量帳不閉合；兩者可能在月平均下被掩蓋，需保留分段基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including the upstream drop again in downstream head double-counts potential energy. Ignoring travel delay also disrupts hourly energy closure. Monthly averages can conceal both errors, so elevation references and interval boundaries must be retained for each stage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「增流邊際功率」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Marginal power from added flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加機組流量會提高水力輸入，也可能增加與流量平方相關的引水損失，因此每增加一單位流量得到的功率不是固定值。教材對含損失的功率式微分，區分平均功率除流量與邊際增益。這個局部分析仍需效率及運轉區域限制，不能作無約束最佳化命令。 損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「增流邊際功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared. Marginal power is therefore not constant. Differentiate a loss-inclusive power equation and distinguish its derivative from average power divided by discharge. Efficiency variation and operating-region limits remain necessary before any optimization interpretation. Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Marginal power from added flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「增流邊際功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Marginal power from added flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 增流邊際功率
knowledge.text: 增加機組流量會提高水力輸入，也可能增加與流量平方相關的引水損失，因此每增加一單位流量得到的功率不是固定值。教材對含損失的功率式微分，區分平均功率除流量與邊際增益。
knowledge.textEn: Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared. Marginal power is therefore not constant.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

無功等於視在功率直接減去實功
optionsEn: Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.
Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「增流邊際功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Marginal power from added flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s)。模型邊界：淨水頭Hs-kQ²且效率固定的局部導數，未含尾水非線性及機組限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s). Model boundary: local derivative for net head Hs-kQ² at constant efficiency, excluding nonlinear tailwater and machine limits. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: local derivative for net head Hs-kQ² at constant efficiency, excluding nonlinear tailwater and machine limits.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「增流邊際功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Marginal power from added flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。若大增量與局部預測不同，應縮小區間或更新模型，不把導數當成全域線性關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verify approximately constant loss coefficient over that interval. A large-increment disagreement calls for a smaller interval or revised model rather than treating a local derivative as a global linear law. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以一個很小及一個較大流量增量比較有限差分與導數，畫出誤差隨步長變化，再加入效率下降情境指出原導數缺少的項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare finite differences using a small and a larger flow increment with the derivative, plot error against step size, and introduce declining efficiency to identify the additional derivative term missing from the original model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verify approximately constant loss coefficient over that interval. A large-increment disagreement calls for a smaller interval or revised model rather than treating a local derivative as a global linear law.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以一個很小及一個較大流量增量比較有限差分與導數，畫出誤差隨步長變化，再加入效率下降情境指出原導數缺少的項目。
knowledge.textEn: Compare finite differences using a small and a larger flow increment with the derivative, plot error against step size, and introduce declining efficiency to identify the additional derivative term missing from the original model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增流邊際功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Marginal power from added flow"?
options: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「增流邊際功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Marginal power from added flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A mathematical power maximum may also lie beyond cavitation, vibration or electrical limits and does not establish an authorized operating point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A mathematical power maximum may also lie beyond cavitation, vibration or electrical limits and does not establish an authorized operating point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「增流邊際功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Marginal power from added flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。
無功等於視在功率直接減去實功
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge.
Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power.
quiz.explanation: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 阿斯旺高壩
summary: 本課以以阿斯旺長期蓄水調節串連土石壩與尼羅河水量為主線，先用跨季庫容水量帳與大湖蒸發與面積界定水力與構造條件，再將核心沉陷與接觸、淤積量與乾密度連結到監測基線與異常。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting Aswan long-term storage with embankment behavior and Nile water accounting through Seasonal reservoir water balance and Lake evaporation and surface area, then connects Core settlement and interfaces and Sediment storage and dry density to Monitoring baseline and anomaly. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查跨季庫容水量帳：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3；再獨立檢查大湖蒸發與面積：HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year。敏感度：同面積500km2下年蒸發深度由1.8增至2.1m，水量損失由0.90增至1.05km3，增加0.15km3；實際湖面積會隨水位變化，故需逐時或逐月積分。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 將核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Seasonal reservoir water balance: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. Independently examine Lake evaporation and surface area: HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year. Sensitivity: over a fixed500km2 surface, annual evaporation increasing from1.8 to2.1m changes loss from0.90 to1.05km3, an increase of0.15km3. Real surface area varies with stage and requires time integration. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨季庫容水量帳」與「大湖蒸發與面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seasonal reservoir water balance" and "Lake evaporation and surface area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨季庫容水量帳」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seasonal reservoir water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阿斯旺案例凸顯長期蓄水必須追蹤入流、放流與損失，單一洪峰並不能描述跨季可靠度。用共同時間窗更新庫存可檢查調節邏輯，但不能忽略水位面積與可用庫容限制；每個水量來源應保留獨立觀測與不確定度。 驗證時應以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化，並辨識以下失效情境：把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨季庫容水量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aswan provides context for long-term storage accounting beyond a single flood peak. Update storage from inflow, release and losses over a common window. This bookkeeping does not remove stage-area or usable-storage limits, and each component needs independent observations and uncertainty rather than one balancing adjustment. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seasonal reservoir water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跨季庫容水量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seasonal reservoir water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨季庫容水量帳
knowledge.text: 阿斯旺案例凸顯長期蓄水必須追蹤入流、放流與損失，單一洪峰並不能描述跨季可靠度。用共同時間窗更新庫存可檢查調節邏輯，但不能忽略水位面積與可用庫容限制；每個水量來源應保留獨立觀測與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Aswan provides context for long-term storage accounting beyond a single flood peak. Update storage from inflow, release and losses over a common window.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨季庫容水量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seasonal reservoir water balance" is correct?
options: 只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度
阿斯旺案例凸顯長期蓄水必須追蹤入流、放流與損失，單一洪峰並不能描述跨季可靠度。
蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺
optionsEn: Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
Aswan provides context for long-term storage accounting beyond a single flood peak.
One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre
quiz.explanation: 阿斯旺案例凸顯長期蓄水必須追蹤入流、放流與損失，單一洪峰並不能描述跨季可靠度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aswan provides context for long-term storage accounting beyond a single flood peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨季庫容水量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seasonal reservoir water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨季庫容水量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seasonal reservoir water balance", which statement holds?
options: 濕密度較高就必定代表壓實骨架更密
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。
optionsEn: Higher wet density always proves a denser compacted skeleton
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨季庫容水量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seasonal reservoir water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以庫水位容量曲線交叉核對同期流量積分的庫存變化作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把所有水量殘差當蒸發會掩蓋量測或漏列放流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Cross-check integrated flows against storage change from the stage-capacity curve. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assigning every residual to evaporation conceals measurement errors or omitted releases. steps.title: 大湖蒸發與面積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lake evaporation and surface area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「大湖蒸發與面積」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lake evaporation and surface area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾燥地區的大湖蒸發涉及水面面積與能量交換，蒸發深度不能直接當成水庫降深。湖面積隨水位變動，風場與氣象站代表性也會影響估算；固定面積算例只能說明單位換算，長期水量帳需用一致時間解析度積分。 驗證時應比較湖面氣象與蒸發估法並依逐月水位更新面積，並辨識以下失效情境：直接以單一岸站蒸發量代表全湖可能形成系統偏差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「大湖蒸發與面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-lake evaporation in an arid setting depends on surface area and energy exchange. Evaporation depth is not automatically reservoir stage decline. Area changes with level and station representativeness matters; a fixed-area calculation illustrates conversion while long-term budgets need consistent temporal integration. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare lake meteorology and evaporation methods and update area from monthly stage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using one shore station for the entire lake can create systematic bias. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lake evaporation and surface area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「大湖蒸發與面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 防滲核心串聯阻力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core seepage resistance in series” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型土石壩的不同土區可形成串聯與並聯流路，不能將各層滲透係數直接算術平均。等面積一維串聯模型以厚度除導水率形成阻力，可顯示低滲層控制作用；裂縫或接觸繞流則可能讓此理想串聯失效。 驗證時應以分層孔壓分配核對主要水頭損失是否位於低滲區，並辨識以下失效情境：沿接觸面繞流可避開原本控制流量的低滲核心。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防滲核心串聯阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different embankment zones create series and parallel paths, so arithmetic averaging of conductivity is generally inappropriate. Equal-area one-dimensional series resistance illustrates control by a low-permeability layer. Cracks and contact bypasses may defeat that idealization and must be checked independently of laboratory conductivity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use layered piezometric heads to locate the dominant head loss. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Contact bypass can avoid the low-permeability core that controls the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core seepage resistance in series” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Equal areaA=100 m2; deltaHead=40 m; layers L1=10 m,k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=20 m,k2=1e-5 m/s; Q=100*40/(10/1e-7+20/1e-5)=0.0000392157 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Equal areaA=100 m2; deltaHead=40 m; layers L1=10 m,k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=20 m,k2=1e-5 m/s; Q=100*40/(10/1e-7+20/1e-5)=0.0000392157 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯各層滲透係數可以直接算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「防滲核心串聯阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「核心沉陷與接觸」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core settlement and interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 核心與壩殼的壓縮性差異會造成相對變形，剛性穿越構造附近尤其需要檢查接觸與反濾連續。相鄰沉陷差只能描述幾何需求，不能直接預測裂縫寬度；施工時序、材料非線性與三維約束會改變實際應變分布。 驗證時應比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，並辨識以下失效情境：差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「核心沉陷與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different compressibility in core and shell creates relative movement, especially near rigid penetrations. Settlement difference describes geometric demand but does not directly predict crack aperture. Construction sequence, nonlinear material response and three-dimensional restraint govern the actual strain distribution and filter continuity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core settlement and interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「核心沉陷與接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Core settlement and interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心沉陷與接觸
knowledge.text: 核心與壩殼的壓縮性差異會造成相對變形，剛性穿越構造附近尤其需要檢查接觸與反濾連續。相鄰沉陷差只能描述幾何需求，不能直接預測裂縫寬度；施工時序、材料非線性與三維約束會改變實際應變分布。
knowledge.textEn: Different compressibility in core and shell creates relative movement, especially near rigid penetrations. Settlement difference describes geometric demand but does not directly predict crack aperture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心沉陷與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core settlement and interfaces" is correct?
options: 相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
核心與壩殼的壓縮性差異會造成相對變形，剛性穿越構造附近尤其需要檢查接觸與反濾連續。
optionsEn: Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Different compressibility in core and shell creates relative movement, especially near rigid penetrations.
quiz.explanation: 核心與壩殼的壓縮性差異會造成相對變形，剛性穿越構造附近尤其需要檢查接觸與反濾連續。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different compressibility in core and shell creates relative movement, especially near rigid penetrations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core settlement and interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心沉陷與接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core settlement and interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心沉陷與接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core settlement and interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。
所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水
基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m.
Every conveyance loss equals permanent basin water consumption
Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core settlement and interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心沉陷與接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core settlement and interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「核心沉陷與接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Core settlement and interfaces"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測。
蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces.
One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre
quiz.explanation: 比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core settlement and interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心沉陷與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core settlement and interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心沉陷與接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Core settlement and interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage.
quiz.explanation: 差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「發電淨水頭與出力」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net head and power output” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。尾水上升與水路損失會降低淨落差，裝置容量也不等於任何時刻能達到的出力；應以一致工況的量測核對能量轉換。 驗證時應同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，並辨識以下失效情境：只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電淨水頭與出力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. Reservoir level is only one upstream contribution; tailwater and conveyance losses reduce usable head. Installed capacity is not guaranteed output at every stage, so compare energy conversion using measurements from the same operating condition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net head and power output” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電淨水頭與出力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net head and power output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發電淨水頭與出力
knowledge.text: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。尾水上升與水路損失會降低淨落差，裝置容量也不等於任何時刻能達到的出力；應以一致工況的量測核對能量轉換。
knowledge.textEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. Reservoir level is only one upstream contribution; tailwater and conveyance losses reduce usable head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發電淨水頭與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Net head and power output" is correct?
options: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積
optionsEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency.
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume
quiz.explanation: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「發電淨水頭與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net head and power output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「發電淨水頭與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net head and power output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發電淨水頭與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Net head and power output"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

Conductivities of layers in series can be averaged arithmetically
Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses.

quiz.explanationEn: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「發電淨水頭與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net head and power output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. Diagnose it by the following check: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. Diagnose it by the following check: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發電淨水頭與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積
optionsEn: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「淤積量與乾密度」與「放流輸配與需水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 淤積量與乾密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment storage and dry density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淤積量與乾密度」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment storage and dry density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫截留泥砂會改變容量與入流三角洲，乾砂質量轉體積需考慮壓密和粒徑分區。相同質量在不同乾密度下佔據不同庫容，不能把水樣固體體積直接當沉積總體積；需要重複測深與分層取樣建立長期變化。 驗證時應以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淤積量與乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trapped sediment changes storage and delta geometry. Converting dry mass to deposit volume requires compaction and grain-size zoning. Equal mass occupies different bulk volume at different dry densities; repeat bathymetry and layered samples rather than treating grain volume as total deposited volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment storage and dry density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淤積量與乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment storage and dry density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3.
Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
Conductivities of layers in series can be averaged arithmetically
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 放流輸配與需水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Release conveyance and demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「放流輸配與需水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Release conveyance and demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「放流輸配與需水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Release conveyance and demand"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳。
相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries.
Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack
quiz.explanation: 核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 放流輸配與需水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Release conveyance and demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「放流輸配與需水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Release conveyance and demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every conveyance loss equals permanent basin water consumption" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「放流輸配與需水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Release conveyance and demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺
把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence
Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand.
quiz.explanation: 把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「枯水連續與備援」與「監測基線與異常」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drought sequence and reserve" and "Monitoring baseline and anomaly": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「枯水連續與備援」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drought sequence and reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。以累積短缺估算備援容量可展示序列效應，但假設需求、損失和初始庫容均已界定；實際可靠度還需多種水文序列、操作限制與不確定度分析。 驗證時應比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設，並辨識以下失效情境：只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「枯水連續與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. Cumulative deficits illustrate reserve demand for defined demand, losses and initial storage. Reliability still requires multiple hydrological sequences, operating constraints and uncertainty rather than treating one synthetic drought as universal. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drought sequence and reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「枯水連續與備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drought sequence and reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 枯水連續與備援
knowledge.text: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。以累積短缺估算備援容量可展示序列效應，但假設需求、損失和初始庫容均已界定；實際可靠度還需多種水文序列、操作限制與不確定度分析。
knowledge.textEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. Cumulative deficits illustrate reserve demand for defined demand, losses and initial storage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「枯水連續與備援」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drought sequence and reserve" is correct?
options: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。
平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺
基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效
optionsEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance.
Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence
Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing
quiz.explanation: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「枯水連續與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drought sequence and reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「枯水連續與備援」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drought sequence and reserve", which statement holds?
options: 蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺
原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。
濕密度較高就必定代表壓實骨架更密
optionsEn: One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre
Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3.
Higher wet density always proves a denser compacted skeleton
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. Keep units when recalculating.
