steps.instruction: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測基線與異常」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring baseline and anomaly" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。
只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration.
Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
quiz.explanation: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 塔貝拉水壩
summary: 本課以以塔貝拉深厚地基防滲及既有水路擴建界面學習為主線，先用大體積填築物流與鋪蓋延伸與流路界定水力與構造條件，再將蓄水分期與孔壓、進水口餘隙與淤積連結到出口消能與修復證據。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops studying Tarbela foundation seepage control and existing-waterway expansion interfaces through Bulk placement logistics and Blanket extension and seepage paths, then connects Impoundment stages and pore pressure and Intake clearance and deposition to Outlet dissipation and repair evidence. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查大體積填築物流：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day；再獨立檢查鋪蓋延伸與流路：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。敏感度：同滲透係數與面積下，示意水路長度由400增至600m，達西流量減至三分之二；鋪蓋延長的真實效果需二維或三維流網，不能用此比例直接估算實際壩基改善。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 將比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Bulk placement logistics: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. Independently examine Blanket extension and seepage paths: k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s. Sensitivity: at fixed conductivity and area, increasing an illustrative seepage path from400 to600m reduces Darcy flow to two-thirds. Real blanket extension requires a two- or three-dimensional flow model rather than direct use of this ratio. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Use the following independent check: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「大體積填築物流」與「鋪蓋延伸與流路」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bulk placement logistics" and "Blanket extension and seepage paths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「大體積填築物流」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bulk placement logistics” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。理想車隊算例假設供料與攤鋪不成瓶頸，實際還需檢查材料分區、道路干擾與品質驗收速度，不能只加車就宣稱產能增加。 驗證時應核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，並辨識以下失效情境：把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「大體積填築物流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. Truck payload, cycle time and productive hours limit output. An ideal fleet estimate assumes loading and spreading are unconstrained; material zoning, road interference and acceptance capacity can become bottlenecks, so adding vehicles alone does not guarantee more placement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bulk placement logistics” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「大體積填築物流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bulk placement logistics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 大體積填築物流
knowledge.text: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。理想車隊算例假設供料與攤鋪不成瓶頸，實際還需檢查材料分區、道路干擾與品質驗收速度，不能只加車就宣稱產能增加。
knowledge.textEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. Truck payload, cycle time and productive hours limit output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大體積填築物流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bulk placement logistics" is correct?
options: 增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加
塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。
鋪蓋越長就可不必檢查局部破損與邊緣效應
optionsEn: More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement
Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics.
A longer blanket removes the need to inspect defects and edge effects
quiz.explanation: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大體積填築物流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bulk placement logistics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大體積填築物流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bulk placement logistics", which statement holds?
options: 低於理想浮起梯度就排除所有內部沖蝕
三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積
原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。
optionsEn: A gradient below ideal heave excludes every internal-erosion mechanism
Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume
Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大體積填築物流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bulk placement logistics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. steps.instruction: 把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Blanket extension and seepage paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋪蓋延伸與流路」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blanket extension and seepage paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上游防滲鋪蓋可改變進入地基的水頭分布與流路長度，不能只看壩體核心而忽略深部地基。均質一維達西式只是方向性示意，鋪蓋邊緣、分層及局部穿透會產生二維效應；需以孔壓分布和分區流量檢驗。 驗證時應用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，並辨識以下失效情境：鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋪蓋延伸與流路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An upstream blanket changes foundation entry heads and seepage paths, making foundation control distinct from the core. A uniform one-dimensional Darcy calculation illustrates direction only. Blanket edges, layering and penetrations create two-dimensional effects that require piezometric and zoned-discharge validation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare heads across the blanket and foundation to establish the actual distribution. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Blanket extension and seepage paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋪蓋越長就可不必檢查局部破損與邊緣效應」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A longer blanket removes the need to inspect defects and edge effects" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋪蓋延伸與流路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Blanket extension and seepage paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路
knowledge.text: 上游防滲鋪蓋可改變進入地基的水頭分布與流路長度，不能只看壩體核心而忽略深部地基。均質一維達西式只是方向性示意，鋪蓋邊緣、分層及局部穿透會產生二維效應；需以孔壓分布和分區流量檢驗。

An upstream blanket changes foundation entry heads and seepage paths, making foundation control distinct from the core.

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋪蓋延伸與流路」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Blanket extension and seepage paths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare heads across the blanket and foundation to establish the actual distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Blanket extension and seepage paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋪蓋延伸與流路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Blanket extension and seepage paths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。診斷時應採取以下查核：用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare heads across the blanket and foundation to establish the actual distribution. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋪蓋越長就可不必檢查局部破損與邊緣效應」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A longer blanket removes the need to inspect defects and edge effects" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。診斷時應採取以下查核：用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare heads across the blanket and foundation to establish the actual distribution. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋪蓋延伸與流路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Blanket extension and seepage paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
分層地基的水平與垂直導水率必定相同
鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Layered foundations must have equal horizontal and vertical conductivity
A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance.
quiz.explanation: 鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A local blanket opening can create a short path that undermines overall performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層導水與各向異性」與「出口梯度與有效重量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Layered conductivity and anisotropy" and "Exit gradient and submerged weight": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層導水與各向異性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered conductivity and anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層導水與各向異性」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沖積地基中水平連續砂礫層與低滲夾層可使水平及垂直導水率不同，單一等向係數可能誤判孔壓。平行層等厚加權只適用層內流向，跨層方向需用阻力式；應以鑽探和試驗建立層序與連通性。 驗證時應比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層，並辨識以下失效情境：把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層導水與各向異性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Continuous granular layers and low-permeability seams create directional conductivity. One isotropic value can misrepresent pressures. Thickness-weighted averaging applies to flow parallel to layers, whereas cross-layer flow uses resistance weighting. Boreholes and testing must establish both layer sequence and hydraulic connectivity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分層地基的水平與垂直導水率必定相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Layered foundations must have equal horizontal and vertical conductivity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層導水與各向異性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layered conductivity and anisotropy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層導水與各向異性

knowledge.textEn: Continuous granular layers and low-permeability seams create directional conductivity. One isotropic value can misrepresent pressures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分層地基的水平與垂直導水率必定相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Layered foundations must have equal horizontal and vertical conductivity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layered conductivity and anisotropy" is correct?
options: 沖積地基中水平連續砂礫層與低滲夾層可使水平及垂直導水率不同，單一等向係數可能誤判孔壓。
分層地基的水平與垂直導水率必定相同
低於理想浮起梯度就排除所有內部沖蝕
optionsEn: Continuous granular layers and low-permeability seams create directional conductivity.
Layered foundations must have equal horizontal and vertical conductivity
A gradient below ideal heave excludes every internal-erosion mechanism

steps.title: 分層導水與各向異性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered conductivity and anisotropy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層導水與各向異性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 分層導水與各向異性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered conductivity and anisotropy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層導水與各向異性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。單一升水步的平均速率不代表可接受操作速度；應按核准程序及失效模式判讀，並辨識尚未達平衡的深層測點。 驗證時應對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，並辨識以下失效情境：只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「蓄水分期與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. Observation periods must fit material and instrument response times. A mean rise rate is descriptive, not an authorized rate; interpret it through approved procedures and failure modes and identify deep points still out of equilibrium. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「蓄水分期與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Impoundment stages and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓
knowledge.text: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。單一升水步的平均速率不代表可接受操作速度；應按核准程序及失效模式判讀，並辨識尚未達平衡的深層測點。
knowledge.textEn: Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. Observation periods must fit material and instrument response times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蓄水分期與孔壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Impoundment stages and pore pressure" is correct?
options: 淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡
三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積
分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。
optionsEn: Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium
Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume
Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses.
quiz.explanation: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Impoundment stages and pore pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蓄水分期與孔壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Impoundment stages and pore pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蓄水分期與孔壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蓄水分期與孔壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Impoundment stages and pore pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes.

steps.title: 三角洲推進與測深：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delta advance and bathymetry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「三角洲推進與測深」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delta advance and bathymetry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。用平均剖面積乘推進距離僅作稜柱近似，沿寬變化和壓密需另處理；應把斷面追蹤、粒徑與輸砂帳連結。 驗證時應沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，並辨識以下失效情境：用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三角洲推進與測深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume. Mean cross-sectional area times advance is a prism approximation that omits lateral changes and consolidation. Link repeated sections, grain-size observations and sediment budgets before interpreting long-term progression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delta advance and bathymetry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「三角洲推進與測深」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delta advance and bathymetry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三角洲推進與測深
knowledge.text: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。用平均剖面積乘推進距離僅作稜柱近似，沿寬變化和壓密需另處理；應把斷面追蹤、粒徑與輸砂帳連結。
knowledge.textEn: Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume. Mean cross-sectional area times advance is a prism approximation that omits lateral changes and consolidation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三角洲推進與測深」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Delta advance and bathymetry" is correct?
options: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。
三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積
平均庫底夠低就保證進水口前沒有淤堵
optionsEn: Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume.
Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume
A low mean reservoir bed guarantees no intake-local blockage
quiz.explanation: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三角洲推進與測深：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Delta advance and bathymetry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三角洲推進與測深」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delta advance and bathymetry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三角洲推進與測深」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Delta advance and bathymetry", which statement holds?
options: 裝置容量乘全年時數就是保證可售電量
原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。
增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加
optionsEn: Nameplate capacity times annual hours equals guaranteed saleable energy
Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3.
More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三角洲推進與測深：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delta advance and bathymetry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三角洲推進與測深」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delta advance and bathymetry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三角洲推進與測深」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Delta advance and bathymetry"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
分層地基的水平與垂直導水率必定相同
沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Layered foundations must have equal horizontal and vertical conductivity
Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density.
quiz.explanation: 沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三角洲推進與測深：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Delta advance and bathymetry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三角洲推進與測深」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Delta advance and bathymetry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. Diagnose it by the following check: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. Diagnose it by the following check: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三角洲推進與測深」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Delta advance and bathymetry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
平均庫底夠低就保證進水口前沒有淤堵
optionsEn: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A low mean reservoir bed guarantees no intake-local blockage
quiz.explanation: 用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「進水口餘隙與淤積」與「既有隧道擴建損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Intake clearance and deposition" and "Existing tunnel conversion losses": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 進水口餘隙與淤積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Intake clearance and deposition: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「進水口餘隙與淤積」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intake clearance and deposition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有進水口的底部餘隙會隨沉積與庫水位變化，幾何淨距不足可能提高吸砂與堵塞風險。標高差只提供空間盤點，不預測局部三維取水或再懸浮；需同時觀測底床地形、流速與取水濃度。 驗證時應重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，並辨識以下失效情境：只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「進水口餘隙與淤積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intake clearance changes with deposition and stage, potentially increasing sediment ingestion or blockage. An elevation difference describes geometry, not three-dimensional withdrawal or resuspension. Combine bed surveys, approach velocities and intake concentration to interpret whether the remaining space is hydraulically adequate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Resurvey the intake bed and compare sediment ingestion with local velocity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A distant mean bed level misses a local mound in front of the intake. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Intake clearance and deposition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：IntakeLowerLipElevation=300 m; localSedimentElevation=292 m; verticalClearance=300-292=8 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: IntakeLowerLipElevation=300 m; localSedimentElevation=292 m; verticalClearance=300-292=8 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均庫底夠低就保證進水口前沒有淤堵」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low mean reservoir bed guarantees no intake-local blockage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「進水口餘隙與淤積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Intake clearance and deposition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 進水口餘隙與淤積
knowledge.text: 既有進水口的底部餘隙會隨沉積與庫水位變化，幾何淨距不足可能提高吸砂與堵塞風險。標高差只提供空間盤點，不預測局部三維取水或再懸浮；需同時觀測底床地形、流速與取水濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Intake clearance changes with deposition and stage, potentially increasing sediment ingestion or blockage. An elevation difference describes geometry, not three-dimensional withdrawal or resuspension.

options: 平均庫底夠低就保證進水口前沒有淤堵

steps.instructionEn: Resurvey the intake bed and compare sediment ingestion with local velocity. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A distant mean bed level misses a local mound in front of the intake. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 進水口餘隙與淤積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Intake clearance and deposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「進水口餘隙與淤積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Intake clearance and deposition” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。診斷時應採取以下查核：重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A distant mean bed level misses a local mound in front of the intake. Diagnose it by the following check: Resurvey the intake bed and compare sediment ingestion with local velocity. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均庫底夠低就保證進水口前沒有淤堵」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low mean reservoir bed guarantees no intake-local blockage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。診斷時應採取以下查核：重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Adequate existing diameter removes the need to check conversion head losses

steps.title: 既有隧道擴建損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Existing tunnel conversion losses: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「既有隧道擴建損失」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Existing tunnel conversion losses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把既有放水隧道接入新增機組時，流量與壓力邊界改變會影響摩阻和暫態，不能只查隧道直徑是否足夠。局部損失係數乘速度水頭可盤點轉接件作用，還需核對接頭、分岔與下游調節對整體系統的影響。 驗證時應比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形，並辨識以下失效情境：新增轉接損失會降低機組可用淨水頭。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「既有隧道擴建損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connecting new generation to an existing release tunnel changes flow and pressure boundaries, affecting friction and transients. Diameter alone is insufficient. A local-loss calculation accounts for one transition, while joints, branching and downstream regulation require a system assessment under the converted operating conditions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Added connection losses reduce net head available to the generating unit. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Existing tunnel conversion losses” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：AssumedTransitionK=0.35; meanV=9 m/s; localHeadLoss=0.35*9**2/(2*9.81)=1.44495 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: AssumedTransitionK=0.35; meanV=9 m/s; localHeadLoss=0.35*9**2/(2*9.81)=1.44495 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原有隧道直徑足夠就不必檢查改接水頭損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate existing diameter removes the need to check conversion head losses" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「既有隧道擴建損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Existing tunnel conversion losses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：原有隧道直徑足夠就不必檢查改接水頭損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate existing diameter removes the need to check conversion head losses Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「既有隧道擴建損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 原有隧道直徑足夠就不必檢查改接水頭損失
裝置容量乘全年時數就是保證可售電量

Nameplate capacity times annual hours equals guaranteed saleable energy

steps.title: 發電用水與放流協調：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「發電用水與放流協調」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generation flow and release coordination” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新增發電功能可能利用原有放流水量，但發電時段與灌溉或下游需求的時間尺度不同。能量算例需清楚定義有效出力與時數，不能把裝置容量全年相乘當保證發電；水量與尾水限制需在共同調度邊界核對。 驗證時應以機組電量表與同期放流水量核對發電時窗，並辨識以下失效情境：把停機或缺水時段也當滿載會高估年度電量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電用水與放流協調」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New generation may use existing releases, but its timing can differ from irrigation or downstream needs. Energy requires defined output and duration; nameplate power times a full year is not guaranteed generation. Reconcile water and tailwater constraints within a common scheduling boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare metered energy with release volumes over the same generating window. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Counting outages or water-limited periods as full output overstates annual energy. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generation flow and release coordination” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝置容量乘全年時數就是保證可售電量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
