quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticTransitionD15=0.8 mm; protectedSoild85=0.25 mm; ratio=0.8/0.25=3.2 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反濾過渡與細粒：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter transitions and fines: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反濾過渡與細粒」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter transitions and fines” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反濾過渡與細粒」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter transitions and fines"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A lower capacity factor necessarily means lower turbine efficiency
Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness.
quiz.explanation: 於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反濾過渡與細粒：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter transitions and fines: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反濾過渡與細粒」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter transitions and fines” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。診斷時應採取以下查核：於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. Diagnose it by the following check: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「料場試驗合格就保證每個鋪築界面都合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing stockpile tests guarantees every placed interface is acceptable" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。診斷時應採取以下查核：於實際鋪築位置取樣核對界面兩側級配與連續厚度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. Diagnose it by the following check: Sample placed material to check both interface gradations and continuous thickness. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反濾過渡與細粒」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filter transitions and fines" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同
optionsEn: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect
quiz.explanation: 只驗料場級配會漏掉運輸鋪築造成的分離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the stockpile misses segregation during transport and placement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分孔洩流與不均流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiple bays and uneven discharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分孔洩流與不均流」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiple bays and uneven discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多孔溢洪道的總流量由各孔實際開度與水頭決定，孔數平均不代表局部水舌或下游壓力相同。合成各孔流量加總只是水量帳；閘門組合改變可能使相鄰水舌交互作用，須對照下游消能與岸坡反應。 驗證時應同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量，並辨識以下失效情境：相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分孔洩流與不均流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total spillway flow sums actual bay discharges, not an assumed uniform share. Adding synthetic bay flows is only mass accounting. Different combinations can alter jet interaction and downstream pressure, so check dissipation and bank response alongside opening and head at each bay. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiple bays and uneven discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分孔洩流與不均流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Multiple bays and uneven discharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分孔洩流與不均流
knowledge.text: 多孔溢洪道的總流量由各孔實際開度與水頭決定，孔數平均不代表局部水舌或下游壓力相同。合成各孔流量加總只是水量帳；閘門組合改變可能使相鄰水舌交互作用，須對照下游消能與岸坡反應。
knowledge.textEn: Total spillway flow sums actual bay discharges, not an assumed uniform share. Adding synthetic bay flows is only mass accounting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分孔洩流與不均流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiple bays and uneven discharge" is correct?
options: 總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同
多孔溢洪道的總流量由各孔實際開度與水頭決定，孔數平均不代表局部水舌或下游壓力相同。
閘門數量多就保證沒有任何共同失效點
optionsEn: Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect
Total spillway flow sums actual bay discharges, not an assumed uniform share.
A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point
quiz.explanation: 多孔溢洪道的總流量由各孔實際開度與水頭決定，孔數平均不代表局部水舌或下游壓力相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total spillway flow sums actual bay discharges, not an assumed uniform share. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分孔洩流與不均流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiple bays and uneven discharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分孔洩流與不均流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiple bays and uneven discharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分孔洩流與不均流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multiple bays and uneven discharge", which statement holds?
options: 湖面積一旦量過就能固定用於所有水位
每天總放流量相同就表示下游影響完全相同
原創教學假設：Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s。
optionsEn: One measured lake area applies unchanged at every stage
Equal daily release volume guarantees identical downstream effects
Original teaching assumptions: Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three hypothetical bays discharge=120,100,80 m3/s; totalQ=120+100+80=300 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分孔洩流與不均流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multiple bays and uneven discharge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分孔洩流與不均流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multiple bays and uneven discharge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分孔洩流與不均流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multiple bays and uneven discharge"?
options: 同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成
optionsEn: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分孔洩流與不均流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multiple bays and uneven discharge: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分孔洩流與不均流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Multiple bays and uneven discharge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. Diagnose it by the following check: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄各孔開度與下游水舌位置並核對總流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. Diagnose it by the following check: Record bay openings and downstream jet positions together and check total flow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分孔洩流與不均流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multiple bays and uneven discharge" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。
閘門數量多就保證沒有任何共同失效點
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank.
A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point
quiz.explanation: 相同總洩量的不同孔組合可能集中衝擊單側岸坡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different bay combinations at equal total flow can concentrate impact on one bank. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共用設備與可用率」與「機組出力與水頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared equipment and availability" and "Generating output and hydraulic head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共用設備與可用率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared equipment and availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共用設備與可用率」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared equipment and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 共用啟閉設備使多個閘門在維修與故障時具有共同依賴，不能把各孔當完全獨立備援。串聯可用率乘積僅適用獨立失效及簡化狀態，現場共因故障需另建事件樹；應檢查設備移動時間、停機及替代方案。 驗證時應以故障維修紀錄分辨共用與獨立設備並核對替代啟閉能力，並辨識以下失效情境：共用啟閉機停機可同時限制多個原本完好的閘門。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共用設備與可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shared hoisting equipment creates common dependencies among gates. Multiplying availabilities represents an ideal independent series system only; common-cause failures require another model. Examine movement time, outages and alternatives instead of counting every gate as fully independent redundancy merely because the leaves are separate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use maintenance records to distinguish shared and independent equipment and check alternative actuation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A shared hoist outage can constrain several otherwise functional gates. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shared equipment and availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ideal independent gate-and-hoist availability: gate=0.98; hoist=0.95; combined=0.98*0.95=0.931 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal independent gate-and-hoist availability: gate=0.98; hoist=0.95; combined=0.98*0.95=0.931 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閘門數量多就保證沒有任何共同失效點」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共用設備與可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shared equipment and availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 共用啟閉設備使多個閘門在維修與故障時具有共同依賴，不能把各孔當完全獨立備援。串聯可用率乘積僅適用獨立失效及簡化狀態，現場共因故障需另建事件樹；應檢查設備移動時間、停機及替代方案。
knowledge.textEn: Shared hoisting equipment creates common dependencies among gates. Multiplying availabilities represents an ideal independent series system only; common-cause failures require another model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共用設備與可用率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared equipment and availability" is correct?
options: 閘門數量多就保證沒有任何共同失效點
裝置容量就是任何水頭下都能維持的出力
共用啟閉設備使多個閘門在維修與故障時具有共同依賴，不能把各孔當完全獨立備援。

Nameplate capacity is output that can be maintained at every head

steps.title: 共用設備與可用率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared equipment and availability: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared equipment and availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用啟閉機停機可同時限制多個原本完好的閘門。診斷時應採取以下查核：以故障維修紀錄分辨共用與獨立設備並核對替代啟閉能力，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared hoist outage can constrain several otherwise functional gates. Diagnose it by the following check: Use maintenance records to distinguish shared and independent equipment and check alternative actuation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「機組出力與水頭」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generating output and hydraulic head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阿科松博提供水庫發電與放流協調的案例，機組出力需用淨水頭而不是壩高。尾水與進水損失會隨流量改變，效率也受工作點影響；合成定效率算例只是能量量級，不能以裝置容量倒推出未量測的流量。 驗證時應以同期電功率流量及上下游水位核對效率範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：用固定最高效率套全年工況會高估發電量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「機組出力與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Akosombo provides context for coordinated reservoir generation and releases. Output uses net head rather than dam height; tailwater, losses and efficiency vary with operating point. A constant-efficiency illustration gives an energy scale and does not justify recovering unmeasured flow directly from nameplate capacity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check efficiency using simultaneous electrical power, flow and both water levels. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying peak efficiency to every operating state overstates generation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generating output and hydraulic head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=200 m3/s; netHead=60 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*200*60*0.90/1e6=105.948 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=200 m3/s; netHead=60 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*200*60*0.90/1e6=105.948 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝置容量就是任何水頭下都能維持的出力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nameplate capacity is output that can be maintained at every head" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「機組出力與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Generating output and hydraulic head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「廣域湖面與庫容」與「風浪水位與壩頂」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Broad lake surface and storage" and "Wind setup and crest checks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 廣域湖面與庫容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Broad lake surface and storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「廣域湖面與庫容」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Broad lake surface and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大面積湖泊的小幅水位變化可能對應大量庫容，但面積並非固定，岸線地形使水位容量關係非線性。以定面積近似只適用短範圍示意，應使用實測地形更新曲線；不同高程基準不能直接拼接成容量變化。 驗證時應以分水位面積曲線與重複測深核對局部容量斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：固定面積外推大幅洩降會錯估可用庫容。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「廣域湖面與庫容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A small level change over a broad lake can represent substantial storage, but shoreline geometry makes area variable. A constant-area approximation covers a limited range only. Update the relation from bathymetry and keep vertical datums consistent rather than joining unlike surveys into a storage trend. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check local storage slope using stage-area curves and repeat bathymetry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Constant-area extrapolation over large drawdown misstates usable storage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Broad lake surface and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HypotheticalMeanArea=1000 km2; stageChange=0.20 m; localStorageChange=1000e6*0.20/1e6=200 million m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalMeanArea=1000 km2; stageChange=0.20 m; localStorageChange=1000e6*0.20/1e6=200 million m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「湖面積一旦量過就能固定用於所有水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One measured lake area applies unchanged at every stage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「廣域湖面與庫容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Broad lake surface and storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 廣域湖面與庫容
knowledge.text: 大面積湖泊的小幅水位變化可能對應大量庫容，但面積並非固定，岸線地形使水位容量關係非線性。以定面積近似只適用短範圍示意，應使用實測地形更新曲線；不同高程基準不能直接拼接成容量變化。
knowledge.textEn: A small level change over a broad lake can represent substantial storage, but shoreline geometry makes area variable. A constant-area approximation covers a limited range only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：湖面積一旦量過就能固定用於所有水位 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One measured lake area applies unchanged at every stage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

大面積湖泊的小幅水位變化可能對應大量庫容，但面積並非固定，岸線地形使水位容量關係非線性。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HypotheticalMeanArea=1000 km2; stageChange=0.20 m; localStorageChange=1000e6*0.20/1e6=200 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalMeanArea=1000 km2; stageChange=0.20 m; localStorageChange=1000e6*0.20/1e6=200 million m3. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Wind over a broad lake can produce both setup and waves, which must be distinguished in crest checks. steps.instruction: 忽略壩頂長期沉陷會高估剩餘餘高。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較壩前水位波浪紀錄與壩頂沉陷並標明浪向，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 下游流量爬升：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「下游流量爬升」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream discharge ramping” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電調峰會改變下游放流時序，平均日水量相同仍可能造成不同水位變化速度。流量差除時間只是放流變率，不能直接等同下游任一斷面的水位升速；河道儲水、傳播時間與支流入流需用路由與量測評估。 驗證時應同步記錄電廠放流與下游多站水位以辨認傳播延遲，並辨識以下失效情境：把出口流量變率直接當居民區水位升速會混淆量綱。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游流量爬升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Peaking changes release timing even when daily volume is unchanged. Discharge change divided by time is a release ramp, not the water-level rise at every downstream section. Channel storage, travel time and tributaries require routing and observations to determine actual downstream response. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record plant release and downstream levels at several stations to identify travel delay. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Equating outlet discharge ramp with settlement-area level rise confuses dimensions. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream discharge ramping” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：ReleaseChangesFrom=100 to220 m3/s over30 min; meanDischargeRamp=(220-100)/30=4 m3/s per min。

steps.title: 下游流量爬升：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downstream discharge ramping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：ReleaseChangesFrom=100 to220 m3/s over30 min; meanDischargeRamp=(220-100)/30=4 m3/s per min。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: ReleaseChangesFrom=100 to220 m3/s over30 min; meanDischargeRamp=(220-100)/30=4 m3/s per min. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄電廠放流與下游多站水位以辨認傳播延遲。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

title: 大迪克桑斯壩
summary: 本課以以大迪克桑斯重力壩高山集水與壩基監測學習為主線，先用高山集水與季節庫存與高壩投影水壓界定水力與構造條件，再將合力偏心與接觸、水化熱與拘束連結到高落差輸水與淨能量。公開高度與年代僅作案例背景，合成斷面不等於真實壩形，所有安全比值均非設計評定。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops studying Grande Dixence gravity action alpine collection and foundation monitoring through Alpine collection and seasonal storage and High dam projected hydrostatic load, then connects Resultant eccentricity and contact and Hydration heat and restraint to High-head conveyance and net energy. Public height and dates provide context only; synthetic sections are not the actual dam and calculated ratios are not design assessments. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。

Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查高山集水與季節庫存：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3；再獨立檢查高壩投影水壓：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。敏感度：合成底面總下向力90000kN與摩擦係數0.7不變，揚力由20000增至30000kN，摩擦抗力由49000降至42000kN，減少14.29%；不能假設排水永久維持初始效果。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。公開高度與年代僅作案例背景，合成斷面不等於真實壩形，所有安全比值均非設計評定。 將保持試段長度壓差一致並比較帷幕上下游孔壓作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Alpine collection and seasonal storage: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3. Independently examine High dam projected hydrostatic load: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width. Sensitivity: with90000kN downward force and0.7 friction coefficient, raising uplift from20000 to30000kN reduces frictional resistance from49000 to42000kN, or14.29 percent. Drainage cannot be assumed permanently effective at its initial state. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Public height and dates provide context only; synthetic sections are not the actual dam and calculated ratios are not design assessments. Use the following independent check: Match interval length and pressure and compare heads on both sides of the curtain. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高山集水與季節庫存」與「高壩投影水壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alpine collection and seasonal storage" and "High dam projected hydrostatic load": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高山集水與季節庫存：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alpine collection and seasonal storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高山集水與季節庫存」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大迪克桑斯系統將高山集水與蓄水發電連結，融雪、降雨與輸水設備共同限制可收集水量。流量積分只表示指定時窗的輸入，不代表全部都可用於發電；溢流、抽水耗能及生態放流需在共同水量邊界另列。 驗證時應將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流，並辨識以下失效情境：只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高山集水與季節庫存」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grande Dixence links alpine collection with storage and generation. Snowmelt, rainfall and conveyance capacity constrain captured water. Integrated flow describes one input window, not fully usable generating water; spills, pumping demand and environmental releases belong in the same accounting boundary. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「收集到的水量必定全部轉成可發電水量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every collected water volume necessarily becomes generating water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高山集水與季節庫存」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alpine collection and seasonal storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高山集水與季節庫存
knowledge.text: 大迪克桑斯系統將高山集水與蓄水發電連結，融雪、降雨與輸水設備共同限制可收集水量。流量積分只表示指定時窗的輸入，不代表全部都可用於發電；溢流、抽水耗能及生態放流需在共同水量邊界另列。
knowledge.textEn: Grande Dixence links alpine collection with storage and generation. Snowmelt, rainfall and conveyance capacity constrain captured water.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：收集到的水量必定全部轉成可發電水量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every collected water volume necessarily becomes generating water Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高山集水與季節庫存」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

公開壩高就是任何工況下的實際水深
optionsEn: Every collected water volume necessarily becomes generating water
Grande Dixence links alpine collection with storage and generation.

steps.title: 高山集水與季節庫存：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alpine collection and seasonal storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高山集水與季節庫存」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticCollectedFlow=12 m3/s for20 days; collectedVolume=12*20*86400/1e6=20.736 million m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高山集水與季節庫存」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alpine collection and seasonal storage", which statement holds?
options: 一個排水孔壓力低就代表整個底面揚力低
揚壓只影響抗浮而不影響滑動摩擦

steps.title: 高山集水與季節庫存：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alpine collection and seasonal storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高山集水與季節庫存」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高山集水與季節庫存」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高山集水與季節庫存：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alpine collection and seasonal storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高山集水與季節庫存」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alpine collection and seasonal storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流。診斷時應採取以下查核：將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Summing collection alone omits conveyance losses and nongenerating releases. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「收集到的水量必定全部轉成可發電水量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every collected water volume necessarily becomes generating water" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只加總取水量會漏掉輸水損失與非發電放流。診斷時應採取以下查核：將各支流取水與庫存變化對帳並區分抽水輸入與自然入流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile tributary collection with storage and distinguish pumped from natural inflow. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高山集水與季節庫存」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alpine collection and seasonal storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 高壩投影水壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High dam projected hydrostatic load: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高壩投影水壓」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High dam projected hydrostatic load” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力壩以自身重量及地基作用抵抗水平水壓，水深增加使三角分布合力按平方成長。單寬投影式只是二維自由體的一項，壩體實際幾何、尾水與地震水動力需另列；不能以公共壩高直接替代運轉水深。 驗證時應以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高壩投影水壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravity dam resists horizontal water action through weight and foundation interaction. The triangular resultant grows with depth squared. A unit-width projection is one term in a two-dimensional free body; actual geometry, tailwater and seismic hydrodynamics remain separate, and public dam height is not operating depth. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High dam projected hydrostatic load” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「公開壩高就是任何工況下的實際水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Published dam height equals actual water depth in every condition" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高壩投影水壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High dam projected hydrostatic load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高壩投影水壓
knowledge.text: 重力壩以自身重量及地基作用抵抗水平水壓，水深增加使三角分布合力按平方成長。單寬投影式只是二維自由體的一項，壩體實際幾何、尾水與地震水動力需另列；不能以公共壩高直接替代運轉水深。
knowledge.textEn: A gravity dam resists horizontal water action through weight and foundation interaction. The triangular resultant grows with depth squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：公開壩高就是任何工況下的實際水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Published dam height equals actual water depth in every condition Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高壩投影水壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High dam projected hydrostatic load" is correct?
options: 公開壩高就是任何工況下的實際水深
混凝土質量的噸數可以直接當作千牛頓重量
重力壩以自身重量及地基作用抵抗水平水壓，水深增加使三角分布合力按平方成長。
optionsEn: Published dam height equals actual water depth in every condition
Concrete mass in tonnes can be used directly as weight in kilonewtons
A gravity dam resists horizontal water action through weight and foundation interaction.
quiz.explanation: 重力壩以自身重量及地基作用抵抗水平水壓，水深增加使三角分布合力按平方成長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gravity dam resists horizontal water action through weight and foundation interaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高壩投影水壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High dam projected hydrostatic load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高壩投影水壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High dam projected hydrostatic load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高壩投影水壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High dam projected hydrostatic load", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。
合力在底面內就保證全底面始終受壓
完全拘束彈性熱應力就是所有實際位置的應力
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width.
A resultant anywhere inside the base guarantees compression over the entire base
Fully restrained elastic thermal stress equals stress at every actual location
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticWaterDepth=180 m; unitWidth=1 m; hydrostaticForce=0.5*9.81*180**2=158922 kN per m width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高壩投影水壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High dam projected hydrostatic load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高壩投影水壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High dam projected hydrostatic load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高壩投影水壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High dam projected hydrostatic load"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖。
垂線差值必定就是壩體絕對地理位移
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections.
A plumb-line difference necessarily equals absolute geographic dam movement
quiz.explanation: 以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高壩投影水壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High dam projected hydrostatic load: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高壩投影水壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High dam projected hydrostatic load” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. Diagnose it by the following check: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「公開壩高就是任何工況下的實際水深」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Published dam height equals actual water depth in every condition" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時庫尾水位及實測斷面建立完整荷載圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. Diagnose it by the following check: Build the complete load diagram from simultaneous reservoir and tailwater levels and surveyed sections. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高壩投影水壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High dam projected hydrostatic load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土質量的噸數可以直接當作千牛頓重量
把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Concrete mass in tonnes can be used directly as weight in kilonewtons
Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment.
quiz.explanation: 把結構總高度當滿水深會錯置受壓範圍與力矩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total structural height as water depth misplaces the loaded area and moment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「混凝土自重與質量」與「底面揚力與排水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concrete weight and mass" and "Base uplift and drainage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混凝土自重與質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete weight and mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土自重與質量」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete weight and mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體混凝土的密度與體積先給質量，再乘重力才得到重量，兩者不可混用。合成單寬斷面自重須使用斷面面積與厚度，廊道和空洞另扣；重心位置同樣重要，因其決定抵抗力矩而不只總重量。 驗證時應核對廊道扣除與重心位置並分別列出質量及重量單位，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣大廊道或錯置重心會同時影響自重與穩定力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土自重與質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Density and volume yield mass; multiplying by gravity yields weight. A synthetic unit-width section needs area and thickness, with galleries and voids deducted. The centroid matters as much as total weight because it sets the resisting moment rather than merely the downward force. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check gallery deductions and centroid and distinguish mass units from force units. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitted galleries or a misplaced centroid alter weight and stability moments. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete weight and mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base uplift and drainage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Linear base head: upstream=100 m; downstream=20 m; baseWidth=80 m; stripWidth=1 m; uplift=9.81*(100+20)/2*80=47088 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Linear base head: upstream=100 m; downstream=20 m; baseWidth=80 m; stripWidth=1 m; uplift=9.81*(100+20)/2*80=47088 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare gallery piezometers and drainage flow with the assumed base-pressure profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 底面揚力與排水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base uplift and drainage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底面揚力與排水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base uplift and drainage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare gallery piezometers and drainage flow with the assumed base-pressure profile. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare gallery piezometers and drainage flow with the assumed base-pressure profile. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 底面揚力與排水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base uplift and drainage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底面揚力與排水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base uplift and drainage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare gallery piezometers and drainage flow with the assumed base-pressure profile. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個排水孔壓力低就代表整個底面揚力低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low pressure at one drain proves low uplift across the entire base" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿底面廊道孔壓與排水流量核對假設分布，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底面揚力與排水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base uplift and drainage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。
合力在底面內就保證全底面始終受壓
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile.
A resultant anywhere inside the base guarantees compression over the entire base
quiz.explanation: 排水堵塞會讓既有線性低壓假設失去依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Drain blockage invalidates an assumed low-pressure profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「合力偏心與接觸」與「抗滑摩擦與揚壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resultant eccentricity and contact" and "Sliding friction and uplift": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 合力偏心與接觸：機制與系統路徑
