steps.objective: 說明「合力偏心與接觸」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resultant eccentricity and contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單寬底面合力的偏心決定線彈性接觸壓力分布，核心範圍判斷須明示底面不能承拉或可承拉的模型。矩形全接觸公式在算出拉應力時已提示假設可能失效，不能保留負接觸壓力繼續當真實地基反力。 驗證時應以完整荷載力矩求合力位置並核對接觸模型是否允許拉力，並辨識以下失效情境：超出全接觸適用範圍仍用線性式會錯估壓縮區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「合力偏心與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Resultant eccentricity controls the linear base-pressure distribution. State whether tension can be transferred. A full-contact rectangular formula that predicts tension signals a possible breakdown of its own assumption; negative contact pressure should not simply be retained as a real foundation reaction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Locate the resultant from all moments and check whether the contact model permits tension. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using full-contact equations beyond their range misstates the compressed area. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resultant eccentricity and contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：SyntheticBaseWidth=60 m; resultantEccentricity=8 m; middleThirdLimit=60/6=10 m; geometricMargin=10-8=2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticBaseWidth=60 m; resultantEccentricity=8 m; middleThirdLimit=60/6=10 m; geometricMargin=10-8=2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合力在底面內就保證全底面始終受壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A resultant anywhere inside the base guarantees compression over the entire base" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「合力偏心與接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resultant eccentricity and contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合力偏心與接觸

knowledge.text: 誤解：合力在底面內就保證全底面始終受壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A resultant anywhere inside the base guarantees compression over the entire base Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合力偏心與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 合力在底面內就保證全底面始終受壓
揚壓只影響抗浮而不影響滑動摩擦

Uplift affects flotation only and never sliding friction
Resultant eccentricity controls the linear base-pressure distribution.

steps.title: 抗滑摩擦與揚壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sliding friction and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抗滑摩擦與揚壓」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding friction and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摩擦抗力取決於有效正力而非總自重，揚壓、地震與不同荷載組合會改變可用接觸。無黏聚簡式只估一項抗力，不能代表含節理岩體的完整穩定；接觸面粗糙、剪脹及強度退化需由適當試驗與分析建立。 驗證時應核對揚壓量測與接觸剪力試驗並分列各荷載組合，並辨識以下失效情境：用總自重計摩擦會高估有揚壓時的抗滑能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抗滑摩擦與揚壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Friction depends on effective normal force rather than gross weight. Uplift and load combinations alter contact. A cohesionless expression estimates one resistance component, not complete stability in jointed rock; roughness, dilation and degradation require suitable testing and analysis before using a strength parameter. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check measured uplift and interface shear testing and list load combinations separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using gross weight for friction overstates resistance when uplift acts. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sliding friction and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：totalDownwardForce=90000 kN; uplift=20000 kN; frictionCoefficient=0.7; frictionResistance=(90000-20000)*0.7=49000 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: totalDownwardForce=90000 kN; uplift=20000 kN; frictionCoefficient=0.7; frictionResistance=(90000-20000)*0.7=49000 kN.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「抗滑摩擦與揚壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding friction and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用總自重計摩擦會高估有揚壓時的抗滑能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對揚壓量測與接觸剪力試驗並分列各荷載組合，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using gross weight for friction overstates resistance when uplift acts. Diagnose it by the following check: Check measured uplift and interface shear testing and list load combinations separately. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「揚壓只影響抗浮而不影響滑動摩擦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uplift affects flotation only and never sliding friction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水化熱與拘束」與「帷幕試驗與滲透」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydration heat and restraint" and "Curtain testing and permeability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水化熱與拘束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydration heat and restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水化熱與拘束」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydration heat and restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大量混凝土的內外溫差與基礎拘束可形成熱應力，澆置分塊及降溫歷程影響開裂。單軸完全拘束且橫向可自由變形的線彈性公式只是應力量級，實際徐變、成熟度與裂縫會鬆弛應力；應用溫度與應變同步紀錄判斷，而非只量表面溫度。 驗證時應比較核心表面溫度與埋設應變並記錄混凝土齡期，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略徐變或拘束差異會使彈性熱應力被誤當實測值。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水化熱與拘束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mass concrete develops thermal stress through gradients and restraint. Block placement and cooling history affect cracking. An elastic estimate with full axial restraint and free lateral deformation gives a uniaxial stress scale only; creep, maturity and cracking relax stress. Interpret temperature and strain together rather than using surface temperature as the full thermal state. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare core and surface temperatures with embedded strain and concrete age. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring creep or restraint differences turns an elastic estimate into a false measured stress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydration heat and restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Uniaxial full axial restraint with free lateral deformation: E=25 GPa; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=12 K; elasticStress=25e9*10e-6*12/1e6=3 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Uniaxial full axial restraint with free lateral deformation: E=25 GPa; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=12 K; elasticStress=25e9*10e-6*12/1e6=3 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全拘束彈性熱應力就是所有實際位置的應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fully restrained elastic thermal stress equals stress at every actual location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水化熱與拘束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydration heat and restraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水化熱與拘束
knowledge.text: 大量混凝土的內外溫差與基礎拘束可形成熱應力，澆置分塊及降溫歷程影響開裂。單軸完全拘束且橫向可自由變形的線彈性公式只是應力量級，實際徐變、成熟度與裂縫會鬆弛應力；應用溫度與應變同步紀錄判斷，而非只量表面溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Mass concrete develops thermal stress through gradients and restraint. Block placement and cooling history affect cracking.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完全拘束彈性熱應力就是所有實際位置的應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fully restrained elastic thermal stress equals stress at every actual location Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水化熱與拘束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydration heat and restraint" is correct?
options: 完全拘束彈性熱應力就是所有實際位置的應力
大量混凝土的內外溫差與基礎拘束可形成熱應力，澆置分塊及降溫歷程影響開裂。
灌漿量越多就必定代表防滲效果越好
optionsEn: Fully restrained elastic thermal stress equals stress at every actual location
Mass concrete develops thermal stress through gradients and restraint.
More injected grout necessarily means better seepage control
quiz.explanation: 大量混凝土的內外溫差與基礎拘束可形成熱應力，澆置分塊及降溫歷程影響開裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mass concrete develops thermal stress through gradients and restraint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水化熱與拘束：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Uniaxial full axial restraint with free lateral deformation: E=25 GPa; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=12 K; elasticStress=25e9*10e-6*12/1e6=3 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Uniaxial full axial restraint with free lateral deformation: E=25 GPa; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=12 K; elasticStress=25e9*10e-6*12/1e6=3 MPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較核心表面溫度與埋設應變並記錄混凝土齡期。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curtain testing and permeability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌漿帷幕應改變裂隙導水而非只追求灌入量，取芯、壓水與監測資料共同評估效果。前後流量比只能在同壓差及試段條件下比較，不能直接等同整壩滲透率降幅；地下水路重分配需靠廊道孔壓與流量追蹤。 驗證時應保持試段長度壓差一致並比較帷幕上下游孔壓，並辨識以下失效情境：只看灌漿量多會誤把遠處流失當有效封堵。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「帷幕試驗與滲透」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A grout curtain should alter fracture conductance, not merely absorb grout volume. Compare pressure tests, cores and monitoring. A before-and-after flow ratio requires matching test intervals and pressure; it does not directly equal whole-dam permeability reduction because pathways may redistribute through the foundation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Match interval length and pressure and compare heads on both sides of the curtain. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curtain testing and permeability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看灌漿量多會誤把遠處流失當有效封堵。診斷時應採取以下查核：保持試段長度壓差一致並比較帷幕上下游孔壓，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Large grout take can represent loss elsewhere instead of effective sealing. Diagnose it by the following check: Match interval length and pressure and compare heads on both sides of the curtain. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿量越多就必定代表防滲效果越好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More injected grout necessarily means better seepage control" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

A plumb-line difference necessarily equals absolute geographic dam movement
Large grout take can represent loss elsewhere instead of effective sealing.

quiz.explanationEn: Large grout take can represent loss elsewhere instead of effective sealing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Plumb-line movement and temperature" and "High-head conveyance and net energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂線位移與溫度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「垂線位移與溫度」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plumb-line movement and temperature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩內垂線與外部測量可追蹤壩體位移，但基準點穩定與溫度水位效應需分開。差值代表相對運動而非絕對地盤移動，參考端本身若漂移需額外控制；應用長期可逆模式辨認新的不可逆殘差。 驗證時應以外部控制網與倒垂線比較基準穩定並核對季節循環，並辨識以下失效情境：基準端移動可使壩體看似發生相反方向位移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂線位移與溫度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal plumb lines and external surveys track movement, but reference stability and temperature-stage effects need separation. A difference is relative motion, not absolute ground movement. If the reference moves, independent control is needed; use reversible long-term patterns to identify a new irreversible residual. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare reference stability using external control and inverted plumb lines and check seasonal cycles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plumb-line movement and temperature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm.

steps.title: 垂線位移與溫度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂線位移與溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plumb-line movement and temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以外部控制網與倒垂線比較基準穩定並核對季節循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare reference stability using external control and inverted plumb lines and check seasonal cycles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredRelativeDisplacement=18 mm; temperatureStageBaseline=13 mm; residual=18-13=5 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 垂線位移與溫度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plumb-line movement and temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以外部控制網與倒垂線比較基準穩定並核對季節循環。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「基準端移動可使壩體看似發生相反方向位移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare reference stability using external control and inverted plumb lines and check seasonal cycles. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

knowledge.textEn: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare reference stability using external control and inverted plumb lines and check seasonal cycles. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「垂線位移與溫度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plumb-line movement and temperature" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 基準端移動可使壩體看似發生相反方向位移。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
壩高就是整個高山水電系統的總發電落差
optionsEn: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dam height equals the full generating head of an alpine scheme
quiz.explanation: 基準端移動可使壩體看似發生相反方向位移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reference movement can make the dam appear to move in the opposite direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高落差輸水與淨能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High-head conveyance and net energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高落差輸水與淨能量」如何影響大迪克桑斯壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-head conveyance and net energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grande Dixence Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山蓄水到低處電廠的高程差提供勢能，輸水損失與抽水投入則影響淨能量。以指定流量與淨水頭估出力只代表單一工作點，不能把壩高等同全系統落差；水路壓力、暫態與機組效率需另作聯合驗證。 驗證時應同步核對上下游能量線機組功率及抽水投入，並辨識以下失效情境：把發電毛能量當淨收益會漏掉抽水與輸水損失。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高落差輸水與淨能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elevation difference from alpine storage to lower generating plants supplies potential energy, while losses and pumping inputs affect net benefit. Power at specified flow and net head is one operating point. Dam height is not total scheme head; waterway pressures, transients and efficiency require joint verification. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check energy lines, generating power and pumping input over matching periods. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating gross generation as net benefit omits pumping input and conveyance losses. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High-head conveyance and net energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HypotheticalQ=25 m3/s; netHead=900 m; efficiency=0.92; power=1000*9.81*25*900*0.92/1e6=203.067 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalQ=25 m3/s; netHead=900 m; efficiency=0.92; power=1000*9.81*25*900*0.92/1e6=203.067 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高就是整個高山水電系統的總發電落差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height equals the full generating head of an alpine scheme" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高落差輸水與淨能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High-head conveyance and net energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高落差輸水與淨能量

knowledge.textEn: Elevation difference from alpine storage to lower generating plants supplies potential energy, while losses and pumping inputs affect net benefit. Power at specified flow and net head is one operating point.

knowledge.text: 誤解：壩高就是整個高山水電系統的總發電落差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「高落差輸水與淨能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-head conveyance and net energy" is correct?
options: 壩高就是整個高山水電系統的總發電落差

optionsEn: Dam height equals the full generating head of an alpine scheme
Elevation difference from alpine storage to lower generating plants supplies potential energy, while losses and pumping inputs affect net benefit.
Every collected water volume necessarily becomes generating water

steps.title: 高落差輸水與淨能量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高落差輸水與淨能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-head conveyance and net energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HypotheticalQ=25 m3/s; netHead=900 m; efficiency=0.92; power=1000*9.81*25*900*0.92/1e6=203.067 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalQ=25 m3/s; netHead=900 m; efficiency=0.92; power=1000*9.81*25*900*0.92/1e6=203.067 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步核對上下游能量線機組功率及抽水投入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check energy lines, generating power and pumping input over matching periods.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 高落差輸水與淨能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-head conveyance and net energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高落差輸水與淨能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-head conveyance and net energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步核對上下游能量線機組功率及抽水投入。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把發電毛能量當淨收益會漏掉抽水與輸水損失」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check energy lines, generating power and pumping input over matching periods. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Treating gross generation as net benefit omits pumping input and conveyance losses. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步核對上下游能量線機組功率及抽水投入作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把發電毛能量當淨收益會漏掉抽水與輸水損失，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check energy lines, generating power and pumping input over matching periods. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Treating gross generation as net benefit omits pumping input and conveyance losses. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把發電毛能量當淨收益會漏掉抽水與輸水損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating gross generation as net benefit omits pumping input and conveyance losses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

title: 德基水庫大壩
summary: 德基課程把高拱壩、岩盤差異位移與大甲溪梯級發電放在共同的能量與量測架構中。跨流域水量、密度底流、管壁環向應力與水錘傳播各有不同邊界，不能只靠一個水頭數字判斷。最後以停機水量帳和儀器取樣問題檢查發電估算是否保持物理一致。
summaryEn: The Deji course connects a high arch dam, differential rock movement and cascading generation through energy and measurement. Diversion water balance, density underflows, pipe hoop stress and water-hammer travel each require distinct boundaries rather than a single head value. Outage accounting and instrument sampling then test whether an energy estimate remains physically consistent.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想兩級發電共用每秒十五立方公尺流量，淨水頭為二百及一百二十公尺、效率為零點九及零點八八，總功率由各級功率相加得四十二點零二六兆瓦。第二級效率下降到零點八時總量成四十點六一三四兆瓦，不能把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭。另一個假想鋼管半徑一點二公尺、壁厚零點零二公尺、內壓二兆帕，薄壁環向應力為一百二十兆帕；此式屬受拉管壁，不是受壓拱壩的設計應力。 核驗：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two generating stages carry the same 15 m3/s, with net heads 200 and 120 m and efficiencies 0.9 and 0.88. Adding stage powers gives 42.026 MW. If the second efficiency falls to 0.8, the total becomes 40.6134 MW; adding the two discharges and multiplying by combined head would double count water. A separate hypothetical steel pipe with radius 1.2 m, thickness 0.02 m and pressure 2 MPa has thin-wall hoop tension of 120 MPa. This pipe equation describes tension and is not an arch-dam compressive stress calculation. Verification: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梯級發電的能量相加」與「高壩底壓與水推力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy addition across a cascade" and "Base pressure and water resultant": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「梯級發電的能量相加」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy addition across a cascade” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大甲溪梯級背景讓同一股水在不同高程依序釋放位能，每級只能利用其邊界內的淨水頭。功率應逐級計算再相加，不能把同一股串聯流量先相加又乘總落差。若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梯級發電的能量相加」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. Stage powers are calculated separately and added; adding the same serial flow first and multiplying by combined head double counts water. Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy addition across a cascade” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「梯級發電的能量相加」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy addition across a cascade”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. Stage powers are calculated separately and added; adding the same serial flow first and multiplying by combined head double counts water.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「梯級發電的能量相加」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭

optionsEn: Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head

quiz.explanationEn: In a cascade, the same water releases potential energy at successive elevations, with each stage using only the net head within its boundary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梯級發電的能量相加」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy addition across a cascade” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW。適用邊界：兩級相同穩定流量且水頭為各級淨值，未使用德基實際機組參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=15 m3/s; H1=200 m; H2=120 m; eta1=0.9; eta2=0.88; P=rho g Q(H1 eta1+H2 eta2)/1e6=42.02604 MW. Applicable boundary: Two stages share constant flow and stage-specific net heads; no actual Deji machine parameters are used. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梯級發電的能量相加」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy addition across a cascade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.

knowledge.text: 將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
knowledge.textEn: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梯級發電的能量相加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy addition across a cascade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梯級發電的能量相加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice.
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level

quiz.explanationEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高壩底壓與水推力」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base pressure and water resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高壩底壓與水推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared. Pressure is force per area, whereas the resultant enters overall equilibrium. Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base pressure and water resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高壩底壓與水推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base pressure and water resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高壩底壓與水推力
knowledge.text: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。
optionsEn: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force.
quiz.explanation: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高壩底壓與水推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base pressure and water resultant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base pressure and water resultant” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors.

knowledge.textEn: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高壩底壓與水推力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base pressure and water resultant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」與「濃密入流的底流尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential abutment movement scale" and "Density underflow velocity scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential abutment movement scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential abutment movement scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩兩岸共同平移與兩岸相對位移有不同結構意義，後者才會改變跨距或扭曲形狀。以相對位移除基準長度可得到平均幾何應變，便於比較監測量級；這不是局部混凝土應變，也沒有包含支承轉角。儀器的共同基準若一起移動，可能掩蓋絕對運動卻仍保留部分相對量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Common translation of both abutments differs from relative movement, which can change span or distort the arch. Relative displacement divided by reference length gives an average geometric strain useful for comparing measurement scales, not local concrete strain and not support rotation. Movement of a shared instrument reference may hide absolute motion while leaving some relative measurements intact, so reference geometry belongs in the interpretation. Relative displacement divided by reference length gives an average geometric strain useful for comparing measurement scales, not local concrete strain and not support rotation.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002。適用邊界：兩位移為沿原跨距連線方向的軸向投影，採小變形及同一穩定基準，只求跨距平均正應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002. Applicable boundary: Both movements are axial projections along the original span line, using small deformation and one stable datum; only span-average normal strain is calculated. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 先將左右岸位移投影到原跨距連線軸線並確認小變形假設，再扣除共同平移量，確認毫米與公尺已轉換。以外部穩定測點閉合測量網，另記旋轉與垂直位移，避免一個水平差值被誤認為完整岩盤變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Project both movements onto the original span axis and verify the small-deformation assumption, remove common translation and convert millimetres to metres. Close the survey network against external stable points while separately recording rotation and vertical motion, so one horizontal difference is not treated as complete rock deformation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將左右岸都額外平移三毫米，重算相對應變並比較絕對位移，然後增加一個支承轉角，說明為何單一跨距應變無法描述新的變形模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add three millimetres of common translation to both sides and compare relative strain with absolute movement. Then introduce support rotation and explain why one span-average strain cannot describe the added deformation mode.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把左右岸位移絕對值相加而不看方向，可能把共同平移誤認為跨距改變；若基準點位於同一移動岩塊上，則可能得到很小差值而漏掉整體位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding absolute movement magnitudes without direction can turn common translation into apparent span change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 含砂較多的入流水可能比庫水密度大，沿底部向前推進形成密度流。以密度差定義約化重力，再與流層厚度組合可估算浮力控制的速度尺度。這個尺度不是底流實際速度，因為坡度、摩擦、混合與顆粒沉降都會改變流體密度及厚度，沿途不一定維持同一狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濃密入流的底流尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density underflow velocity scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s。適用邊界：小密度差的特徵速度，未選經驗福祿係數或推定真實底流到達時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 濃密入流的底流尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Density underflow velocity scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濃密入流的底流尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density underflow velocity scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測入口與庫內不同深度的密度或含砂剖面，將溫度造成的密度差也分開。以多個測站到達時間估算傳播，對照流層厚度變化，檢查沿途混合是否讓原先密度差逐漸減弱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure density or sediment profiles at the inlet and several reservoir depths while separating temperature contributions. Estimate propagation from arrival times at multiple stations and compare changing current thickness to determine whether entrainment weakens the original density contrast. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把流層厚度加倍而密度差減半，重算速度尺度並解釋為何數值可能不變，但兩個流場的混合、沉降與幾何條件仍然不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double thickness while halving density contrast, recalculate the velocity scale and explain why its value may stay unchanged even though mixing, settling and geometric conditions differ between the two currents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Holding inlet density contrast constant throughout the reservoir neglects entrainment and settling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 濃密入流的底流尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density underflow velocity scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濃密入流的底流尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density underflow velocity scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Holding inlet density contrast constant throughout the reservoir neglects entrainment and settling. Turning a velocity scale into a precise arrival forecast also treats omitted topography and resistance as absent rather than unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個尺度不是底流實際速度，因為坡度、摩擦、混合與顆粒沉降都會改變流體密度及厚度，沿途不一定維持同一狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not the actual underflow speed, because slope, friction, entrainment and particle settling alter density and thickness as the current advances, so conditions need not remain constant along the irregular reservoir floor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮力速度尺度就是可直接預報的真實底流速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The buoyancy velocity scale directly predicts the actual underflow speed" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濃密入流的底流尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。

steps.title: 越域引水的獨立水量帳：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 跨流域引水增加的是實際通過邊界的水，而非來源集水區全部降雨。德基背景的假想日水量帳把本地入流、引入流、機組用水與其他損失分開，避免把同一水量在來源及目的地重複計入。若隧道或中間池有暫存，兩端同時刻流量也可能不一致，需在更小控制體補上蓄量項。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「越域引水的獨立水量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interbasin diversion adds water that actually crosses a boundary, not all rainfall over the source catchment. A daily account separates local inflow, imported flow, generation release and other losses to avoid counting one transfer twice. Storage in a tunnel or intermediate pool can make simultaneous endpoint flows differ, requiring an additional storage term in the smaller control volume rather than an unexplained balance error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Separate diversion water accounting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「越域引水的獨立水量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 越域引水的獨立水量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Separate diversion water accounting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「越域引水的獨立水量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Separate diversion water accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將引水兩端資料依旅行時間對齊，核對水表累積值的起迄時刻，並把中間暫存單獨列出。對來源河川保留未引走流量，目的水庫只入帳實際收到的水，避免用設計流量代替量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align diversion endpoint records for travel time, check cumulative-meter interval boundaries and account for intermediate storage. Retain undiverted flow in the source-river balance and credit the destination only with water received, not nominal design discharge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把引入水量減半，重新求日蓄量變化，再列出源頭及目的地兩本水量帳，證明對整個系統而言內部轉水應相互抵銷而不是創造新水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve imported water and recalculate daily storage change. Write separate source and destination accounts and show that an internal transfer cancels in the combined system instead of creating additional water.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：來源流量、引水量與目的地入流同時相加會把轉送水重複計算；用設計輸水能力乘整日時間也可能高估實際供水，因為水源不足或停機會改變可送水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding source flow, diversion flow and destination inflow together duplicates transferred water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Separate diversion water accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 來源流量、引水量與目的地入流同時相加會把轉送水重複計算；用設計輸水能力乘整日時間也可能高估實際供水，因為水源不足或停機會改變可送水量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding source flow, diversion flow and destination inflow together duplicates transferred water. Multiplying design capacity by a whole day can overstate delivery when source scarcity or outages limit the quantity actually conveyed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若隧道或中間池有暫存，兩端同時刻流量也可能不一致，需在更小控制體補上蓄量項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Storage in a tunnel or intermediate pool can make simultaneous endpoint flows differ, requiring an additional storage term in the smaller control volume rather than an unexplained balance error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objective: 說明「局部低壓與汽化裕度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local pressure and cavitation index” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速出流區的壓力若接近該水溫的蒸氣壓，可能產生汽化空穴，後續在高壓區潰滅造成侵蝕。氣蝕指數把絕對壓力超過蒸氣壓的差額除以動壓，提供相對尺度；各種幾何具有不同臨界條件，指數本身不能直接宣告安全，更不能把表壓與絕對蒸氣壓混用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部低壓與汽化裕度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If local pressure approaches vapor pressure at the water temperature, cavities can form and later collapse in a higher-pressure region. A cavitation index divides the absolute-pressure margin above vapor pressure by dynamic pressure. It provides a relative scale, not a universal safe threshold, because critical behavior depends on geometry. Gauge pressure must not be mixed with absolute vapor pressure in the numerator. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local pressure and cavitation index” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部低壓與汽化裕度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 核對壓力儀表是否已加大氣壓，並記錄水溫以選對蒸氣壓。以局部速度而非管道平均值估算動壓，對照表面形狀與脈動資料，將氣蝕、磨蝕及化學侵蝕的證據分開檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm whether atmospheric pressure has been included and record water temperature for vapor pressure. Use local rather than blindly averaged velocity, compare geometry and pressure fluctuations, and distinguish evidence of cavitation from abrasion and chemical deterioration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持局部壓力不變，把速度提高百分之十，重算指數並說明平方速度的影響，再列出真實流場中壓力也可能同步改變的原因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold local pressure fixed, increase velocity ten percent and recalculate the index. Explain the squared-velocity effect and identify reasons why pressure itself may change simultaneously in a real flow field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部低壓與汽化裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local pressure and cavitation index"?
