steps.title: 局部低壓與汽化裕度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local pressure and cavitation index: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部低壓與汽化裕度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local pressure and cavitation index” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Equal average indices can still accompany different local accelerations and pressure fluctuations around surface irregularities, so one mean value cannot exclude local cavitation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣蝕指數把絕對壓力超過蒸氣壓的差額除以動壓，提供相對尺度；各種幾何具有不同臨界條件，指數本身不能直接宣告安全，更不能把表壓與絕對蒸氣壓混用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gauge pressure must not be mixed with absolute vapor pressure in the numerator.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表壓可以直接減去絕對蒸氣壓來算氣蝕指數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gauge pressure can directly subtract absolute vapor pressure in a cavitation index" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Equal average indices can still accompany different local accelerations and pressure fluctuations around surface irregularities, so one mean value cannot exclude local cavitation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部低壓與汽化裕度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local pressure and cavitation index" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼管環向拉應力」與「壓力波往返時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel pipe hoop tension" and "Pressure wave round trip time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管環向拉應力」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel pipe hoop tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。薄壁圓管可由切開半圓截面的平衡推得壓力乘半徑除壁厚的平均環向應力。壁厚相對半徑必須小，且此式不包含焊縫缺陷、腐蝕減薄、支承彎曲或壓力循環疲勞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼管環向拉應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. Cutting a thin circular pipe into halves gives mean hoop stress as pressure times radius divided by wall thickness. Thickness must be small relative to radius, and the relation excludes weld defects, corrosion loss, support bending and fatigue caused by repeated pressure cycles. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel pipe hoop tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼管環向拉應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steel pipe hoop tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼管環向拉應力
knowledge.text: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。薄壁圓管可由切開半圓截面的平衡推得壓力乘半徑除壁厚的平均環向應力。
knowledge.textEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. Cutting a thin circular pipe into halves gives mean hoop stress as pressure times radius divided by wall thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼管環向拉應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel pipe hoop tension" is correct?
options: 受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。
壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速
optionsEn: A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch.
Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe
quiz.explanation: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼管環向拉應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel pipe hoop tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。適用邊界：薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Applicable boundary: Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently derive the relation from pressure on a half-pipe projection balanced by two tensile sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。適用邊界：薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Applicable boundary: Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼管環向拉應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel pipe hoop tension", which statement holds?
options: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失
壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。
optionsEn: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管環向拉應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel pipe hoop tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。檢查量測位置、焊縫與支承附近是否需局部分析，並把壓力最高值與疲勞循環範圍分開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently derive the relation from pressure on a half-pipe projection balanced by two tensile sections. Compare using measured minimum rather than nominal thickness, identify weld and support regions needing local analysis, and separate peak pressure from fatigue-cycle range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把有效壁厚降到十六毫米，重算環向應力並求增加百分比，再討論局部點蝕為何不能只用平均厚度減少量代表其應力集中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce effective thickness to sixteen millimetres, recalculate hoop stress and percentage increase, then explain why localized pitting cannot be represented solely by a uniform reduction in average wall thickness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用名目厚度而忽略局部腐蝕會低估應力；把這個受拉管壁公式解讀成拱壩受壓驗證，雖形式相似卻混淆不同邊界與失效機制，不能互相替代。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring local corrosion while using nominal thickness understates stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。檢查量測位置、焊縫與支承附近是否需局部分析，並把壓力最高值與疲勞循環範圍分開。

steps.title: 壓力波往返時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure wave round trip time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瞬變分析先要知道壓力訊息在水路中的傳播尺度，往返時間由兩倍管長除波速得到。它不是水粒子通過管線所需時間，也不是機組旋轉週期。把假想流量變化時間與往返時間比較，可判斷反射是否會在變化過程中返回，但多分支、調壓室及氣穴會使單管圖像需要擴充。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力波往返時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transient interpretation starts with the time for a pressure signal to travel through the waterway and return, equal to twice length divided by wave speed. This is neither water-particle travel time nor machine rotation period. Comparing a hypothetical flow-change duration with this scale reveals whether reflections return during the change, while branches, surge chambers and cavities require more than the single-pipe picture. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure wave round trip time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 壓力波往返時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure wave round trip time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力波往返時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure wave round trip time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s。適用邊界：單一均勻管段且波速固定，只計傳播時間而非瞬變壓力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s. Applicable boundary: A single uniform pipe segment with constant wave speed; propagation time only, not transient pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從兩支壓力感測器波峰的時間差估算波速，確認取樣時鐘同步並保留量測距離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate wave speed from peak arrival differences at two synchronized pressure sensors with a known separation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均流速代替波速會把秒級訊息傳播誤算成很長的旅行時間；只因變化時間大於往返時間就宣告沒有水錘，也忽略反射疊加及邊界條件可能仍產生瞬變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「地震記錄的取樣尺度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling scale for seismic records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震感測器輸出若以離散時間記錄，取樣率決定可辨識的頻率上限。理想奈奎斯特條件要求取樣頻率超過最高訊號頻率兩倍，但實務還要抗混疊濾波及保留相位精度。高取樣率不能補救飽和、感測器安裝鬆動或時鐘不同步，所以監測鏈須從物理感測到資料處理一起檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震記錄的取樣尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete earthquake records can resolve only a limited frequency range set by sampling rate. The ideal Nyquist condition requires sampling above twice the highest signal frequency, while practical systems also need anti-alias filtering and adequate phase accuracy. High sampling alone cannot repair sensor saturation, loose mounting or unsynchronized clocks, so the full chain from physical sensing to data processing must be examined as one measurement system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling scale for seismic records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling scale for seismic records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「地震記錄的取樣尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling scale for seismic records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling scale for seismic records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。適用邊界：理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz. Applicable boundary: Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知頻率訊號做桌上資料實驗，逐步降取樣觀察假頻率，保留抗混疊濾波前後紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a known-frequency signal in a desktop experiment, downsample progressively and observe apparent frequencies while preserving before-and-after filter records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。適用邊界：理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz. Applicable boundary: Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度

Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz.

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling scale for seismic records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地震記錄的取樣尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling scale for seismic records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知頻率訊號做桌上資料實驗，逐步降取樣觀察假頻率，保留抗混疊濾波前後紀錄。同步檢查滿量程、安裝方向與時鐘漂移，不能只看檔案每秒筆數就判定地震資料品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a known-frequency signal in a desktop experiment, downsample progressively and observe apparent frequencies while preserving before-and-after filter records. Check full scale, mounting orientation and clock drift rather than judging earthquake data quality solely by samples per second. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：產生一個七十赫茲正弦波，分別以二百與一百赫茲取樣並比較表觀頻率，說明抗混疊濾波需在何時介入，以及這個實驗不代表實際壩體頻率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Generate a seventy-hertz sinusoid, sample at two hundred and one hundred hertz and compare apparent frequencies. Explain when anti-alias filtering must intervene and why this experiment does not identify a real dam vibration frequency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未濾掉高頻就降取樣會把高頻折返成假低頻，可能誤認壩體出現新的振動模態；若感測器早已飽和，即使取樣率很高也無法重建被削平的真實峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Downsampling without removing high frequencies aliases them into false lower frequencies that may resemble a new vibration mode. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機發電量與留存水量」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outage energy and retained water” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。德基梯級背景的停機帳應同時追蹤水量，避免把短期延後發電誤稱永久損失。若水位因留存上升，後續淨水頭也可能變動，使固定功率估計只是一階比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機發電量與留存水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. A cascade outage account must therefore follow water as well as electricity, distinguishing delayed generation from permanent loss. Retained water may change level and subsequent net head, making constant-power multiplication only a first-order comparison. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outage energy and retained water” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機發電量與留存水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Outage energy and retained water”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停機發電量與留存水量
knowledge.text: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。德基梯級背景的停機帳應同時追蹤水量，避免把短期延後發電誤稱永久損失。
knowledge.textEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. A cascade outage account must therefore follow water as well as electricity, distinguishing delayed generation from permanent loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停機發電量與留存水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage energy and retained water" is correct?
options: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失
機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。
串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭
optionsEn: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently
Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later.
Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
quiz.explanation: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機發電量與留存水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outage energy and retained water” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。適用邊界：固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Applicable boundary: Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。適用邊界：固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Applicable boundary: Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停機發電量與留存水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage energy and retained water", which statement holds?
options: 兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水

Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機發電量與留存水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outage energy and retained water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。對後續補發只計實際新增能量，避免把原本就會發出的基線電量重複列為恢復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Count only genuinely additional later generation as recovery, avoiding credit for baseline energy that would have been produced anyway. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設一半留水能於後續以相同淨水頭利用，求可補回能量，再改變後續效率做敏感度分析，清楚區分延後電量、旁通損失與未知部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assume half the retained water is later used at the same net head, calculate recoverable energy and vary subsequent efficiency. Distinguish deferred generation, bypass loss and unresolved quantities in the final account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。對後續補發只計實際新增能量，避免把原本就會發出的基線電量重複列為恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Count only genuinely additional later generation as recovery, avoiding credit for baseline energy that would have been produced anyway.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 假設一半留水能於後續以相同淨水頭利用，求可補回能量，再改變後續效率做敏感度分析，清楚區分延後電量、旁通損失與未知部分。
knowledge.textEn: Assume half the retained water is later used at the same net head, calculate recoverable energy and vary subsequent efficiency. Distinguish deferred generation, bypass loss and unresolved quantities in the final account.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停機發電量與留存水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage energy and retained water"?
options: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停機發電量與留存水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outage energy and retained water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Claiming complete recovery can instead ignore spill, timing constraints and downstream demand; both extremes fail to close the multi-period water-energy account. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若水位因留存上升，後續淨水頭也可能變動，使固定功率估計只是一階比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retained water may change level and subsequent net head, making constant-power multiplication only a first-order comparison.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Claiming complete recovery can instead ignore spill, timing constraints and downstream demand; both extremes fail to close the multi-period water-energy account.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停機發電量與留存水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage energy and retained water" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。
串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water.
Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
quiz.explanation: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 曾文水庫大壩
summary: 曾文案例將土石壩內的有效應力及排水，連到下游串聯水庫、灌溉渠道與水能利用。學生把閘門出流、消能功率與泥砂質量分開記帳，再核對渠道容量、田間需水及壩頂沉陷趨勢。全課以假想資料檢驗物理關係，避免把容量相加當成可以任意調度的同一水池。
summaryEn: The Tsengwen case links effective stress and drainage inside an embankment to downstream serial storage, irrigation canals and energy recovery. Learners keep gate discharge, dissipated power and sediment mass in separate accounts before checking canal capacity, field demand and settlement trends. Hypothetical data test physical relationships without treating two reservoir capacities as one freely interchangeable pool.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想曾文上游水池每天流入一百二十萬立方公尺，輸往下游八十萬、其他損失十萬，蓄量增加三十萬立方公尺。下游接收八十萬，灌溉取走七十萬、損失五萬，增加五萬；全系統增加三十五萬，內部轉水應互相抵銷。若下游需求增百分之二十到八十四萬，下游轉成減少九萬而全系統只增二十一萬。另以六百毫米淨灌溉水深、兩百公頃及效率零點七五求得毛需水一百六十萬立方公尺，不可把效率損失重複扣算。 核驗：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。
workedExample.textEn: Assume the upper reservoir receives 1.2 million m3 per day, transfers 0.8 million and loses 0.1 million; storage rises by 0.3 million m3. The lower pool receives that transfer, supplies 0.7 million and loses 0.05 million, gaining 0.05 million. System storage therefore rises by 0.35 million, with the internal transfer cancelling. Raising lower demand twenty percent to 0.84 million makes its change negative 0.09 million and the system gain 0.21 million. Separately, a 600 mm net depth over 200 ha at efficiency 0.75 requires 1.6 million m3 gross supply. Verification: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「串聯水庫的內部轉水」與「壩體孔壓與有效應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs" and "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串聯水庫的內部轉水」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。分池蓄量仍很重要，因為下游需求不能無視輸水能力與旅行時間。兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串聯水庫的內部轉水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. Individual storage still matters because downstream demand is constrained by conveyance capacity and travel time. A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日封閉雙池系統，內部轉水抵銷，沒有額外下游天然入流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: A two-pool daily system with internal transfers cancelling and no additional natural inflow to the lower pool. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「串聯水庫的內部轉水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將下游需求增加百分之二十，重新求系統與各池蓄量差，再指定內部轉水八十萬立方公尺每天，證明總帳不因轉水名稱而改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.

knowledge.textEn: Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「串聯水庫的內部轉水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「串聯水庫的內部轉水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。
孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources.
Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壩體孔壓與有效應力」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壩體孔壓與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance. Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
knowledge.text: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。
knowledge.textEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壩體孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" is correct?
options: 孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。
optionsEn: Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。適用邊界：飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Applicable boundary: One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。適用邊界：飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Applicable boundary: One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。
每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力
發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa.
Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure
Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壩體孔壓與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。將量測高程與水壓基準寫清楚，並以多點剖面辨識局部孔壓，避免把一個平均值套到整個壩坡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Record elevation and pressure datum and use multiple points to identify local conditions rather than assigning one average to an entire slope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。將量測高程與水壓基準寫清楚，並以多點剖面辨識局部孔壓，避免把一個平均值套到整個壩坡。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Record elevation and pressure datum and use multiple points to identify local conditions rather than assigning one average to an entire slope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。
knowledge.textEn: Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壩體孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。
兩次量測求出的平均沉陷速率必定可永久線性外推
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles.
An average settlement rate from two surveys can always be extrapolated indefinitely
quiz.explanation: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. During drainage blockage, total stress may stay almost unchanged while skeleton stress falls, so total-pressure observations alone can miss the important change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。
knowledge.textEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. During drainage blockage, total stress may stay almost unchanged while skeleton stress falls, so total-pressure observations alone can miss the important change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壩體孔壓與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation.
quiz.explanation: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水層的導水阻力」與「假想閘下出流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer" and "Hypothetical gated underflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水層的導水阻力」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。達西式可由流量反推所需水頭損失，顯示濾料堵塞或有效面積縮小會提高上游水頭。導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水層的導水阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. Rearranging Darcy's relation gives the head loss required to pass a flow, showing why clogging or reduced effective area increases upstream head. Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水層的導水阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。將維護清理、細料出現與降雨時段一起標記，再檢查水頭升高是來水增加還是阻力增加，不能只看流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence. Mark cleaning, observed fines and rainfall periods, then determine whether rising head reflects increased inflow or increased resistance rather than interpreting discharge alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把滲透係數減半並保持流量不變，重算所需水頭差，再把截面也減少四分之一，比較兩種劣化疊加的效果與量測所需證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve permeability at fixed flow and recalculate required head difference, then also reduce area by one quarter. Compare the combined effects and identify measurements needed to distinguish the two deterioration mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Local blockage can redirect flow through bypasses, leaving total drainage similar while changing the internal pore-pressure distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 假想閘下出流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hypothetical gated underflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「假想閘下出流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hypothetical gated underflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出開口中心與自由水面，核對水頭定義後用量水設施求實際係數。比較不同開度的係數是否穩定，記錄尾水變化和水面波動，再決定簡單孔口式是否足以描述該測試區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw opening center and free surface, verify the head definition and infer discharge coefficient from measurements. Compare coefficients across openings while recording tailwater and surface fluctuations before deciding whether a simple orifice relation describes the tested range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將假想開口高度減半但暫維持中心水頭，求流量變化，再重新加入中心位置改變，說明分步比較有助於分辨面積與水頭兩種效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve opening height while temporarily holding center head fixed, then account for the changed center elevation. Explain how the two-step comparison separates area effects from the effect of altered hydraulic head.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把開口高度改變造成的中心高程變化完全忽略，會使大幅開度比較不一致；尾水淹沒後仍使用自由出流式，則可能高估通量並錯配下游水量帳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the changing opening-center elevation can make comparisons inconsistent over large opening changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hypothetical gated underflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把開口高度改變造成的中心高程變化完全忽略，會使大幅開度比較不一致；尾水淹沒後仍使用自由出流式，則可能高估通量並錯配下游水量帳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the changing opening-center elevation can make comparisons inconsistent over large opening changes. Retaining a free-discharge equation after submergence can overstate flow and distort the downstream water balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：曾文案例的教學參數完全是假想，不是現地閘門開度表，計算目的是理解水頭平方根與開口面積的一次關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All parameters here are hypothetical rather than a Tsengwen gate schedule; the purpose is to distinguish square-root head dependence from linear dependence on opening area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「消能區的功率通量」與「近底取水的輸砂效率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power flux in a dissipating reach" and "Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 消能區的功率通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Power flux in a dissipating reach: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「消能區的功率通量」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power flux in a dissipating reach” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。把功率除以示意面積得到平均面功率通量，有助比較能量集中程度，但單位不是壓力，不能直接當作混凝土或岩盤承受的力。局部沖刷還取決於流向、脈動、材料與持續時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「消能區的功率通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. Discharge times head loss gives dissipated power, and dividing by an illustrative area gives mean areal power flux. This compares energy concentration but is not pressure or a structural force. Local scour additionally depends on flow direction, fluctuations, material resistance and duration, so equal mean flux does not imply equal damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Power flux in a dissipating reach” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「消能區的功率通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Power flux in a dissipating reach”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 消能區的功率通量
knowledge.titleEn: Power flux in a dissipating reach
knowledge.text: 溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。把功率除以示意面積得到平均面功率通量，有助比較能量集中程度，但單位不是壓力，不能直接當作混凝土或岩盤承受的力。
knowledge.textEn: Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. Discharge times head loss gives dissipated power, and dividing by an illustrative area gives mean areal power flux.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「消能區的功率通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Power flux in a dissipating reach" is correct?
options: 每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力
原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多
溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。

Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval
Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound.
quiz.explanation: 溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 消能區的功率通量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Power flux in a dissipating reach: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「消能區的功率通量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Power flux in a dissipating reach” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2。適用邊界：耗散能量在假想面積上的平均分配，不是局部衝擊壓力或沖刷深度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2. Applicable boundary: Mean dissipated power over a hypothetical area, not local impact pressure or scour depth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以總功率核對流量與水頭損失，再確認除以面積後單位仍含每秒能量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check total power from flow and head loss, then retain the energy-per-time unit after division by area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
