steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Power flux in a dissipating reach” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以總功率核對流量與水頭損失，再確認除以面積後單位仍含每秒能量。比較水槽中的流態與壓力脈動量測，將面功率圖與沖刷地形分開呈現，避免以同一色階暗示兩者一一對應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check total power from flow and head loss, then retain the energy-per-time unit after division by area. Compare flume flow patterns and pressure fluctuations, presenting power-flux and scour maps separately rather than suggesting a one-to-one relationship through shared coloring. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靠近底部的取水可能攜帶較濃泥砂，但輸砂效果應用乾固體質量與放流水量共同衡量，而非只說水看起來很濁。質量濃度本身就是每單位水混合物體積攜帶的固體，乘流量才變成質量率。沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「近底取水的輸砂效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Withdrawal near the bottom may carry more concentrated sediment, but performance requires both dry-solids mass and released water volume rather than visual darkness. Concentration measures solids per mixture volume, and multiplication by flow gives mass rate. Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.titleEn: Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「近底取水的輸砂效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. A large dilute release may consume much water while carrying few solids; both cases require consistent mass and water boundaries for comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。
knowledge.textEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. A large dilute release may consume much water while carrying few solids; both cases require consistent mass and water boundaries for comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「近底取水的輸砂效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗
optionsEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
quiz.explanation: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共同放流的發電與灌溉」與「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy and irrigation from one release" and "Manning scale for an irrigation canal": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同放流的發電與灌溉」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy and irrigation from one release” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。帳目應把通過機組的水列為同一次放流，避免再加成第二份供水；實際是否可共用仍受渠道高程、時間和取水位置限制。發電效率影響能量轉換，不直接把相同比例水量變成不可用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同放流的發電與灌溉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The turbine flow therefore remains a single water transfer rather than a second supply allocation. Actual reuse depends on canal elevation, timing and withdrawal location. Conversion efficiency changes electrical output, not the fraction of water physically remaining, so energy and water ledgers must use different units and boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy and irrigation from one release” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy and irrigation from one release”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy and irrigation from one release” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。適用邊界：同一放流先經假想機組再到下游，未計渠道損失或真實取水配置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW. Applicable boundary: One release passes a hypothetical unit before downstream use, excluding canal losses and actual withdrawal configuration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

options: 毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共同放流的發電與灌溉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy and irrigation from one release” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。比較機組出口及渠道入口累積流量，將中間損失或暫存另外列帳，確認沒有因兩種用途而重複計水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units. Compare cumulative turbine-outlet and canal-inlet flows, accounting for intermediate losses or storage so two services do not create duplicate water allocations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一流量求一日通過水量，再計一日發電量，將兩者以各自單位並列。若渠道另損失百分之五，只修改下游水量帳並說明是否改變已發出的電。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate daily water throughput and energy at the same flow, displaying their distinct units. Apply a separate five-percent canal loss only to downstream water and explain whether it changes electricity already generated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共同放流的發電與灌溉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy and irrigation from one release" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。
矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability.
Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth
quiz.explanation: 把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Manning scale for an irrigation canal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。矩形斷面水力半徑是面積除濕周，不等於水深，尤其窄渠道差異顯著。曼寧式可估算均勻流通水量，但回水、閘門控制或急變流會破壞水面坡與底坡近似相同的條件，需要另作水面線分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. For a rectangular section, hydraulic radius is area divided by wetted perimeter, not simply depth, especially in a narrow canal. Manning's relation estimates uniform-flow capacity, while backwater, gates or rapidly varied flow can invalidate the approximation that energy slope follows bed slope and require a water-surface-profile calculation instead. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Manning scale for an irrigation canal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度
knowledge.titleEn: Manning scale for an irrigation canal
knowledge.text: 開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。矩形斷面水力半徑是面積除濕周，不等於水深，尤其窄渠道差異顯著。
knowledge.textEn: Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. For a rectangular section, hydraulic radius is area divided by wetted perimeter, not simply depth, especially in a narrow canal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Manning scale for an irrigation canal" is correct?
options: 矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深
兩次量測求出的平均沉陷速率必定可永久線性外推
開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。
optionsEn: Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth
An average settlement rate from two surveys can always be extrapolated indefinitely
Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness.
quiz.explanation: 開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Manning scale for an irrigation canal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s。適用邊界：國際單位制曼寧式、棱柱矩形渠均勻流，糙率為假想值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s. Applicable boundary: SI Manning relation for uniform flow in a prismatic rectangular canal, with assumed roughness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Applicable boundary: SI Manning relation for uniform flow in a prismatic rectangular canal, with assumed roughness.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Manning scale for an irrigation canal: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。比較量得流量與不同糙率結果，保留植物、沉積與維護狀態，不把糙率當永久固定常數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow. Compare measured discharge across plausible roughness values while documenting vegetation, deposits and maintenance rather than treating roughness as permanently fixed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把渠道糙率增至零點零三，保持幾何與坡度重算流量，再比較擴寬一公尺的結果，說明兩種改善或劣化不能只用斷面面積判斷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise roughness to zero point zero three at fixed geometry and slope, then compare with widening the canal by one metre. Explain why area alone cannot characterize either change in conveyance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接把水深當水力半徑會高估窄渠通量；若下游閘門回水卻仍採底坡為能量坡，則可能得到不符合現地水面線的流量，連帶錯估供水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing hydraulic radius with depth overstates narrow-channel flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。比較量得流量與不同糙率結果，保留植物、沉積與維護狀態，不把糙率當永久固定常數。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow. Compare measured discharge across plausible roughness values while documenting vegetation, deposits and maintenance rather than treating roughness as permanently fixed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把渠道糙率增至零點零三，保持幾何與坡度重算流量，再比較擴寬一公尺的結果，說明兩種改善或劣化不能只用斷面面積判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Raise roughness to zero point zero three at fixed geometry and slope, then compare with widening the canal by one metre. Explain why area alone cannot characterize either change in conveyance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Manning scale for an irrigation canal"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。
每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow.

quiz.explanationEn: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接把水深當水力半徑會高估窄渠通量；若下游閘門回水卻仍採底坡為能量坡，則可能得到不符合現地水面線的流量，連帶錯估供水能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing hydraulic radius with depth overstates narrow-channel flow. Using bed slope as energy slope under downstream backwater can produce a discharge inconsistent with the observed water surface and misstate delivery capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：曼寧式可估算均勻流通水量，但回水、閘門控制或急變流會破壞水面坡與底坡近似相同的條件，需要另作水面線分析。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Manning's relation estimates uniform-flow capacity, while backwater, gates or rapidly varied flow can invalidate the approximation that energy slope follows bed slope and require a water-surface-profile calculation instead.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 壩頂沉陷的速率解讀：機制與系統路徑

steps.title: 壩頂沉陷的速率解讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interpreting crest settlement rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壩頂沉陷的速率解讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interpreting crest settlement rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：settlement1=12 mm; settlement2=21 mm; dt=180 day; rate=(21-12)/dt=0.05 mm/day。適用邊界：沉陷向下為正、兩次測量共用穩定基準，僅時段平均速率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: settlement1=12 mm; settlement2=21 mm; dt=180 day; rate=(21-12)/dt=0.05 mm/day. Applicable boundary: Downward settlement is positive and both surveys share a stable datum; interval-average rate only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以閉合水準測量核對基準穩定，將同日庫水位、氣溫與儀器變更標在沉陷圖上。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close the leveling survey against stable references and annotate reservoir level, temperature and instrument changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 壩頂沉陷的速率解讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interpreting crest settlement rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壩頂沉陷的速率解讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interpreting crest settlement rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以閉合水準測量核對基準穩定，將同日庫水位、氣溫與儀器變更標在沉陷圖上。比較多個壩頂點的差異沉陷，並用至少三個時段查看速率是否加快，避免兩點直線掩蓋曲線轉折。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close the leveling survey against stable references and annotate reservoir level, temperature and instrument changes. Compare differential settlement across crest points and examine at least three intervals for acceleration, rather than letting a two-point straight line conceal curvature in the trend. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加第三次測量，假設再過一百八十日只增加三毫米，計算兩段速率並畫累積曲線，說明平均值相同或不同時仍需查看空間差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a third survey after another one hundred eighty days with only three millimetres of additional settlement. Compare interval rates and cumulative curves, explaining why spatial differences still matter alongside averaged trends.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用兩次量測直接外推多年會忽略蠕變速率改變；基準點下沉可能讓壩頂看似上升，若未檢查閉合誤差與外部參考，便可能把量測網變動誤判為壩體回彈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating years from two observations ignores changing creep rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壩頂沉陷的速率解讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.titleEn: Interpreting crest settlement rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壩頂沉陷的速率解讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interpreting crest settlement rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用兩次量測直接外推多年會忽略蠕變速率改變；基準點下沉可能讓壩頂看似上升，若未檢查閉合誤差與外部參考，便可能把量測網變動誤判為壩體回彈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 田間淨需水與毛取水：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net field need and gross withdrawal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌溉淨需水深度乘田區面積得到作物端水量，除以整體輸配效率才得到水源端毛需求。效率是同一邊界下有用水與取水的比值，若已涵蓋渠道損失，就不能再扣一次。不同作物、降雨及回歸水會改變真正需求，這個固定深度例子只用來練習單位與邊界，不代表實際配水規則。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「田間淨需水與毛取水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net irrigation depth times field area gives water needed at the crop boundary, while division by delivery efficiency gives gross source withdrawal. Efficiency must refer to consistent boundaries; canal losses included in it cannot be deducted again. Crop choice, rainfall and return flows alter real demand, so this fixed-depth exercise teaches units and accounting rather than prescribing allocation or representing a measured seasonal irrigation requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net field need and gross withdrawal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: depth=0.6 m; area=200 ha=2000000 m2; eta=0.75; Vgross=depth area/eta=1600000 m3.

quiz.question: 關於「田間淨需水與毛取水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Net field need and gross withdrawal" is correct?
options: 毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率
灌溉淨需水深度乘田區面積得到作物端水量，除以整體輸配效率才得到水源端毛需求。
上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源
optionsEn: Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency
Net irrigation depth times field area gives water needed at the crop boundary, while division by delivery efficiency gives gross source withdrawal.
Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources
quiz.explanation: 灌溉淨需水深度乘田區面積得到作物端水量，除以整體輸配效率才得到水源端毛需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Net irrigation depth times field area gives water needed at the crop boundary, while division by delivery efficiency gives gross source withdrawal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 田間淨需水與毛取水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Net field need and gross withdrawal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「田間淨需水與毛取水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net field need and gross withdrawal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：depth=0.6 m; area=200 ha=2000000 m2; eta=0.75; Vgross=depth area/eta=1600000 m3。適用邊界：淨深度已扣有效降雨，效率含假想輸配損失，不再重複扣減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: depth=0.6 m; area=200 ha=2000000 m2; eta=0.75; Vgross=depth area/eta=1600000 m3. Applicable boundary: Net depth already excludes effective rainfall and efficiency includes assumed conveyance losses, with no second deduction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先將公頃換成平方公尺、毫米換成公尺，再分別列淨需水與毛取水，核對效率分子分母。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert hectares to square metres and millimetres to metres, then list net need and gross withdrawal separately with explicit efficiency boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 田間淨需水與毛取水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Net field need and gross withdrawal: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「田間淨需水與毛取水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net field need and gross withdrawal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先將公頃換成平方公尺、毫米換成公尺，再分別列淨需水與毛取水，核對效率分子分母。以渠道入流及田間供水比較估計效率時，要對齊時段並考慮暫存，不能把回歸水直接當完全損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert hectares to square metres and millimetres to metres, then list net need and gross withdrawal separately with explicit efficiency boundaries. When comparing canal input and field delivery, align periods and account for storage rather than treating all return flow as irrecoverable loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把效率提高到零點八五，計算毛取水減少量與比例，再指出是否能把所有減少量都當流域新水資源，並討論原本回歸水可能已有下游用途。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase efficiency to zero point eight five and calculate gross-withdrawal reduction. Explain why all of that reduction may not become new basin supply when previous return flows already supported downstream uses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Convert hectares to square metres and millimetres to metres, then list net need and gross withdrawal separately with explicit efficiency boundaries. When comparing canal input and field delivery, align periods and account for storage rather than treating all return flow as irrecoverable loss.

knowledge.text: 把效率提高到零點八五，計算毛取水減少量與比例，再指出是否能把所有減少量都當流域新水資源，並討論原本回歸水可能已有下游用途。
knowledge.textEn: Increase efficiency to zero point eight five and calculate gross-withdrawal reduction. Explain why all of that reduction may not become new basin supply when previous return flows already supported downstream uses.

quiz.question: 要驗證「田間淨需水與毛取水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Net field need and gross withdrawal"?
options: 先將公頃換成平方公尺、毫米換成公尺，再分別列淨需水與毛取水，核對效率分子分母。

quiz.explanationEn: Convert hectares to square metres and millimetres to metres, then list net need and gross withdrawal separately with explicit efficiency boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 田間淨需水與毛取水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Net field need and gross withdrawal: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「田間淨需水與毛取水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net field need and gross withdrawal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need. Dividing by efficiency and then adding the same canal loss inflates demand twice, making apparent savings depend on inconsistent accounting rather than physical improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同作物、降雨及回歸水會改變真正需求，這個固定深度例子只用來練習單位與邊界，不代表實際配水規則。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Crop choice, rainfall and return flows alter real demand, so this fixed-depth exercise teaches units and accounting rather than prescribing allocation or representing a measured seasonal irrigation requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need. Dividing by efficiency and then adding the same canal loss inflates demand twice, making apparent savings depend on inconsistent accounting rather than physical improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「田間淨需水與毛取水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Net field need and gross withdrawal" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。
上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need.
Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources
quiz.explanation: 以淨需水乘效率會把水源需求算得比田間需求還小；若先除效率又再加同一渠道損失，則重複放大需求，導致不同方案比較只是帳目定義不同而非真正節水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying net need by efficiency makes source demand smaller than field need. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 南化水庫大壩
summary: 南化課程以跨流域引水、庫容曲線、原水混合和聯通管線為核心，區分集水區產流與可成功導入水庫的水量。壩體超高、泥砂占容、乾旱需求和流量計不確定度接續形成供水風險帳。可靠度與漏水範例使用明示假設，保留共因失效及量測誤差的影響。
summaryEn: Nanhua focuses on interbasin diversion, storage curves, raw-water mixing and connecting pipelines, separating watershed runoff from water actually delivered to storage. Freeboard, sediment occupation, drought demand and meter uncertainty extend this into a supply-risk account. Reliability and leakage examples retain common-cause failures and measurement errors through explicitly stated assumptions.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想一天本地入流五十萬立方公尺，越域進水三十萬、供水六十萬、其他損失四萬，蓄量增加十六萬立方公尺；若越域水源減半，增加量只剩一萬，不能把集水區降雨全部視為可取水。另用上下兩個高程的水面積四與五平方公里、相差兩公尺，以梯形法得區間庫容九百萬立方公尺。若面積曲線中點較線性插值高百分之十，辛普森估值為九百六十萬，提醒粗糙曲線可能低估而不是保證固定庫容。 核驗：Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day。對齊本地入流、引水出口和供水流量計的累積時段，以庫水位曲線反推蓄量差核對。標記引水中斷或旅行時間跨日的區段，再將管路暫存補入帳，避免把延遲誤判為水量損失。
workedExample.textEn: Assume daily local inflow of 0.5 million m3, diversion of 0.3 million, supply of 0.6 million and other losses of 0.04 million. Storage increases by 0.16 million m3; halving diversion leaves only 0.01 million. Catchment rainfall therefore cannot be counted directly as obtainable supply. Separately, water areas of 4 and 5 km2 separated by 2 m give 9 million m3 by trapezoidal integration. If midpoint area is ten percent above the linear midpoint, Simpson integration gives 9.6 million m3, illustrating sensitivity to the shape of the area curve. Verification: Align cumulative intervals for local inflow, diversion outlet and supply meters, then compare storage inferred from reservoir levels. Mark interruptions and transfers crossing a daily boundary, adding conveyance storage so travel delay is not misidentified as a water loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「本地入流與越域供水」與「水面積曲線與區間庫容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local inflow and imported supply" and "Area curve and interval storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 本地入流與越域供水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local inflow and imported supply: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「本地入流與越域供水」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local inflow and imported supply” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 南化的本地集水與甲仙越域引水屬不同來源，應分別記錄實際到庫水量，再與供水及損失相減。來源河川有水不代表全數都能引入，因為輸水能力、時段與其他用水需求各有限制。水量帳以清楚邊界避免重複計算，並保留入庫延遲，不能只用來源地降雨面積推定目的水庫已收到多少水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「本地入流與越域供水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Local catchment inflow and imported water are distinct sources and must be measured as volumes actually received before subtracting supply and losses. Water present in a source river is not necessarily transferable because capacity, timing and competing needs constrain delivery. Explicit boundaries and travel delay prevent double counting; rainfall over a source area cannot by itself establish how much water has already reached the destination reservoir. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local inflow and imported supply” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day.

knowledge.title: 本地入流與越域供水
knowledge.text: 南化的本地集水與甲仙越域引水屬不同來源，應分別記錄實際到庫水量，再與供水及損失相減。來源河川有水不代表全數都能引入，因為輸水能力、時段與其他用水需求各有限制。
knowledge.textEn: Local catchment inflow and imported water are distinct sources and must be measured as volumes actually received before subtracting supply and losses. Water present in a source river is not necessarily transferable because capacity, timing and competing needs constrain delivery.

steps.title: 本地入流與越域供水：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「本地入流與越域供水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local inflow and imported supply” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日實收水量，損失合併表示，非目前實際供水或引水配額。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vlocal=500000 m3/day; Vimport=300000 m3/day; Vsupply=600000 m3/day; Vloss=40000 m3/day; dV=160000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: Volumes received during one day with combined losses, not current supply or diversion allocations. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊本地入流、引水出口和供水流量計的累積時段，以庫水位曲線反推蓄量差核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align cumulative intervals for local inflow, diversion outlet and supply meters, then compare storage inferred from reservoir levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 本地入流與越域供水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local inflow and imported supply: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「本地入流與越域供水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local inflow and imported supply” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊本地入流、引水出口和供水流量計的累積時段，以庫水位曲線反推蓄量差核對。標記引水中斷或旅行時間跨日的區段，再將管路暫存補入帳，避免把延遲誤判為水量損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align cumulative intervals for local inflow, diversion outlet and supply meters, then compare storage inferred from reservoir levels. Mark interruptions and transfers crossing a daily boundary, adding conveyance storage so travel delay is not misidentified as a water loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將越域水量減半並重算，再把一天拆成兩個時段分別設定引水中斷與恢復，檢查總量及時段最低蓄量，說明日平均可能隱藏的變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve imported volume and recalculate, then split the day into interruption and recovery intervals. Compare total volume and minimum interim storage to show what a daily average can conceal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把來源河川流量直接當目的水庫入流會忽略未引走水量；若引水停止卻仍使用長期平均值，短期蓄量估算可能保持正值而實際已接近持平或下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating source-river flow as destination inflow ignores water not diverted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊本地入流、引水出口和供水流量計的累積時段，以庫水位曲線反推蓄量差核對。標記引水中斷或旅行時間跨日的區段，再將管路暫存補入帳，避免把延遲誤判為水量損失。
knowledge.textEn: Align cumulative intervals for local inflow, diversion outlet and supply meters, then compare storage inferred from reservoir levels. Mark interruptions and transfers crossing a daily boundary, adding conveyance storage so travel delay is not misidentified as a water loss.

knowledge.text: 將越域水量減半並重算，再把一天拆成兩個時段分別設定引水中斷與恢復，檢查總量及時段最低蓄量，說明日平均可能隱藏的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Halve imported volume and recalculate, then split the day into interruption and recovery intervals. Compare total volume and minimum interim storage to show what a daily average can conceal.

quiz.question: 要驗證「本地入流與越域供水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local inflow and imported supply"?
options: 對齊本地入流、引水出口和供水流量計的累積時段，以庫水位曲線反推蓄量差核對。

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime

quiz.explanationEn: Align cumulative intervals for local inflow, diversion outlet and supply meters, then compare storage inferred from reservoir levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 本地入流與越域供水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local inflow and imported supply: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「本地入流與越域供水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local inflow and imported supply” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把來源河川流量直接當目的水庫入流會忽略未引走水量；若引水停止卻仍使用長期平均值，短期蓄量估算可能保持正值而實際已接近持平或下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating source-river flow as destination inflow ignores water not diverted. Retaining a long-term import average during an interruption can predict growing storage even when the short-term balance is nearly zero or negative. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水量帳以清楚邊界避免重複計算，並保留入庫延遲，不能只用來源地降雨面積推定目的水庫已收到多少水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Explicit boundaries and travel delay prevent double counting; rainfall over a source area cannot by itself establish how much water has already reached the destination reservoir.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「來源河川的全部流量都可直接列為水庫實收入流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All source-river discharge can be entered as water actually received by the reservoir" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「本地入流與越域供水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差

Treating source-river flow as destination inflow ignores water not diverted.
Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference

steps.title: 水面積曲線與區間庫容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Area curve and interval storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水面積曲線與區間庫容」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Area curve and interval storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 庫容不是水面積乘整座壩高，而是面積隨高程積分。相鄰兩個水位的面積可用梯形近似區間體積，這隱含中間面積近似線性變化；若谷地擴寬不均或岸坡轉折，較密高程資料可改善估算。每次地形測量還應保留基準、邊界與淤積年代，否則不同版本差異未必全是沉積造成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水面積曲線與區間庫容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage is the integral of water area over elevation, not one area multiplied by total dam height. Trapezoidal integration between adjacent levels assumes approximately linear area variation. Abrupt valley widening or bank changes require finer elevation spacing. Survey datum, coverage and date must also remain explicit, because differences between capacity-curve versions do not necessarily arise entirely from deposited sediment or represent the same geometric boundary. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Area curve and interval storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: A1=4000000 m2; A2=5000000 m2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)dz/2=9000000 m3.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「水面積曲線與區間庫容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：A1=4000000 m2; A2=5000000 m2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)dz/2=9000000 m3。適用邊界：兩高程間面積線性近似，只求區間增量，不是水庫總容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: A1=4000000 m2; A2=5000000 m2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)dz/2=9000000 m3. Applicable boundary: Linear area interpolation between two elevations; interval increment only, not total reservoir capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將面積單位先統一成平方公尺，畫面積高程曲線並以圖形面積核對積分。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水面積曲線與區間庫容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Area curve and interval storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水面積曲線與區間庫容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Area curve and interval storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將面積單位先統一成平方公尺，畫面積高程曲線並以圖形面積核對積分。加入中點面積後比較梯形與辛普森估值，再檢查水深測量基準是否一致，將幾何離散誤差與儀器誤差分開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert areas to square metres, plot area against elevation and verify the integral geometrically. Add a midpoint area to compare trapezoidal and Simpson estimates, then check survey datums so discretization error remains separate from instrument error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：令中點面積比線性插值大百分之十，使用辛普森式重算並與九百萬立方公尺比較，解釋差異來自曲線形狀而不是新增入庫水量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set midpoint area ten percent above linear interpolation, use Simpson integration and compare with nine million cubic metres. Explain that the difference arises from curve shape rather than additional incoming water.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩個高程的面積差乘高差會漏掉主要體積；將高程基準不同的兩次庫容曲線直接相減，又可能把基準偏移誤認為整庫淤積，產生虛假的容量損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying area difference by elevation difference omits most of the volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水面積曲線與區間庫容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Area curve and interval storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水面積曲線與區間庫容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Area curve and interval storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩個高程的面積差乘高差會漏掉主要體積；將高程基準不同的兩次庫容曲線直接相減，又可能把基準偏移誤認為整庫淤積，產生虛假的容量損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying area difference by elevation difference omits most of the volume. Subtracting curves referenced to different vertical datums can instead turn a survey offset into apparent reservoir-wide sedimentation and a false capacity loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每次地形測量還應保留基準、邊界與淤積年代，否則不同版本差異未必全是沉積造成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Survey datum, coverage and date must also remain explicit, because differences between capacity-curve versions do not necessarily arise entirely from deposited sediment or represent the same geometric boundary.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩個高程的面積差乘高差會漏掉主要體積；將高程基準不同的兩次庫容曲線直接相減，又可能把基準偏移誤認為整庫淤積，產生虛假的容量損失。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying area difference by elevation difference omits most of the volume. Subtracting curves referenced to different vertical datums can instead turn a survey offset into apparent reservoir-wide sedimentation and a false capacity loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水面積曲線與區間庫容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Area curve and interval storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩來源濃度可不管流量比例直接取算術平均

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two source concentrations can be averaged without considering their flow proportions
Multiplying area difference by elevation difference omits most of the volume.
quiz.explanation: 把兩個高程的面積差乘高差會漏掉主要體積；將高程基準不同的兩次庫容曲線直接相減，又可能把基準偏移誤認為整庫淤積，產生虛假的容量損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying area difference by elevation difference omits most of the volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙來源保守成分混合」與「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conservative mixing of two sources" and "Pumping energy in an intertie": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙來源保守成分混合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conservative mixing of two sources: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙來源保守成分混合」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conservative mixing of two sources” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 越域與本地原水可能具有不同保守溶質濃度，混合結果由各股溶質質量率加總後除總水量求得。這可討論來源比例對取水水質的影響，但不代表濁度、消毒需求或會沉降反應的成分也必定線性。採樣時間須配合輸水旅行時間，否則即使公式正確也可能比較到不同水團。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙來源保守成分混合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Imported and local raw water may contain different concentrations of a conservative dissolved constituent. The blend follows summed solute mass flux divided by total flow. This illustrates source-proportion effects but does not guarantee linear mixing of turbidity, disinfectant demand or settling and reactive constituents. Sampling must account for travel time, otherwise a correct equation can be compared with measurements of different water parcels and appear inconsistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conservative mixing of two sources” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qlocal=2 m3/s; Clocal=18 mg/L; Qimport=1 m3/s; Cimport=42 mg/L; Cmix=26 mg/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qlocal=2 m3/s; Clocal=18 mg/L; Qimport=1 m3/s; Cimport=42 mg/L; Cmix=26 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩來源濃度可不管流量比例直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two source concentrations can be averaged without considering their flow proportions" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙來源保守成分混合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conservative mixing of two sources”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙來源保守成分混合

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩來源濃度可不管流量比例直接取算術平均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two source concentrations can be averaged without considering their flow proportions Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙來源保守成分混合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 雙來源保守成分混合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conservative mixing of two sources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙來源保守成分混合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conservative mixing of two sources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將兩個來源的取樣時間移到同一水團抵達混合點的時刻，再用流量加權預測。下游應採多點樣本確認混勻，並檢查輸入輸出溶質質量率是否相符，不以單一濁度計直接代替保守成分濃度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Shift source sampling times to represent parcels arriving together at the mixing point, then predict the flow-weighted blend. Use multiple downstream samples to verify mixing and compare solute fluxes, without substituting a single turbidity reading for conservative-solute concentration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持總流量三立方公尺每秒，把高濃度來源改為一半，再重算濃度並畫來源比例關係，指出哪些水質成分不適合用這條直線預測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total flow at three cubic metres per second, halve the high-concentration source contribution and recalculate the blend. Plot source fraction and identify water-quality variables that should not be predicted using this straight line.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩來源濃度直接平均會在流量不等時偏差；若中間發生沉降或反應，質量不守恆的表象可能反映模型邊界漏掉過程，而非一定是流量計壞掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A simple arithmetic mean is biased when source flows differ. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 把兩來源濃度直接平均會在流量不等時偏差；若中間發生沉降或反應，質量不守恆的表象可能反映模型邊界漏掉過程，而非一定是流量計壞掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 聯通管輸水的抽水能源：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping energy in an intertie” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨區聯通管線可增加供水路徑，但若需要抽升就必須付出位能與摩擦耗能。總揚程把地形高差與沿程局部損失加總，輸入電功率再除泵組效率求得。效率應明確包含哪些設備，不能把馬達、泵及變頻損失在不同位置重複扣除，也不能把輸水能耗誤認為實際水量全部被消耗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connecting pipeline adds a supply path but requires energy when water must be lifted against elevation and hydraulic losses. Total head combines static lift with distributed and local losses, and electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump-set efficiency. The efficiency boundary must identify included equipment so motor, pump and drive losses are not deducted twice, while energy consumption must remain distinct from physical water loss. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping energy in an intertie” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=1.8 m3/s; Hstatic=45 m; Hloss=12 m; eta=0.78; Pin=rho g Q(Hstatic+Hloss)/eta/1000=1290.39231 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=1.8 m3/s; Hstatic=45 m; Hloss=12 m; eta=0.78; Pin=rho g Q(Hstatic+Hloss)/eta/1000=1290.39231 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水輸入功率應低於同流量揚程的理想水力功率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pumping electrical input should be lower than the ideal hydraulic power at the same duty" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instructionEn: Check head from suction and discharge total energy levels, identify auxiliary loads in the electrical meter and pair it with simultaneous flow for energy per delivered volume. Compare losses across flows rather than explaining every power change by static elevation alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將損失水頭增至十八公尺，保持流量與效率重算，再把效率降至零點七，分別比較兩種因素對耗電的影響，避免將所有變化歸因於泵老化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise loss head to eighteen metres at unchanged flow and efficiency, then reduce efficiency to zero point seven. Compare the two effects separately rather than attributing every energy increase to pump aging.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算地形高差會漏掉管路摩擦；把效率乘在水力功率上則得到低於理想需求的輸入值，違反能量方向，可能使備援電源容量評估失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using static lift alone omits hydraulic losses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pumping energy in an intertie"?
options: 以吸入與排出總水頭差檢查揚程，核對電表是否含輔機，再用同一時段流量計求單位水耗能。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
