quiz.explanationEn: Check head from suction and discharge total energy levels, identify auxiliary loads in the electrical meter and pair it with simultaneous flow for energy per delivered volume. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 聯通管輸水的抽水能源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy in an intertie: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pumping energy in an intertie” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算地形高差會漏掉管路摩擦；把效率乘在水力功率上則得到低於理想需求的輸入值，違反能量方向，可能使備援電源容量評估失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using static lift alone omits hydraulic losses. Multiplying hydraulic power by efficiency gives an input below the ideal requirement and reverses the energy relationship, distorting an illustrative backup-power assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：效率應明確包含哪些設備，不能把馬達、泵及變頻損失在不同位置重複扣除，也不能把輸水能耗誤認為實際水量全部被消耗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The efficiency boundary must identify included equipment so motor, pump and drive losses are not deducted twice, while energy consumption must remain distinct from physical water loss.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水輸入功率應低於同流量揚程的理想水力功率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pumping electrical input should be lower than the ideal hydraulic power at the same duty" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只算地形高差會漏掉管路摩擦；把效率乘在水力功率上則得到低於理想需求的輸入值，違反能量方向，可能使備援電源容量評估失真。
knowledge.textEn: Using static lift alone omits hydraulic losses. Multiplying hydraulic power by efficiency gives an input below the ideal requirement and reverses the energy relationship, distorting an illustrative backup-power assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聯通管輸水的抽水能源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping energy in an intertie" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只算地形高差會漏掉管路摩擦；把效率乘在水力功率上則得到低於理想需求的輸入值，違反能量方向，可能使備援電源容量評估失真。
有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using static lift alone omits hydraulic losses.
Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent
quiz.explanation: 只算地形高差會漏掉管路摩擦；把效率乘在水力功率上則得到低於理想需求的輸入值，違反能量方向，可能使備援電源容量評估失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using static lift alone omits hydraulic losses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「備援路徑與共因失效」與「幾何超高與波浪餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backup paths and common cause failure" and "Geometric freeboard and wave allowance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 備援路徑與共因失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backup paths and common cause failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「備援路徑與共因失效」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup paths and common cause failure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩條供水路徑只有在失效近似獨立時，才可用失效率乘積估算同時失效。共同電源、同一河川污染或相同控制系統可能同時切斷兩路，使表面上的雙路備援效果下降。以條件機率把共因事件與獨立事件分開，可以檢查可靠度假設；數值不是歷史故障統計，也不是供水保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援路徑與共因失效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two supply paths benefit from multiplying failure probabilities only when failures are approximately independent. Shared electricity, source contamination or control systems can disable both paths together and reduce apparent redundancy. A conditional-probability model separates a common-cause event from otherwise independent failures, exposing the assumption behind a reliability estimate. Its numbers are hypothetical, not historical outage statistics or a guarantee that supply will remain available during an actual event. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup paths and common cause failure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「備援路徑與共因失效」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backup paths and common cause failure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 備援路徑與共因失效
knowledge.titleEn: Backup paths and common cause failure
knowledge.text: 兩條供水路徑只有在失效近似獨立時，才可用失效率乘積估算同時失效。共同電源、同一河川污染或相同控制系統可能同時切斷兩路，使表面上的雙路備援效果下降。
knowledge.textEn: Two supply paths benefit from multiplying failure probabilities only when failures are approximately independent. Shared electricity, source contamination or control systems can disable both paths together and reduce apparent redundancy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「備援路徑與共因失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backup paths and common cause failure" is correct?
options: 有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立
只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪
兩條供水路徑只有在失效近似獨立時，才可用失效率乘積估算同時失效。
optionsEn: Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent
A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration
Two supply paths benefit from multiplying failure probabilities only when failures are approximately independent.
quiz.explanation: 兩條供水路徑只有在失效近似獨立時，才可用失效率乘積估算同時失效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two supply paths benefit from multiplying failure probabilities only when failures are approximately independent. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 備援路徑與共因失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backup paths and common cause failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備援路徑與共因失效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup paths and common cause failure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196。適用邊界：共因事件必使雙路失效；無共因時兩路條件獨立，機率同屬一時段。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196. Applicable boundary: The common event disables both paths; otherwise failures are conditionally independent over the same time interval. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫共同電源與各自設備的故障樹，檢查事件是否重複包含，再把同時段事件紀錄整理成條件機率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a fault tree containing shared utilities and separate equipment, checking for duplicated events before estimating conditional probabilities from matching intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196。適用邊界：共因事件必使雙路失效；無共因時兩路條件獨立，機率同屬一時段。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196. Applicable boundary: The common event disables both paths; otherwise failures are conditionally independent over the same time interval.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「備援路徑與共因失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backup paths and common cause failure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196。
庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命
正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196.
Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime
The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: pc=0.02; p1=0.05; p2=0.04; Pboth=pc+(1-pc)p1p2=0.02196. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 備援路徑與共因失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backup paths and common cause failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「備援路徑與共因失效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup paths and common cause failure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫共同電源與各自設備的故障樹，檢查事件是否重複包含，再把同時段事件紀錄整理成條件機率。比較有無共因的答案，並列出資料不足的相依事件，不能以路線數量直接當可靠度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a fault tree containing shared utilities and separate equipment, checking for duplicated events before estimating conditional probabilities from matching intervals. Compare results with and without common cause and identify unresolved dependencies rather than using route count as a reliability measure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把共因機率減半重算，另把其中一路獨立失效機率減半比較改善幅度，說明為何先處理共用設備有時比再增加單一路徑可靠度更有效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve common-cause probability and recalculate, then separately halve one route's independent failure probability. Compare improvements and explain why addressing a shared dependency can sometimes matter more than improving one individual path.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先畫共同電源與各自設備的故障樹，檢查事件是否重複包含，再把同時段事件紀錄整理成條件機率。比較有無共因的答案，並列出資料不足的相依事件，不能以路線數量直接當可靠度。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a fault tree containing shared utilities and separate equipment, checking for duplicated events before estimating conditional probabilities from matching intervals. Compare results with and without common cause and identify unresolved dependencies rather than using route count as a reliability measure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把共因機率減半重算，另把其中一路獨立失效機率減半比較改善幅度，說明為何先處理共用設備有時比再增加單一路徑可靠度更有效。
knowledge.textEn: Halve common-cause probability and recalculate, then separately halve one route's independent failure probability. Compare improvements and explain why addressing a shared dependency can sometimes matter more than improving one individual path.

quiz.question: 要驗證「備援路徑與共因失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backup paths and common cause failure"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先畫共同電源與各自設備的故障樹，檢查事件是否重複包含，再把同時段事件紀錄整理成條件機率。
區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Draw a fault tree containing shared utilities and separate equipment, checking for duplicated events before estimating conditional probabilities from matching intervals.
Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference
quiz.explanation: 先畫共同電源與各自設備的故障樹，檢查事件是否重複包含，再把同時段事件紀錄整理成條件機率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw a fault tree containing shared utilities and separate equipment, checking for duplicated events before estimating conditional probabilities from matching intervals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 備援路徑與共因失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup paths and common cause failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備援路徑與共因失效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup paths and common cause failure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause. Conversely, adding common cause to route probabilities that already include it double counts events, producing a conservative-looking but internally inconsistent probability model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以條件機率把共因事件與獨立事件分開，可以檢查可靠度假設；數值不是歷史故障統計，也不是供水保證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its numbers are hypothetical, not historical outage statistics or a guarantee that supply will remain available during an actual event.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause. Conversely, adding common cause to route probabilities that already include it double counts events, producing a conservative-looking but internally inconsistent probability model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「備援路徑與共因失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backup paths and common cause failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪
直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration
Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause.
quiz.explanation: 直接把兩條路的失效機率相乘會漏掉共因；反之將已含共同事件的總失效率再加入共因項，會重複計算，讓保守外觀掩蓋不一致的機率定義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying route failure probabilities alone misses common cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 幾何超高與波浪餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometric freeboard and wave allowance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何超高與波浪餘量」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric freeboard and wave allowance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩壩頂與水面的高程差是幾何超高，但波浪上爬、風壅水與沉陷可能占用這段距離。把假想餘量逐項扣除可練習垂直基準與符號，不能把結果稱為現地允許水位或安全保證。各項未必同時達峰，實際組合需符合適用設計情境，而且壩頂局部低點比平均高程更相關。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何超高與波浪餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geometric freeboard is the elevation difference between crest and water, but wave runup, wind setup and settlement may use part of that distance. Subtracting assumed allowances teaches datum and sign conventions rather than establishing a permitted level or safety guarantee. Peaks need not coincide, actual combinations require an applicable design scenario, and local low crest points matter more than an average elevation when assessing possible overtopping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric freeboard and wave allowance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何超高與波浪餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric freeboard and wave allowance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 幾何超高與波浪餘量
knowledge.text: 土石壩壩頂與水面的高程差是幾何超高，但波浪上爬、風壅水與沉陷可能占用這段距離。把假想餘量逐項扣除可練習垂直基準與符號，不能把結果稱為現地允許水位或安全保證。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「幾何超高與波浪餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometric freeboard and wave allowance" is correct?
options: 土石壩壩頂與水面的高程差是幾何超高，但波浪上爬、風壅水與沉陷可能占用這段距離。
只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪
總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量
optionsEn: Geometric freeboard is the elevation difference between crest and water, but wave runup, wind setup and settlement may use part of that distance.
A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration
Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge
quiz.explanation: 土石壩壩頂與水面的高程差是幾何超高，但波浪上爬、風壅水與沉陷可能占用這段距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric freeboard is the elevation difference between crest and water, but wave runup, wind setup and settlement may use part of that distance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 幾何超高與波浪餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometric freeboard and wave allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何超高與波浪餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric freeboard and wave allowance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m。適用邊界：同一高程基準的假想垂直餘量，波浪項不含重複計入，不是設計準則。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m. Applicable boundary: Hypothetical vertical allowances sharing one datum, with wave terms not double counted; not a design criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查明波浪上爬高度是否已包含風壅水，再核對壩頂量測採目前局部低點或設計高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether runup already includes wind setup and whether crest data represent a current local low point or design elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m。適用邊界：同一高程基準的假想垂直餘量，波浪項不含重複計入，不是設計準則。

Applicable boundary: Hypothetical vertical allowances sharing one datum, with wave terms not double counted; not a design criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「幾何超高與波浪餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometric freeboard and wave allowance", which statement holds?
options: 需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m。
來源河川的全部流量都可直接列為水庫實收入流
optionsEn: Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: crest=108 m.
All source-river discharge can be entered as water actually received by the reservoir
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: crest=108 m; water=103 m; runup=1.2 m; setup=0.3 m; settlement=0.4 m; margin=crest-water-runup-setup-settlement=3.1 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 幾何超高與波浪餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometric freeboard and wave allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「幾何超高與波浪餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric freeboard and wave allowance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查明波浪上爬高度是否已包含風壅水，再核對壩頂量測採目前局部低點或設計高程。畫各項垂直距離並對齊基準，若使用未來沉陷預估，需清楚區分已發生沉陷與額外預留量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether runup already includes wind setup and whether crest data represent a current local low point or design elevation. Draw all vertical distances on one datum and distinguish settlement already observed from an additional future allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將水面升高一公尺而壩頂不變，重算餘量，再比較波浪上爬增加與壩頂沉陷增加的同量效果，註明相同算術結果不代表相同發生機率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise water level one metre at fixed crest, then compare equal increases in runup and settlement. Recalculate the margins and state why identical arithmetic effects do not imply identical occurrence probabilities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將已反映在實測壩頂的沉陷再扣一次會重複保守；忽略局部低點則可能反向樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting settlement already included in a measured crest double counts it, while ignoring local low points can be unconservative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將已反映在實測壩頂的沉陷再扣一次會重複保守；忽略局部低點則可能反向樂觀。只看算得正餘量而未說明波浪情境，無法支持任何真實超高判定。
knowledge.textEn: Subtracting settlement already included in a measured crest double counts it, while ignoring local low points can be unconservative. A positive arithmetic remainder without a defined wave scenario cannot support a real freeboard conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「幾何超高與波浪餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量
optionsEn: Subtracting settlement already included in a measured crest double counts it, while ignoring local low points can be unconservative.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge

quiz.explanationEn: Subtracting settlement already included in a measured crest double counts it, while ignoring local low points can be unconservative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」與「淤積占容的名目年數」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment storm runoff volume" and "Nominal sediment occupation horizon": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水區暴雨的逕流體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment storm runoff volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment storm runoff volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴雨總雨量乘集水面積是降到地表的水量，還需扣除截留、入滲與暫存才成為逕流。簡化逕流係數把多種過程合併成比例，適合體積敏感度但不能直接給洪峰流量。南化背景下若土壤前期含水不同，同樣降雨可能產生不同逕流，因此係數不是不變材料常數，也不是可引入水庫的保證比例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times catchment area gives precipitation volume, while interception, infiltration and storage reduce runoff. A simplified runoff coefficient combines these processes for volume sensitivity but does not directly produce peak discharge. Antecedent soil moisture can make identical storms yield different runoff, so the coefficient is not an immutable material constant or a guaranteed fraction that can actually be diverted into the reservoir. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment storm runoff volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment storm runoff volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水區暴雨的逕流體積
knowledge.text: 暴雨總雨量乘集水面積是降到地表的水量，還需扣除截留、入滲與暫存才成為逕流。簡化逕流係數把多種過程合併成比例，適合體積敏感度但不能直接給洪峰流量。
knowledge.textEn: Rain depth times catchment area gives precipitation volume, while interception, infiltration and storage reduce runoff. A simplified runoff coefficient combines these processes for volume sensitivity but does not directly produce peak discharge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment storm runoff volume" is correct?
options: 總逕流體積可直接當作暴雨洪峰流量
暴雨總雨量乘集水面積是降到地表的水量，還需扣除截留、入滲與暫存才成為逕流。
庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命
optionsEn: Total runoff volume can directly be treated as peak storm discharge
Rain depth times catchment area gives precipitation volume, while interception, infiltration and storage reduce runoff.
Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime
quiz.explanation: 暴雨總雨量乘集水面積是降到地表的水量，還需扣除截留、入滲與暫存才成為逕流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rain depth times catchment area gives precipitation volume, while interception, infiltration and storage reduce runoff. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水區暴雨的逕流體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment storm runoff volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment storm runoff volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3。適用邊界：事件總體積且係數無因次，未描述洪峰、匯流歷時與取水限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3. Applicable boundary: Event volume with a dimensionless coefficient, excluding peak flow, routing duration and abstraction constraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用面雨量而非單一雨量站代表整個集水區，記錄前期降雨與土壤狀態，再積分事件出流並扣除基流比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use areal rainfall rather than one gauge for the entire basin, record antecedent conditions and compare with integrated event discharge after separating baseflow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3。適用邊界：事件總體積且係數無因次，未描述洪峰、匯流歷時與取水限制。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3. Applicable boundary: Event volume with a dimensionless coefficient, excluding peak flow, routing duration and abstraction constraints.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Catchment storm runoff volume", which statement holds?
options: 正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率
區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差

optionsEn: The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage
Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: P=0.12 m; A=40000000 m2; C=0.45; Vrunoff=P A C=2160000 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水區暴雨的逕流體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment storm runoff volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水區暴雨的逕流體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment storm runoff volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用面雨量而非單一雨量站代表整個集水區，記錄前期降雨與土壤狀態，再積分事件出流並扣除基流比較。將體積估算與洪峰量測分開，不可把總立方公尺直接標成每秒立方公尺。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use areal rainfall rather than one gauge for the entire basin, record antecedent conditions and compare with integrated event discharge after separating baseflow. Keep volume and peak-flow measurements distinct; cubic metres cannot be relabeled as cubic metres per second. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將係數設為零點三與零點六，求事件體積上下界，再指定不同匯流歷時畫兩條同體積歷線，說明同體積仍可能具有完全不同的洪峰。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use coefficients of zero point three and zero point six to bracket event volume, then sketch equal-volume hydrographs with different durations. Explain how the same volume can accompany very different peak discharges.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總逕流體積當作瞬時流量會遺失時間尺度；若忽略暴雨前土壤已飽和，固定係數可能低估產流，反之乾土情境又可能高估，必須保留假設方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating runoff volume as instantaneous discharge removes the timescale. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 淤積占容的名目年數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal sediment occupation horizon: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淤積占容的名目年數」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal sediment occupation horizon” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可用庫容除以每年淨淤積量得到名目占容年數，這只是固定速率下的比例尺，不是水庫壽命預報。侵蝕事件、壓密、排砂與供水最低水位都會改變可用空間與損失速率。南化背景的教學應把容量曲線年代與年淤積定義寫明，並區分總庫容消失、有效庫容不足及取水口受影響等不同問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淤積占容的名目年數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Available storage divided by annual net deposition gives a nominal occupation horizon under constant rate, not a reservoir-life forecast. Erosion events, consolidation, sediment removal and minimum supply level change both usable space and loss rate. The storage-curve date and deposition definition must remain explicit, while loss of gross capacity, inadequate usable storage and interference with an intake are distinct outcomes rather than interchangeable meanings of reservoir lifetime. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal sediment occupation horizon” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淤積占容的名目年數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal sediment occupation horizon”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淤積占容的名目年數
knowledge.text: 可用庫容除以每年淨淤積量得到名目占容年數，這只是固定速率下的比例尺，不是水庫壽命預報。侵蝕事件、壓密、排砂與供水最低水位都會改變可用空間與損失速率。
knowledge.textEn: Available storage divided by annual net deposition gives a nominal occupation horizon under constant rate, not a reservoir-life forecast. Erosion events, consolidation, sediment removal and minimum supply level change both usable space and loss rate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淤積占容的名目年數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal sediment occupation horizon" is correct?
options: 庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命
需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五
可用庫容除以每年淨淤積量得到名目占容年數，這只是固定速率下的比例尺，不是水庫壽命預報。
optionsEn: Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime
Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent
Available storage divided by annual net deposition gives a nominal occupation horizon under constant rate, not a reservoir-life forecast.
quiz.explanation: 可用庫容除以每年淨淤積量得到名目占容年數，這只是固定速率下的比例尺，不是水庫壽命預報。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Available storage divided by annual net deposition gives a nominal occupation horizon under constant rate, not a reservoir-life forecast. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淤積占容的名目年數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal sediment occupation horizon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淤積占容的名目年數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal sediment occupation horizon” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year。適用邊界：固定假想淨淤積率的比例估算，沒有預測洪水事件或實際剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year. Applicable boundary: A ratio under constant hypothetical net deposition, without forecasting storm events or actual remaining service life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用同基準的重複水深測量求淨體積差，註明測區與取水高程，並將單次極端事件與多年背景分開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use repeated surveys with a common datum to estimate net volume change, documenting coverage and intake elevation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year。適用邊界：固定假想淨淤積率的比例估算，沒有預測洪水事件或實際剩餘壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year. Applicable boundary: A ratio under constant hypothetical net deposition, without forecasting storm events or actual remaining service life.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淤積占容的名目年數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal sediment occupation horizon", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year。
來源河川的全部流量都可直接列為水庫實收入流
兩來源濃度可不管流量比例直接取算術平均
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year.
All source-river discharge can be entered as water actually received by the reservoir
Two source concentrations can be averaged without considering their flow proportions
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vavailable=30000000 m3; Snet=600000 m3/year; T=Vavailable/Snet=50 year. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淤積占容的名目年數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nominal sediment occupation horizon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淤積占容的名目年數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nominal sediment occupation horizon” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用同基準的重複水深測量求淨體積差，註明測區與取水高程，並將單次極端事件與多年背景分開。比較沉積乾容重變化和庫容曲線修訂，確認年損失不是量測覆蓋改變造成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use repeated surveys with a common datum to estimate net volume change, documenting coverage and intake elevation. Separate extreme-event deposits from background years and compare bulk-density change and curve revisions so apparent annual loss is not merely changed survey coverage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將背景淤積率減半但每十年加入一次三百萬立方公尺事件，求二十年占容並與固定速率比較，指出事件發生時間還會影響短期供水功能。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve background deposition but add one three-million-cubic-metre event every ten years. Calculate twenty-year occupation, compare with a constant rate and explain why event timing can still affect short-term supply function.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把一場極端事件的淤積量當作每年固定值可能過度縮短名目年數；只看全庫剩餘體積又可能漏掉取水口附近局部埋積，讓總量充足掩蓋功能先受影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeating one extreme event every year can artificially shorten the nominal horizon. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用同基準的重複水深測量求淨體積差，註明測區與取水高程，並將單次極端事件與多年背景分開。比較沉積乾容重變化和庫容曲線修訂，確認年損失不是量測覆蓋改變造成。
knowledge.textEn: Use repeated surveys with a common datum to estimate net volume change, documenting coverage and intake elevation. Separate extreme-event deposits from background years and compare bulk-density change and curve revisions so apparent annual loss is not merely changed survey coverage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將背景淤積率減半但每十年加入一次三百萬立方公尺事件，求二十年占容並與固定速率比較，指出事件發生時間還會影響短期供水功能。
knowledge.textEn: Halve background deposition but add one three-million-cubic-metre event every ten years. Calculate twenty-year occupation, compare with a constant rate and explain why event timing can still affect short-term supply function.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淤積占容的名目年數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nominal sediment occupation horizon"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用同基準的重複水深測量求淨體積差，註明測區與取水高程，並將單次極端事件與多年背景分開。
有兩條供水路徑就可以保證故障彼此獨立
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use repeated surveys with a common datum to estimate net volume change, documenting coverage and intake elevation.
Having two supply routes guarantees that their failures are independent
quiz.explanation: 使用同基準的重複水深測量求淨體積差，註明測區與取水高程，並將單次極端事件與多年背景分開。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use repeated surveys with a common datum to estimate net volume change, documenting coverage and intake elevation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淤積占容的名目年數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal sediment occupation horizon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淤積占容的名目年數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal sediment occupation horizon” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把一場極端事件的淤積量當作每年固定值可能過度縮短名目年數；只看全庫剩餘體積又可能漏掉取水口附近局部埋積，讓總量充足掩蓋功能先受影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeating one extreme event every year can artificially shorten the nominal horizon. Conversely, adequate reservoir-wide volume may hide local accumulation near an intake, where function can be impaired before total storage becomes small. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：南化背景的教學應把容量曲線年代與年淤積定義寫明，並區分總庫容消失、有效庫容不足及取水口受影響等不同問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The storage-curve date and deposition definition must remain explicit, while loss of gross capacity, inadequate usable storage and interference with an intake are distinct outcomes rather than interchangeable meanings of reservoir lifetime.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「庫容除年淤積量就是確定無誤的水庫剩餘壽命」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Storage divided by annual deposition is the exact remaining reservoir lifetime" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把一場極端事件的淤積量當作每年固定值可能過度縮短名目年數；只看全庫剩餘體積又可能漏掉取水口附近局部埋積，讓總量充足掩蓋功能先受影響。
knowledge.textEn: Repeating one extreme event every year can artificially shorten the nominal horizon. Conversely, adequate reservoir-wide volume may hide local accumulation near an intake, where function can be impaired before total storage becomes small.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淤積占容的名目年數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nominal sediment occupation horizon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五
把一場極端事件的淤積量當作每年固定值可能過度縮短名目年數；只看全庫剩餘體積又可能漏掉取水口附近局部埋積，讓總量充足掩蓋功能先受影響。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent
Repeating one extreme event every year can artificially shorten the nominal horizon.
quiz.explanation: 把一場極端事件的淤積量當作每年固定值可能過度縮短名目年數；只看全庫剩餘體積又可能漏掉取水口附近局部埋積，讓總量充足掩蓋功能先受影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeating one extreme event every year can artificially shorten the nominal horizon. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」與「管網水量差與誤差範圍」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Demand adjustment and static supply duration" and "Network imbalance and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乾旱需求調整與靜態續供：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Demand adjustment and static supply duration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Demand adjustment and static supply duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾旱時以可用水量除每日需求可得到無入流的靜態續供時間，但水位下降可能使取水能力或水質改變，不能把這個商當作保證供水天數。需求削減也要區分可實現的節水與只是帳面假設。比較不同需求情境時應使用同一有效庫存邊界，保留不能動用的水量，而非把總庫容全部拿來相除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable water divided by daily demand gives a no-inflow static duration, but falling level can change intake capacity or quality, so the quotient is not guaranteed supply time. Demand reduction must distinguish achievable savings from an accounting assumption. Scenarios need the same usable-storage boundary and should retain unavailable water rather than dividing gross reservoir capacity by demand and ignoring physical access constraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Demand adjustment and static supply duration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Demand adjustment and static supply duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乾旱需求調整與靜態續供
knowledge.titleEn: Demand adjustment and static supply duration
knowledge.text: 乾旱時以可用水量除每日需求可得到無入流的靜態續供時間，但水位下降可能使取水能力或水質改變，不能把這個商當作保證供水天數。需求削減也要區分可實現的節水與只是帳面假設。
knowledge.textEn: Usable water divided by daily demand gives a no-inflow static duration, but falling level can change intake capacity or quality, so the quotient is not guaranteed supply time. Demand reduction must distinguish achievable savings from an accounting assumption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Demand adjustment and static supply duration" is correct?
options: 乾旱時以可用水量除每日需求可得到無入流的靜態續供時間，但水位下降可能使取水能力或水質改變，不能把這個商當作保證供水天數。
需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五
正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率
optionsEn: Usable water divided by daily demand gives a no-inflow static duration, but falling level can change intake capacity or quality, so the quotient is not guaranteed supply time.
Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent
The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage
quiz.explanation: 乾旱時以可用水量除每日需求可得到無入流的靜態續供時間，但水位下降可能使取水能力或水質改變，不能把這個商當作保證供水天數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Usable water divided by daily demand gives a no-inflow static duration, but falling level can change intake capacity or quality, so the quotient is not guaranteed supply time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 乾旱需求調整與靜態續供：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Demand adjustment and static supply duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Demand adjustment and static supply duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day。適用邊界：無入流、無其他損失且削減比例可實現，僅作靜態比較。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day. Applicable boundary: No inflow or other losses and an achievable reduction fraction, for static comparison only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先核對可用庫存是否已扣除無法取水的部分，再用實際日需求區間重算，不把單日低需求當長期平均。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify whether usable storage excludes inaccessible water, then recalculate over observed daily-demand ranges rather than using one unusually low day as the long-term mean.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day。適用邊界：無入流、無其他損失且削減比例可實現，僅作靜態比較。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day. Applicable boundary: No inflow or other losses and an achievable reduction fraction, for static comparison only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Demand adjustment and static supply duration", which statement holds?
options: 區間庫容等於上下水面積之差乘上高程差
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day。
抽水輸入功率應低於同流量揚程的理想水力功率
optionsEn: Interval storage equals the difference in water areas times elevation difference
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vusable=12000000 m3.
Pumping electrical input should be lower than the ideal hydraulic power at the same duty
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vusable=12000000 m3; Dbase=500000 m3/day; reduction=0.15; Dnew=Dbase(1-reduction); T=Vusable/Dnew=28.235294 day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乾旱需求調整與靜態續供：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Demand adjustment and static supply duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Demand adjustment and static supply duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對可用庫存是否已扣除無法取水的部分，再用實際日需求區間重算，不把單日低需求當長期平均。保留節水措施開始時間與執行率，將新入流或水質限制列為獨立敏感度項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify whether usable storage excludes inaccessible water, then recalculate over observed daily-demand ranges rather than using one unusually low day as the long-term mean. Record the start and realization of savings and treat inflow and quality constraints as separate sensitivities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較零、百分之十五及百分之二十五削減情境的續供時間，再加入每日兩萬立方公尺其他損失，說明用水與損失邊界改變後為何需重算而非加固定天數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare zero, fifteen and twenty-five percent reductions, then add twenty thousand cubic metres of other daily losses. Explain why changed demand and loss boundaries require recalculation rather than adding a fixed number of days.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先核對可用庫存是否已扣除無法取水的部分，再用實際日需求區間重算，不把單日低需求當長期平均。保留節水措施開始時間與執行率，將新入流或水質限制列為獨立敏感度項。
knowledge.textEn: Verify whether usable storage excludes inaccessible water, then recalculate over observed daily-demand ranges rather than using one unusually low day as the long-term mean. Record the start and realization of savings and treat inflow and quality constraints as separate sensitivities.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較零、百分之十五及百分之二十五削減情境的續供時間，再加入每日兩萬立方公尺其他損失，說明用水與損失邊界改變後為何需重算而非加固定天數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare zero, fifteen and twenty-five percent reductions, then add twenty thousand cubic metres of other daily losses. Explain why changed demand and loss boundaries require recalculation rather than adding a fixed number of days.

quiz.question: 要驗證「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Demand adjustment and static supply duration"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要幾何壩頂高於靜水面就完全不必考慮波浪
先核對可用庫存是否已扣除無法取水的部分，再用實際日需求區間重算，不把單日低需求當長期平均。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A crest above still water never needs any wave consideration
Verify whether usable storage excludes inaccessible water, then recalculate over observed daily-demand ranges rather than using one unusually low day as the long-term mean.
quiz.explanation: 先核對可用庫存是否已扣除無法取水的部分，再用實際日需求區間重算，不把單日低需求當長期平均。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify whether usable storage excludes inaccessible water, then recalculate over observed daily-demand ranges rather than using one unusually low day as the long-term mean. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 乾旱需求調整與靜態續供：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Demand adjustment and static supply duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Demand adjustment and static supply duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand. Using an unrealized reduction treats a policy target as achieved supply performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較不同需求情境時應使用同一有效庫存邊界，保留不能動用的水量，而非把總庫容全部拿來相除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Scenarios need the same usable-storage boundary and should retain unavailable water rather than dividing gross reservoir capacity by demand and ignoring physical access constraints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「需求降低百分之十五就使續供天數恰增加百分之十五」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing demand fifteen percent increases supply duration by exactly fifteen percent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。
knowledge.textEn: A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand. Using an unrealized reduction treats a policy target as achieved supply performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「乾旱需求調整與靜態續供」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Demand adjustment and static supply duration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率
optionsEn: A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage
quiz.explanation: 把百分之十五節水誤讀成續供天數也增加百分之十五，忽略倒數關係；若實際需求沒有達標，仍用假設削減後需求外推，就會把政策目標當成已實現的供水能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fifteen-percent demand reduction does not increase duration by exactly fifteen percent because duration is inversely related to demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 管網水量差與誤差範圍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Network imbalance and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管網水量差與誤差範圍」如何影響南化水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Network imbalance and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Nanhua Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯通管路進出水量之差可提示漏失或暫存，但量測誤差也能形成殘差。若兩個流量計誤差獨立，以平方和開根號合成不確定度，再將殘差除以該尺度可比較訊號大小。這個比值不是漏水機率；共同校準偏差、旅行延遲或管內儲水改變都可能破壞獨立假設，應先檢查再判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管網水量差與誤差範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The difference between pipeline input and output may indicate leakage or storage, but measurement error also creates residuals. Independent meter uncertainties combine by root sum of squares, allowing residual magnitude to be compared with an uncertainty scale. The ratio is not a leakage probability; shared calibration bias, travel delay and changing pipe storage can violate the assumptions and must be examined before interpreting the imbalance as physical loss. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Network imbalance and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=1.8 m3/s; Qout=1.74 m3/s; uin=0.02 m3/s; uout=0.018 m3/s; z=(Qin-Qout)/sqrt(uin2+uout2)=2.229882。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=1.8 m3/s; Qout=1.74 m3/s; uin=0.02 m3/s; uout=0.018 m3/s; z=(Qin-Qout)/sqrt(uin2+uout2)=2.229882.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管網水量差與誤差範圍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Network imbalance and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管網水量差與誤差範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Network imbalance and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=1.8 m3/s; Qout=1.74 m3/s; uin=0.02 m3/s; uout=0.018 m3/s; z=(Qin-Qout)/sqrt(uin2+uout2)=2.229882。適用邊界：兩標準不確定度獨立且流量同步穩態，無蓄量變化；比值不是機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=1.8 m3/s; Qout=1.74 m3/s; uin=0.02 m3/s; uout=0.018 m3/s; z=(Qin-Qout)/sqrt(uin2+uout2)=2.229882. Applicable boundary: Independent standard uncertainties and synchronized steady flows with no storage change; the ratio is not a probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用共同時鐘比較累積水量，先排除充水、排空及壓力改變造成的暫存，再檢查流量計校準是否共享偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare cumulative volumes on a shared clock, excluding filling, draining and pressure-related storage before checking shared calibration bias.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 管網水量差與誤差範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network imbalance and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管網水量差與誤差範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Network imbalance and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用共同時鐘比較累積水量，先排除充水、排空及壓力改變造成的暫存，再檢查流量計校準是否共享偏差。以多日殘差趨勢搭配分段量測定位，不把一次超出誤差尺度直接當成漏水位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare cumulative volumes on a shared clock, excluding filling, draining and pressure-related storage before checking shared calibration bias. Combine multi-day residual trends with sectional measurements for localization rather than treating one large normalized residual as a leak location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把兩儀表標準不確定度各加倍，重算比值並保持水量差不變，再說明若共享系統偏差存在，應如何改寫變異數而非繼續套獨立公式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double both meter standard uncertainties while keeping imbalance fixed, recalculate the ratio and explain how a shared systematic component requires a covariance term rather than continued use of the independent-error formula.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把比值二點多說成漏水機率百分之二點多，混淆無因次尺度與機率；若兩流量計誤差高度相關卻仍用獨立平方和，則不確定度可能被錯估，診斷信心隨之失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting a ratio near two as a two-percent leak probability confuses a scale with probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare cumulative volumes on a shared clock, excluding filling, draining and pressure-related storage before checking shared calibration bias. Combine multi-day residual trends with sectional measurements for localization rather than treating one large normalized residual as a leak location.

knowledge.textEn: Double both meter standard uncertainties while keeping imbalance fixed, recalculate the ratio and explain how a shared systematic component requires a covariance term rather than continued use of the independent-error formula.

options: 使用共同時鐘比較累積水量，先排除充水、排空及壓力改變造成的暫存，再檢查流量計校準是否共享偏差。
