quiz.explanationEn: Compare cumulative volumes on a shared clock, excluding filling, draining and pressure-related storage before checking shared calibration bias. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管網水量差與誤差範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network imbalance and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管網水量差與誤差範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Network imbalance and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把比值二點多說成漏水機率百分之二點多，混淆無因次尺度與機率；若兩流量計誤差高度相關卻仍用獨立平方和，則不確定度可能被錯估，診斷信心隨之失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting a ratio near two as a two-percent leak probability confuses a scale with probability. Applying independent root-sum-square uncertainty to correlated meters can misstate uncertainty and distort confidence in the diagnosis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個比值不是漏水機率；共同校準偏差、旅行延遲或管內儲水改變都可能破壞獨立假設，應先檢查再判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio is not a leakage probability; shared calibration bias, travel delay and changing pipe storage can violate the assumptions and must be examined before interpreting the imbalance as physical loss.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「正規化水量差數值就是管線漏水的百分比機率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The normalized flow imbalance directly equals the percentage probability of leakage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把比值二點多說成漏水機率百分之二點多，混淆無因次尺度與機率；若兩流量計誤差高度相關卻仍用獨立平方和，則不確定度可能被錯估，診斷信心隨之失真。
knowledge.textEn: Interpreting a ratio near two as a two-percent leak probability confuses a scale with probability. Applying independent root-sum-square uncertainty to correlated meters can misstate uncertainty and distort confidence in the diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管網水量差與誤差範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network imbalance and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把比值二點多說成漏水機率百分之二點多，混淆無因次尺度與機率；若兩流量計誤差高度相關卻仍用獨立平方和，則不確定度可能被錯估，診斷信心隨之失真。
來源河川的全部流量都可直接列為水庫實收入流
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Interpreting a ratio near two as a two-percent leak probability confuses a scale with probability.
All source-river discharge can be entered as water actually received by the reservoir
quiz.explanation: 把比值二點多說成漏水機率百分之二點多，混淆無因次尺度與機率；若兩流量計誤差高度相關卻仍用獨立平方和，則不確定度可能被錯估，診斷信心隨之失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpreting a ratio near two as a two-percent leak probability confuses a scale with probability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 三峽升船機
summary: 本課以三峽升船機為入口，深入高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Three Gorges ship lift as its entry point, this course examines counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 提升功率敏感度固定速度0.2 m/s與g=9.81 m/s²，只將不平衡質量由100 t降至50 t。純重力功率Δmgv由196.2降至98.1 kW，減少50%；這只是相同速度下需克服的重力項。摩擦、啟停加速度、再生回送和傳動效率仍須另計，不能因此宣稱整機耗電也減半。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For lifting-power sensitivity, hold speed at 0.2 m/s and g at 9.81 m/s², reducing only imbalance mass from 100 t to 50 t. Gravity-only power Δmgv falls from 196.2 to 98.1 kW, a 50% reduction in that component. Friction, starting acceleration, regeneration and drive efficiency remain separate, so total machine electricity consumption need not halve.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「船舶排水與船廂質量」與「配重不平衡功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vessel displacement and caisson mass" and "Counterweight imbalance power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 船舶排水與船廂質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vessel displacement and caisson mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「船舶排水與船廂質量」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vessel displacement and caisson mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮船進入保持固定水位的船廂時，會排出等重的水，因此船加水總重近似不變。這個平衡依賴船舶自由浮動及水量能夠交換，不能套用坐底或封閉增水情況。 假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。 船舶坐底後不再完整由浮力支承，水位改變也會破壞固定總重假設。若混淆載貨重量和船舶總排水質量，平衡重判讀將出現大幅偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船舶排水與船廂質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floating vessel entering a fixed-level caisson displaces water of equal weight, keeping vessel-plus-water mass approximately constant. This requires free flotation and water exchange, and does not apply to grounding or added water in a sealed chamber. Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Grounding removes full buoyant support, while changing level breaks constant total mass. Confusing cargo weight with total vessel displacement can cause a large error in interpreting counterweight balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vessel displacement and caisson mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 配重不平衡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Counterweight imbalance power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配重不平衡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Counterweight imbalance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。將上升與下降的功率差分離為重力項，核對摩擦估計是否維持合理的非負耗能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration. Compare opposite directions under matched conditions and avoid interpreting regenerated electricity as negative friction. Separate gravitational demand from opposite-direction power differences and check that inferred friction remains a plausible nonnegative loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以配重不平衡功率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for counterweight imbalance power, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration. Compare opposite directions under matched conditions and avoid interpreting regenerated electricity as negative friction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 配重不平衡功率：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Counterweight imbalance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「有配重就能完全消除所有重力差所需的驅動功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Counterweights completely eliminate drive power required by every gravitational imbalance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「配重不平衡功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。
配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth.
Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish.

quiz.explanationEn: Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「齒條切向力分配」與「四角同步與船廂傾斜」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rack tangential-force sharing" and "Corner synchronization and caisson tilt": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 齒條切向力分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rack tangential-force sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「齒條切向力分配」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rack tangential-force sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 齒輪齒條把轉矩轉成豎向力，多驅動點必須協調分擔。平均轉矩相同不保證齒面接觸相同，幾何誤差和傳動剛度會造成局部偏載。 假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。 一個驅動點遲滯會使其他點先承載，扭矩平均值可能仍正常。齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「齒條切向力分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points. Equal mean torque does not ensure equal tooth contact because geometric error and drivetrain stiffness create local unequal loading. Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m. Tangential force T/r=400 kN, an ideal contact resultant excluding tooth-root stress concentration. A lagging drive shifts load to other points despite an apparently normal mean torque. Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rack tangential-force sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「齒條切向力分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rack tangential-force sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points. Equal mean torque does not ensure equal tooth contact because geometric error and drivetrain stiffness create local unequal loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「齒條切向力分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rack tangential-force sharing" is correct?
options: 齒輪齒條把轉矩轉成豎向力，多驅動點必須協調分擔。
平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。
所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。
optionsEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points.
Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth.
Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized.
quiz.explanation: 齒輪齒條把轉矩轉成豎向力，多驅動點必須協調分擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner synchronization and caisson tilt” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型船廂由多點支承，位置差會轉成傾斜與扭曲，進而改變導向和對接條件。同步控制須比較同基準位置，不能只比較各馬達轉速。 假設橫向支承跨20 m、兩側高差4 mm，小角度θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad，即0.01146°；剛體近似不含扭曲。 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「四角同步與船廂傾斜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components. steps.instruction: 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rope extension and temperature" and "Self-locking of screw mechanisms": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rope extension and temperature: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼索彈伸與溫度」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rope extension and temperature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼索受力會伸長，等長索因有效剛度和溫度差也可能產生不同位移。鋼索等效模數與實心鋼棒不同，必須使用實測或供應者資料。 假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。 端接滑移可能表現為長度增加卻不符合索力變化，斷絲也會降低有效剛度。若把所有延伸都視為可逆彈性，便會漏掉需獨立檢查的損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼索彈伸與溫度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature. Rope effective modulus differs from a solid steel bar and requires measured or supplier-supported values. Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Anchorage slip produces extension inconsistent with tension, and broken wires reduce effective stiffness. Treating all elongation as reversible elasticity misses damage that requires an independent physical inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rope extension and temperature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼索彈伸與溫度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rope extension and temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度

knowledge.textEn: Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature. Rope effective modulus differs from a solid steel bar and requires measured or supplier-supported values.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼索彈伸與溫度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

螺旋機構具有靜態自鎖就保證所有動態情況安全。

optionsEn: A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
Static screw self-locking guarantees safety under every dynamic condition.
Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature.

steps.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼索彈伸與溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rope extension and temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 螺旋升降或安全機構的自鎖與導程角、摩擦和牙型有關。靜態幾何比較可解釋反驅趨勢，不能替代實際安全裝置的設計和動態試驗。 假設理想方牙螺旋導程角3°、摩擦係數0.08，tan3°=0.0524小於0.08，靜態模型有自鎖趨勢；未含振動、潤滑變動與其他牙型。 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「螺旋機構自鎖判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Screw self-locking depends on lead angle, friction and thread form. A static geometric comparison explains back-driving tendency without replacing the design and dynamic verification of a real safety mechanism. Assume an ideal square thread with lead angle three degrees and friction coefficient 0.08. tan3°=0.0524 below 0.08 suggests static self-locking, excluding vibration, lubrication change and other thread forms. Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Self-locking of screw mechanisms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺旋機構具有靜態自鎖就保證所有動態情況安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Static screw self-locking guarantees safety under every dynamic condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。若把自鎖當成不需檢查的永久特性，會忽略磨耗和污染造成的改變。
knowledge.textEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Treating self-locking as permanent ignores wear and contamination that alter the mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「螺旋機構自鎖判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Self-locking of screw mechanisms" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。
optionsEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
quiz.explanation: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「對接水位差作用」與「啟停加速度與慣性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Docking head-difference force" and "Start-stop acceleration and inertia": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對接水位差作用」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Docking head-difference force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。對接荷載需區分平衡水位、間隙充水和結構鎖定，不可只憑水面看似齊平。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對接水位差作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. Docking assessment separates equalized levels, gap filling and structural restraint instead of relying on water surfaces that merely appear aligned. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area. Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Docking head-difference force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對接水位差作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Docking head-difference force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對接水位差作用
knowledge.text: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。對接荷載需區分平衡水位、間隙充水和結構鎖定，不可只憑水面看似齊平。
knowledge.textEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. Docking assessment separates equalized levels, gap filling and structural restraint instead of relying on water surfaces that merely appear aligned.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「對接水位差作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Docking head-difference force" is correct?
options: 肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。
船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。
配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。
optionsEn: Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces.
Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
quiz.explanation: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對接水位差作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Docking head-difference force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「對接水位差作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Docking head-difference force", which statement holds?
options: 提升速度最快的設備必定具有最大的全年通航量。
有配重就能完全消除所有重力差所需的驅動功率。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: The fastest lifting equipment necessarily has the greatest annual throughput.
Counterweights completely eliminate drive power required by every gravitational imbalance.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對接水位差作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Docking head-difference force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。將兩側水位差直接換算壓差，核對間隙充水過程的荷載峰值是否符合量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value. Convert the two-sided level difference directly to pressure and check whether measured peaks match the gap-filling stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以對接水位差作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking head-difference force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。將兩側水位差直接換算壓差，核對間隙充水過程的荷載峰值是否符合量測。
knowledge.textEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value. Convert the two-sided level difference directly to pressure and check whether measured peaks match the gap-filling stage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以對接水位差作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking head-difference force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value.

quiz.question: 要驗證「對接水位差作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Docking head-difference force"?
options: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。
optionsEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized.
quiz.explanation: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「對接水位差作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Docking head-difference force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。
配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact.
Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
quiz.explanation: 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 啟停加速度與慣性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Start-stop acceleration and inertia: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「啟停加速度與慣性」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。加速時兩者動能同時增加，不能將淨重量小誤當總慣性小。 假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「啟停加速度與慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. Both gain kinetic energy during acceleration, so small net weight does not imply small total inertial demand. Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia. Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「啟停加速度與慣性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Start-stop acceleration and inertia”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 啟停加速度與慣性
knowledge.text: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。加速時兩者動能同時增加，不能將淨重量小誤當總慣性小。
knowledge.textEn: Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. Both gain kinetic energy during acceleration, so small net weight does not imply small total inertial demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「啟停加速度與慣性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Start-stop acceleration and inertia" is correct?
options: 配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。
單一平均塔柱溫度足以描述所有熱變形和對中變化。
即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。
optionsEn: Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
One mean tower temperature describes all thermal deformation and alignment changes.
Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia.
quiz.explanation: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 啟停加速度與慣性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Start-stop acceleration and inertia: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「啟停加速度與慣性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「啟停加速度與慣性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Start-stop acceleration and inertia", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN。
船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。
平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s².
A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass.
Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 啟停加速度與慣性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Start-stop acceleration and inertia: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「啟停加速度與慣性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。以能量增量獨立核對加速功，確認配重和傳動旋轉件沒有從總慣性中遺漏。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms. Independently check acceleration work from energy increase and verify that counterweights and rotating drivetrain inertia are not omitted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以啟停加速度與慣性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for start-stop acceleration and inertia, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。以能量增量獨立核對加速功，確認配重和傳動旋轉件沒有從總慣性中遺漏。
knowledge.textEn: Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms. Independently check acceleration work from energy increase and verify that counterweights and rotating drivetrain inertia are not omitted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以啟停加速度與慣性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for start-stop acceleration and inertia, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Compare drive-force changes with predicted inertia, estimating friction and gravitational imbalance as separate terms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「啟停加速度與慣性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Start-stop acceleration and inertia"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。
鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay.
A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
quiz.explanation: 從位置資料以適當濾波求速度和加速度，保留濾波延遲說明；比較驅動力變化與理論慣性項，並把摩擦和不平衡重力另外估計。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Derive speed and acceleration from position using documented filtering and delay. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 啟停加速度與慣性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Start-stop acceleration and inertia: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「啟停加速度與慣性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。

quiz.question: 在「啟停加速度與慣性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Start-stop acceleration and inertia" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
單一平均塔柱溫度足以描述所有熱變形和對中變化。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One mean tower temperature describes all thermal deformation and alignment changes.
Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塔柱溫度與對中」與「全流程時間與容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tower temperature and alignment" and "Full-cycle time and capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塔柱溫度與對中：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tower temperature and alignment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塔柱溫度與對中」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower temperature and alignment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高塔受日照與季節溫度變化會伸縮，導軌相對位置因此改變。均勻伸長和橫向溫差彎曲是不同機制，應用獨立幾何量測辨認。 假設有效塔高120 m、混凝土熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻升溫10 K，伸長αLΔT=12 mm；不含溫差彎曲與徐變。 日照不均造成的彎曲可能比平均溫升更影響導向，測站自身也會熱變形。若把可逆日變化當永久沉降，可能誤導對中診斷和維護優先次序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塔柱溫度與對中」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tall towers expand with solar and seasonal temperature changes, shifting guide alignment. Uniform extension differs from curvature caused by transverse thermal gradients and requires independent geometric observations. Assume effective tower height 120 m, concrete thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K and uniform warming 10 K. Extension αLΔT=12 mm, excluding thermal curvature and creep. Uneven solar heating can affect guidance more than mean warming, and survey stations can also deform thermally. Mistaking reversible daily movement for settlement misdirects alignment diagnosis and maintenance priorities. steps.instruction: 提升速度只決定垂直運動的一段時間，通航能力還包含進出船、對接與確認。以單程升降時間推算每日通過量，會高估系統容量。 假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「全流程時間與容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 全流程時間與容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle time and capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全流程時間與容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-cycle time and capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed. Adding 1300 s for entry, exit and docking gives 1800 s and ideal two cycles per hour, excluding outages. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed. Adding 1300 s for entry, exit and docking gives 1800 s and ideal two cycles per hour, excluding outages.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全流程時間與容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-cycle time and capacity", which statement holds?
options: 平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。
鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s。
optionsEn: Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth.
A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設提升100 m、速度0.2 m/s，恆速需500 s；另有進出與對接1300 s，循環1800 s，理想每小時2 cycles，不含停機。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift 100 m at 0.2 m/s, requiring 500 s at constant speed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全流程時間與容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle time and capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全流程時間與容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-cycle time and capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。把每循環最長串聯作業時間加總，並確認每小時容量沒有把必要確認程序當成重疊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability. Sum the longest sequential activities per cycle and ensure hourly capacity does not treat necessary confirmations as overlapping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以全流程時間與容量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle time and capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。把每循環最長串聯作業時間加總，並確認每小時容量沒有把必要確認程序當成重疊。
knowledge.textEn: Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability. Sum the longest sequential activities per cycle and ensure hourly capacity does not treat necessary confirmations as overlapping.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以全流程時間與容量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle time and capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Identify overlapping versus sequential activities, separating theoretical upper capacity, observed service rate and maintenance unavailability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全流程時間與容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-cycle time and capacity"?
options: 按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。
optionsEn: Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
quiz.explanation: 按功能拆分時間戳並保留船型與方向，核對哪些活動能重疊、哪些必須先後完成；把理論上限、實際服務率和維護不可用時間分開呈現。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Split timestamps by function and retain vessel type and direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全流程時間與容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle time and capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全流程時間與容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-cycle time and capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. Using the fastest transit as annual performance hides queues and availability differences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using the fastest transit as annual performance hides queues and availability differences.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升速度最快的設備必定具有最大的全年通航量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The fastest lifting equipment necessarily has the greatest annual throughput." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。以最短一次通過代表全年績效，會隱藏排隊和可用度差異。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. Using the fastest transit as annual performance hides queues and availability differences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全流程時間與容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-cycle time and capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。
船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations.
A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass.
quiz.explanation: 假設所有活動都能重疊會把必要的對接與確認時間刪掉，長船與不同水位也可能改變耗時。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming universal overlap removes necessary docking and confirmation time, while vessel length and levels change durations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機
summary: 本課以比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機為入口，深入纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Strepy-Thieu boat lift as its entry point, this course examines cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「船廂水位與額外質量」與「纜索群載重分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Caisson level and extra mass" and "Cable-group load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「船廂水位與額外質量」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caisson level and extra mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。大平面船廂即使小幅水位變化，也會使配重平衡出現明顯差異。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船廂水位與額外質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. A level error directly changes water volume, so even a small change across a large plan area noticeably alters counterweight balance. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Caisson level and extra mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「船廂水位與額外質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Caisson level and extra mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 船廂水位與額外質量
knowledge.text: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。大平面船廂即使小幅水位變化，也會使配重平衡出現明顯差異。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. A level error directly changes water volume, so even a small change across a large plan area noticeably alters counterweight balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「船廂水位與額外質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson level and extra mass" is correct?
options: 浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。
總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。
optionsEn: A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level.
Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
quiz.explanation: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船廂水位與額外質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caisson level and extra mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

optionsEn: A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³.
