steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船廂水位與額外質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Caisson level and extra mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。另外檢查船舶進出時水位計受到遮蔽的區段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates. Also identify intervals when vessel entry or exit obstructs the level measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以船廂水位與額外質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for caisson level and extra mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「船廂水位與額外質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Caisson level and extra mass"?
options: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.

quiz.explanationEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船廂水位與額外質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Caisson level and extra mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船廂水位與額外質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Caisson level and extra mass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment.
Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.

quiz.explanationEn: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纜索群載重分配」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable-group load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。總索數除重量只提供理想平均，不保證最大索力或端部連接需求。 假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纜索群載重分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization. Dividing weight by rope count gives an ideal mean rather than the maximum tension or anchorage demand. Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cable-group load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「纜索群載重分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「纜索群載重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable-group load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「纜索群載重分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable-group load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。以最大值和分位數呈現分配，而非只有平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions. Report maxima and distribution quantiles instead of presenting only the mean tension. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以纜索群載重分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cable-group load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cable-group load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「纜索群載重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cable-group load sharing"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load.
All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.

quiz.explanationEn: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「纜索群載重分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable-group load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「纜索群載重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable-group load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing.
quiz.explanation: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「均衡梁槓桿關係」與「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equalizer lever equilibrium" and "Sheave curvature and bending cycles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equalizer lever equilibrium: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「均衡梁槓桿關係」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equalizer lever equilibrium” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均衡梁藉槓桿轉動重新分配索力，但臂長、接頭摩擦與行程限制會影響效果。能轉動的機構不一定仍處於有效均衡範圍。 假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN；理想無摩擦鉸接。 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「均衡梁槓桿關係」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An equalizer redistributes tension through lever rotation, with arm length, joint friction and travel limits controlling performance. A movable mechanism is not necessarily still within its effective equalization range. Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m. From T1×0.8=T2×1.2, T1=1.2 MN and T2=0.8 MN, for an ideal frictionless pivot. Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equalizer lever equilibrium” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN；理想無摩擦鉸接。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「均衡梁槓桿關係」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equalizer lever equilibrium”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係
knowledge.text: 均衡梁藉槓桿轉動重新分配索力，但臂長、接頭摩擦與行程限制會影響效果。能轉動的機構不一定仍處於有效均衡範圍。
knowledge.textEn: An equalizer redistributes tension through lever rotation, with arm length, joint friction and travel limits controlling performance. A movable mechanism is not necessarily still within its effective equalization range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「均衡梁槓桿關係」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equalizer lever equilibrium" is correct?
options: 均衡梁藉槓桿轉動重新分配索力，但臂長、接頭摩擦與行程限制會影響效果。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。
optionsEn: An equalizer redistributes tension through lever rotation, with arm length, joint friction and travel limits controlling performance.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.
quiz.explanation: 均衡梁藉槓桿轉動重新分配索力，但臂長、接頭摩擦與行程限制會影響效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An equalizer redistributes tension through lever rotation, with arm length, joint friction and travel limits controlling performance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equalizer lever equilibrium: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「均衡梁槓桿關係」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equalizer lever equilibrium” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN；理想無摩擦鉸接。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m. From T1×0.8=T2×1.2, T1=1.2 MN and T2=0.8 MN, for an ideal frictionless pivot. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m. From T1×0.8=T2×1.2, T1=1.2 MN and T2=0.8 MN, for an ideal frictionless pivot.

quiz.question: 依「均衡梁槓桿關係」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equalizer lever equilibrium", which statement holds?
options: 塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總力2 MN、兩臂長0.8與1.2 m，力矩平衡T1×0.8=T2×1.2，T1=1.2 MN、T2=0.8 MN。
配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。
optionsEn: Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total force 2 MN and lever arms 0.8 and 1.2 m.

steps.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equalizer lever equilibrium: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「均衡梁槓桿關係」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equalizer lever equilibrium” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。對照梁端止擋距離與可容許的剩餘調平行程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium. Compare hysteresis during opposite load changes and verify that ends have not reached geometric travel stops. Compare end-stop distances with the remaining available travel for tension equalization. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以均衡梁槓桿關係編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for equalizer lever equilibrium, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium. Compare hysteresis during opposite load changes and verify that ends have not reached geometric travel stops.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「均衡梁槓桿關係」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equalizer lever equilibrium"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
至少一座船廂可用就代表整個系統完整容量可用。
同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
At least one available caisson means full system capacity is available.
Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium.
quiz.explanation: 同時量測梁角、兩端位移和張力，檢查是否滿足力矩平衡；在載重反向變化時比較遲滯，並確認梁端尚未碰觸幾何行程限制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure beam angle, end movement and tension together and check moment equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 均衡梁槓桿關係：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equalizer lever equilibrium: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「均衡梁槓桿關係」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equalizer lever equilibrium” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。只確認梁體沒有裂紋，無法證明整個調平機構仍能有效動作。
knowledge.textEn: Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. An uncracked beam alone does not establish that the complete leveling mechanism still functions effectively.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「均衡梁槓桿關係」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equalizer lever equilibrium" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。
optionsEn: Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.
quiz.explanation: 軸銷摩擦可讓張力差暫時維持而梁不轉，接近止擋時均衡功能也會退化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pin friction can preserve unequal tension without movement, and approaching a stop degrades equalization. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sheave curvature and bending cycles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sheave curvature and bending cycles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼索反覆繞過輪槽時，單絲承受彎曲與接觸作用，輪徑對索徑比是重要幾何指標。該比值不能單獨給出疲勞壽命，還需張力譜和索結構。 假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ropes repeatedly bending over grooves experience wire bending and contact. Sheave-to-rope diameter ratio is useful geometry, but fatigue life also depends on tension spectrum and rope construction. Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. At 20000 bends annually, five years gives 100000 bends, a count rather than a life guarantee. Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sheave curvature and bending cycles” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sheave curvature and bending cycles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環
knowledge.text: 鋼索反覆繞過輪槽時，單絲承受彎曲與接觸作用，輪徑對索徑比是重要幾何指標。該比值不能單獨給出疲勞壽命，還需張力譜和索結構。
knowledge.textEn: Ropes repeatedly bending over grooves experience wire bending and contact. Sheave-to-rope diameter ratio is useful geometry, but fatigue life also depends on tension spectrum and rope construction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sheave curvature and bending cycles" is correct?
options: 索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。
鋼索反覆繞過輪槽時，單絲承受彎曲與接觸作用，輪徑對索徑比是重要幾何指標。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.
Ropes repeatedly bending over grooves experience wire bending and contact.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
quiz.explanation: 鋼索反覆繞過輪槽時，單絲承受彎曲與接觸作用，輪徑對索徑比是重要幾何指標。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ropes repeatedly bending over grooves experience wire bending and contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sheave curvature and bending cycles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sheave curvature and bending cycles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. At 20000 bends annually, five years gives 100000 bends, a count rather than a life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. At 20000 bends annually, five years gives 100000 bends, a count rather than a life guarantee.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sheave curvature and bending cycles", which statement holds?
options: 任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。
optionsEn: Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設索輪直徑4 m、鋼索直徑0.08 m，D/d=50；若一年20000次繞曲，5年為100000次，僅計數而非壽命保證。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sheave diameter 4 m and rope diameter 0.08 m, giving D/d=50. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。確認檢測覆蓋同一段鋼索而非不同索段。
knowledge.textEn: Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones. Interpret lubrication, magnetic inspection and visual evidence together rather than using any one indicator alone. Verify that repeated inspections cover the same rope section rather than different segments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以索輪曲率與彎曲循環編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sheave curvature and bending cycles, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones. Interpret lubrication, magnetic inspection and visual evidence together rather than using any one indicator alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sheave curvature and bending cycles"?
options: 對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
optionsEn: Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
quiz.explanation: 對照輪槽尺寸、索徑和彎曲循環紀錄，檢查斷絲位置是否集中於反覆繞曲區；把潤滑狀態、磁漏檢測與外觀證據合併判讀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare groove geometry, rope diameter and bending records, locating broken wires relative to repeated bend zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 索輪曲率與彎曲循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sheave curvature and bending cycles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sheave curvature and bending cycles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。若只用循環次數或直徑比決定狀況，會漏掉局部磨擦與腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Cycle count or diameter ratio alone misses localized rubbing and corrosion mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索輪曲率與彎曲循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sheave curvature and bending cycles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
quiz.explanation: 索輪磨耗可改變接觸壓力而不改變名義輪徑，內部斷絲也未必外露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Groove wear changes contact pressure without changing nominal diameter, and internal wire breaks may be hidden. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「捲揚轉速與機械效率」與「塔架側移與導向」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Winch speed and mechanical efficiency" and "Tower sway and guidance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Winch speed and mechanical efficiency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「捲揚轉速與機械效率」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 捲揚機把索的線速度轉為轉速，減速機改變轉矩和速度但不創造功率。有效鼓徑隨繞層可能改變，因此編碼器轉角不一定固定對應索長。 假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「捲揚轉速與機械效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Winches convert rope speed to rotation. Gear reduction exchanges speed and torque without creating power, while changing winding radius can alter the relationship between encoder angle and rope travel. Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip. Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「捲揚轉速與機械效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率
knowledge.text: 捲揚機把索的線速度轉為轉速，減速機改變轉矩和速度但不創造功率。有效鼓徑隨繞層可能改變，因此編碼器轉角不一定固定對應索長。
knowledge.textEn: Winches convert rope speed to rotation. Gear reduction exchanges speed and torque without creating power, while changing winding radius can alter the relationship between encoder angle and rope travel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「捲揚轉速與機械效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Winch speed and mechanical efficiency" is correct?
options: 減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。
捲揚機把索的線速度轉為轉速，減速機改變轉矩和速度但不創造功率。
optionsEn: Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
Winches convert rope speed to rotation.
quiz.explanation: 捲揚機把索的線速度轉為轉速，減速機改變轉矩和速度但不創造功率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Winches convert rope speed to rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Winch speed and mechanical efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「捲揚轉速與機械效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「捲揚轉速與機械效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Winch speed and mechanical efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效鼓半徑1.5 m、索速0.15 m/s，轉速n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm；單層固定半徑，未含滑移。
配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。
至少一座船廂可用就代表整個系統完整容量可用。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip.
Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective drum radius 1.5 m and rope speed 0.15 m/s. n=60v/(2πr)=0.9549 rpm, for a fixed single-layer radius without slip. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Winch speed and mechanical efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「捲揚轉速與機械效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。對獨立行程資料進行完整往返閉合檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position. Check input speed, output torque and power together to ensure inferred efficiency respects physical limits. Check independent travel measurements for closure over a complete outward and return movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for winch speed and mechanical efficiency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check input speed, output torque and power together to ensure inferred efficiency respects physical limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「捲揚轉速與機械效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Winch speed and mechanical efficiency"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。
總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position.
Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
quiz.explanation: 比較編碼器轉角與獨立索長量測，按繞層和鼓槽位置分組；再核對輸入轉速、輸出轉矩與功率，確認效率不超過物理上限。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare encoder angle with independent rope travel, grouped by winding layer and groove position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 捲揚轉速與機械效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Winch speed and mechanical efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「捲揚轉速與機械效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Winch speed and mechanical efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。
knowledge.textEn: Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Rope slip can leave rotational signals agreeing while actual travel differs, requiring independent displacement evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「捲揚轉速與機械效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Winch speed and mechanical efficiency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。
多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion.
quiz.explanation: 多層繞索使半徑改變，仍用固定換算會累積位置誤差；索在輪槽滑移又可能讓兩個轉速訊號一致但實際行程不同，必須有獨立位移證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple layers alter radius and accumulate position error under a fixed conversion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 塔架側移與導向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tower sway and guidance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塔架側移與導向」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tower sway and guidance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高塔的側向柔度改變導向間隙和索具幾何，風與熱作用可能疊加。簡化懸臂模型適合比較剛度敏感性，不能替代含橫梁與基礎的整體模型。 假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。單點位移也可能受測站移動影響，若缺少獨立基準就會誤判導向系統的幾何變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塔架側移與導向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tower lateral flexibility changes guide clearance and rope geometry, with wind and thermal effects interacting. A cantilever model compares stiffness sensitivity without replacing the full frame and foundation model. Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation. Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. A moving survey station can also imitate sway and misidentify changes in guidance geometry without independent references. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tower sway and guidance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「塔架側移與導向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tower sway and guidance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塔架側移與導向
knowledge.text: 高塔的側向柔度改變導向間隙和索具幾何，風與熱作用可能疊加。簡化懸臂模型適合比較剛度敏感性，不能替代含橫梁與基礎的整體模型。
knowledge.textEn: Tower lateral flexibility changes guide clearance and rope geometry, with wind and thermal effects interacting. A cantilever model compares stiffness sensitivity without replacing the full frame and foundation model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塔架側移與導向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tower sway and guidance" is correct?
options: 高塔的側向柔度改變導向間隙和索具幾何，風與熱作用可能疊加。
塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。
任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
optionsEn: Tower lateral flexibility changes guide clearance and rope geometry, with wind and thermal effects interacting.
Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
quiz.explanation: 高塔的側向柔度改變導向間隙和索具幾何，風與熱作用可能疊加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tower lateral flexibility changes guide clearance and rope geometry, with wind and thermal effects interacting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塔架側移與導向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tower sway and guidance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塔架側移與導向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower sway and guidance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塔架側移與導向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tower sway and guidance", which statement holds?
options: 對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm。
浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
optionsEn: All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation.
A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效懸臂高80 m、頂部橫力200 kN、EI=4×10¹² N·m²，δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm；線彈性單柱近似。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent cantilever height 80 m, top force 200 kN and EI=4×10¹² N·m². δ=FL³/(3EI)=8.533 mm, a linear-elastic single-column approximation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塔架側移與導向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tower sway and guidance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塔架側移與導向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tower sway and guidance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。將測得塔身曲率與基礎轉角分別列出比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required. Report measured tower curvature separately from foundation rotation for direct comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以塔架側移與導向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tower sway and guidance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。將測得塔身曲率與基礎轉角分別列出比較。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required. Report measured tower curvature separately from foundation rotation for direct comparison.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以塔架側移與導向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tower sway and guidance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Check the cantilever shape before deciding whether frame or soil coupling is required.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塔架側移與導向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tower sway and guidance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt.
quiz.explanation: 用塔頂與中段測點重建變形形狀，對照風向、溫度和基礎傾斜；檢查是否符合懸臂曲線，再決定是否需要框架或地基耦合模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct deflection shape from top and intermediate targets and compare wind, temperature and foundation tilt. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。單點位移也可能受測站移動影響，若缺少獨立基準就會誤判導向系統的幾何變化。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. A moving survey station can also imitate sway and misidentify changes in guidance geometry without independent references.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塔架側移與導向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tower sway and guidance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
optionsEn: Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
quiz.explanation: 基礎轉動能產生近似線性側移，不能全歸因於塔柱彎曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Foundation rotation creates near-linear displacement that should not all be attributed to bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「配重行程與幾何邊界」與「制動動能與停止距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Counterweight travel and geometric limits" and "Braking energy and stopping distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 配重行程與幾何邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Counterweight travel and geometric limits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「配重行程與幾何邊界」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Counterweight travel and geometric limits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船廂與配重之間的索路幾何決定行程比，不能僅由名稱推定一比一。滑輪組、端部空間與纜索彈伸共同限制可達位置。 假設理想索路長度約束x+2y=constant，船廂上升60 m則配重位移y=−30 m；此為教學滑輪配置，非宣稱本站索路。 把虛構滑輪比例套到實際系統會直接錯估行程，索具伸長也會改變端部餘裕。即使中段運動正常，端部空間不足仍可能成為主要限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「配重行程與幾何邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rope routing determines the travel ratio between caisson and counterweight; it cannot be inferred from terminology alone. Pulley arrangements, endpoint space and rope extension jointly constrain reachable positions. Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant. A caisson rise of 60 m gives counterweight displacement y=−30 m; this is not a claim about the actual site routing. Applying an assumed pulley ratio to the real system misstates travel, while rope extension changes endpoint clearance. Normal mid-travel motion does not establish adequate space near the ends. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Counterweight travel and geometric limits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理想索路長度約束x+2y=constant，船廂上升60 m則配重位移y=−30 m；此為教學滑輪配置，非宣稱本站索路。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「配重行程與幾何邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Counterweight travel and geometric limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 配重行程與幾何邊界
knowledge.text: 船廂與配重之間的索路幾何決定行程比，不能僅由名稱推定一比一。滑輪組、端部空間與纜索彈伸共同限制可達位置。
knowledge.textEn: Rope routing determines the travel ratio between caisson and counterweight; it cannot be inferred from terminology alone. Pulley arrangements, endpoint space and rope extension jointly constrain reachable positions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「配重行程與幾何邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Counterweight travel and geometric limits" is correct?
options: 任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
船廂與配重之間的索路幾何決定行程比，不能僅由名稱推定一比一。
配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。
optionsEn: Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
Rope routing determines the travel ratio between caisson and counterweight; it cannot be inferred from terminology alone.
Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.
quiz.explanation: 船廂與配重之間的索路幾何決定行程比，不能僅由名稱推定一比一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rope routing determines the travel ratio between caisson and counterweight; it cannot be inferred from terminology alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant. A caisson rise of 60 m gives counterweight displacement y=−30 m; this is not a claim about the actual site routing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace length change along every rope segment, identifying fixed and moving pulleys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「配重行程與幾何邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an ideal teaching rope constraint x+2y=constant.

steps.title: 配重行程與幾何邊界：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 沿圖面追蹤每段索長變化，逐一核對固定和活動滑輪；用低速量測的兩端位移比驗算幾何，並把伸長補償和端部餘裕分開。於索路各端標出正方向以防行程符號錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
