steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Braking energy and stopping distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 制動需吸收整個移動系統的動能，配重不會抵銷動能。停止距離與減速度相關，而不平衡重力可能在同一方向持續加入能量。 假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「制動動能與停止距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brakes absorb kinetic energy of the moving system, which counterweights do not cancel. Stopping distance depends on deceleration, while imbalance gravity may continue adding energy in the direction of motion. Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Constant deceleration 0.01 m/s² gives stopping distance 1.125 m. Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Braking energy and stopping distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「制動動能與停止距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Braking energy and stopping distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 制動動能與停止距離
knowledge.text: 制動需吸收整個移動系統的動能，配重不會抵銷動能。停止距離與減速度相關，而不平衡重力可能在同一方向持續加入能量。
knowledge.textEn: Brakes absorb kinetic energy of the moving system, which counterweights do not cancel. Stopping distance depends on deceleration, while imbalance gravity may continue adding energy in the direction of motion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「制動動能與停止距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Braking energy and stopping distance" is correct?
options: 配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。
對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
制動需吸收整個移動系統的動能，配重不會抵銷動能。
optionsEn: Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.
All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
Brakes absorb kinetic energy of the moving system, which counterweights do not cancel.
quiz.explanation: 制動需吸收整個移動系統的動能，配重不會抵銷動能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brakes absorb kinetic energy of the moving system, which counterweights do not cancel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 制動動能與停止距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Braking energy and stopping distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「制動動能與停止距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Braking energy and stopping distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Constant deceleration 0.01 m/s² gives stopping distance 1.125 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Constant deceleration 0.01 m/s² gives stopping distance 1.125 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「制動動能與停止距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Braking energy and stopping distance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ。
浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ.
A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效移動質量16 million kg、速度0.15 m/s，動能mv²/2=180 kJ；若恆減速度0.01 m/s²，停止距離v²/(2a)=1.125 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent moving mass 16 million kg and speed 0.15 m/s, giving kinetic energy 180 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 制動動能與停止距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Braking energy and stopping distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「制動動能與停止距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Braking energy and stopping distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。把指令延遲造成的自由行程另加到總停止距離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading. Add travel during command-response delay separately to the total stopping distance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以制動動能與停止距離編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for braking energy and stopping distance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。把指令延遲造成的自由行程另加到總停止距離。
knowledge.textEn: Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading. Add travel during command-response delay separately to the total stopping distance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以制動動能與停止距離編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for braking energy and stopping distance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Record brake heat and gravity direction separately to distinguish kinetic absorption from sustained loading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「制動動能與停止距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Braking energy and stopping distance"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
quiz.explanation: 將制動起始位置、速度和停止位置同時核對，積分實測減速度驗算距離；另記錄制動熱與重力方向，區分動能吸收和持續荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check initial position, velocity and final position together, integrating measured deceleration to verify distance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 制動動能與停止距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Braking energy and stopping distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「制動動能與停止距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Braking energy and stopping distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。只以低速空載停止測試推論高能量工況，會低估距離與熱負擔。
knowledge.textEn: Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Extrapolating a slow unloaded stop to high-energy conditions understates distance and thermal demand on the braking system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「制動動能與停止距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Braking energy and stopping distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force.
quiz.explanation: 反應延遲會在真正減速前增加行程，固定減速度也可能因摩擦溫升而失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Response delay adds travel before deceleration, and heating may invalidate constant braking force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「對接間隙充水體積」與「雙船廂服務與可用度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Docking-gap filling volume" and "Two-caisson service and availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 對接間隙充水體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Docking-gap filling volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對接間隙充水體積」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Docking-gap filling volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船廂與固定航道之間的間隙需要形成可控水域，間隙體積影響水位變化和密封負荷。幾何體積不是漏水量，兩者應以不同量測辨認。 假設有效對接截面50 m²、間隙長0.25 m，充水體積12.5 m³；若由面積1000 m²船廂供應，理想水位下降12.5 mm。 若把正常間隙填水當成密封漏流，會誤判設備狀況；反之持續漏水被短時大流量掩蓋時也可能漏報。水位解析度不足更會使兩種原因難以區分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對接間隙充水體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The docking gap between caisson and fixed reach forms a controlled water volume. Its geometry influences level change and seal loading, but gap volume is not leakage and requires a separate measurement interpretation. Assume docking cross-section 50 m² and gap length 0.25 m, giving fill volume 12.5 m³. Supplied by a 1000 m² caisson, ideal level reduction is 12.5 mm. Normal gap filling can be mistaken for seal leakage, while large initial flow can conceal sustained leakage. Inadequate level resolution further obscures the distinction between temporary storage and a continuing defect. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Docking-gap filling volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效對接截面50 m²、間隙長0.25 m，充水體積12.5 m³；若由面積1000 m²船廂供應，理想水位下降12.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume docking cross-section 50 m² and gap length 0.25 m, giving fill volume 12.5 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對接間隙充水體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Docking-gap filling volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對接間隙充水體積

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。

All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
At least one available caisson means full system capacity is available.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 兩座獨立船廂可以增加服務彈性，但共用航道與維修資源會形成瓶頸。至少一座可用和兩座同時達到全部容量，是不同的可靠度問題。 假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975；兩座同時可用0.95²=0.9025，未含共同原因。 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙船廂服務與可用度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two independent caissons improve service flexibility, but shared approaches and maintenance resources can constrain capacity. Availability of at least one differs from simultaneous availability of full two-caisson throughput. Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each. Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities. steps.observation: 如何核對：分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975；兩座同時可用0.95²=0.9025，未含共同原因。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each. At least one is available with probability 0.9975, while both are available with probability 0.9025, excluding common causes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙船廂服務與可用度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Two-caisson service and availability", which statement holds?
options: 均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975。
optionsEn: The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩船廂獨立可用度各0.95，至少一座可用為1−0.05²=0.9975；兩座同時可用0.95²=0.9025，未含共同原因。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent caisson availability 0.95 each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙船廂服務與可用度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-caisson service and availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙船廂服務與可用度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-caisson service and availability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。另外報告共用航道不可用時造成的服務中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption. Report service interruptions caused by an unavailable shared navigation approach separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以雙船廂服務與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for two-caisson service and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。另外報告共用航道不可用時造成的服務中斷。
knowledge.textEn: Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption. Report service interruptions caused by an unavailable shared navigation approach separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以雙船廂服務與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for two-caisson service and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Identify outages occurring in the same event before accepting an independence assumption.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙船廂服務與可用度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-caisson service and availability"?
options: 分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
optionsEn: Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
quiz.explanation: 分別統計部分服務和完整容量時段，核對共用供電、航道與排程限制；檢查兩座停機是否在相同事件中發生，再判斷獨立性是否合理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count partial-service and full-capacity periods separately, checking shared power, approaches and scheduling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙船廂服務與可用度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-caisson service and availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙船廂服務與可用度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-caisson service and availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「至少一座船廂可用就代表整個系統完整容量可用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "At least one available caisson means full system capacity is available." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。必須先定義成功條件再引用數值。
knowledge.textEn: Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. A closed shared approach can prevent both healthy caissons from serving traffic, so success must be defined before quoting probabilities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙船廂服務與可用度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-caisson service and availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。
浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput.
A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
quiz.explanation: 把至少一座可用率當作完整容量可用率會誇大通行能力，共用航道停用又可能讓兩座正常設備都無法服務。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using at-least-one availability as full-capacity availability exaggerates throughput. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 福爾柯克水輪
summary: 本課以福爾柯克水輪為入口，深入旋轉升船的浮力平衡、齒輪定向與循環能量。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Falkirk Wheel as its entry point, this course examines buoyant balance, geared orientation and cycle energy in a rotating boat lift. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 水位差敏感度固定槽面積200 m²、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及水平力臂12 m，只將單槽多出的水深0.02 m減為0.01 m。Δm=ρAΔh由4 t降至2 t，重力轉矩ρAΔhgr由470.88降至235.44 kN·m。減半關係只適用此水平姿態的集中質量模型，不代表整圈轉動的實際電能或任意角度轉矩。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold gondola area 200 m², ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and horizontal lever arm 12 m fixed, reducing only excess depth from 0.02 m to 0.01 m. Imbalance Δm=ρAΔh falls from 4 t to 2 t and gravity torque ρAΔhgr from 470.88 to 235.44 kN·m. Halving applies to this horizontal concentrated-mass model, not full-rotation electricity use or torque at every angle.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「成對船槽質量平衡」與「重力轉矩隨角度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Paired gondola mass balance" and "Gravity torque versus angle": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成對船槽質量平衡」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Paired gondola mass balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。但船槽水位差、積水和附著物仍會破壞理想對稱。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成對船槽質量平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. Level differences, retained water and deposits can still break the ideal symmetry. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Paired gondola mass balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「成對船槽質量平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Paired gondola mass balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成對船槽質量平衡
knowledge.text: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。但船槽水位差、積水和附著物仍會破壞理想對稱。
knowledge.textEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. Level differences, retained water and deposits can still break the ideal symmetry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「成對船槽質量平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Paired gondola mass balance" is correct?
options: 兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。
水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。
質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
optionsEn: With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats.
A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
quiz.explanation: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「成對船槽質量平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Paired gondola mass balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「成對船槽質量平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Paired gondola mass balance", which statement holds?
options: 半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。
設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「成對船槽質量平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Paired gondola mass balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。把多餘水量與兩槽質量差放在同一張平衡表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position. Place excess water and the two-gondola mass difference in one balance sheet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以成對船槽質量平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for paired gondola mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Place excess water and the two-gondola mass difference in one balance sheet.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for paired gondola mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position.

quiz.question: 要驗證「成對船槽質量平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Paired gondola mass balance"?
options: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。
optionsEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling.
quiz.explanation: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成對船槽質量平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Paired gondola mass balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成對船槽質量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Paired gondola mass balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。
knowledge.textEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成對船槽質量平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Paired gondola mass balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。
質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water.
A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
quiz.explanation: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力轉矩隨角度」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity torque versus angle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。固定轉矩模型無法描述整個半圈動作。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力轉矩隨角度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. Gravity torque can approach zero vertically and peak horizontally, so constant torque cannot describe an entire half-turn. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gravity torque versus angle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力轉矩隨角度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gravity torque versus angle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重力轉矩隨角度
knowledge.text: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。固定轉矩模型無法描述整個半圈動作。
knowledge.textEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. Gravity torque can approach zero vertically and peak horizontally, so constant torque cannot describe an entire half-turn.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重力轉矩隨角度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gravity torque versus angle" is correct?
options: 質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。
optionsEn: A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle.
quiz.explanation: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. The other options are common misconceptions.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重力轉矩隨角度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gravity torque versus angle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。以水平與垂直位置的理論極值檢查角度定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction. Use theoretical horizontal and vertical extrema to verify the chosen angular reference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以重力轉矩隨角度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gravity torque versus angle, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gravity torque versus angle"?

Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape.

steps.title: 重力轉矩隨角度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gravity torque versus angle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力轉矩隨角度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gravity torque versus angle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重力轉矩隨角度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gravity torque versus angle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees.
quiz.explanation: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「船槽水平與齒輪定向」與「旋轉速度與旅程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gondola leveling by gearing" and "Rotation speed and travel": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 船槽水平與齒輪定向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gondola leveling by gearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「船槽水平與齒輪定向」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gondola leveling by gearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船槽需要在主輪轉動時保持接近水平，定向機構抵銷支臂相對地面的旋轉。這是運動學約束，不是只靠自由擺動就能保證的結果。 假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。只在上下終點檢查水平，可能漏掉中途最大的船槽傾斜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船槽水平與齒輪定向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gondolas remain approximately horizontal by counteracting the arm rotation relative to the ground. This is a kinematic constraint rather than a result guaranteed solely by free swinging. Assume the main arm rotates 180 degrees and the gondola rotates −180 degrees relative to it. Ground-referenced change is zero, an ideal opposite one-to-one relation rather than actual site tooth counts. Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following. Checking level only at upper and lower endpoints can miss the largest gondola tilt during intermediate rotation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gondola leveling by gearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume the main arm rotates 180 degrees and the gondola rotates −180 degrees relative to it.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「船槽水平與齒輪定向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gondola leveling by gearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 船槽水平與齒輪定向
knowledge.text: 船槽需要在主輪轉動時保持接近水平，定向機構抵銷支臂相對地面的旋轉。這是運動學約束，不是只靠自由擺動就能保證的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Gondolas remain approximately horizontal by counteracting the arm rotation relative to the ground. This is a kinematic constraint rather than a result guaranteed solely by free swinging.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「船槽水平與齒輪定向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gondola leveling by gearing" is correct?
options: 船槽需要在主輪轉動時保持接近水平，定向機構抵銷支臂相對地面的旋轉。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。
optionsEn: Gondolas remain approximately horizontal by counteracting the arm rotation relative to the ground.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 船槽需要在主輪轉動時保持接近水平，定向機構抵銷支臂相對地面的旋轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gondolas remain approximately horizontal by counteracting the arm rotation relative to the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船槽水平與齒輪定向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gondola leveling by gearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume the main arm rotates 180 degrees and the gondola rotates −180 degrees relative to it. Ground-referenced change is zero, an ideal opposite one-to-one relation rather than actual site tooth counts. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以地面水平基準同時量主臂和船槽角度，檢查兩角和在全行程是否穩定；將齒隙造成的換向偏差和結構撓曲分開繪製。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure arm and gondola angles against a ground-level reference and check their sum over the full travel.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「船槽水平與齒輪定向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gondola leveling by gearing", which statement holds?
options: 設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。

steps.instruction: 以地面水平基準同時量主臂和船槽角度，檢查兩角和在全行程是否穩定；將齒隙造成的換向偏差和結構撓曲分開繪製。另以獨立傾角計檢查水面與槽體的相對角度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure arm and gondola angles against a ground-level reference and check their sum over the full travel. steps.title: 船槽水平與齒輪定向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gondola leveling by gearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船槽水平與齒輪定向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gondola leveling by gearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。只在上下終點檢查水平，可能漏掉中途最大的船槽傾斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following. Checking level only at upper and lower endpoints can miss the largest gondola tilt during intermediate rotation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只在上下終點檢查水平，可能漏掉中途最大的船槽傾斜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Checking level only at upper and lower endpoints can miss the largest gondola tilt during intermediate rotation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船槽水平與齒輪定向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gondola leveling by gearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。
optionsEn: Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
quiz.explanation: 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 旋轉速度與旅程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotation speed and travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋轉速度與旅程」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotation speed and travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 半圈旋轉的平均角速度與最大角速度不同，啟停段必須留出加減速。船槽線速度也隨半徑變化，不能把軸的轉速當成乘客的平移速度。 假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。 將全程平均速度當成處處相同會低估加速段需求，非均勻運轉亦影響水面晃蕩。若半徑取到錯誤位置，換算船槽邊緣速度也會系統性偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋轉速度與旅程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean half-turn angular speed differs from maximum speed because start and stop need acceleration. Gondola linear speed also depends on radius, so shaft rotation is not passenger translation speed. Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s. Using average speed everywhere misses acceleration demand, while nonuniform movement excites water sloshing. A radius taken to the wrong point also systematically miscalculates speed at the gondola edge. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotation speed and travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋轉速度與旅程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotation speed and travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旋轉速度與旅程
knowledge.text: 半圈旋轉的平均角速度與最大角速度不同，啟停段必須留出加減速。船槽線速度也隨半徑變化，不能把軸的轉速當成乘客的平移速度。
knowledge.textEn: Mean half-turn angular speed differs from maximum speed because start and stop need acceleration. Gondola linear speed also depends on radius, so shaft rotation is not passenger translation speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旋轉速度與旅程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rotation speed and travel" is correct?
options: 半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。
半圈旋轉的平均角速度與最大角速度不同，啟停段必須留出加減速。
兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。
optionsEn: Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
Mean half-turn angular speed differs from maximum speed because start and stop need acceleration.
Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero.
quiz.explanation: 半圈旋轉的平均角速度與最大角速度不同，啟停段必須留出加減速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean half-turn angular speed differs from maximum speed because start and stop need acceleration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 旋轉速度與旅程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotation speed and travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旋轉速度與旅程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotation speed and travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從角位置歷線估算速度並核對線性位移，清楚標記加減速段；比較平均值與峰值，並確認資料濾波沒有把短時速度變化抹去。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate speed from angle history and verify it against linear travel, marking acceleration intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「旋轉速度與旅程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rotation speed and travel", which statement holds?
options: 預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。

optionsEn: All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.
