knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「串聯防線薄弱節點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weak links along a defence line", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三個必須全成功的區段年失效機率各0.001且獨立，系統失效1−0.999³=0.002997；不是把機率相乘成10⁻⁹。
離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。
設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume three essential segments each fail annually with probability 0.001 independently.
Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system.
The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三個必須全成功的區段年失效機率各0.001且獨立，系統失效1−0.999³=0.002997；不是把機率相乘成10⁻⁹。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume three essential segments each fail annually with probability 0.001 independently. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 串聯防線薄弱節點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weak links along a defence line: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「串聯防線薄弱節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weak links along a defence line” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先繪出淹水可能路徑，確認哪些區段是串聯、哪些是真正替代防線；用共同水位與地基條件檢查相關性，避免只依設備數量畫失效樹。以任一區段失效是否形成完整淹水路徑作測試。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map possible inundation routes and identify essential versus genuinely alternative defences. Check dependence through common water levels and ground conditions rather than drawing fault trees from equipment count alone. Test whether failure of each segment creates a complete inundation pathway. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以串聯防線薄弱節點編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先繪出淹水可能路徑，確認哪些區段是串聯、哪些是真正替代防線；用共同水位與地基條件檢查相關性，避免只依設備數量畫失效樹。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for weak links along a defence line, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map possible inundation routes and identify essential versus genuinely alternative defences. Check dependence through common water levels and ground conditions rather than drawing fault trees from equipment count alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把沿岸相鄰堤段當成互相備援會嚴重低估風險，一個缺口即可繞過其他完好區段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating adjacent bank segments as backups understates risk because one breach bypasses intact sections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Check dependence through common water levels and ground conditions rather than drawing fault trees from equipment count alone. Test whether failure of each segment creates a complete inundation pathway.

quiz.question: 要驗證「串聯防線薄弱節點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weak links along a defence line"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先繪出淹水可能路徑，確認哪些區段是串聯、哪些是真正替代防線；用共同水位與地基條件檢查相關性，避免只依設備數量畫失效樹。
只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Map possible inundation routes and identify essential versus genuinely alternative defences.
Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit.
quiz.explanation: 先繪出淹水可能路徑，確認哪些區段是串聯、哪些是真正替代防線；用共同水位與地基條件檢查相關性，避免只依設備數量畫失效樹。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map possible inundation routes and identify essential versus genuinely alternative defences. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 串聯防線薄弱節點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weak links along a defence line: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「串聯防線薄弱節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weak links along a defence line” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把沿岸相鄰堤段當成互相備援會嚴重低估風險，一個缺口即可繞過其他完好區段。相反地，真正具有隔離功能的內堤又不能完全忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating adjacent bank segments as backups understates risk because one breach bypasses intact sections. Conversely, internal defences that genuinely isolate areas should not be omitted from the network model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相反地，真正具有隔離功能的內堤又不能完全忽略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversely, internal defences that genuinely isolate areas should not be omitted from the network model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一保護圈的多段堤防可以當成完全平行備援。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Several segments of one protection ring act as fully parallel backups." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把沿岸相鄰堤段當成互相備援會嚴重低估風險，一個缺口即可繞過其他完好區段。相反地，真正具有隔離功能的內堤又不能完全忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Treating adjacent bank segments as backups understates risk because one breach bypasses intact sections. Conversely, internal defences that genuinely isolate areas should not be omitted from the network model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「串聯防線薄弱節點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weak links along a defence line" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。
把沿岸相鄰堤段當成互相備援會嚴重低估風險，一個缺口即可繞過其他完好區段。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading.
Treating adjacent bank segments as backups understates risk because one breach bypasses intact sections.
quiz.explanation: 把沿岸相鄰堤段當成互相備援會嚴重低估風險，一個缺口即可繞過其他完好區段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating adjacent bank segments as backups understates risk because one breach bypasses intact sections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「暴潮共同原因相關」與「防洪與潮灘面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Common storm dependence" and "Protection and tidal-flat area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 暴潮共同原因相關：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Common storm dependence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「暴潮共同原因相關」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common storm dependence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。相關性須來自共同機制與資料，而不是為簡化計算而任意設定。 假設P(A)=0.02、P(B|A)=0.4，聯合P(A∩B)=0.008；若誤用P(B)=0.02獨立相乘，只得0.0004，相差20倍。 少數共同事件可能支配區域風險，分散地理位置不保證氣象獨立。若只保留單站最大值而刪除時間戳，就無法重建真正的聯合荷載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「暴潮共同原因相關」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities. Dependence should come from shared mechanisms and evidence rather than computational convenience. Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4. Joint probability is 0.008; incorrectly using independent P(B)=0.02 gives 0.0004, twenty times smaller. A few shared events can dominate regional risk, and geographic separation does not guarantee meteorological independence. Deleting timestamps while retaining station maxima prevents reconstruction of actual joint loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common storm dependence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設P(A)=0.02、P(B|A)=0.4，聯合P(A∩B)=0.008；若誤用P(B)=0.02獨立相乘，只得0.0004，相差20倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「暴潮共同原因相關」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Common storm dependence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 暴潮共同原因相關
knowledge.text: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。相關性須來自共同機制與資料，而不是為簡化計算而任意設定。
knowledge.textEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities. Dependence should come from shared mechanisms and evidence rather than computational convenience.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「暴潮共同原因相關」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Common storm dependence" is correct?
options: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。
兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。
保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
optionsEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities.
Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading.
Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
quiz.explanation: 不同屏障可能同時遭遇同一風場與海水位，聯合失效不一定等於各機率乘積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different barriers can face the same wind and sea level, so joint failure need not equal the product of individual probabilities. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 暴潮共同原因相關：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Common storm dependence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「暴潮共同原因相關」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Common storm dependence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設P(A)=0.02、P(B|A)=0.4，聯合P(A∩B)=0.008；若誤用P(B)=0.02獨立相乘，只得0.0004，相差20倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4. Joint probability is 0.008; incorrectly using independent P(B)=0.02 gives 0.0004, twenty times smaller. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把共同風暴、供電和預報錯誤列成可追溯事件類別，核對兩站事件是否同時；比較條件與無條件機率的樣本量，報告稀少資料造成的區間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Classify common storms, power and forecast errors as traceable events and check simultaneity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4. Joint probability is 0.008; incorrectly using independent P(B)=0.02 gives 0.0004, twenty times smaller.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「暴潮共同原因相關」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Common storm dependence", which statement holds?
options: 只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設P(A)=0.02、P(B|A)=0.4，聯合P(A∩B)=0.008。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
optionsEn: Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume P(A)=0.02 and P(B|A)=0.4. Keep units when recalculating.

加權總分最高的方案在任何權重與限制下都必然最佳。

steps.title: 暴潮共同原因相關：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Common storm dependence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暴潮共同原因相關」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common storm dependence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少數共同事件可能支配區域風險，分散地理位置不保證氣象獨立。若只保留單站最大值而刪除時間戳，就無法重建真正的聯合荷載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A few shared events can dominate regional risk, and geographic separation does not guarantee meteorological independence. Deleting timestamps while retaining station maxima prevents reconstruction of actual joint loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只保留單站最大值而刪除時間戳，就無法重建真正的聯合荷載。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deleting timestamps while retaining station maxima prevents reconstruction of actual joint loading.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.

steps.title: 防洪與潮灘面積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Protection and tidal-flat area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防洪與潮灘面積」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Protection and tidal-flat area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海口改變會影響潮差和潮灘濕潤頻率，防洪效益不能只以封閉長度評價。簡化斜坡幾何可連結水位變化與棲地面積，但真實地形需要測量。 假設平直潮灘長10 km、橫坡1:1000、水位帶縮小0.2 m，水平寬度差200 m，面積差2 km²；純幾何，不預測生態品質。 面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。地形隨侵蝕淤積改變時，固定坡度模型也會逐年偏離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防洪與潮灘面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet modification changes tidal range and intertidal wetting frequency, so protection benefits cannot be judged only by closure length. A simple slope connects level change to habitat area, while real terrain requires surveys. Assume straight tidal flat length 10 km, cross-slope 1:1000 and tidal-band reduction 0.2 m. Width changes 200 m and area 2 km², a geometric estimate rather than ecological quality. Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence. Erosion and deposition also progressively invalidate a fixed-slope geometric model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Protection and tidal-flat area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平直潮灘長10 km、橫坡1:1000、水位帶縮小0.2 m，水平寬度差200 m，面積差2 km²；純幾何，不預測生態品質。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume straight tidal flat length 10 km, cross-slope 1:1000 and tidal-band reduction 0.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防洪與潮灘面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Protection and tidal-flat area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防洪與潮灘面積
knowledge.text: 海口改變會影響潮差和潮灘濕潤頻率，防洪效益不能只以封閉長度評價。簡化斜坡幾何可連結水位變化與棲地面積，但真實地形需要測量。
knowledge.textEn: Inlet modification changes tidal range and intertidal wetting frequency, so protection benefits cannot be judged only by closure length. A simple slope connects level change to habitat area, while real terrain requires surveys.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防洪與潮灘面積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Protection and tidal-flat area" is correct?
options: 保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
海口改變會影響潮差和潮灘濕潤頻率，防洪效益不能只以封閉長度評價。
離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。
optionsEn: Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
Inlet modification changes tidal range and intertidal wetting frequency, so protection benefits cannot be judged only by closure length.
Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system.
quiz.explanation: 海口改變會影響潮差和潮灘濕潤頻率，防洪效益不能只以封閉長度評價。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Inlet modification changes tidal range and intertidal wetting frequency, so protection benefits cannot be judged only by closure length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防洪與潮灘面積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Protection and tidal-flat area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防洪與潮灘面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Protection and tidal-flat area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平直潮灘長10 km、橫坡1:1000、水位帶縮小0.2 m，水平寬度差200 m，面積差2 km²；純幾何，不預測生態品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume straight tidal flat length 10 km, cross-slope 1:1000 and tidal-band reduction 0.2 m. Width changes 200 m and area 2 km², a geometric estimate rather than ecological quality. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同基準地形網格計算濕潤頻率曲線，對照底棲生物與沉積資料；將短期潮差變化和長期地形調整分開，核查斜坡假設的代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate inundation-frequency curves from common-datum terrain and compare benthic and sediment data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

knowledge.text: 用同基準地形網格計算濕潤頻率曲線，對照底棲生物與沉積資料；將短期潮差變化和長期地形調整分開，核查斜坡假設的代表性。分別報告面積、濕潤時長和底質粒徑變化。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate inundation-frequency curves from common-datum terrain and compare benthic and sediment data. Separate short-term tidal change from long-term morphological adjustment and test the representative-slope assumption. Report changes in area, inundation duration and bed grain size separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以防洪與潮灘面積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用同基準地形網格計算濕潤頻率曲線，對照底棲生物與沉積資料；將短期潮差變化和長期地形調整分開，核查斜坡假設的代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for protection and tidal-flat area, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calculate inundation-frequency curves from common-datum terrain and compare benthic and sediment data. Separate short-term tidal change from long-term morphological adjustment and test the representative-slope assumption.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防洪與潮灘面積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Protection and tidal-flat area"?
options: 用同基準地形網格計算濕潤頻率曲線，對照底棲生物與沉積資料；將短期潮差變化和長期地形調整分開，核查斜坡假設的代表性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。
optionsEn: Calculate inundation-frequency curves from common-datum terrain and compare benthic and sediment data.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years.
quiz.explanation: 用同基準地形網格計算濕潤頻率曲線，對照底棲生物與沉積資料；將短期潮差變化和長期地形調整分開，核查斜坡假設的代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate inundation-frequency curves from common-datum terrain and compare benthic and sediment data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防洪與潮灘面積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Protection and tidal-flat area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防洪與潮灘面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Protection and tidal-flat area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。地形隨侵蝕淤積改變時，固定坡度模型也會逐年偏離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence. Erosion and deposition also progressively invalidate a fixed-slope geometric model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地形隨侵蝕淤積改變時，固定坡度模型也會逐年偏離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Erosion and deposition also progressively invalidate a fixed-slope geometric model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。地形隨侵蝕淤積改變時，固定坡度模型也會逐年偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence. Erosion and deposition also progressively invalidate a fixed-slope geometric model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防洪與潮灘面積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Protection and tidal-flat area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。
離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence.
Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system.
quiz.explanation: 面積相同的棲地可能有不同淹水時長、粒徑和食物供應，不能直接當作等值生態補償。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal habitat area can differ in inundation duration, grain size and food supply, preventing automatic ecological equivalence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿岸砂量收支」與「航運代價與關閉頻率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Coastal sediment budget" and "Navigation cost and closure frequency": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿岸砂量收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coastal sediment budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沿岸砂量收支」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coastal sediment budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海岸維持取決於砂的來源、搬運與流失，而不只是某一斷面的寬度。補砂量應放進區域控制體，避免把移到鄰岸的砂全部當作消失。 假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³；未含深水交換。 只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。不同年代測量範圍不一致，可能產生不存在的體積增減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沿岸砂量收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coastal maintenance depends on sediment sources, transport and loss rather than one beach width. Nourishment belongs in a regional control volume so sand moved to a neighboring reach is not all treated as lost. Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³. Net gain is 0.2 million m³, excluding deep-water exchange. Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence. Inconsistent survey footprints can create fictitious volume gains or losses between years. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coastal sediment budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³；未含深水交換。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沿岸砂量收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Coastal sediment budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沿岸砂量收支
knowledge.text: 海岸維持取決於砂的來源、搬運與流失，而不只是某一斷面的寬度。補砂量應放進區域控制體，避免把移到鄰岸的砂全部當作消失。
knowledge.textEn: Coastal maintenance depends on sediment sources, transport and loss rather than one beach width. Nourishment belongs in a regional control volume so sand moved to a neighboring reach is not all treated as lost.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沿岸砂量收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coastal sediment budget" is correct?
options: 離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。
只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
海岸維持取決於砂的來源、搬運與流失，而不只是某一斷面的寬度。
optionsEn: Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system.
Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
Coastal maintenance depends on sediment sources, transport and loss rather than one beach width.
quiz.explanation: 海岸維持取決於砂的來源、搬運與流失，而不只是某一斷面的寬度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Coastal maintenance depends on sediment sources, transport and loss rather than one beach width. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沿岸砂量收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coastal sediment budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沿岸砂量收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coastal sediment budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³；未含深水交換。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³. Net gain is 0.2 million m³, excluding deep-water exchange. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³；未含深水交換。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³. Net gain is 0.2 million m³, excluding deep-water exchange.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沿岸砂量收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coastal sediment budget", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
加權總分最高的方案在任何權重與限制下都必然最佳。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.
The highest weighted score remains best under every weighting and constraint.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年沿岸輸入0.4 million m³、輸出0.7 million m³、補砂0.5 million m³，淨增加0.2 million m³；未含深水交換。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual input 0.4 million m³, output 0.7 million m³ and nourishment 0.5 million m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沿岸砂量收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coastal sediment budget: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沿岸砂量收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coastal sediment budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。核對每次測量邊界是否包含同一近岸沙洲。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes. Use seasonal repeats to distinguish alongshore transport, cross-shore exchange and measurement error. Verify that every survey boundary includes the same nearshore sandbar footprint. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以沿岸砂量收支編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for coastal sediment budget, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes. Use seasonal repeats to distinguish alongshore transport, cross-shore exchange and measurement error.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。核對每次測量邊界是否包含同一近岸沙洲。
knowledge.textEn: Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes. Use seasonal repeats to distinguish alongshore transport, cross-shore exchange and measurement error. Verify that every survey boundary includes the same nearshore sandbar footprint.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以沿岸砂量收支編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for coastal sediment budget, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes. Use seasonal repeats to distinguish alongshore transport, cross-shore exchange and measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沿岸砂量收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coastal sediment budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將海灘與近岸水下測量合成一致體積基準，核對補砂計量和側邊通量；以季節重複資料區分沿岸搬運、跨岸搬運與量測誤差。
同一保護圈的多段堤防可以當成完全平行備援。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes.
Several segments of one protection ring act as fully parallel backups.

quiz.explanationEn: Combine beach and submerged-nearshore surveys on one volume reference and check nourishment accounting and boundary fluxes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沿岸砂量收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coastal sediment budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沿岸砂量收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coastal sediment budget” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。不同年代測量範圍不一致，可能產生不存在的體積增減。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence. Inconsistent survey footprints can create fictitious volume gains or losses between years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同年代測量範圍不一致，可能產生不存在的體積增減。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inconsistent survey footprints can create fictitious volume gains or losses between years.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。不同年代測量範圍不一致，可能產生不存在的體積增減。
knowledge.textEn: Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence. Inconsistent survey footprints can create fictitious volume gains or losses between years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沿岸砂量收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coastal sediment budget" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence.
quiz.explanation: 只量乾灘會把移到近岸沙洲的砂當成流失，忽略粒徑差又會誤估補砂持續時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry-beach surveys alone mistake movement to nearshore bars for loss, while grain-size differences alter nourishment persistence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 航運代價與關閉頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Navigation cost and closure frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「航運代價與關閉頻率」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Navigation cost and closure frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪屏障的關閉影響航運時間，長期關閉頻率改變會使等待成本累積。每次平均代價不能代表尖峰供應鏈損失，須區分服務延遲和真實經濟損害。 假設每年12次關閉、每次8艘船各延遲2 h，總192 vessel-hours；假設時間成本1000 currency/h，對應192000 currency/year，非實際損失。 把所有港口延遲都歸於防洪會誇大代價，忽略關閉後隊列消散又會低估代價。若把假設時間價值當作業者實際損失，會產生不當精確感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「航運代價與關閉頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Barrier closures delay navigation and accumulate waiting as their frequency changes. Average event cost does not represent peak supply-chain consequences, requiring service delay to be separated from verified economic loss. Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours. At assumed cost 1000 currency/h this is 192000 currency/year, not measured loss. Attributing all port delays to defence exaggerates cost, while omitting post-closure queue recovery understates it. Presenting assumed time values as actual operator losses creates unjustified numerical precision. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Navigation cost and closure frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年12次關閉、每次8艘船各延遲2 h，總192 vessel-hours；假設時間成本1000 currency/h，對應192000 currency/year，非實際損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「航運代價與關閉頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Navigation cost and closure frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「航運代價與關閉頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Navigation cost and closure frequency" is correct?
options: 防洪屏障的關閉影響航運時間，長期關閉頻率改變會使等待成本累積。
只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。
optionsEn: Barrier closures delay navigation and accumulate waiting as their frequency changes.
Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit.

steps.title: 航運代價與關閉頻率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「航運代價與關閉頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Navigation cost and closure frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年12次關閉、每次8艘船各延遲2 h，總192 vessel-hours；假設時間成本1000 currency/h，對應192000 currency/year，非實際損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours. At assumed cost 1000 currency/h this is 192000 currency/year, not measured loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名船舶時間戳核對延遲是否由屏障造成，扣除原有等待；將單船成本假設與資料來源分開，並對尖峰到達率和替代航路做敏感度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use anonymous vessel timestamps to attribute delay to the barrier and remove pre-existing waiting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年12次關閉、每次8艘船各延遲2 h，總192 vessel-hours；假設時間成本1000 currency/h，對應192000 currency/year，非實際損失。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours. At assumed cost 1000 currency/h this is 192000 currency/year, not measured loss.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「航運代價與關閉頻率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Navigation cost and closure frequency", which statement holds?
options: 只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年12次關閉、每次8艘船各延遲2 h，總192 vessel-hours。
千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。
optionsEn: Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours.
A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume twelve closures annually, eight vessels per event and two hours delay each: 192 vessel-hours. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 航運代價與關閉頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Navigation cost and closure frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「航運代價與關閉頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Navigation cost and closure frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名船舶時間戳核對延遲是否由屏障造成，扣除原有等待；將單船成本假設與資料來源分開，並對尖峰到達率和替代航路做敏感度。以關閉後隊列消散時間補足延遲統計範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use anonymous vessel timestamps to attribute delay to the barrier and remove pre-existing waiting. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for navigation cost and closure frequency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use anonymous vessel timestamps to attribute delay to the barrier and remove pre-existing waiting. Separate assumed time values from evidence and test peak arrivals and alternative routes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有港口延遲都歸於防洪會誇大代價，忽略關閉後隊列消散又會低估代價。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「航運代價與關閉頻率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Navigation cost and closure frequency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把所有港口延遲都歸於防洪會誇大代價，忽略關閉後隊列消散又會低估代價。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。
optionsEn: Attributing all port delays to defence exaggerates cost, while omitting post-closure queue recovery understates it.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit.
quiz.explanation: 把所有港口延遲都歸於防洪會誇大代價，忽略關閉後隊列消散又會低估代價。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing all port delays to defence exaggerates cost, while omitting post-closure queue recovery understates it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「維護組合與風險降低」與「內外防線蓄洪耦合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction" and "Coupled outer defence and storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 維護組合與風險降低：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「維護組合與風險降低」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維護資源有限時，應比較失效機率、後果和措施效益，而不是只修最老設備。風險降低估算需要相同時間尺度及可核對的因果鏈。 假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency；非投資建議。 把所有故障都歸於老化會錯過共因與設計缺陷，維護也可能造成暫時停用風險。若效益和成本使用不同年度貨幣，排序會受到隱藏換算影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「維護組合與風險降低」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Limited maintenance resources require comparing probability, consequence and intervention effect rather than simply repairing the oldest asset. Estimated risk reduction needs a common time scale and a defensible causal link. Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency. Expected annual loss falls by 120000 currency, an educational estimate rather than investment advice. Attributing every failure to age misses common causes and design defects, while maintenance itself creates temporary outages. Comparing benefits and costs in different price years introduces hidden ranking distortions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency；非投資建議。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「維護組合與風險降低」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 維護組合與風險降低
knowledge.text: 維護資源有限時，應比較失效機率、後果和措施效益，而不是只修最老設備。風險降低估算需要相同時間尺度及可核對的因果鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Limited maintenance resources require comparing probability, consequence and intervention effect rather than simply repairing the oldest asset. Estimated risk reduction needs a common time scale and a defensible causal link.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「維護組合與風險降低」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction" is correct?
options: 設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。
維護資源有限時，應比較失效機率、後果和措施效益，而不是只修最老設備。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
optionsEn: The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit.
Limited maintenance resources require comparing probability, consequence and intervention effect rather than simply repairing the oldest asset.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.
quiz.explanation: 維護資源有限時，應比較失效機率、後果和措施效益，而不是只修最老設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Limited maintenance resources require comparing probability, consequence and intervention effect rather than simply repairing the oldest asset. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 維護組合與風險降低：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「維護組合與風險降低」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency；非投資建議。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency. Expected annual loss falls by 120000 currency, an educational estimate rather than investment advice. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency；非投資建議。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency. Expected annual loss falls by 120000 currency, an educational estimate rather than investment advice.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「維護組合與風險降低」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction", which statement holds?
options: 加權總分最高的方案在任何權重與限制下都必然最佳。
同一保護圈的多段堤防可以當成完全平行備援。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency。
optionsEn: The highest weighted score remains best under every weighting and constraint.
Several segments of one protection ring act as fully parallel backups.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年失效機率由0.01降至0.004、條件損失20 million currency，期望年損失降低0.006×20 million=120000 currency；非投資建議。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual failure probability falls from 0.01 to 0.004 with conditional loss 20 million currency. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 維護組合與風險降低：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維護組合與風險降低」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。將維修期間新增的暫時風險列為獨立項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction. Compare options with consistent price year and horizon while retaining consequences that cannot be credibly monetized. Include temporary additional risk during maintenance as a separate assessment item. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以維護組合與風險降低編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for maintenance portfolio and risk reduction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction. Compare options with consistent price year and horizon while retaining consequences that cannot be credibly monetized.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有故障都歸於老化會錯過共因與設計缺陷，維護也可能造成暫時停用風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing every failure to age misses common causes and design defects, while maintenance itself creates temporary outages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。將維修期間新增的暫時風險列為獨立項目。
knowledge.textEn: Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction. Compare options with consistent price year and horizon while retaining consequences that cannot be credibly monetized. Include temporary additional risk during maintenance as a separate assessment item.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以維護組合與風險降低編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for maintenance portfolio and risk reduction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction. Compare options with consistent price year and horizon while retaining consequences that cannot be credibly monetized.

quiz.question: 要驗證「維護組合與風險降低」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction"?
options: 逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
optionsEn: Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
quiz.explanation: 逐項列出措施改變哪個失效模式，核對機率減少是否有試驗或歷史支持；以相同價格年和分析期間比較方案，保留不可量化後果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify the failure mode changed by each measure and check evidence supporting the probability reduction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 維護組合與風險降低：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維護組合與風險降低」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有故障都歸於老化會錯過共因與設計缺陷，維護也可能造成暫時停用風險。若效益和成本使用不同年度貨幣，排序會受到隱藏換算影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing every failure to age misses common causes and design defects, while maintenance itself creates temporary outages. Comparing benefits and costs in different price years introduces hidden ranking distortions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若效益和成本使用不同年度貨幣，排序會受到隱藏換算影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing benefits and costs in different price years introduces hidden ranking distortions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備年齡最高就一定具有最大的維護風險降低效益。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The oldest asset necessarily offers the greatest maintenance risk-reduction benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「維護組合與風險降低」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Maintenance portfolio and risk reduction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

把所有故障都歸於老化會錯過共因與設計缺陷，維護也可能造成暫時停用風險。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。

Attributing every failure to age misses common causes and design defects, while maintenance itself creates temporary outages.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.
