quiz.explanationEn: Attributing every failure to age misses common causes and design defects, while maintenance itself creates temporary outages. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 內外防線蓄洪耦合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coupled outer defence and storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「內外防線蓄洪耦合」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coupled outer defence and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外海屏障降低暴潮進入，卻可能限制內河排水，內部蓄洪空間因此成為系統的一部分。把堤防與蓄水設施各自最佳化可能產生相互衝突。 假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。 名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。把所有低地直接相加作可用面積，會低估局部最高水位和淹水轉移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「內外防線蓄洪耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An outer barrier excludes surge but can restrict river drainage, making inland storage part of the defence system. Optimizing embankments and storage independently may create conflicting requirements. Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³. At allowed mean rise 0.3 m, ideal effective area is 24 km². Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. Adding all low ground as usable area understates local maximum levels and the redistribution of flooding. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coupled outer defence and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「內外防線蓄洪耦合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Coupled outer defence and storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內外防線蓄洪耦合
knowledge.text: 外海屏障降低暴潮進入，卻可能限制內河排水，內部蓄洪空間因此成為系統的一部分。把堤防與蓄水設施各自最佳化可能產生相互衝突。
knowledge.textEn: An outer barrier excludes surge but can restrict river drainage, making inland storage part of the defence system. Optimizing embankments and storage independently may create conflicting requirements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內外防線蓄洪耦合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coupled outer defence and storage" is correct?
options: 地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。
外海屏障降低暴潮進入，卻可能限制內河排水，內部蓄洪空間因此成為系統的一部分。
optionsEn: All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.
Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit.
An outer barrier excludes surge but can restrict river drainage, making inland storage part of the defence system.
quiz.explanation: 外海屏障降低暴潮進入，卻可能限制內河排水，內部蓄洪空間因此成為系統的一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An outer barrier excludes surge but can restrict river drainage, making inland storage part of the defence system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內外防線蓄洪耦合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coupled outer defence and storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「內外防線蓄洪耦合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coupled outer defence and storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³. At allowed mean rise 0.3 m, ideal effective area is 24 km². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³. At allowed mean rise 0.3 m, ideal effective area is 24 km².

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「內外防線蓄洪耦合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coupled outer defence and storage", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³。
千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。
兩座屏障距離遠就能直接假設風暴失效互相獨立。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³.
A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years.
Widely separated barriers can automatically be assumed independent under storm loading.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設外閘關閉4 h、內河淨入流500 m³/s，需暫存7.2 million m³；若允許平均升水0.3 m，理想有效面積24 km²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume outer closure four hours with net river inflow 500 m³/s, requiring storage 7.2 million m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 內外防線蓄洪耦合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coupled outer defence and storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「內外防線蓄洪耦合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coupled outer defence and storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。檢查連通口流量是否足以在洪峰前使用庫容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together. Use water-surface gradients to test whether nominal storage area is actually accessible during the event. Check whether connection capacity can make the storage accessible before the flood peak. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以內外防線蓄洪耦合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for coupled outer defence and storage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together. Use water-surface gradients to test whether nominal storage area is actually accessible during the event.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。檢查連通口流量是否足以在洪峰前使用庫容。
knowledge.textEn: Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together. Use water-surface gradients to test whether nominal storage area is actually accessible during the event. Check whether connection capacity can make the storage accessible before the flood peak.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以內外防線蓄洪耦合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for coupled outer defence and storage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together. Use water-surface gradients to test whether nominal storage area is actually accessible during the event.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內外防線蓄洪耦合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Coupled outer defence and storage"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。
離開乾灘的砂就一定永久離開整個海岸系統。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together.
Sand leaving the dry beach has permanently left the entire coastal system.
quiz.explanation: 同步列出海側閉合期間和河流入流歷線，將分區庫容與連通能力一起核對；用水位坡度檢查可用蓄洪面積是否真能在事件期間被利用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align outer-closure periods with river hydrographs, checking compartment storage and connectivity together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 內外防線蓄洪耦合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Coupled outer defence and storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「內外防線蓄洪耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Coupled outer defence and storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。把所有低地直接相加作可用面積，會低估局部最高水位和淹水轉移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. Adding all low ground as usable area understates local maximum levels and the redistribution of flooding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把所有低地直接相加作可用面積，會低估局部最高水位和淹水轉移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding all low ground as usable area understates local maximum levels and the redistribution of flooding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。把所有低地直接相加作可用面積，會低估局部最高水位和淹水轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. Adding all low ground as usable area understates local maximum levels and the redistribution of flooding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內外防線蓄洪耦合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Coupled outer defence and storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。
名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit.
Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak.
quiz.explanation: 名義庫容若被堤路隔開或入口狹窄，可能在洪峰前無法充分使用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal storage separated by roads or narrow entrances may not fill before the peak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「調適門檻與提前量」與「多目標權重敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adaptation trigger and lead time" and "Multi-objective weight sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 調適門檻與提前量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adaptation trigger and lead time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調適門檻與提前量」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adaptation trigger and lead time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分期調適需要在功能不足前啟動設計施工，監測門檻因此必須包含實施提前量。看到水位達極限才開始準備，可能已錯過調整窗口。 假設剩餘功能裕度0.4 m、情境增加速率0.01 m/year，達限40 years；若實施需15 years，最晚應於25 years前啟動，限線性情境。 海平面加速或施工延期會縮短可用時間，單一速率估算不能當精確倒數。若監測指標與實際失效模式沒有關聯，提早量再長也可能觸發錯誤措施。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調適門檻與提前量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged adaptation must start design and construction before performance becomes inadequate, so monitoring triggers need implementation lead time. Waiting until the limit is reached can miss the available response window. Assume remaining performance margin 0.4 m and scenario change 0.01 m/year: limit in forty years. With fifteen years implementation, initiation is needed by year twenty-five under this linear scenario. Accelerating change or construction delay shortens available time, so one rate is not an exact countdown. A monitoring indicator disconnected from the failure mechanism may trigger the wrong measure despite ample lead time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adaptation trigger and lead time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設剩餘功能裕度0.4 m、情境增加速率0.01 m/year，達限40 years；若實施需15 years，最晚應於25 years前啟動，限線性情境。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume remaining performance margin 0.4 m and scenario change 0.01 m/year: limit in forty years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「調適門檻與提前量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adaptation trigger and lead time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調適門檻與提前量
knowledge.text: 分期調適需要在功能不足前啟動設計施工，監測門檻因此必須包含實施提前量。看到水位達極限才開始準備，可能已錯過調整窗口。
knowledge.textEn: Staged adaptation must start design and construction before performance becomes inadequate, so monitoring triggers need implementation lead time. Waiting until the limit is reached can miss the available response window.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「調適門檻與提前量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只有監測值真的到達功能極限時才需要開始設計調適。
加權總分最高的方案在任何權重與限制下都必然最佳。
optionsEn: Staged adaptation must start design and construction before performance becomes inadequate, so monitoring triggers need implementation lead time.
Adaptation design need only start once monitoring reaches the actual performance limit.
The highest weighted score remains best under every weighting and constraint.

steps.title: 調適門檻與提前量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adaptation trigger and lead time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調適門檻與提前量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adaptation trigger and lead time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設剩餘功能裕度0.4 m、情境增加速率0.01 m/year，達限40 years；若實施需15 years，最晚應於25 years前啟動，限線性情境。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume remaining performance margin 0.4 m and scenario change 0.01 m/year: limit in forty years. With fifteen years implementation, initiation is needed by year twenty-five under this linear scenario. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調適門檻與提前量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 海平面加速或施工延期會縮短可用時間，單一速率估算不能當精確倒數。若監測指標與實際失效模式沒有關聯，提早量再長也可能觸發錯誤措施。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accelerating change or construction delay shortens available time, so one rate is not an exact countdown. A monitoring indicator disconnected from the failure mechanism may trigger the wrong measure despite ample lead time. steps.instructionEn: Confirm that higher scores consistently mean better performance, then plot rankings across weights. Keep scoring evidence, stakeholder preferences and non-compensable limits as separate records. Mark minimum functional constraints that cannot be compensated by high scores elsewhere. steps.title: 多目標權重敏感度：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 以高生態分數補償不可接受的防洪失效可能不符合決策邊界，正規化方式也會改變排序。若只公布最終總分，會掩蓋價值取捨與資料不確定度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

title: 混凝土重力壩分塊澆築
summary: 本課以混凝土重力壩分塊澆築為入口，深入澆塊熱歷程、層面品質與重力壩荷載路徑。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction as its entry point, this course examines block thermal histories, lift-joint quality and gravity-dam load paths. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「絕熱溫升與膠結材」與「澆置供應與冷縫風險」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adiabatic rise and binder heat" and "Placement supply and cold joints": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adiabatic rise and binder heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「絕熱溫升與膠結材」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大體積混凝土內部散熱慢，膠結材水化熱會累積。絕熱溫升把放熱量和材料熱容量連結，但真實澆塊還有表面交換、骨材溫度與時間效應。 假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「絕熱溫升與膠結材」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heat accumulates inside mass concrete because dissipation is slow. Adiabatic rise links binder heat to material heat capacity, while actual blocks also exchange heat at surfaces and depend on aggregate temperature and time. Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature. Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「絕熱溫升與膠結材」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Adiabatic rise and binder heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材
knowledge.text: 大體積混凝土內部散熱慢，膠結材水化熱會累積。絕熱溫升把放熱量和材料熱容量連結，但真實澆塊還有表面交換、骨材溫度與時間效應。
knowledge.textEn: Heat accumulates inside mass concrete because dissipation is slow. Adiabatic rise links binder heat to material heat capacity, while actual blocks also exchange heat at surfaces and depend on aggregate temperature and time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「絕熱溫升與膠結材」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Adiabatic rise and binder heat" is correct?
options: 絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。
大體積混凝土內部散熱慢，膠結材水化熱會累積。
只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。
optionsEn: Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach.
Heat accumulates inside mass concrete because dissipation is slow.
Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
quiz.explanation: 大體積混凝土內部散熱慢，膠結材水化熱會累積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Heat accumulates inside mass concrete because dissipation is slow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Adiabatic rise and binder heat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「絕熱溫升與膠結材」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Adiabatic rise is 18.75 K, not the actual peak temperature.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「絕熱溫升與膠結材」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Adiabatic rise and binder heat", which statement holds?
options: 澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。
成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K。
optionsEn: Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K).
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材180 kg/m³、累積放熱250 kJ/kg、混凝土體積熱容量2.4 MJ/(m³·K)，絕熱溫升18.75 K；不是實際峰值溫度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 180 kg/m³, cumulative heat 250 kJ/kg and volumetric heat capacity 2.4 MJ/(m³·K). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Adiabatic rise and binder heat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「絕熱溫升與膠結材」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。以初始骨材溫度獨立檢查入倉混凝土熱量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately. Independently check placed-concrete initial heat against measured aggregate temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以絕熱溫升與膠結材編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for adiabatic rise and binder heat, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。以初始骨材溫度獨立檢查入倉混凝土熱量。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately. Independently check placed-concrete initial heat against measured aggregate temperature.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以絕熱溫升與膠結材編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for adiabatic rise and binder heat, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Compare block-core and surface temperatures, verify initial conditions by energy balance, and list formwork, air-temperature and cooling boundaries separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「絕熱溫升與膠結材」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Adiabatic rise and binder heat"?
options: 以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。
optionsEn: Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Freshly placed concrete is immediately self-supporting and exerts no fluid-like form pressure.
quiz.explanation: 以材料量熱試驗取得放熱歷線，核對膠結材來源與配比，再比較澆塊中心與表面溫度；用能量平衡檢查溫度初值，並分列模板、氣溫與冷卻邊界。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain heat-release histories from calorimetry, checking binder source and mixture proportions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 絕熱溫升與膠結材：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Adiabatic rise and binder heat: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「絕熱溫升與膠結材」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Adiabatic rise and binder heat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。相同膠結材用量也不保證不同配方具有相同放熱速率。
knowledge.textEn: Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Equal binder content also does not guarantee equal heat-release rates across different cementitious formulations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「絕熱溫升與膠結材」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Adiabatic rise and binder heat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。
只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information.
Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
quiz.explanation: 把最終總放熱瞬間施加會錯估早期峰值，忽略表面散熱則會過度保守或失去梯度資訊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying ultimate heat instantly misstates early peaks, while neglecting surface loss removes gradient information. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 澆置供應與冷縫風險：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Placement supply and cold joints: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「澆置供應與冷縫風險」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Placement supply and cold joints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分塊澆築要求連續供料與有序覆蓋，供應率不足會延長新舊料接觸時間。總日產量達標不代表每一局部層面都在可接受條件下接續。 假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「澆置供應與冷縫風險」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Block placement needs continuous supply and orderly coverage. Insufficient delivery prolongs local intervals between layers, so meeting daily output does not establish acceptable continuity at every local interface. Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence. The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Placement supply and cold joints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「澆置供應與冷縫風險」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Placement supply and cold joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 澆置供應與冷縫風險
knowledge.text: 分塊澆築要求連續供料與有序覆蓋，供應率不足會延長新舊料接觸時間。總日產量達標不代表每一局部層面都在可接受條件下接續。
knowledge.textEn: Block placement needs continuous supply and orderly coverage. Insufficient delivery prolongs local intervals between layers, so meeting daily output does not establish acceptable continuity at every local interface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「澆置供應與冷縫風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Placement supply and cold joints" is correct?
options: 只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。
接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。
分塊澆築要求連續供料與有序覆蓋，供應率不足會延長新舊料接觸時間。
optionsEn: Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.
Block placement needs continuous supply and orderly coverage.
quiz.explanation: 分塊澆築要求連續供料與有序覆蓋，供應率不足會延長新舊料接觸時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Block placement needs continuous supply and orderly coverage. The other options are common misconceptions.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Placement requires eight hours, or 9.5 h with a 1.5 h outage, excluding local compaction and coverage sequence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「澆置供應與冷縫風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Placement supply and cold joints", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。
只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。
接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h.
Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking.
A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設澆塊600 m³、有效供應率75 m³/h，純澆置需8 h；若停機1.5 h則9.5 h，未計振實和局部覆蓋順序。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block volume 600 m³ and effective supply 75 m³/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 澆置供應與冷縫風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placement supply and cold joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「澆置供應與冷縫風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Placement supply and cold joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。追蹤最久停頓位置的層面實際凝結狀況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data. Map supply interruptions to actual interfaces, then examine joint quality with cores or specified interface tests rather than total volume alone. Track actual setting condition at the interface with the longest interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以澆置供應與冷縫風險編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for placement supply and cold joints, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data. Map supply interruptions to actual interfaces, then examine joint quality with cores or specified interface tests rather than total volume alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Track actual setting condition at the interface with the longest interruption.

quiz.question: 要驗證「澆置供應與冷縫風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Placement supply and cold joints"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。
圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data.
Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements.
quiz.explanation: 按位置記錄每批到達與覆蓋時間，對照氣溫、坍度與凝結資料；將供料停頓映射到實際層面，另以取芯或指定界面試驗檢查接續品質，而非只查總方量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record delivery and covering times by location and compare temperature, workability and setting data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 澆置供應與冷縫風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Placement supply and cold joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「澆置供應與冷縫風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Placement supply and cold joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。若只補足少澆的方量，已形成的弱層不會自動消失。
knowledge.textEn: The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Making up missing volume does not automatically remove an already formed weak layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「澆置供應與冷縫風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Placement supply and cold joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。
同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.
The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality.
quiz.explanation: 同一停機時間在不同溫度下會產生不同接縫狀態，盲目加水恢復工作性又會改變材料品質。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The same interruption produces different interface states at different temperatures, and adding water to restore workability changes material quality. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「層面剪力與有效正應力」與「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lift-joint shear and effective stress" and "Thermal diffusion and block dimensions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 層面剪力與有效正應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift-joint shear and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「層面剪力與有效正應力」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift-joint shear and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水平施工層面傳遞剪力，黏聚、摩擦與孔壓共同控制可動員阻力。層面清理和骨材嵌固影響黏結，不能用完整混凝土強度直接代表接縫。 假設層面面積100 m²、總正力30 MN、上浮10 MN、c=0.1 MPa、μ=0.6，阻力cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN；參數為假設峰值。 漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。若在可能開裂的接縫仍無條件保留黏聚力，會高估滑動後阻力並掩蓋排水功能的重要性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層面剪力與有效正應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal lift joints transfer shear through cohesion and friction under effective normal stress. Cleaning and aggregate interlock affect bond, so intact-concrete strength cannot directly represent the interface. Assume interface area 100 m², normal force 30 MN, uplift 10 MN, c=0.1 MPa and μ=0.6. Resistance cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN, using assumed peak parameters. Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction. Retaining cohesion unconditionally after possible cracking overstates post-movement resistance and obscures the importance of drainage performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift-joint shear and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設層面面積100 m²、總正力30 MN、上浮10 MN、c=0.1 MPa、μ=0.6，阻力cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN；參數為假設峰值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume interface area 100 m², normal force 30 MN, uplift 10 MN, c=0.1 MPa and μ=0.6.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「層面剪力與有效正應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lift-joint shear and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 層面剪力與有效正應力
knowledge.text: 水平施工層面傳遞剪力，黏聚、摩擦與孔壓共同控制可動員阻力。層面清理和骨材嵌固影響黏結，不能用完整混凝土強度直接代表接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal lift joints transfer shear through cohesion and friction under effective normal stress. Cleaning and aggregate interlock affect bond, so intact-concrete strength cannot directly represent the interface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層面剪力與有效正應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift-joint shear and effective stress" is correct?
options: 水平施工層面傳遞剪力，黏聚、摩擦與孔壓共同控制可動員阻力。
接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。
澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。
optionsEn: Horizontal lift joints transfer shear through cohesion and friction under effective normal stress.
A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.
Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
quiz.explanation: 水平施工層面傳遞剪力，黏聚、摩擦與孔壓共同控制可動員阻力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal lift joints transfer shear through cohesion and friction under effective normal stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設層面面積100 m²、總正力30 MN、上浮10 MN、c=0.1 MPa、μ=0.6，阻力cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN；參數為假設峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Resistance cA+μ(N−U)=22 MN, using assumed peak parameters. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check bond and roughness with interface cores and shear testing, referring piezometers to the same lift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以層面取芯與剪切試驗核對黏結及粗糙度，將孔壓測站換算到相同層位；分列峰值與殘餘參數，檢查抗力式是否對應實際可用接觸面積。以滑移後試驗檢查是否仍可保留黏聚項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check bond and roughness with interface cores and shear testing, referring piezometers to the same lift. Separate peak and residual parameters and verify that the resistance formula uses the actual available contact area. Use post-slip testing to check whether retaining cohesion remains defensible. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift-joint shear and effective stress, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check bond and roughness with interface cores and shear testing, referring piezometers to the same lift. Separate peak and residual parameters and verify that the resistance formula uses the actual available contact area.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層面剪力與有效正應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.

steps.title: 層面剪力與有效正應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift-joint shear and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「層面剪力與有效正應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift-joint shear and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。若在可能開裂的接縫仍無條件保留黏聚力，會高估滑動後阻力並掩蓋排水功能的重要性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction. Retaining cohesion unconditionally after possible cracking overstates post-movement resistance and obscures the importance of drainage performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若在可能開裂的接縫仍無條件保留黏聚力，會高估滑動後阻力並掩蓋排水功能的重要性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retaining cohesion unconditionally after possible cracking overstates post-movement resistance and obscures the importance of drainage performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫剪力能力可以直接等同完整混凝土的強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層面剪力與有效正應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。
optionsEn: Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
quiz.explanation: 漿皮或污染使層面黏結降低，孔壓增加又削弱摩擦項。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Laitance or contamination reduces bond, while pore pressure reduces friction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 熱擴散與澆塊尺寸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal diffusion and block dimensions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal diffusion and block dimensions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 熱擴散時間大致與傳熱距離平方成正比，澆塊尺度增加會讓中心維持高溫更久。這個尺度關係說明分塊原因，但不能給出精確冷卻完成時間。 假設熱擴散係數α=10⁻⁶ m²/s、特徵距離2 m，t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days；僅尺度估算，不是指定等待期。 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal diffusion time scales approximately with the square of travel distance, so larger blocks retain core heat longer. This explains the value of subdivision without predicting an exact cooling-completion time. Assume diffusivity α=10⁻⁶ m²/s and characteristic distance 2 m. t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days, a scale estimate rather than a prescribed waiting period. Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal diffusion and block dimensions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設熱擴散係數α=10⁻⁶ m²/s、特徵距離2 m，t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days；僅尺度估算，不是指定等待期。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume diffusivity α=10⁻⁶ m²/s and characteristic distance 2 m. t=L²/α=4 million s=46.30 days, a scale estimate rather than a prescribed waiting period.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal diffusion and block dimensions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱擴散與澆塊尺寸
knowledge.text: 熱擴散時間大致與傳熱距離平方成正比，澆塊尺度增加會讓中心維持高溫更久。這個尺度關係說明分塊原因，但不能給出精確冷卻完成時間。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal diffusion time scales approximately with the square of travel distance, so larger blocks retain core heat longer. This explains the value of subdivision without predicting an exact cooling-completion time.

knowledge.text: 誤解：澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal diffusion and block dimensions" is correct?
options: 澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。
熱擴散時間大致與傳熱距離平方成正比，澆塊尺度增加會讓中心維持高溫更久。

optionsEn: Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
Thermal diffusion time scales approximately with the square of travel distance, so larger blocks retain core heat longer.
Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.titleEn: Thermal diffusion and block dimensions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal diffusion and block dimensions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較不同深度溫度變化的相位與幅度，以實測材料導熱率和熱容量重建擴散係數；將冷卻管、表面邊界和新增澆層列入，檢查單一距離是否具代表性。比較半厚與全厚邊界定義對時間尺度的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity. Include cooling pipes, surface conditions and added lifts, testing whether one characteristic distance is representative. Compare half-thickness and full-thickness boundary definitions in the diffusion scale. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以熱擴散與澆塊尺寸編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較不同深度溫度變化的相位與幅度，以實測材料導熱率和熱容量重建擴散係數；將冷卻管、表面邊界和新增澆層列入，檢查單一距離是否具代表性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thermal diffusion and block dimensions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity. Include cooling pipes, surface conditions and added lifts, testing whether one characteristic distance is representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal diffusion and block dimensions"?
options: 比較不同深度溫度變化的相位與幅度，以實測材料導熱率和熱容量重建擴散係數；將冷卻管、表面邊界和新增澆層列入，檢查單一距離是否具代表性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。
optionsEn: Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach.
