quiz.explanationEn: Compare temperature phase and amplitude at several depths and derive diffusivity from measured conductivity and heat capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱擴散與澆塊尺寸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal diffusion and block dimensions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal diffusion and block dimensions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。後續澆層改變表面散熱條件，原本冷卻中的塊體可能再升溫，不能只外推初期曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Later lifts alter heat loss and can reheat a cooling block, invalidating simple extrapolation of early records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱擴散與澆塊尺寸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal diffusion and block dimensions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。
只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions.
Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking.
quiz.explanation: 用半厚或全厚當距離會造成四倍時間差，必須與邊界定義一致。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using half-thickness versus full thickness changes the time scale fourfold and must match boundary definitions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「冷卻水能量移除」與「成熟度與強度校正」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cooling-water heat removal" and "Maturity and strength calibration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 冷卻水能量移除：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cooling-water heat removal: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「冷卻水能量移除」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooling-water heat removal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 埋管冷卻以水流帶走熱量，進出口溫差與流量共同決定移熱率。大流量低溫差和小流量高溫差不能只憑其中一項判斷效果。 假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。 冷卻過快可能加大局部溫差和拉應力，不是移熱越多就越好。進出口感測器零點差也會在小溫差時造成大比例誤差，掩蓋實際冷卻不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冷卻水能量移除」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Embedded cooling removes heat through water flow, with inlet-outlet temperature difference and flow jointly determining removal. Neither flow nor temperature rise alone establishes cooling performance. Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Heat removal is 41.8 kW or 3.61152 GJ over 24 h at constant conditions. Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better. Sensor offset between inlet and outlet causes large relative errors at small differences and can conceal inadequate removal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cooling-water heat removal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「冷卻水能量移除」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cooling-water heat removal”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷卻水能量移除
knowledge.text: 埋管冷卻以水流帶走熱量，進出口溫差與流量共同決定移熱率。大流量低溫差和小流量高溫差不能只憑其中一項判斷效果。
knowledge.textEn: Embedded cooling removes heat through water flow, with inlet-outlet temperature difference and flow jointly determining removal. Neither flow nor temperature rise alone establishes cooling performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻水能量移除」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cooling-water heat removal" is correct?
options: 只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。
成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。
埋管冷卻以水流帶走熱量，進出口溫差與流量共同決定移熱率。
optionsEn: Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking.
A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength.
Embedded cooling removes heat through water flow, with inlet-outlet temperature difference and flow jointly determining removal.
quiz.explanation: 埋管冷卻以水流帶走熱量，進出口溫差與流量共同決定移熱率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Embedded cooling removes heat through water flow, with inlet-outlet temperature difference and flow jointly determining removal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻水能量移除：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooling-water heat removal: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷卻水能量移除」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cooling-water heat removal” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Heat removal is 41.8 kW or 3.61152 GJ over 24 h at constant conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測各迴路進出口溫度和流量，積分移熱量與壩內溫度下降比較；檢查旁通、儀器偏差與管路漏水，避免只以泵流量代替真正穿過埋管的流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure temperature and flow in each circuit synchronously and compare integrated removal with internal cooling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Heat removal is 41.8 kW or 3.61152 GJ over 24 h at constant conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「冷卻水能量移除」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cooling-water heat removal", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW。
混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。
進料總方量與設計相符就能證明澆塊內完全沒有缺陷。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K.
Freshly placed concrete is immediately self-supporting and exerts no fluid-like form pressure.
Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水流2 kg/s、比熱4.18 kJ/(kg·K)、升溫5 K，移熱率41.8 kW；持續24 h移除3.61152 GJ，忽略流量溫差變化。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume water flow 2 kg/s, heat capacity 4.18 kJ/(kg·K) and rise 5 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冷卻水能量移除：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooling-water heat removal: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冷卻水能量移除」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cooling-water heat removal” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測各迴路進出口溫度和流量，積分移熱量與壩內溫度下降比較；檢查旁通、儀器偏差與管路漏水，避免只以泵流量代替真正穿過埋管的流量。以分迴路熱量總和檢查主回水量測的閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperature and flow in each circuit synchronously and compare integrated removal with internal cooling. Check bypasses, instrument bias and leaks instead of using pump discharge as the flow through embedded pipes. Check main-return measurements against the sum of individual circuit heat removal. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以冷卻水能量移除編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測各迴路進出口溫度和流量，積分移熱量與壩內溫度下降比較；檢查旁通、儀器偏差與管路漏水，避免只以泵流量代替真正穿過埋管的流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cooling-water heat removal, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure temperature and flow in each circuit synchronously and compare integrated removal with internal cooling. Check bypasses, instrument bias and leaks instead of using pump discharge as the flow through embedded pipes.

steps.title: 冷卻水能量移除：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「冷卻水能量移除」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 冷卻過快可能加大局部溫差和拉應力，不是移熱越多就越好。進出口感測器零點差也會在小溫差時造成大比例誤差，掩蓋實際冷卻不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better. Sensor offset between inlet and outlet causes large relative errors at small differences and can conceal inadequate removal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sensor offset between inlet and outlet causes large relative errors at small differences and can conceal inadequate removal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要冷卻水流量夠大，便能保證混凝土沒有溫差裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sufficiently high cooling-water flow guarantees freedom from thermal-gradient cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「冷卻水能量移除」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength.
Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better.

quiz.explanationEn: Excessively fast cooling increases local gradients and tension, so more heat removal is not always better. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 成熟度與強度校正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Maturity and strength calibration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「成熟度與強度校正」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maturity and strength calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 成熟度把時間和溫度整合為水化歷程指標，必須經同配比強度校正才可推論能力。不同膠結材或養護濕度會改變關係，不能把成熟度當直接強度。 假設Nurse-Saul基準溫度−10°C，混凝土20°C維持48 h，M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h；未由此指定任何MPa。 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「成熟度與強度校正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maturity combines time and temperature into a hydration-history index and needs same-mixture calibration before implying strength. Binder and curing moisture change the relationship, so maturity is not strength itself. Assume Nurse-Saul datum −10°C and concrete at 20°C for 48 h. M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h, without assigning any strength in MPa. High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Maturity and strength calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Nurse-Saul基準溫度−10°C，混凝土20°C維持48 h，M=(20−(−10))×48=1440°C·h；未由此指定任何MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Nurse-Saul datum −10°C and concrete at 20°C for 48 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「成熟度與強度校正」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Maturity and strength calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 成熟度與強度校正
knowledge.text: 成熟度把時間和溫度整合為水化歷程指標，必須經同配比強度校正才可推論能力。不同膠結材或養護濕度會改變關係，不能把成熟度當直接強度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.
Integrate concrete temperature histories rather than ambient averages and calibrate with same-mixture specimens of different ages.
quiz.explanation: 用現場溫度歷線積分而非平均氣溫，與同配比不同齡期試體建立關係；另核對濕養護和高溫歷程是否超出校正範圍，保留實際拉壓強度試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate concrete temperature histories rather than ambient averages and calibrate with same-mixture specimens of different ages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 成熟度與強度校正：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Maturity and strength calibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「成熟度與強度校正」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maturity and strength calibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。若以其他配方成熟度曲線套用，會產生看似精確但缺乏材料依據的承載判讀。
knowledge.textEn: High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Borrowing another mixture maturity curve creates apparently precise capacity estimates without the required material-specific evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「成熟度與強度校正」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Maturity and strength calibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。
optionsEn: High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak.
quiz.explanation: 高早期溫度可能改變後期強度發展，乾燥也可能中斷水化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High early temperature can alter later strength development, and drying can interrupt hydration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接縫開度與止水變形」與「模板側壓與澆置狀態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint opening and waterstop deformation" and "Form pressure and placement state": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接縫開度與止水變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint opening and waterstop deformation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫開度與止水變形」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint opening and waterstop deformation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 澆塊收縮使接縫開度改變，止水需要承受法向張開及剪向錯動。只量接縫寬度無法代表三維變形，也不能以材料伸長率直接代替完整接頭性能。 假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。 止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。若只以接縫平均寬度判斷，會漏掉局部錯動與埋設缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫開度與止水變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Block contraction changes joint opening, while waterstops face both normal opening and shear offset. Width alone misses three-dimensional movement, and material elongation is not complete-joint performance. Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.4 mm, excluding restraint and neighboring-block movement and not an allowable waterstop opening. Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. Average joint width misses local shear offsets and defects in embedded placement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint opening and waterstop deformation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫開度與止水變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint opening and waterstop deformation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫開度與止水變形
knowledge.text: 澆塊收縮使接縫開度改變，止水需要承受法向張開及剪向錯動。只量接縫寬度無法代表三維變形，也不能以材料伸長率直接代替完整接頭性能。
knowledge.textEn: Block contraction changes joint opening, while waterstops face both normal opening and shear offset. Width alone misses three-dimensional movement, and material elongation is not complete-joint performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫開度與止水變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint opening and waterstop deformation" is correct?
options: 接縫平均開度很小就能保證止水一定不會漏水。
澆塊收縮使接縫開度改變，止水需要承受法向張開及剪向錯動。
混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。
optionsEn: A small mean joint opening guarantees that the waterstop cannot leak.
Block contraction changes joint opening, while waterstops face both normal opening and shear offset.
Freshly placed concrete is immediately self-supporting and exerts no fluid-like form pressure.
quiz.explanation: 澆塊收縮使接縫開度改變，止水需要承受法向張開及剪向錯動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Block contraction changes joint opening, while waterstops face both normal opening and shear offset. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫開度與止水變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint opening and waterstop deformation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫開度與止水變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint opening and waterstop deformation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.4 mm, excluding restraint and neighboring-block movement and not an allowable waterstop opening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.4 mm, excluding restraint and neighboring-block movement and not an allowable waterstop opening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫開度與止水變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint opening and waterstop deformation", which statement holds?
options: 進料總方量與設計相符就能證明澆塊內完全沒有缺陷。
只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。
optionsEn: Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.
Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效收縮長20 m、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫12 K，自由收縮2.4 mm；忽略拘束與相鄰塊共同變形，非止水容許開度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective contraction length 20 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and cooling 12 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接縫開度與止水變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint opening and waterstop deformation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫開度與止水變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint opening and waterstop deformation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。把接縫剪移與張開對止水的影響分列。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths. Separate the effects of joint shear and opening on waterstop behavior. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以接縫開度與止水變形編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for joint opening and waterstop deformation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。把接縫剪移與張開對止水的影響分列。
knowledge.textEn: Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths. Separate the effects of joint shear and opening on waterstop behavior.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以接縫開度與止水變形編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for joint opening and waterstop deformation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Check waterstop placement against tested joint geometry and use sectional leakage observations to locate preferential paths.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫開度與止水變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint opening and waterstop deformation"?
options: 使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
quiz.explanation: 使用多方向接縫計核對張開與剪移，對照兩側溫度和庫水壓；檢查止水埋設位置與接頭試驗是否相符，並用分區漏流辨認局部通道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use multi-axis joint meters to separate opening and shear, comparing temperatures and reservoir pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。若只以接縫平均寬度判斷，會漏掉局部錯動與埋設缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. Average joint width misses local shear offsets and defects in embedded placement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「接縫開度與止水變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip.
Freshly placed concrete is immediately self-supporting and exerts no fluid-like form pressure.
quiz.explanation: 止水扭曲或接合不良可能在開度不大時漏水，混凝土蜂窩也會繞過完整止水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Twisted or poorly joined waterstops may leak at small openings, while honeycombing bypasses an intact strip. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模板側壓與澆置狀態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Form pressure and placement state: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模板側壓與澆置狀態」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Form pressure and placement state” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新拌混凝土對模板的側壓取決於澆置速率、凝結與振動，短時間內可近似液體。把已硬化混凝土的側向性質拿來估新拌壓力會嚴重失真。 假設新拌混凝土容重24 kN/m³、液態有效高3 m，底壓72 kPa；每米寬合力γh²/2=108 kN/m，作靜水上界示例。 延緩凝結或重新振動可能延長液態壓力作用，局部供料堆高也會增加側壓。只按平均澆築高估算而忽略局部集中，會低估模板與拉桿需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模板側壓與澆置狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh-concrete form pressure depends on placing rate, setting and vibration and may initially approximate a liquid. Hardened-concrete lateral behavior cannot represent the fresh material pressure field. Assume fresh-concrete unit weight 24 kN/m³ and effective fluid height 3 m. Base pressure is 72 kPa and resultant per width is 108 kN/m, as a hydrostatic-bound example. Retarded setting or revibration can prolong fluid-like pressure, while local placement piles increase head. Average lift height can miss local concentrations and understate demand on formwork and ties. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Form pressure and placement state” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌混凝土容重24 kN/m³、液態有效高3 m，底壓72 kPa；每米寬合力γh²/2=108 kN/m，作靜水上界示例。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土剛澆入就已完全自立，所以模板不承受液態側壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「模板側壓與澆置狀態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Form pressure and placement state”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements.
Fresh-concrete form pressure depends on placing rate, setting and vibration and may initially approximate a liquid.

steps.title: 模板側壓與澆置狀態：定量估算

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh-concrete unit weight 24 kN/m³ and effective fluid height 3 m. Base pressure is 72 kPa and resultant per width is 108 kN/m, as a hydrostatic-bound example. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對澆置速率、料溫與凝結試驗，將模板壓力計讀數按高度作圖；檢查振動期間峰值與拉桿反力，並確認壓力假設涵蓋實際材料工作性。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Adiabatic temperature rise is the highest temperature that every placed block must reach.
A construction-joint shear capacity directly equals intact-concrete strength.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模板側壓與澆置狀態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對澆置速率、料溫與凝結試驗，將模板壓力計讀數按高度作圖；檢查振動期間峰值與拉桿反力，並確認壓力假設涵蓋實際材料工作性。檢查模板拉桿反力總和是否符合側壓積分。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

quiz.explanationEn: Retarded setting or revibration can prolong fluid-like pressure, while local placement piles increase head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上浮折減與抗滑」與「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Uplift reduction and sliding" and "Block geometry and material traceability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 上浮折減與抗滑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Uplift reduction and sliding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上浮折減與抗滑」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uplift reduction and sliding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力壩的自重提供摩擦抗滑，但基底上浮降低有效正向力。排水效果需由孔壓驗證，不能因設計有排水孔就自動採取最大折減。 假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上浮折減與抗滑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dam weight provides frictional resistance, but uplift reduces effective normal force. Drainage effectiveness requires pressure evidence rather than an automatic maximum reduction because drains appear on drawings. Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Friction-only ratio μ(W−U)/H=1.575, excluding cohesion and earthquake loading. Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uplift reduction and sliding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「上浮折減與抗滑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Uplift reduction and sliding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 上浮折減與抗滑
knowledge.text: 重力壩的自重提供摩擦抗滑，但基底上浮降低有效正向力。排水效果需由孔壓驗證，不能因設計有排水孔就自動採取最大折減。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity-dam weight provides frictional resistance, but uplift reduces effective normal force. Drainage effectiveness requires pressure evidence rather than an automatic maximum reduction because drains appear on drawings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上浮折減與抗滑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uplift reduction and sliding" is correct?
options: 重力壩的自重提供摩擦抗滑，但基底上浮降低有效正向力。
圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。
進料總方量與設計相符就能證明澆塊內完全沒有缺陷。
optionsEn: Gravity-dam weight provides frictional resistance, but uplift reduces effective normal force.
Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements.
Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.
quiz.explanation: 重力壩的自重提供摩擦抗滑，但基底上浮降低有效正向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity-dam weight provides frictional resistance, but uplift reduces effective normal force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上浮折減與抗滑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uplift reduction and sliding: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上浮折減與抗滑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uplift reduction and sliding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Friction-only ratio μ(W−U)/H=1.575, excluding cohesion and earthquake loading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Friction-only ratio μ(W−U)/H=1.575, excluding cohesion and earthquake loading.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上浮折減與抗滑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Uplift reduction and sliding", which statement holds?
options: 只要最後總澆置方量正確，局部冷縫就不會影響壩體。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575。
澆塊厚度加倍只會讓熱擴散時間加倍。
optionsEn: Correct final placed volume means local cold joints cannot affect the dam.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m.
Doubling block thickness only doubles the thermal diffusion time.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每米壩段重量12 MN/m、上浮3 MN/m、μ=0.7、水平推力4 MN/m，純摩擦比μ(W−U)/H=1.575；未含黏聚與地震。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume per-metre weight 12 MN/m, uplift 3 MN/m, μ=0.7 and horizontal force 4 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 上浮折減與抗滑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Uplift reduction and sliding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上浮折減與抗滑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Uplift reduction and sliding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。將堵塞情境下上浮分布另做整體力矩檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone. Check global moments separately using an uplift distribution representing blocked drains. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以上浮折減與抗滑編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for uplift reduction and sliding, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。將堵塞情境下上浮分布另做整體力矩檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone. Check global moments separately using an uplift distribution representing blocked drains.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以上浮折減與抗滑編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for uplift reduction and sliding, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Keep slip plane, material parameters and load combination consistent, then assess sensitivity to impaired drainage instead of checking one ratio alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上浮折減與抗滑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uplift reduction and sliding"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
成熟度達到固定數字就代表所有混凝土具有同一強度。
沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A fixed maturity value means every concrete mixture has the same strength.
Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes.
quiz.explanation: 沿基底量測孔壓並積分上浮，對照排水量和庫位變化；確認滑動面位置、材料參數與荷載組合一致，再比較排水減弱時的敏感度，而非只驗一個數字。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate measured basal pressure into uplift and compare drainage and reservoir changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上浮折減與抗滑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uplift reduction and sliding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上浮折減與抗滑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uplift reduction and sliding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「圖面有排水孔就能不量孔壓而忽略全部基底上浮。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drains shown on drawings allow all foundation uplift to be ignored without pressure measurements." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。若把排水孔附近低壓當整個基底均值，會過度樂觀估計有效重量與抗滑能力。
knowledge.textEn: Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Extrapolating low pressure beside drains across the whole base overstates effective weight and sliding resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上浮折減與抗滑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uplift reduction and sliding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
進料總方量與設計相符就能證明澆塊內完全沒有缺陷。
optionsEn: Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Matching delivered and design volume proves the entire block is defect-free.
quiz.explanation: 排水量變小可能代表堵塞而非更防水，孔壓升高會讓摩擦比降低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lower drainage may indicate clogging rather than improved impermeability, and rising pressure lowers frictional reserve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 澆塊幾何與材料追溯：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Block geometry and material traceability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」如何影響混凝土重力壩分塊澆築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Block geometry and material traceability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Block-by-block concrete gravity-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分塊施工讓每一批混凝土對應空間位置，幾何方量與材料紀錄可互相驗證。超澆、孔洞和預留廊道會影響方量，不能用進料量直接當完成實體。 假設矩形澆塊20×15×2 m，扣除廊道30 m³，淨量570 m³；若供料590 m³，差20 m³須查損耗和幾何，不能直接稱空洞。 把運輸損耗或模板外擴誤判為內部空洞會導致錯誤調查，反過來總量吻合也可能掩蓋局部蜂窩。空間追溯能找出缺陷位置，總方量卻無法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Block construction links concrete batches to spatial locations, enabling geometric and material records to cross-check. Overpour, voids and galleries affect volume, so delivered material is not automatically completed solid geometry. Assume block 20×15×2 m minus gallery 30 m³, giving net 570 m³. Delivery 590 m³ leaves a 20 m³ difference requiring geometry and loss checks, not an automatic void diagnosis. Spatial traceability can locate defects, whereas aggregate quantity cannot resolve their distribution. quiz.question: 關於「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 澆塊幾何與材料追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Block geometry and material traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Block geometry and material traceability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形澆塊20×15×2 m，扣除廊道30 m³，淨量570 m³；若供料590 m³，差20 m³須查損耗和幾何，不能直接稱空洞。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block 20×15×2 m minus gallery 30 m³, giving net 570 m³. Delivery 590 m³ leaves a 20 m³ difference requiring geometry and loss checks, not an automatic void diagnosis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把測量面、預留件和批次進料分別建帳，核對每車時間與澆築位置；以收方幾何、廢料紀錄和密度試驗做閉合，對不能解釋的差異要求獨立查證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Maintain separate surveyed surfaces, embedded-volume and delivery records, matching batches to placement location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Block geometry and material traceability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把測量面、預留件和批次進料分別建帳，核對每車時間與澆築位置；以收方幾何、廢料紀錄和密度試驗做閉合，對不能解釋的差異要求獨立查證。對差異最大的批次回查供料和廢料原始憑據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 在「澆塊幾何與材料追溯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

絕熱溫升就是工地澆塊必定量到的最高溫度。
