title: 碾壓混凝土壩施工
summary: 本課以碾壓混凝土壩施工為入口，深入碾壓層密實、材料配比與層間滲流的品質鏈。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction as its entry point, this course examines quality links between rcc compaction, mixture proportions and interlift seepage. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 鋪層節拍比較固定面積5000 m²及厚度0.3 m，因此需料1500 m³不變，只將有效供料率250增至300 m³/h。t=V/Q由6 h降至5 h，供料率增加20%而時間減少16.67%。模型仍未含邊緣修整、設備等待及接縫時間限制；增加供料不能被直接解讀為所有施工工序都縮短相同比例。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Keep lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m fixed, so volume remains 1500 m³, increasing only effective supply from 250 to 300 m³/h. Duration t=V/Q falls from 6 h to 5 h: 20% more supply gives 16.67% less time. Edge finishing, equipment queues and joint-time limits remain excluded; other construction tasks need not shorten by the same proportion.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋪層體積與供料節拍」與「壓實度與參考密度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lift volume and supply rhythm" and "Compaction and reference density": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift volume and supply rhythm: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋪層體積與供料節拍」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift volume and supply rhythm” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碾壓混凝土以薄層連續鋪築形成大體積結構，層面暴露時間由面積和供料節拍共同決定。設備名義產能不等於可持續有效供料，需考慮運輸與等待。 假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋪層體積與供料節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RCC forms mass structures through thin successive lifts. Lift exposure depends on area and delivery rhythm, while rated plant capacity differs from sustainable placement because transport and queuing intervene. Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions. A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift volume and supply rhythm” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋪層體積與供料節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lift volume and supply rhythm”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍
knowledge.text: 碾壓混凝土以薄層連續鋪築形成大體積結構，層面暴露時間由面積和供料節拍共同決定。設備名義產能不等於可持續有效供料，需考慮運輸與等待。
knowledge.textEn: RCC forms mass structures through thin successive lifts. Lift exposure depends on area and delivery rhythm, while rated plant capacity differs from sustainable placement because transport and queuing intervene.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋪層體積與供料節拍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift volume and supply rhythm" is correct?
options: 拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。
碾壓混凝土以薄層連續鋪築形成大體積結構，層面暴露時間由面積和供料節拍共同決定。
平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。
optionsEn: Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
RCC forms mass structures through thin successive lifts.
Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
quiz.explanation: 碾壓混凝土以薄層連續鋪築形成大體積結構，層面暴露時間由面積和供料節拍共同決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: RCC forms mass structures through thin successive lifts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift volume and supply rhythm: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋪層體積與供料節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift volume and supply rhythm” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Effective supply 250 m³/h requires six hours, excluding edge work and local interruptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋪層體積與供料節拍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift volume and supply rhythm", which statement holds?
options: 碾壓遍數越多就必然讓所有深度的品質持續提高。
等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。
optionsEn: More roller passes necessarily keep improving quality at every depth.
Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設鋪層面積5000 m²、厚0.3 m，體積1500 m³；有效供料250 m³/h需6 h，未含邊緣修整和局部停頓。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift area 5000 m² and thickness 0.3 m, giving 1500 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift volume and supply rhythm: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋪層體積與供料節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift volume and supply rhythm” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。將最長暴露區的時間納入層面處理證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions. Include the longest-exposed region in the evidence for interface preparation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以鋪層體積與供料節拍編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift volume and supply rhythm, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。將最長暴露區的時間納入層面處理證據。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions. Include the longest-exposed region in the evidence for interface preparation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以鋪層體積與供料節拍編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift volume and supply rhythm, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Separate batching capacity from transport bottlenecks, then check scheduling assumptions against actual interface conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋪層體積與供料節拍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift volume and supply rhythm"?
options: 以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。
optionsEn: Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface.
quiz.explanation: 以實際出料、運輸到達和攤鋪位置時間戳重建節拍，核對最久暴露區；將廠拌能力與運輸瓶頸分開，再用現場層面狀況檢查排程假設是否成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct rhythm from batching, arrival and placement timestamps and identify the longest-exposed area. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋪層體積與供料節拍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift volume and supply rhythm: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋪層體積與供料節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lift volume and supply rhythm” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。若以最高一小時產量推算全日，便會低估冷縫風險。
knowledge.textEn: A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Extrapolating the best production hour to a full day understates cold-interface risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋪層體積與供料節拍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift volume and supply rhythm" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。
平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays.
Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
quiz.explanation: 大面積整層平均完成很快仍可能有角落長時間未覆蓋，臨時道路交錯也會造成局部延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fast average lift cycle can conceal long exposure in corners, while crossing haul routes cause local delays. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓實度與參考密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compaction and reference density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓實度與參考密度」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compaction and reference density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: RCC密實程度影響孔隙、強度與滲透性，現場密度需對應代表性參考值。參考試體的含水量與級配不同時，密實度百分比會失去可比性。 假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓實度與參考密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RCC density influences voids, strength and permeability, and field density needs a representative reference. A percentage loses comparability if reference specimens differ in moisture or grading from the placed material. Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion. Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compaction and reference density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓實度與參考密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compaction and reference density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓實度與參考密度
knowledge.text: RCC密實程度影響孔隙、強度與滲透性，現場密度需對應代表性參考值。參考試體的含水量與級配不同時，密實度百分比會失去可比性。
knowledge.textEn: RCC density influences voids, strength and permeability, and field density needs a representative reference. A percentage loses comparability if reference specimens differ in moisture or grading from the placed material.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓實度與參考密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compaction and reference density" is correct?
options: 平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。
只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。
RCC密實程度影響孔隙、強度與滲透性，現場密度需對應代表性參考值。
optionsEn: Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
RCC density influences voids, strength and permeability, and field density needs a representative reference.
quiz.explanation: RCC密實程度影響孔隙、強度與滲透性，現場密度需對應代表性參考值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: RCC density influences voids, strength and permeability, and field density needs a representative reference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓實度與參考密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compaction and reference density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓實度與參考密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compaction and reference density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Relative compaction is 96.667 percent, a teaching ratio rather than an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓實度與參考密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compaction and reference density", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%。
總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。
垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³.
Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.
Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設現場乾密度2320 kg/m³、參考最大乾密度2400 kg/m³，密實度96.667%；僅教學比例，不作任何工程驗收標準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume field dry density 2320 kg/m³ and reference maximum dry density 2400 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓實度與參考密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compaction and reference density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓實度與參考密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compaction and reference density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。核對粗骨材修正前後是否使用同一密度定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately. Check that density definitions remain consistent before and after coarse-aggregate correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以壓實度與參考密度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction and reference density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。核對粗骨材修正前後是否使用同一密度定義。
knowledge.textEn: Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately. Check that density definitions remain consistent before and after coarse-aggregate correction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以壓實度與參考密度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction and reference density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Cross-check with core density, voids and strength, grouping edge and interior samples separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓實度與參考密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compaction and reference density"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
quiz.explanation: 用同配比試驗確認參考密度，核對現場量測含水修正與大骨材影響；以取芯密度、孔隙和強度作交叉檢查，並將邊緣與中部樣本分組。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish reference density for the same mixture, checking moisture correction and large-aggregate effects in field measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓實度與參考密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compaction and reference density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓實度與參考密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compaction and reference density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。只驗平均密實度可能漏掉層底或模板附近的連續鬆散帶。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Mean compaction alone can miss continuous loose bands at lift bottoms or beside forms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓實度與參考密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compaction and reference density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。
密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response.
quiz.explanation: 密度計校正偏差可能讓全層數字一致但錯誤，粗骨材集中又會改變局部讀數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibration bias can make all readings consistently wrong, while coarse-aggregate concentration changes local response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含水量與膠結比」與「壓實功與遍數解讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Moisture and water-binder ratio" and "Compaction effort and pass count": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含水量與膠結比：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture and water-binder ratio: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水量與膠結比」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture and water-binder ratio” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含水不足會降低可壓實性，過多則改變骨架和漿體孔隙。總水量需含骨材自由水，不能只看拌合機外加水；吸收水與自由水的角色不同。 假設膠結材150 kg/m³、設計有效水90 kg/m³，w/b=0.60；骨材帶入自由水15 kg/m³時，外加水應為75 kg/m³，限已知吸水修正。 把吸收水全部當成可用拌合水會低估外加需求，雨後自由水未扣除則會提高有效水膠比。現場補水若未記錄，後續強度異常將難以追溯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水量與膠結比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Too little water impairs compactability, while excess changes the aggregate skeleton and paste voids. Total mixing water includes aggregate free moisture, with absorbed and free water serving different roles. Assume binder 150 kg/m³ and effective water 90 kg/m³, giving w/b=0.60. Aggregate free water 15 kg/m³ leaves added water 75 kg/m³, with absorption already accounted for. Counting absorbed water as free mixing water understates additions, while failing to subtract rainwater increases effective ratio. Unrecorded field water makes later strength anomalies difficult to trace to their origin. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture and water-binder ratio” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材150 kg/m³、設計有效水90 kg/m³，w/b=0.60；骨材帶入自由水15 kg/m³時，外加水應為75 kg/m³，限已知吸水修正。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 150 kg/m³ and effective water 90 kg/m³, giving w/b=0.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 含水量與膠結比

knowledge.textEn: Too little water impairs compactability, while excess changes the aggregate skeleton and paste voids. Total mixing water includes aggregate free moisture, with absorbed and free water serving different roles.

quiz.question: 關於「含水量與膠結比」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Too little water impairs compactability, while excess changes the aggregate skeleton and paste voids.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
More roller passes necessarily keep improving quality at every depth.

steps.title: 含水量與膠結比：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設膠結材150 kg/m³、設計有效水90 kg/m³，w/b=0.60；骨材帶入自由水15 kg/m³時，外加水應為75 kg/m³，限已知吸水修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume binder 150 kg/m³ and effective water 90 kg/m³, giving w/b=0.60. Aggregate free water 15 kg/m³ leaves added water 75 kg/m³, with absorption already accounted for. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別量測骨材含水和吸水率，核對外加水計量與批次修正；比較稠度、壓實反應和取芯品質，確認比例變化不是單純由濕骨材質量換算錯誤造成。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure aggregate moisture and absorption separately and check metered additions and batch corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 分別量測骨材含水和吸水率，核對外加水計量與批次修正；比較稠度、壓實反應和取芯品質，確認比例變化不是單純由濕骨材質量換算錯誤造成。以骨材乾質量重算含水修正避免濕重誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure aggregate moisture and absorption separately and check metered additions and batch corrections. Compare consistency, compaction response and cores to ensure apparent ratio changes are not wet-mass conversion errors. Recalculate moisture corrections from dry aggregate mass to avoid wet-mass errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for moisture and water-binder ratio, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure aggregate moisture and absorption separately and check metered additions and batch corrections. Compare consistency, compaction response and cores to ensure apparent ratio changes are not wet-mass conversion errors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把吸收水全部當成可用拌合水會低估外加需求，雨後自由水未扣除則會提高有效水膠比。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting absorbed water as free mixing water understates additions, while failing to subtract rainwater increases effective ratio. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compaction effort and pass count” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碾壓遍數是施工過程指標，不是材料狀態本身；振幅、頻率、速度、層厚及骨材都影響輸入和傳遞。增加遍數可能使密度趨於平台或造成粒料破碎。 假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓實功與遍數解讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compaction effort and pass count” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 壓實功與遍數解讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compaction effort and pass count: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓實功與遍數解讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compaction effort and pass count” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m. Nominal energy density is 400 kJ/m³, not entirely effective energy delivered to concrete. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m. Nominal energy density is 400 kJ/m³, not entirely effective energy delivered to concrete.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓實功與遍數解讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compaction effort and pass count", which statement holds?
options: 垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。
optionsEn: Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單遍等效輸入能量20 kJ/m²、6遍、層厚0.3 m，名義能量密度400 kJ/m³；不代表全部能量有效傳入混凝土。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent input 20 kJ/m² per pass, six passes and lift thickness 0.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓實功與遍數解讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compaction effort and pass count: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓實功與遍數解讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compaction effort and pass count” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。用粒徑變化確認碾壓是否正在破碎骨材。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage. Use grading changes to determine whether rolling is crushing aggregate particles. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以壓實功與遍數解讀編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction effort and pass count, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。用粒徑變化確認碾壓是否正在破碎骨材。
knowledge.textEn: Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage. Use grading changes to determine whether rolling is crushing aggregate particles.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以壓實功與遍數解讀編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compaction effort and pass count, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Compare bottom cores with surface readings and inspect whether extra passes alter grading through aggregate breakage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓實功與遍數解讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compaction effort and pass count"?
options: 在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。
optionsEn: Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
quiz.explanation: 在試驗鋪層逐遍記錄密度與沉降，核對設備設定和行走路線；比較層底取芯與表面讀數，並檢查增加遍數後級配是否因骨材破碎而改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record density and settlement after each pass on a trial lift, checking settings and travel paths. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓實功與遍數解讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compaction effort and pass count: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓實功與遍數解讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compaction effort and pass count” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「碾壓遍數越多就必然讓所有深度的品質持續提高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More roller passes necessarily keep improving quality at every depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。把更多碾壓視為必然改善，會忽略破碎和離析。
knowledge.textEn: A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Assuming more rolling always improves quality overlooks particle breakage and segregation caused by excessive working.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓實功與遍數解讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compaction effort and pass count" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。
總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts.
Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.
quiz.explanation: 表面密度達平台可能只是上部已密實而底部仍鬆散，遍數紀錄也可能因路徑重疊計算錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A surface-density plateau may conceal a loose lower lift, and overlapping paths can distort pass counts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」與「層間黏結與有效齡期」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mortar volume and skeleton voids" and "Interlift bond and exposure age": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 砂漿體積與骨架空隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mortar volume and skeleton voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mortar volume and skeleton voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 骨材骨架需要足夠砂漿填充空隙並形成黏結，砂漿過少可能留下連通孔隙。粗骨材堆積密度與級配影響所需體積，不能只以水泥重量評估。 假設每立方公尺粗骨材骨架空隙0.28 m³、有效砂漿0.31 m³，體積餘裕0.03 m³，即空隙的10.714%；不代表最佳配比。 砂漿充足不保證運輸後仍均勻分布，離析可在局部留下缺漿粗料。過多細料又可能增加需水與收縮，單一體積餘裕不能證明耐久性全面提升。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The aggregate skeleton needs mortar to fill voids and bond particles. Insufficient mortar can leave connected porosity, while packing density and grading control volume demand rather than cement mass alone. Assume coarse-skeleton voids 0.28 m³ per bulk cubic metre and effective mortar 0.31 m³. Margin is 0.03 m³, or 10.714 percent of void volume, not an optimum mix. Adequate total mortar does not ensure uniform distribution after transport; segregation can leave locally deficient coarse pockets. Excess fines increase water demand and shrinkage, so one volume margin does not demonstrate overall durability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mortar volume and skeleton voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每立方公尺粗骨材骨架空隙0.28 m³、有效砂漿0.31 m³，體積餘裕0.03 m³，即空隙的10.714%；不代表最佳配比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume coarse-skeleton voids 0.28 m³ per bulk cubic metre and effective mortar 0.31 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mortar volume and skeleton voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 砂漿體積與骨架空隙
knowledge.text: 骨材骨架需要足夠砂漿填充空隙並形成黏結，砂漿過少可能留下連通孔隙。粗骨材堆積密度與級配影響所需體積，不能只以水泥重量評估。
knowledge.textEn: The aggregate skeleton needs mortar to fill voids and bond particles. Insufficient mortar can leave connected porosity, while packing density and grading control volume demand rather than cement mass alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mortar volume and skeleton voids" is correct?
options: 總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。
等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。
骨材骨架需要足夠砂漿填充空隙並形成黏結，砂漿過少可能留下連通孔隙。
optionsEn: Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.
Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions.
The aggregate skeleton needs mortar to fill voids and bond particles.
quiz.explanation: 骨材骨架需要足夠砂漿填充空隙並形成黏結，砂漿過少可能留下連通孔隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The aggregate skeleton needs mortar to fill voids and bond particles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 砂漿體積與骨架空隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mortar volume and skeleton voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「砂漿體積與骨架空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mortar volume and skeleton voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每立方公尺粗骨材骨架空隙0.28 m³、有效砂漿0.31 m³，體積餘裕0.03 m³，即空隙的10.714%；不代表最佳配比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume coarse-skeleton voids 0.28 m³ per bulk cubic metre and effective mortar 0.31 m³. Margin is 0.03 m³, or 10.714 percent of void volume, not an optimum mix. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測骨材堆積空隙並核對砂漿實際體積，將細料吸附與骨材形狀一起考慮；用取芯孔隙連通性和界面觀察檢查是否真正填滿，而不是只看外觀。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mortar volume and skeleton voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 砂漿充足不保證運輸後仍均勻分布，離析可在局部留下缺漿粗料。過多細料又可能增加需水與收縮，單一體積餘裕不能證明耐久性全面提升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate total mortar does not ensure uniform distribution after transport; segregation can leave locally deficient coarse pockets. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interlift bond and exposure age” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰層的黏結受暴露溫度、時間、表面乾燥與處理影響，不只是日曆時間。等效齡期可比較熱歷程，但接縫強度仍需同材料與同處理試驗。 假設簡化反應速率每升10 K加倍，基準20°C，30°C暴露4 h相當20°C的8 h；僅教學Q10模型，非接縫接受時間。 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層間黏結與有效齡期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlift bond depends on exposure temperature, duration, drying and treatment rather than clock time alone. Four hours at 30°C equals eight hours at 20°C, a teaching Q10 model rather than an interface acceptance time. At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interlift bond and exposure age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。
optionsEn: A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a simplified reaction rate doubling per ten kelvin above 20°C.
Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化反應速率每升10 K加倍，基準20°C，30°C暴露4 h相當20°C的8 h；僅教學Q10模型，非接縫接受時間。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a simplified reaction rate doubling per ten kelvin above 20°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 層間黏結與有效齡期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interlift bond and exposure age: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「層間黏結與有效齡期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interlift bond and exposure age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。在相同表面處理下分別比較不同溫度歷程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range. Compare different temperature histories while holding interface preparation conditions constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以層間黏結與有效齡期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for interlift bond and exposure age, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。在相同表面處理下分別比較不同溫度歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range. Compare different temperature histories while holding interface preparation conditions constant.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以層間黏結與有效齡期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for interlift bond and exposure age, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層間黏結與有效齡期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interlift bond and exposure age"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。
將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens.
quiz.explanation: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 層間黏結與有效齡期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interlift bond and exposure age: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「層間黏結與有效齡期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interlift bond and exposure age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。
knowledge.textEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層間黏結與有效齡期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interlift bond and exposure age" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
optionsEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「層狀滲透異向性」與「上下游面層協調」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Layered permeability anisotropy" and "Facing and RCC compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「層狀滲透異向性」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered permeability anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。層狀介質的等效滲透率須依平行或垂直流向計算。 假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層狀滲透異向性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. Equivalent permeability of layers differs for flow parallel and perpendicular to them. Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s. A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. Directly extrapolating intact small specimens to the dam understates scale and interface effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered permeability anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「層狀滲透異向性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layered permeability anisotropy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 層狀滲透異向性
knowledge.text: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。層狀介質的等效滲透率須依平行或垂直流向計算。
knowledge.textEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. Equivalent permeability of layers differs for flow parallel and perpendicular to them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層狀滲透異向性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layered permeability anisotropy" is correct?
options: 垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。
面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。
optionsEn: Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy.
Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface.
quiz.explanation: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「層狀滲透異向性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered permeability anisotropy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「層狀滲透異向性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Layered permeability anisotropy", which statement holds?
options: 平均強度相同就代表兩個施工區具有完全相同品質穩定性。
平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。
optionsEn: Equal mean strength means two construction zones have identical quality consistency.
Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「層狀滲透異向性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered permeability anisotropy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。把芯樣中實際穿越的層面數量清楚列出。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head. Overlay drain locations with interfaces and determine whether fracture flow has exceeded the assumptions of a homogeneous Darcy model. steps.instruction: 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. steps.title: 上下游面層協調：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上下游面層協調」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Facing and RCC compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面層和內部RCC可能具有不同彈性、收縮與溫度歷程，接合區需傳遞相對變形。外表平整不能證明內部相容，尤其在澆置時間錯開時。 假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上下游面層協調」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement. A smooth exterior does not establish compatibility, especially with different placement times. Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution. An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Facing and RCC compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「上下游面層協調」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Facing and RCC compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement. A smooth exterior does not establish compatibility, especially with different placement times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上下游面層協調」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。

optionsEn: Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
