quiz.question: 要驗證「上下游面層協調」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Facing and RCC compatibility"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。
總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences.
Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上下游面層協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上下游面層協調」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Facing and RCC compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。
knowledge.textEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上下游面層協調」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Facing and RCC compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths.
quiz.explanation: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「邊緣壓實與死角」與「強度抽樣與空間變異」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Edge compaction and restricted zones" and "Strength sampling and spatial variability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 邊緣壓實與死角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Edge compaction and restricted zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣壓實與死角」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Edge compaction and restricted zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。中部試驗成果不能直接代表受限空間，幾何可達性是品質控制的一部分。 假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。 體積占比小但若沿上游形成連續通道，可能主導滲流而非平均強度。以隨機中部取樣代表全部工程，會系統性漏掉可達性不足造成的缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊緣壓實與死角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. Central trial results do not represent these areas, making geometric access part of quality control. Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible. A small-volume band can dominate seepage if continuous near the upstream face. Random sampling confined to central areas systematically misses defects caused by restricted equipment access along the structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Edge compaction and restricted zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊緣壓實與死角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Edge compaction and restricted zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 邊緣壓實與死角
knowledge.text: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。中部試驗成果不能直接代表受限空間，幾何可達性是品質控制的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. Central trial results do not represent these areas, making geometric access part of quality control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「邊緣壓實與死角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Edge compaction and restricted zones" is correct?
options: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
平均強度相同就代表兩個施工區具有完全相同品質穩定性。
optionsEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
Equal mean strength means two construction zones have identical quality consistency.
quiz.explanation: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 邊緣壓實與死角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Edge compaction and restricted zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊緣壓實與死角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Edge compaction and restricted zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「邊緣壓實與死角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Edge compaction and restricted zones", which statement holds?
options: 平均密實度達到要求就代表層內每個位置都同樣密實。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³。
碾壓遍數越多就必然讓所有深度的品質持續提高。
optionsEn: Meeting mean compaction requirements means every location is equally dense.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick.
More roller passes necessarily keep improving quality at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 邊緣壓實與死角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Edge compaction and restricted zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊緣壓實與死角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Edge compaction and restricted zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。追蹤弱帶是否在上下相鄰層形成連續通道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts. Trace whether weak bands connect into continuous paths across adjacent lifts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以邊緣壓實與死角編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for edge compaction and restricted zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：體積占比小但若沿上游形成連續通道，可能主導滲流而非平均強度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small-volume band can dominate seepage if continuous near the upstream face. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。追蹤弱帶是否在上下相鄰層形成連續通道。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts. Trace whether weak bands connect into continuous paths across adjacent lifts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以邊緣壓實與死角編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for edge compaction and restricted zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verify alternative compaction with trials and check whether weak bands connect across successive lifts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「邊緣壓實與死角」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Edge compaction and restricted zones"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。
把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions.
Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone.
quiz.explanation: 把設備軌跡與埋件位置疊合標出未覆蓋區，分區選取密度和芯樣；確認替代壓實工法有試驗證據，並檢查弱帶是否沿多個層次連續相接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlay roller tracks with embedded items to locate uncovered areas and sample density and cores by zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Edge compaction and restricted zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊緣壓實與死角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

A teaching normal fifth percentile is 15.065 MPa, not a code design value. title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析
titleEn: Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
summary: 本課以雙曲拱壩拱座分析為入口，深入拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams as its entry point, this course examines three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 薄拱公式的局部敏感度固定均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa和半徑80 m，只將厚度由8增加至10 m。理想壓應力σ=pR/t由5降至4 MPa，減少20%。比較保持無彎曲的連續圓拱假設；真實加厚會改變三維剛度、溫度與拱梁分載，不能把此倒數關係視為完整拱壩設計結論。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For local sensitivity of the thin-arch relation, hold uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa and radius 80 m fixed, increasing only thickness from 8 m to 10 m. Ideal compression σ=pR/t falls from 5 to 4 MPa, a 20% reduction. The comparison retains a continuous circular arch without bending; actual thickening changes three-dimensional stiffness, temperature and arch-cantilever sharing, so the inverse relation is not a complete dam-design conclusion.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄拱膜力初估」與「拱與懸臂分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thin-arch membrane estimate" and "Arch and cantilever load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄拱膜力初估」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin-arch membrane estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。 假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄拱膜力初估」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry. Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thin-arch membrane estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄拱膜力初估」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thin-arch membrane estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄拱膜力初估
knowledge.text: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。
knowledge.textEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thin-arch membrane estimate" is correct?
options: 薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄拱膜力初估」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄拱膜力初估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thin-arch membrane estimate", which statement holds?
options: 岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄拱膜力初估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thin-arch membrane estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thin-arch membrane estimate"?
options: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄拱膜力初估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
knowledge.textEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄拱膜力初估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thin-arch membrane estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱與懸臂分擔」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch and cantilever load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。 假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱與懸臂分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller. Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch and cantilever load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱與懸臂分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch and cantilever load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱與懸臂分擔
knowledge.text: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch and cantilever load sharing" is correct?
options: 拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。
optionsEn: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement.
quiz.explanation: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱與懸臂分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱與懸臂分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch and cantilever load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN。
裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch and cantilever load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岸坡推力方向」與「楔體滑動抗力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment thrust direction" and "Wedge sliding resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岸坡推力方向」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment thrust direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。大壓力若指向易滑節理組合，仍可能形成不利楔體受力。 假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸坡推力方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. Large compression can still destabilize a wedge when directed unfavorably relative to joints. Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system. Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment thrust direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岸坡推力方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment thrust direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岸坡推力方向
knowledge.text: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。大壓力若指向易滑節理組合，仍可能形成不利楔體受力。
knowledge.textEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. Large compression can still destabilize a wedge when directed unfavorably relative to joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岸坡推力方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment thrust direction" is correct?
options: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
optionsEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
quiz.explanation: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岸坡推力方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment thrust direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岸坡推力方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abutment thrust direction", which statement holds?
options: 完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岸坡推力方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Abutment thrust direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。以向量點積獨立重算法向與剪向分量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation. Independently recompute normal and tangential components using vector projections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以岸坡推力方向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for abutment thrust direction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。以向量點積獨立重算法向與剪向分量。
knowledge.textEn: Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation. Independently recompute normal and tangential components using vector projections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以岸坡推力方向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for abutment thrust direction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Cross-check mapping and model reactions, retaining changes in thrust direction with elevation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岸坡推力方向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abutment thrust direction"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要重新擬合後殘差變小，就證明原先結構異常已消失。
把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared.
Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces.
quiz.explanation: 把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岸坡推力方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abutment thrust direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岸坡推力方向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abutment thrust direction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
optionsEn: Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
quiz.explanation: 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 楔體滑動抗力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wedge sliding resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「楔體滑動抗力」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge sliding resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岸坡不穩定可能沿既有節理滑動，而非岩石材料壓碎。有效正向力、節理摩擦與水壓控制抗力，幾何可動性必須先於數值安全比判讀。 假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「楔體滑動抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Abutments can fail by sliding on existing joints rather than crushing intact rock. Effective normal force, joint friction and water pressure govern resistance, after geometric freedom to move has been established. Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN. Cohesionless resistance ratio is 1.5405. Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge sliding resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「楔體滑動抗力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wedge sliding resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 楔體滑動抗力
knowledge.text: 岸坡不穩定可能沿既有節理滑動，而非岩石材料壓碎。有效正向力、節理摩擦與水壓控制抗力，幾何可動性必須先於數值安全比判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Abutments can fail by sliding on existing joints rather than crushing intact rock. Effective normal force, joint friction and water pressure govern resistance, after geometric freedom to move has been established.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「楔體滑動抗力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wedge sliding resistance" is correct?
options: 岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
岸坡不穩定可能沿既有節理滑動，而非岩石材料壓碎。
裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
Abutments can fail by sliding on existing joints rather than crushing intact rock.
Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
quiz.explanation: 岸坡不穩定可能沿既有節理滑動，而非岩石材料壓碎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Abutments can fail by sliding on existing joints rather than crushing intact rock. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 楔體滑動抗力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wedge sliding resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「楔體滑動抗力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge sliding resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN. Cohesionless resistance ratio is 1.5405. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單滑面總正力30 MN、水壓合力8 MN、摩擦角35°、驅動剪力10 MN，無黏聚比值(30−8)tan35°/10=1.5405。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume single-plane normal force 30 MN, water resultant 8 MN, friction angle 35 degrees and driving shear 10 MN. Cohesionless resistance ratio is 1.5405.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「楔體滑動抗力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wedge sliding resistance", which statement holds?

Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.

steps.title: 楔體滑動抗力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wedge sliding resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「楔體滑動抗力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge sliding resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。檢查潛在楔體是否真有可向外移動的自由面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism. Check whether the potential wedge genuinely has an outward movement surface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以楔體滑動抗力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wedge sliding resistance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism. Check whether the potential wedge genuinely has an outward movement surface.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wedge sliding resistance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Separate peak and residual friction and check whether wedge movement and crack observations support the assumed mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「楔體滑動抗力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wedge sliding resistance"?
options: 用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
optionsEn: Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
quiz.explanation: 用節理測繪確認滑面連續性和出露，將孔壓位置與實際滑面對應；分開峰值與殘餘摩擦，檢查楔體位移及裂縫監測是否支持所假設運動模式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map continuity and daylighting of the sliding surface and locate pore pressures relative to it. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 楔體滑動抗力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wedge sliding resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「楔體滑動抗力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge sliding resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。若忽略節理水壓或錯將不連續面當完整岩體，會高估岸坡承載並錯估壩體反力邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Omitting joint pressure or treating discontinuities as intact material overstates abutment support and distorts the boundary reactions assigned to the dam.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「楔體滑動抗力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wedge sliding resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。
裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance.
Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
quiz.explanation: 即使岩石單軸強度高，光滑充填節理仍可能具有低抗剪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Strong intact rock can contain smooth filled joints with low shear resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂隙水壓分布」與「岩體柔度與拱座位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint water-pressure distribution" and "Rock compliance and abutment movement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂隙水壓分布：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint water-pressure distribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙水壓分布」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint water-pressure distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水沿岩體節理傳遞到岸坡內部，裂隙開度與排水會使壓力分布不同於外部庫水線性內插。水壓合力及作用點都會影響楔體穩定。 假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙水壓分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water transmits through abutment joints, with aperture and drainage producing pressure distributions different from a simple interpolation of reservoir level. Both resultant and location influence wedge stability. Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa. Resultant is 40 MN at two-thirds length from the low-pressure edge, for a linear distribution. Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint water-pressure distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂隙水壓分布」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint water-pressure distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂隙水壓分布
knowledge.text: 水沿岩體節理傳遞到岸坡內部，裂隙開度與排水會使壓力分布不同於外部庫水線性內插。水壓合力及作用點都會影響楔體穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Water transmits through abutment joints, with aperture and drainage producing pressure distributions different from a simple interpolation of reservoir level. Both resultant and location influence wedge stability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂隙水壓分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint water-pressure distribution" is correct?
options: 裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
水沿岩體節理傳遞到岸坡內部，裂隙開度與排水會使壓力分布不同於外部庫水線性內插。
optionsEn: Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.

quiz.explanation: 水沿岩體節理傳遞到岸坡內部，裂隙開度與排水會使壓力分布不同於外部庫水線性內插。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙水壓分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa. Resultant is 40 MN at two-thirds length from the low-pressure edge, for a linear distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「裂隙水壓分布」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint water-pressure distribution", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 200 m² with pressure rising linearly from zero to 0.4 MPa.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設矩形節理面200 m²，壓力由上緣0線性增到底部0.4 MPa，水壓合力40 MN，作用點距低壓邊2/3長度；限線性分布。 重算時請保留單位。
