steps.title: 裂隙水壓分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint water-pressure distribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂隙水壓分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint water-pressure distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。利用壓力積分求作用點以核對不利轉動力矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Report discharge and pressure separately, integrating measured nonlinear profiles against the triangular teaching approximation. Locate the integrated pressure resultant to check its adverse rotational moment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以裂隙水壓分布編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for joint water-pressure distribution, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Report discharge and pressure separately, integrating measured nonlinear profiles against the triangular teaching approximation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Report discharge and pressure separately, integrating measured nonlinear profiles against the triangular teaching approximation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂隙水壓分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint water-pressure distribution"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
沿裂隙不同高程安裝代表性孔壓量測，核對與庫位變化的幅值和遲滯；將出水量與水壓分別報告，並積分非線性實測曲線比較教學三角形。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure representative pressures at several joint elevations and compare amplitude and lag with reservoir levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂隙水壓分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint water-pressure distribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙水壓分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint water-pressure distribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。只用一個低壓測點代表整個滑面，會低估未排水區的合力和不利力矩。
knowledge.textEn: Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Extending one low-pressure point over the full slip plane understates force and adverse moment in undrained portions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂隙水壓分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint water-pressure distribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock.
quiz.explanation: 出水量小可能因通道堵塞而水壓更高，不等於岸坡變乾。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low discharge can indicate blockage with higher pressure rather than drier rock. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩體柔度與拱座位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock compliance and abutment movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩體柔度與拱座位移」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock compliance and abutment movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岸坡會在推力下變形，拱座向外移動可能改變拱壩內力分配。岩體等效模數受節理和尺度影響，不能直接使用完整岩芯模數代替現地反應。 假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm；均質單軸類比，非岸坡真實三維解。 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩體柔度與拱座位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Abutments deform under thrust and outward movement changes arch force distribution. Jointing and scale affect rock-mass modulus, preventing direct substitution of intact-core modulus for field response. Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution. Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock compliance and abutment movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm；均質單軸類比，非岸坡真實三維解。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩體柔度與拱座位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rock compliance and abutment movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩體柔度與拱座位移

knowledge.textEn: Abutments deform under thrust and outward movement changes arch force distribution. Jointing and scale affect rock-mass modulus, preventing direct substitution of intact-core modulus for field response.

knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩體柔度與拱座位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rock compliance and abutment movement" is correct?

完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。

optionsEn: Abutments deform under thrust and outward movement changes arch force distribution.

quiz.explanation: 岸坡會在推力下變形，拱座向外移動可能改變拱壩內力分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩體柔度與拱座位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rock compliance and abutment movement", which statement holds?
options: 把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm。
薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
optionsEn: Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution.
Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設簡化壓縮區長20 m、面積400 m²、岩體E=10 GPa、推力40 MN，δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm；均質單軸類比，非岸坡真實三維解。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume compressed zone length 20 m, area 400 m², rock-mass E=10 GPa and force 40 MN. δ=FL/EA=0.2 mm, a uniform uniaxial analogy rather than a real three-dimensional solution. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩體柔度與拱座位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rock compliance and abutment movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩體柔度與拱座位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rock compliance and abutment movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。將完整岩芯與岩體模數的來源分開標示。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range. Vary foundation boundary distance and stiffness and check stability of dam forces and abutment reactions. Identify intact-core and rock-mass modulus evidence as separate information sources. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以岩體柔度與拱座位移編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rock compliance and abutment movement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range. Vary foundation boundary distance and stiffness and check stability of dam forces and abutment reactions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Vary foundation boundary distance and stiffness and check stability of dam forces and abutment reactions. Identify intact-core and rock-mass modulus evidence as separate information sources.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩體柔度與拱座位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rock compliance and abutment movement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range.
quiz.explanation: 比較現地變形試驗、節理調查與監測位移，建立模數範圍而非單值；改變基礎模型邊界距離和剛度，檢查壩體內力及拱座反力是否穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare field deformation tests, joint mapping and monitored movements to establish a modulus range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩體柔度與拱座位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rock compliance and abutment movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩體柔度與拱座位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rock compliance and abutment movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。若只靠調整岩體模數配合壩頂量測，其他邊界錯誤可能被隱藏。
knowledge.textEn: Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Adjusting modulus solely to fit crest movement can hide errors in other boundary assumptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩體柔度與拱座位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rock compliance and abutment movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。
optionsEn: Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
quiz.explanation: 把基礎截斷面固定得太近會人工增硬，可能得到過小位移和錯誤應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixing foundation boundaries too close artificially stiffens the model and produces small displacements with wrong stresses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」與「網格收斂與局部奇異」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure temperature and joint closure" and "Mesh convergence and singularity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure temperature and joint closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure temperature and joint closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩接縫灌漿後形成不同於分離懸臂的整體作用，封拱溫度決定後續升溫壓縮和降溫張開傾向。溫度是結構初始狀態的一部分。 假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint grouting creates an integrated arch distinct from separate cantilevers. Closure temperature establishes later warming compression and cooling-opening tendencies, making temperature part of the structural initial state. Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Free shortening is 16 mm; actual restraint converts it into movement and stress rather than this exact total opening. Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure temperature and joint closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure temperature and joint closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合
knowledge.text: 拱壩接縫灌漿後形成不同於分離懸臂的整體作用，封拱溫度決定後續升溫壓縮和降溫張開傾向。溫度是結構初始狀態的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Joint grouting creates an integrated arch distinct from separate cantilevers. Closure temperature establishes later warming compression and cooling-opening tendencies, making temperature part of the structural initial state.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure temperature and joint closure" is correct?
options: 接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。
拱壩接縫灌漿後形成不同於分離懸臂的整體作用，封拱溫度決定後續升溫壓縮和降溫張開傾向。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
Joint grouting creates an integrated arch distinct from separate cantilevers.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 拱壩接縫灌漿後形成不同於分離懸臂的整體作用，封拱溫度決定後續升溫壓縮和降溫張開傾向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint grouting creates an integrated arch distinct from separate cantilevers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure temperature and joint closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure temperature and joint closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Free shortening is 16 mm; actual restraint converts it into movement and stress rather than this exact total opening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Free shortening is 16 mm; actual restraint converts it into movement and stress rather than this exact total opening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure temperature and joint closure", which statement holds?
options: 只要重新擬合後殘差變小，就證明原先結構異常已消失。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm。
optionsEn: A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效拱長200 m、α=10⁻⁵/K、相對封拱溫度下降8 K，自由縮短16 mm；真實拘束會轉成接縫位移和應力，非直接開縫總量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective arch length 200 m, α=10⁻⁵/K and cooling eight kelvin below closure temperature. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure temperature and joint closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure temperature and joint closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。對各灌漿區塊保留自己的封拱溫度紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates. Compare deformation at equal reservoir level but different temperature to test the initial-state model. Retain a separate closure-temperature record for every grouted block group. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以封拱溫度與接縫閉合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for closure temperature and joint closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates. Compare deformation at equal reservoir level but different temperature to test the initial-state model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure temperature and joint closure"?
options: 核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
optionsEn: Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
quiz.explanation: 核對灌漿時的多點溫度而非單一氣溫，將接縫計零點與施工日期連結；比較後續同庫位不同溫度的變形，確認模型初始狀態可重現觀測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check multi-point grouting temperatures rather than ambient air alone and link joint-meter zeros to construction dates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 封拱溫度與接縫閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure temperature and joint closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure temperature and joint closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。若模型沒有記錄封拱狀態，溫度應力的符號可能被錯判。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Without the closure state, even the sign of inferred thermal stress can be misinterpreted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「封拱溫度與接縫閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure temperature and joint closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 把所有壩段視為同時同溫度閉合會忽略施工分期，局部灌漿不完整也可能保留柔弱面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming simultaneous equal-temperature closure misses construction staging, and incomplete grouting leaves compliant interfaces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 網格收斂與局部奇異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mesh convergence and singularity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「網格收斂與局部奇異」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mesh convergence and singularity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 三維分析須區分真正的應力集中和幾何尖角造成的數值奇異。網格愈細不一定讓尖角最大應力收斂，應同時檢查位移、能量與有限區域平均。 假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。 只報最細網格最大應力可能讓數值奇異冒充材料失效，反之只看位移收斂也會漏掉接觸邊緣問題。收斂是特定輸出量的性質，不能概括全部結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「網格收斂與局部奇異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Three-dimensional analysis must distinguish physical concentration from numerical singularities at sharp corners. Finer meshes may not converge the point maximum, requiring displacement, energy and finite-area averages to be checked together. Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Relative difference is 2.564 percent, describing this displacement only rather than proving local stress convergence. Reporting only the finest-mesh maximum can mistake a singularity for material failure, while displacement convergence can miss contact-edge issues. Convergence applies to a specific output and cannot certify every model result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mesh convergence and singularity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「網格收斂與局部奇異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mesh convergence and singularity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 網格收斂與局部奇異
knowledge.text: 三維分析須區分真正的應力集中和幾何尖角造成的數值奇異。網格愈細不一定讓尖角最大應力收斂，應同時檢查位移、能量與有限區域平均。
knowledge.textEn: Three-dimensional analysis must distinguish physical concentration from numerical singularities at sharp corners. Finer meshes may not converge the point maximum, requiring displacement, energy and finite-area averages to be checked together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「網格收斂與局部奇異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mesh convergence and singularity" is correct?
options: 壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。
三維分析須區分真正的應力集中和幾何尖角造成的數值奇異。
optionsEn: Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.
Three-dimensional analysis must distinguish physical concentration from numerical singularities at sharp corners.
quiz.explanation: 三維分析須區分真正的應力集中和幾何尖角造成的數值奇異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Three-dimensional analysis must distinguish physical concentration from numerical singularities at sharp corners. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網格收斂與局部奇異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mesh convergence and singularity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「網格收斂與局部奇異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mesh convergence and singularity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Relative difference is 2.564 percent, describing this displacement only rather than proving local stress convergence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保持材料與荷載不變細化網格，分別追蹤位移、反力和局部平均應力；檢查尖角最大值是否隨單元尺寸無界增加，並以合理幾何圓角測試模型敏感性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Refine meshes with unchanged materials and loads, tracking displacement, reactions and local average stress separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Relative difference is 2.564 percent, describing this displacement only rather than proving local stress convergence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「網格收斂與局部奇異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mesh convergence and singularity", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%。
薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm.
Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩次細化壩頂位移由12.0降至11.7 mm，相對差0.3/11.7=2.564%；此差只衡量該位移，不能保證局部應力已收斂。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume refined crest displacement changes from 12.0 to 11.7 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 保持材料與荷載不變細化網格，分別追蹤位移、反力和局部平均應力；檢查尖角最大值是否隨單元尺寸無界增加，並以合理幾何圓角測試模型敏感性。對有限面積平均應力另做網格收斂曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Refine meshes with unchanged materials and loads, tracking displacement, reactions and local average stress separately. Check whether corner maxima grow without bound and test sensitivity to physically reasonable geometric rounding. Construct a separate mesh-convergence curve for stress averaged over finite areas. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以網格收斂與局部奇異編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。保持材料與荷載不變細化網格，分別追蹤位移、反力和局部平均應力；檢查尖角最大值是否隨單元尺寸無界增加，並以合理幾何圓角測試模型敏感性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for mesh convergence and singularity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Refine meshes with unchanged materials and loads, tracking displacement, reactions and local average stress separately. Check whether corner maxima grow without bound and test sensitivity to physically reasonable geometric rounding.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報最細網格最大應力可能讓數值奇異冒充材料失效，反之只看位移收斂也會漏掉接觸邊緣問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only the finest-mesh maximum can mistake a singularity for material failure, while displacement convergence can miss contact-edge issues. steps.title: 地震慣性與附加水質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia and added water mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震慣性與附加水質量」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic inertia and added water mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震作用同時包含壩體、基礎和庫水的動力互制，靜力慣性項只提供量級。附加水質量隨頻率與邊界改變，不能任意當成固定壩重增加。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設等效振動質量5 million kg、水平加速度0.1g，慣性力ma=4.905 MN；僅單模態量級，不含動力放大或真實庫水附加質量。 把峰值地面加速度直接乘全部壩重不能代表每點同相加速，基礎柔度與輻射阻尼也會改變反應。忽略水庫耦合可能錯估頻率和壩頂放大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震慣性與附加水質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earthquake response involves dam, foundation and reservoir interaction. A static inertia term gives only a scale, while hydrodynamic added mass depends on frequency and boundaries rather than an arbitrary fixed weight increase. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume equivalent vibrating mass 5 million kg and horizontal acceleration 0.1g. Inertia ma=4.905 MN, a single-mode scale without dynamic amplification or actual reservoir added mass. Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic inertia and added water mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Check identified frequencies and damping and distinguish foundation input from free-field motion.
quiz.explanation: 以觀測或辨識的模態檢查頻率與阻尼，核對輸入地震在基礎和自由場的定義；比較含水與無水模型的反應，保留頻率相關邊界而非只調總質量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check identified frequencies and damping and distinguish foundation input from free-field motion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震慣性與附加水質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia and added water mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地震慣性與附加水質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seismic inertia and added water mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把峰值地面加速度直接乘全部壩重不能代表每點同相加速，基礎柔度與輻射阻尼也會改變反應。忽略水庫耦合可能錯估頻率和壩頂放大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略水庫耦合可能錯估頻率和壩頂放大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Foundation compliance, radiation damping and reservoir coupling can change frequencies and crest amplification substantially.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared.

quiz.explanationEn: Peak ground acceleration times total weight does not mean every point accelerates in phase. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水溫荷載與監測殘差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩位移同時受庫水位、溫度和時間影響，異常診斷需先扣除可解釋的正常反應。統計模型只能在已驗證範圍內描述資料，不直接證明結構安全。 線性係數分別為0.1 mm/m與0.2 mm/K。假設教學位移模型d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm，ΔH=10 m、ΔT=5 K，預測2 mm；觀測2.6 mm則殘差0.6 mm，非警戒值。 高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。重新訓練前若未檢查原因，異常可能被數學上消除卻仍存在。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水溫荷載與監測殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch displacement responds to water level, temperature and time, so anomaly interpretation first removes explainable normal behavior. Statistical models describe validated data ranges rather than independently proving structural safety. The linear coefficients are 0.1 mm/m and 0.2 mm/K, respectively. Assume teaching displacement d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm with ΔH=10 m and ΔT=5 K. Prediction is 2 mm; observation 2.6 mm leaves residual 0.6 mm, not an alarm threshold. Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration. Retraining without investigating causes may mathematically erase an anomaly while its physical source remains. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The linear coefficients are 0.1 mm/m and 0.2 mm/K, respectively.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要重新擬合後殘差變小，就證明原先結構異常已消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The linear coefficients are 0.1 mm/m and 0.2 mm/K, respectively. Assume teaching displacement d=0.1ΔH+0.2ΔT mm with ΔH=10 m and ΔT=5 K. Prediction is 2 mm; observation 2.6 mm leaves residual 0.6 mm, not an alarm threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要重新擬合後殘差變小，就證明原先結構異常已消失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smaller residual after refitting proves the original structural anomaly has disappeared." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。重新訓練前若未檢查原因，異常可能被數學上消除卻仍存在。
knowledge.textEn: Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration. Retraining without investigating causes may mathematically erase an anomaly while its physical source remains.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水溫荷載與監測殘差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydrothermal effects and monitoring residuals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。
薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration.
Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
quiz.explanation: 高度相關的水位與溫度會讓係數難以識別，模型也可能把長期損傷吸收為時間趨勢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Correlated level and temperature make coefficients difficult to identify, and a time trend can absorb deterioration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 混凝土面板堆石壩施工
summary: 本課以混凝土面板堆石壩施工為入口，深入堆石變形、混凝土面板與周邊接縫的相容。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Concrete-face rockfill dam construction as its entry point, this course examines compatibility of rockfill deformation, concrete facing and perimeter joints. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
architectureNodes: Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face

labelsEn: Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 密度敏感度固定顆粒密度2700 kg/m³，只將乾密度由2100提高到2200 kg/m³。n=1−ρd/ρs由0.2222降至0.1852，即孔隙率約由22.22%降至18.52%。這是相同顆粒密度下的體積比例比較，仍忽略顆粒內孔隙及含水修正誤差；單由孔隙率下降不能推定壓縮模數或滲透係數變化量。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold particle density at 2700 kg/m³ and change only dry density from 2100 to 2200 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs falls from 0.2222 to 0.1852, approximately 22.22% to 18.52%. This volume-ratio comparison still excludes intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error; the porosity change alone does not determine changes in compressibility or permeability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「堆石孔隙與密實」與「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rockfill voids and density" and "Layer compression and crest settlement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堆石孔隙與密實」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rockfill voids and density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。顆粒尺寸遠大於一般試體時，尺寸效應必須獨立處理。 假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堆石孔隙與密實」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. Dry density indicates bulk voids but does not directly give compressibility, and particles larger than normal specimens require separate treatment of scale effects. Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rockfill voids and density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堆石孔隙與密實」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rockfill voids and density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堆石孔隙與密實
knowledge.text: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。顆粒尺寸遠大於一般試體時，尺寸效應必須獨立處理。
knowledge.textEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. Dry density indicates bulk voids but does not directly give compressibility, and particles larger than normal specimens require separate treatment of scale effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堆石孔隙與密實」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rockfill voids and density" is correct?
options: 堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。
壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
optionsEn: Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage.
Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
quiz.explanation: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「堆石孔隙與密實」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rockfill voids and density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堆石孔隙與密實」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rockfill voids and density", which statement holds?
options: 只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222。
optionsEn: Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「堆石孔隙與密實」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rockfill voids and density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。比較濕化前後的壓縮試驗以檢查密度代表性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines. Compare compression before and after wetting to test density representativeness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以堆石孔隙與密實編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rockfill voids and density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。比較濕化前後的壓縮試驗以檢查密度代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines. Compare compression before and after wetting to test density representativeness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以堆石孔隙與密實編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rockfill voids and density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堆石孔隙與密實」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rockfill voids and density"?
options: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。
optionsEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「堆石孔隙與密實」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rockfill voids and density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。
knowledge.textEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堆石孔隙與密實」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rockfill voids and density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。
壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression.
Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
quiz.explanation: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layer compression and crest settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layer compression and crest settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。分層量測能辨認填築、蓄水與長期作用各自造成的位移。 假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. Layered measurements distinguish placement, impoundment and long-term contributions to movement. Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layer compression and crest settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layer compression and crest settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降
knowledge.text: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。分層量測能辨認填築、蓄水與長期作用各自造成的位移。
knowledge.textEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. Layered measurements distinguish placement, impoundment and long-term contributions to movement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layer compression and crest settlement" is correct?
options: 壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。
optionsEn: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest.
quiz.explanation: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layer compression and crest settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layer compression and crest settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Layer compression and crest settlement", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m。
趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002.
A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layer compression and crest settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layer compression and crest settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。以不同高程錨點差分辨認真正的薄層壓縮。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself. Difference anchors at several elevations to identify compression within thin layers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分層壓縮與壩頂沉降編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for layer compression and crest settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
