knowledge.textEn: Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself. Difference anchors at several elevations to identify compression within thin layers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以分層壓縮與壩頂沉降編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較分層沉降計與壩頂測量的閉合，將各層填築完成時間和蓄水歷程對齊；檢查儀器錨點是否移動，並區分地基沉降與壩體自身壓縮。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for layer compression and crest settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Close layer-settlement measurements against crest surveying and align completion dates with reservoir history. Check anchor movement and separate foundation settlement from compression within the embankment itself.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layer compression and crest settlement"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layer compression and crest settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。
knowledge.textEn: Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Layer compression and crest settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature.
quiz.explanation: 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板曲率與拉應變」與「周邊接縫位移分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face curvature and tensile strain" and "Perimeter-joint movement components": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板曲率與拉應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face curvature and tensile strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面板曲率與拉應變」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face curvature and tensile strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土面板隨堆石支承變形彎曲，曲率比整體平移更直接影響表面拉應變。面板厚度與支承接觸條件共同控制反應，不能只檢查混凝土抗壓強度。 假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。 支承局部脫空可能使彎曲集中，即使整體沉降平滑仍可裂縫。用過長測距平均曲率會漏掉短波變形，單側應變也難分膜力與彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板曲率與拉應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation. Thickness and support contact govern response, so compressive strength alone is insufficient. Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending. Surface strain κt/2=200 microstrain, excluding membrane strain. Local support loss concentrates bending despite smooth overall settlement. Long gauge spacing averages away short-wavelength curvature, while one-sided strain alone cannot distinguish membrane action from flexural response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face curvature and tensile strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面板曲率與拉應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face curvature and tensile strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation. Thickness and support contact govern response, so compressive strength alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「面板曲率與拉應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。
optionsEn: Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation.
High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土面板隨堆石支承變形彎曲，曲率比整體平移更直接影響表面拉應變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 面板曲率與拉應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face curvature and tensile strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板曲率與拉應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face curvature and tensile strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending. Surface strain κt/2=200 microstrain, excluding membrane strain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用相鄰測點曲線估算曲率，檢查測距與數值微分對雜訊的敏感性；對照面板兩面應變和裂縫方向，並將剛體位移與局部彎曲分開判讀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate curvature from neighboring survey points and test sensitivity to spacing and differentiation noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.titleEn: Face curvature and tensile strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板曲率與拉應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 用相鄰測點曲線估算曲率，檢查測距與數值微分對雜訊的敏感性；對照面板兩面應變和裂縫方向，並將剛體位移與局部彎曲分開判讀。以更密測點確認局部曲率不是微分雜訊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。它不是只靠混凝土重量阻水，岩面弱帶和接縫繞流也必須追蹤。 假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「趾板基礎接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. Concrete weight alone does not block seepage through weak seams or bypass joints. Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment. Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plinth foundation contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN.

knowledge.title: 趾板基礎接觸
knowledge.text: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。它不是只靠混凝土重量阻水，岩面弱帶和接縫繞流也必須追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. Concrete weight alone does not block seepage through weak seams or bypass joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「趾板基礎接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。
optionsEn: A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plinth foundation contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。將趾板合力位置與實際接觸區域互相核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth. Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams. Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。支承剛度和反濾能力是不同要求，級配必須與相鄰材料及施工離析一起檢查。 假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。 墊層缺口可能同時造成漏流和面板脫空，局部細料流失未必立刻反映在總漏水量。只確認粒徑比合格，仍不能排除施工接頭或厚度不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墊層反濾相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. Support stiffness and filtration are separate requirements, so grading must be checked with adjacent materials and placement segregation. Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests. A cushion gap can create leakage and support loss together, while local fines migration may not immediately change total leakage. Passing one grading ratio does not exclude construction discontinuities or insufficient layer thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cushion-filter compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cushion-filter compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 墊層反濾相容
knowledge.text: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。支承剛度和反濾能力是不同要求，級配必須與相鄰材料及施工離析一起檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. Support stiffness and filtration are separate requirements, so grading must be checked with adjacent materials and placement segregation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「墊層反濾相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cushion-filter compatibility" is correct?
options: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。
optionsEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
quiz.explanation: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 墊層反濾相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cushion-filter compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊層反濾相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cushion-filter compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從面板下實際鋪設材料取樣，對照料場級配及含泥量；以方向相符的滲流試驗觀察細料流失，並核對支承平整度是否因離析或沖刷而降低。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample placed material beneath the face and compare stockpile grading and fines.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斜面水壓與合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斜面水壓與合力」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜水壓垂直作用在面板表面，合力依垂直水深分布而非沿坡距離直接計算。法向力再由堆石支承和趾板系統傳遞，須保留方向。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米寬面板斜長50 m、坡角對水平30°，底部垂深25 m，合力γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m；平面靜水且頂部在水面。 以斜長當水深會高估壓力，忽略法向分量又會誤判支承需求。若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斜面水壓與合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the face and varies with vertical depth rather than slope distance alone. Rockfill support and plinth transfer the normal resultant, whose direction must be retained. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume face slope length 50 m per metre width at thirty degrees to horizontal, giving bottom depth 25 m. Resultant γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m, with the top at the surface. Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米寬面板斜長50 m、坡角對水平30°，底部垂深25 m，合力γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m；平面靜水且頂部在水面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Check datum, wetted extent and support-reaction directions, keeping horizontal projections distinct from inclined surface area. Independently check the horizontal pressure component using the vertical projection. steps.instructionEn: Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「斜面水壓與合力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.question: 關於「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged filling and wetting settlement", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged filling and wetting settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Staged filling and wetting settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。保留每階段預測與後續實測的差異紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant. Validate prediction intervals on later data rather than relying only on an early fit. Retain a record of each stage prediction and subsequent measured discrepancy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分期蓄水與濕化沉降編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for staged filling and wetting settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant. Validate prediction intervals on later data rather than relying only on an early fit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Validate prediction intervals on later data rather than relying only on an early fit. Retain a record of each stage prediction and subsequent measured discrepancy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged filling and wetting settlement"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。
趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant.
A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
quiz.explanation: 將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged filling and wetting settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged filling and wetting settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。
knowledge.textEn: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged filling and wetting settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load.
quiz.explanation: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏流與水量閉合」與「長期蠕變與變形預留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leakage and water-balance closure" and "Long-term creep and movement allowance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏流與水量閉合」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leakage and water-balance closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。分區量測與水質示蹤可區分壩體、基礎和外部集水。 假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏流與水量閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. Total change alone cannot locate face cracks; sectional measurement and water-quality tracing distinguish embankment, foundation and external collection. Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag. An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leakage and water-balance closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏流與水量閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leakage and water-balance closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏流與水量閉合
knowledge.text: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。分區量測與水質示蹤可區分壩體、基礎和外部集水。
knowledge.textEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. Total change alone cannot locate face cracks; sectional measurement and water-quality tracing distinguish embankment, foundation and external collection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏流與水量閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leakage and water-balance closure" is correct?
options: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。
排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
optionsEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
quiz.explanation: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏流與水量閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leakage and water-balance closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏流與水量閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leakage and water-balance closure", which statement holds?
options: 壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s。
只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。
optionsEn: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s.
Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏流與水量閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leakage and water-balance closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。將清通排水管的時間與流量跳變逐項對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty. Compare drain-clearing times individually against observed jumps in measured flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以漏流與水量閉合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for leakage and water-balance closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。將清通排水管的時間與流量跳變逐項對照。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty. Compare drain-clearing times individually against observed jumps in measured flow.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏流與水量閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leakage and water-balance closure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources.
quiz.explanation: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏流與水量閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leakage and water-balance closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。
knowledge.textEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏流與水量閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leakage and water-balance closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
optionsEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
quiz.explanation: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期蠕變與變形預留」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term creep and movement allowance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。短期壓實完成不表示服役期變形停止，接縫預留需檢查情境。 假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期蠕變與變形預留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. Log-time relations are empirical descriptions; completed compaction does not end service movement, so joint allowance must be checked across scenarios. Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure. A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term creep and movement allowance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期蠕變與變形預留」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-term creep and movement allowance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留
knowledge.text: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。短期壓實完成不表示服役期變形停止，接縫預留需檢查情境。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. Log-time relations are empirical descriptions; completed compaction does not end service movement, so joint allowance must be checked across scenarios.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期蠕變與變形預留」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term creep and movement allowance" is correct?
options: 壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
quiz.explanation: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期蠕變與變形預留」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term creep and movement allowance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期蠕變與變形預留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term creep and movement allowance", which statement holds?
options: 面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm。
optionsEn: High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期蠕變與變形預留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term creep and movement allowance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。檢查新增載重後是否應重新定義時間起點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes. Check whether a new load requires redefining the empirical time origin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以長期蠕變與變形預留編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for long-term creep and movement allowance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。檢查新增載重後是否應重新定義時間起點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes. Check whether a new load requires redefining the empirical time origin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以長期蠕變與變形預留編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for long-term creep and movement allowance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期蠕變與變形預留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term creep and movement allowance"?
options: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。
optionsEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
quiz.explanation: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期蠕變與變形預留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term creep and movement allowance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期蠕變與變形預留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term creep and movement allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
quiz.explanation: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 心牆土石壩分區填築
titleEn: Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams
summary: 本課以心牆土石壩分區填築為入口，深入心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams as its entry point, this course examines compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 達西敏感度固定平均水力坡降5與通流面積1000 m²，只將k由10⁻⁹增至2×10⁻⁹ m/s。Q=kiA由5×10⁻⁶增至10⁻⁵ m³/s，即0.005增至0.010 L/s，恰為兩倍。這要求同一均質、無裂縫材料內仍可用線性達西流；若提高流量是裂縫或繞流造成，就不能只用調整均質k來解釋。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For Darcy sensitivity, hold gradient five and flow area 1000 m² fixed, changing only k from 10⁻⁹ to 2×10⁻⁹ m/s. Q=kiA doubles from 5×10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁵ m³/s, or 0.005 to 0.010 L/s. This assumes linear Darcy flow in the same homogeneous uncracked medium; increased flow from cracking or bypass cannot be explained solely by adjusting homogeneous k.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分區滲透功能」與「含水調整與乾土質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic functions of zones" and "Moisture adjustment on dry mass": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區滲透功能」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic functions of zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。把所有區域都做得不透水，可能反而讓下游孔壓無法消散。 假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。若排水層被細料污染，孔壓會增加而不是變得更安全，必須依各區功能解讀性能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區滲透功能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. Their functions differ, and making every zone impermeable can prevent downstream pore pressures from dissipating. Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. Fines-contaminated drains can raise pressure rather than improve safety, requiring performance to be interpreted according to each zones intended function. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic functions of zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區滲透功能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic functions of zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區滲透功能
knowledge.text: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。把所有區域都做得不透水，可能反而讓下游孔壓無法消散。
knowledge.textEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. Their functions differ, and making every zone impermeable can prevent downstream pore pressures from dissipating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區滲透功能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic functions of zones" is correct?
options: 所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。
用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。
optionsEn: Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water.
Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
quiz.explanation: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區滲透功能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic functions of zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區滲透功能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic functions of zones", which statement holds?
options: 只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s。
optionsEn: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區滲透功能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic functions of zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。分別列出完整心牆流與缺陷集中流的證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate. List intact-core flow evidence separately from concentrated flow through defects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分區滲透功能編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic functions of zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區滲透功能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic functions of zones"?

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區滲透功能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic functions of zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。若排水層被細料污染，孔壓會增加而不是變得更安全，必須依各區功能解讀性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. Fines-contaminated drains can raise pressure rather than improve safety, requiring performance to be interpreted according to each zones intended function. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區滲透功能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability.
Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
