steps.title: 含水調整與乾土質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture adjustment on dry mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水調整與乾土質量」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。含水量影響壓實、滲透和施工孔壓，不能只追求最大乾密度。 假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水調整與乾土質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis. Moisture affects compaction, permeability and construction pore pressure rather than density alone. Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水調整與乾土質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture adjustment on dry mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含水調整與乾土質量
knowledge.text: 心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。含水量影響壓實、滲透和施工孔壓，不能只追求最大乾密度。
knowledge.textEn: Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis. Moisture affects compaction, permeability and construction pore pressure rather than density alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水調整與乾土質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture adjustment on dry mass" is correct?
options: 用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。
optionsEn: Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis.
quiz.explanation: 心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水調整與乾土質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture adjustment on dry mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水調整與乾土質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先由烘乾試驗核對乾土質量，再對不同深度取樣檢查混合均勻；將加水計量與天候損失閉合，並比較壓實後孔壓、強度和滲透試驗而非只有含水平均。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify dry mass by drying tests and sample several depths for mixing uniformity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水調整與乾土質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 先由烘乾試驗核對乾土質量，再對不同深度取樣檢查混合均勻；將加水計量與天候損失閉合，並比較壓實後孔壓、強度和滲透試驗而非只有含水平均。在壓實層底重新取樣檢查上濕下乾現象。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 含水調整與乾土質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture adjustment on dry mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水調整與乾土質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。
knowledge.textEn: Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水調整與乾土質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture adjustment on dry mass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean.
quiz.explanation: 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度孔隙與飽和度」與「水力劈裂與小主應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Density void ratio and saturation" and "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度孔隙與飽和度」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density void ratio and saturation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。這些相態關係能抓出不合理數據，但不能取代強度與滲透試驗。 此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度孔隙與飽和度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. Phase relations detect inconsistent data without replacing strength or permeability testing. Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81. Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density void ratio and saturation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度孔隙與飽和度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density void ratio and saturation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度
knowledge.text: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。這些相態關係能抓出不合理數據，但不能取代強度與滲透試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. Phase relations detect inconsistent data without replacing strength or permeability testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度孔隙與飽和度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density void ratio and saturation" is correct?
options: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
optionsEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度孔隙與飽和度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density void ratio and saturation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密度孔隙與飽和度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Density void ratio and saturation", which statement holds?
options: 反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.

quiz.explanationEn: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度孔隙與飽和度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density void ratio and saturation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic fracture and minor stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力劈裂與小主應力」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。簡單總應力比較只能提示敏感性，實際起裂還取決於抗拉、缺陷和應力路徑。 假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力劈裂與小主應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. A simple total-stress comparison indicates sensitivity; initiation also depends on tension resistance, defects and stress history. Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only. Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力劈裂與小主應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力劈裂與小主應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress" is correct?

心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
optionsEn: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.

quiz.explanationEn: Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion. steps.observation: 連結機制：只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水力劈裂與小主應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
quiz.explanation: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「心牆拱效應與沉降差」與「反濾保持與排水能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core arching and differential settlement" and "Filter retention and drainage capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Core arching and differential settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「心牆拱效應與沉降差」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core arching and differential settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。這有時降低心牆壓應力，不能把荷載轉移一律視為有利。 假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。若只以心牆壓力降低當作減載好處，會忽略裂縫與水力劈裂敏感性提高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「心牆拱效應與沉降差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. Reduced core compression can be unfavorable, so load transfer is not automatically beneficial. Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient. Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. Viewing reduced core stress only as beneficial unloading overlooks increased sensitivity to cracking and hydraulic fracture. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core arching and differential settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「心牆拱效應與沉降差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Core arching and differential settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差
knowledge.text: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。這有時降低心牆壓應力，不能把荷載轉移一律視為有利。
knowledge.textEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. Reduced core compression can be unfavorable, so load transfer is not automatically beneficial.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心牆拱效應與沉降差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core arching and differential settlement" is correct?
options: 心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。
optionsEn: Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways.
quiz.explanation: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core arching and differential settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「心牆拱效應與沉降差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core arching and differential settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「心牆拱效應與沉降差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core arching and differential settlement", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。
各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。
水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25.
Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core arching and differential settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「心牆拱效應與沉降差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core arching and differential settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。比較陡岸與谷底區域的應力轉移差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences. Compare stress-transfer behavior near steep abutments with the valley-center region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以心牆拱效應與沉降差編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for core arching and differential settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。比較陡岸與谷底區域的應力轉移差異。
knowledge.textEn: Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences. Compare stress-transfer behavior near steep abutments with the valley-center region.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以心牆拱效應與沉降差編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for core arching and differential settlement, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences.

quiz.question: 要驗證「心牆拱效應與沉降差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Core arching and differential settlement"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。

Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：失效診斷

quiz.question: 在「心牆拱效應與沉降差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Core arching and differential settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient.
quiz.explanation: 窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾保持與排水能力」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter retention and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。粒徑比只是初步條件，分散性土與間斷級配需要專門試驗。 假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾保持與排水能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. Grain-size ratios are preliminary checks, while dispersive soils and gap grading require dedicated testing. Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion. Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter retention and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反濾保持與排水能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter retention and drainage capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反濾保持與排水能力
knowledge.text: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。粒徑比只是初步條件，分散性土與間斷級配需要專門試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. Grain-size ratios are preliminary checks, while dispersive soils and gap grading require dedicated testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反濾保持與排水能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter retention and drainage capacity" is correct?
options: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。
optionsEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
quiz.explanation: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反濾保持與排水能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter retention and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反濾保持與排水能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter retention and drainage capacity", which statement holds?
options: 新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3。
所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
optionsEn: All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three.
Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反濾保持與排水能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter retention and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。用出水細料量判斷是否出現持續顆粒遷移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records. Use discharged-fines mass to determine whether particle migration continues over time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以反濾保持與排水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for filter retention and drainage capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。用出水細料量判斷是否出現持續顆粒遷移。
knowledge.textEn: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records. Use discharged-fines mass to determine whether particle migration continues over time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以反濾保持與排水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for filter retention and drainage capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反濾保持與排水能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter retention and drainage capacity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination.
quiz.explanation: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反濾保持與排水能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter retention and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反濾保持與排水能力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filter retention and drainage capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。
optionsEn: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
quiz.explanation: 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水帶流量與水頭」與「分區方量與邊界污染」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drain flow and hydraulic head" and "Zone volumes and boundary contamination": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水帶流量與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drain flow and hydraulic head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水帶流量與水頭」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drain flow and hydraulic head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水帶需把滲流導出而不累積高孔壓，其能力取決於滲透率、斷面和水力坡降。出水端堵塞或尾水升高也會改變系統，不能只看材料試驗k值。 假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。 高流量時粗料可能出現非達西效應，出口被淹也會降低實際坡降。若把設計名義斷面當永遠有效，會高估經沉降與細料遷移後的排水能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水帶流量與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A drain must transmit seepage without building high pore pressure. Capacity depends on permeability, area and gradient, while outlet blockage or tailwater changes the system beyond the material permeability value. Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05. Q=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s, for steady saturated Darcy flow without outlet loss. Coarse drains can become non-Darcy at high flow, and submerged outlets reduce gradients. Treating nominal section as permanently effective overstates capacity after settlement and fines migration alter the flow paths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drain flow and hydraulic head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水帶流量與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drain flow and hydraulic head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水帶流量與水頭
knowledge.text: 排水帶需把滲流導出而不累積高孔壓，其能力取決於滲透率、斷面和水力坡降。出水端堵塞或尾水升高也會改變系統，不能只看材料試驗k值。
knowledge.textEn: A drain must transmit seepage without building high pore pressure. Capacity depends on permeability, area and gradient, while outlet blockage or tailwater changes the system beyond the material permeability value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水帶流量與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drain flow and hydraulic head" is correct?
options: 排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。
排水帶需把滲流導出而不累積高孔壓，其能力取決於滲透率、斷面和水力坡降。
各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。
optionsEn: High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
A drain must transmit seepage without building high pore pressure.
Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
quiz.explanation: 排水帶需把滲流導出而不累積高孔壓，其能力取決於滲透率、斷面和水力坡降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A drain must transmit seepage without building high pore pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水帶流量與水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drain flow and hydraulic head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水帶流量與水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drain flow and hydraulic head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05. Q=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s, for steady saturated Darcy flow without outlet loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水帶流量與水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drain flow and hydraulic head", which statement holds?
options: 水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。
用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s。
optionsEn: At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.
Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設排水k=0.01 m/s、通流面積2 m²、坡降0.05，Q=kiA=0.001 m³/s=1 L/s；穩定飽和達西流，未含出口損失。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume drain k=0.01 m/s, flow area 2 m² and gradient 0.05. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水帶流量與水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drain flow and hydraulic head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水帶流量與水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drain flow and hydraulic head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。將出口淹沒情境下的有效坡降重新計算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Inspect reduced area from deformation or contamination and use several heads to test the linear Darcy assumption. Recalculate effective gradients for the scenario with a submerged drain outlet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以排水帶流量與水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain flow and hydraulic head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Inspect reduced area from deformation or contamination and use several heads to test the linear Darcy assumption.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高流量時粗料可能出現非達西效應，出口被淹也會降低實際坡降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coarse drains can become non-Darcy at high flow, and submerged outlets reduce gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.text: 以排水帶流量與水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain flow and hydraulic head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Inspect reduced area from deformation or contamination and use several heads to test the linear Darcy assumption.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水帶流量與水頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drain flow and hydraulic head"?
options: 沿排水帶量測水頭並核對出口尾水，對照集水流量和降雨；檢查通流面積是否被壓縮或污染縮小，再以不同水頭下資料確認線性達西假設是否合理。

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure heads along the drain and check outlet tailwater against collected flow and rain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水帶流量與水頭：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drain flow and hydraulic head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

Treating nominal section as permanently effective overstates capacity after settlement and fines migration alter the flow paths. quiz.question: 在「排水帶流量與水頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
