steps.title: 分區方量與邊界污染：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Zone volumes and boundary contamination: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區方量與邊界污染」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zone volumes and boundary contamination” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區填築的空間邊界維持不同材料的功能，推土機越界和運輸掉料可能造成混雜。總材料量正確不能證明反濾帶厚度或心牆連續性正確。 假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區方量與邊界污染」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Zoned placement preserves distinct material functions through spatial boundaries. Equipment crossing and spillage mix materials, so correct total quantities do not establish filter thickness or core continuity. Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Mixed bands 0.1 m wide on both sides affect 10 m³, or 3.333 percent. A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Zone volumes and boundary contamination” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區方量與邊界污染」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Zone volumes and boundary contamination”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區方量與邊界污染
knowledge.text: 分區填築的空間邊界維持不同材料的功能，推土機越界和運輸掉料可能造成混雜。總材料量正確不能證明反濾帶厚度或心牆連續性正確。
knowledge.textEn: Zoned placement preserves distinct material functions through spatial boundaries. Equipment crossing and spillage mix materials, so correct total quantities do not establish filter thickness or core continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區方量與邊界污染」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zone volumes and boundary contamination" is correct?
options: 各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。
新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
分區填築的空間邊界維持不同材料的功能，推土機越界和運輸掉料可能造成混雜。
optionsEn: Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
Zoned placement preserves distinct material functions through spatial boundaries.
quiz.explanation: 分區填築的空間邊界維持不同材料的功能，推土機越界和運輸掉料可能造成混雜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Zoned placement preserves distinct material functions through spatial boundaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區方量與邊界污染：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zone volumes and boundary contamination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區方量與邊界污染」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zone volumes and boundary contamination” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Mixed bands 0.1 m wide on both sides affect 10 m³, or 3.333 percent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Mixed bands 0.1 m wide on both sides affect 10 m³, or 3.333 percent.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區方量與邊界污染」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Zone volumes and boundary contamination", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³。
所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³.
Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層心牆長200 m、寬6 m、厚0.25 m，方量300 m³；兩側各混入0.1 m寬帶則受影響10 m³，占3.333%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core lift length 200 m, width 6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 300 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區方量與邊界污染：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zone volumes and boundary contamination: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區方量與邊界污染」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Zone volumes and boundary contamination” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。以界面剖面照片核對反濾帶連續厚度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones. Check continuous filter thickness against photographs of the actual zone interface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分區方量與邊界污染編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for zone volumes and boundary contamination, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。以界面剖面照片核對反濾帶連續厚度。
knowledge.textEn: Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones. Check continuous filter thickness against photographs of the actual zone interface.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以分區方量與邊界污染編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for zone volumes and boundary contamination, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Map crossing traffic and spillage to as-built surfaces and check continuity between successive zones.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區方量與邊界污染」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Zone volumes and boundary contamination"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
quiz.explanation: 用測量線、照片與批次標記核對每層分區位置，抽查界面粒徑而非只取中間；將跨區車行和材料外溢事件映射到收方面，確認相鄰層邊界連續。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use survey lines, photographs and batch labels to verify each lift boundary and sample interfaces rather than centers only. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區方量與邊界污染：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zone volumes and boundary contamination: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區方量與邊界污染」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zone volumes and boundary contamination” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。若只按各料區進場重量驗收，空間錯位會被總量平衡掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Acceptance based only on incoming material mass allows spatial misplacement to hide behind a correct total balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區方量與邊界污染」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zone volumes and boundary contamination" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core.
quiz.explanation: 局部混料占比小仍可能沿整條反濾帶形成堵塞，心牆被粗粒貫穿也可增加缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small mixed fraction can clog a continuous filter strip, while coarse intrusion damages the core. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工孔壓與載重速率」與「快速退水與支承改變」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction pore pressure and loading rate" and "Rapid drawdown and lost support": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工孔壓與載重速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction pore pressure and loading rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工孔壓與載重速率」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction pore pressure and loading rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快速加高會讓低滲透心牆來不及排水，新增總應力部分轉為孔壓。施工穩定必須使用相符的排水條件，不能以長期有效應力強度直接取代短期分析。 假設新增總應力100 kPa、量測孔壓增加70 kPa，該增量的有效應力增加30 kPa；以Δσ′=Δσ−Δu計，不等同整體ru。 儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工孔壓與載重速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid raising can load a low-permeability core faster than it drains, converting part of added total stress into pore pressure. Construction stability requires matching drainage conditions rather than substituting long-term behavior. Assume added total stress 100 kPa and measured pore-pressure increase 70 kPa. Effective stress increases 30 kPa by Δσ′=Δσ−Δu, not a whole-dam ru value. Slow instruments can understate true pressure peaks, while continued dissipation shows long-term conditions are not established. Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction pore pressure and loading rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新增總應力100 kPa、量測孔壓增加70 kPa，該增量的有效應力增加30 kPa；以Δσ′=Δσ−Δu計，不等同整體ru。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume added total stress 100 kPa and measured pore-pressure increase 70 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工孔壓與載重速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction pore pressure and loading rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工孔壓與載重速率
knowledge.titleEn: Construction pore pressure and loading rate
knowledge.text: 快速加高會讓低滲透心牆來不及排水，新增總應力部分轉為孔壓。施工穩定必須使用相符的排水條件，不能以長期有效應力強度直接取代短期分析。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid raising can load a low-permeability core faster than it drains, converting part of added total stress into pore pressure. Construction stability requires matching drainage conditions rather than substituting long-term behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工孔壓與載重速率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction pore pressure and loading rate" is correct?
options: 快速加高會讓低滲透心牆來不及排水，新增總應力部分轉為孔壓。
新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。
optionsEn: Rapid raising can load a low-permeability core faster than it drains, converting part of added total stress into pore pressure.
All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.
quiz.explanation: 快速加高會讓低滲透心牆來不及排水，新增總應力部分轉為孔壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid raising can load a low-permeability core faster than it drains, converting part of added total stress into pore pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工孔壓與載重速率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction pore pressure and loading rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工孔壓與載重速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction pore pressure and loading rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新增總應力100 kPa、量測孔壓增加70 kPa，該增量的有效應力增加30 kPa；以Δσ′=Δσ−Δu計，不等同整體ru。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume added total stress 100 kPa and measured pore-pressure increase 70 kPa. Effective stress increases 30 kPa by Δσ′=Δσ−Δu, not a whole-dam ru value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每層填築重量、時間與孔壓歷線對齊，分辨載重上升和停工消散；核對土壓計及孔壓計零點，並以排水距離與材料滲透性檢查反應時間合理性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align lift weight and timing with pore-pressure histories, separating loading from dissipation during pauses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction pore pressure and loading rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每層填築重量、時間與孔壓歷線對齊，分辨載重上升和停工消散；核對土壓計及孔壓計零點，並以排水距離與材料滲透性檢查反應時間合理性。比對停工後孔壓消散曲線與施工載重紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction pore pressure and loading rate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check pressure-instrument zeros and assess response time using drainage distance and material permeability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工孔壓與載重速率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 施工孔壓與載重速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction pore pressure and loading rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工孔壓與載重速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction pore pressure and loading rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow instruments can understate true pressure peaks, while continued dissipation shows long-term conditions are not established. Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 儀器反應遲緩可能低估真正孔壓峰值，停工後仍在消散則說明長期狀態尚未建立。若把總應力增加全部當有效壓密，會高估即時抗剪能力。
knowledge.textEn: Slow instruments can understate true pressure peaks, while continued dissipation shows long-term conditions are not established. Treating all added total stress as effective compression overstates immediate shear resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工孔壓與載重速率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.

steps.title: 快速退水與支承改變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rapid drawdown and lost support: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快速退水與支承改變」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rapid drawdown and lost support” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 退水移除上游水體支承，但心牆與坡體孔壓可能來不及下降。外部水位低不代表內部已排水，穩定分析需使用時間相關的孔壓場。 假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速退水與支承改變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drawdown removes external upstream support while internal pore pressures can lag. Low reservoir level does not establish drained soil, so stability requires a time-dependent internal pressure field. Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa. Assuming pressure already fell to 40 kPa gives 140 kPa, an overestimate by factor 2.333. Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rapid drawdown and lost support” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快速退水與支承改變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rapid drawdown and lost support”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快速退水與支承改變

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

退水移除上游水體支承，但心牆與坡體孔壓可能來不及下降。

optionsEn: At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.

Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa. Assuming pressure already fell to 40 kPa gives 140 kPa, an overestimate by factor 2.333.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快速退水與支承改變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rapid drawdown and lost support", which statement holds?
options: 乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa。
optionsEn: Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某點總正應力180 kPa、退水後孔壓仍120 kPa，有效60 kPa；若誤假設孔壓已降40 kPa，會估140 kPa，高估2.333倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total normal stress 180 kPa and retained pore pressure 120 kPa, giving effective stress 60 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 快速退水與支承改變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rapid drawdown and lost support: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快速退水與支承改變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rapid drawdown and lost support” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。把外水支承消失與內部孔壓消散分別建模。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity. Model loss of external water support separately from internal pressure dissipation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以快速退水與支承改變編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rapid drawdown and lost support, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。把外水支承消失與內部孔壓消散分別建模。
knowledge.textEn: Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity. Model loss of external water support separately from internal pressure dissipation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以快速退水與支承改變編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rapid drawdown and lost support, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Reconstruct external support and internal pressure at the same instant and test drainage-rate and strength sensitivity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「快速退水與支承改變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rapid drawdown and lost support"?
options: 比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
排水料滲透係數很高就保證任何出口條件下都能充分排水。
optionsEn: Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
quiz.explanation: 比較水庫退水率與坡內各深度孔壓消散，確認量測點涵蓋可能滑面；用同一時間截面重建外水支承與內部壓力，並對排水速度和土體強度做敏感度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare reservoir drawdown with pore-pressure dissipation at several depths and cover plausible slip surfaces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 快速退水與支承改變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rapid drawdown and lost support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速退水與支承改變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rapid drawdown and lost support” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。慢速表面排水不能代表深部弱層同樣迅速排水。
knowledge.textEn: Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Surface drainage does not establish equally rapid drainage in deep weak layers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快速退水與支承改變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rapid drawdown and lost support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。
所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic.
Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
quiz.explanation: 把退水後的最低庫位配上早已消散的孔壓會形成不真實荷載組合，忽略外水支承消失又會偏樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Combining minimum reservoir level with fully dissipated pressures can create an unrealistic load case, while retaining lost external support is optimistic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工
summary: 本課以瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工為入口，深入瀝青心牆的溫度依存、孔隙控制與界面變形。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction as its entry point, this course examines temperature dependence, void control and interface deformation in asphalt cores. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每100 kg礦料加入6 kg瀝青，按礦料為6%，按總重為6/106=5.6604%；僅分母換算，不是建議配比。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理論最大密度2500 kg/m³、實測體積密度2450 kg/m³，空隙率1−2450/2500=2%；非任何專案接受上限。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 空隙率敏感度固定理論最大密度2500 kg/m³，只將體積密度2450提高至2475 kg/m³。空隙率100(1−ρb/ρmax)由2%降至1%，是降低1個百分點而非降低1%。比較假定材料組成和測定方法不變；它不設定施工壓實目標，也未據此證明瀝青心牆的抗滲或低溫變形性能。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume six kilograms of bitumen per hundred kilograms of mineral material. Content is six percent of mineral mass but 5.6604 percent of total mass, a denominator conversion rather than a recommended mix. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume theoretical maximum density 2500 kg/m³ and measured bulk density 2450 kg/m³. Air void content is two percent, not a project acceptance limit. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold theoretical maximum density at 2500 kg/m³ and change only bulk density from 2450 to 2475 kg/m³. Air-void content 100(1−ρb/ρmax) drops from 2% to 1%, one percentage point rather than a 1% relative decrease. Composition and measurement method remain fixed. This comparison neither sets a compaction target nor establishes permeability or cold-temperature deformation performance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「膠結料比例基準」與「體積孔隙與連通性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Binder proportion basis" and "Air voids and connectivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 膠結料比例基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder proportion basis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結料比例基準」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder proportion basis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瀝青含量可按礦料重量或混合料總重量表示，兩種百分比不能直接比較。配方必須先確認分母，再連結骨材表面覆蓋與孔隙填充，不能把道路配方直接移植到壩心牆。 假設每100 kg礦料加入6 kg瀝青，按礦料為6%，按總重為6/106=5.6604%；僅分母換算，不是建議配比。 把礦料百分比當總重百分比會系統性多加膠結料，反向誤用則可能缺料。即使含量相同，不同骨材形狀和細粉也會改變工作性與體積孔隙。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結料比例基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bitumen content may use mineral mass or total mixture mass as denominator, making the percentages noninterchangeable. Mixture interpretation must establish the basis before relating coating and void filling, rather than copying road asphalt into dam cores. Assume six kilograms of bitumen per hundred kilograms of mineral material. Content is six percent of mineral mass but 5.6604 percent of total mass, a denominator conversion rather than a recommended mix. Using a mineral-basis percentage as total-basis content systematically adds too much binder, while reversing the error underdoses it. Equal content also does not ensure equal workability or voids for different aggregates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder proportion basis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每100 kg礦料加入6 kg瀝青，按礦料為6%，按總重為6/106=5.6604%；僅分母換算，不是建議配比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume six kilograms of bitumen per hundred kilograms of mineral material.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「按礦料重量和按總混合料重量表示的瀝青百分比完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bitumen percentages based on mineral mass and total mixture mass are identical." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結料比例基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder proportion basis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 膠結料比例基準
knowledge.text: 瀝青含量可按礦料重量或混合料總重量表示，兩種百分比不能直接比較。配方必須先確認分母，再連結骨材表面覆蓋與孔隙填充，不能把道路配方直接移植到壩心牆。
knowledge.textEn: Bitumen content may use mineral mass or total mixture mass as denominator, making the percentages noninterchangeable. Mixture interpretation must establish the basis before relating coating and void filling, rather than copying road asphalt into dam cores.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：按礦料重量和按總混合料重量表示的瀝青百分比完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bitumen percentages based on mineral mass and total mixture mass are identical. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結料比例基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder proportion basis" is correct?

瀝青含量可按礦料重量或混合料總重量表示，兩種百分比不能直接比較。

optionsEn: Bitumen percentages based on mineral mass and total mixture mass are identical.

Low total void content proves that no connected leakage path exists in the core.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder proportion basis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每100 kg礦料加入6 kg瀝青，按礦料為6%，按總重為6/106=5.6604%；僅分母換算，不是建議配比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume six kilograms of bitumen per hundred kilograms of mineral material. Content is six percent of mineral mass but 5.6604 percent of total mass, a denominator conversion rather than a recommended mix. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check denominator definitions in batch records, extraction tests and reports and recalculate both fractions for one sample.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 核對拌合紀錄、萃取試驗和報表的分母定義，用同一批樣品重算兩種比例；另查含水或細粉是否計入礦料重量，將配方版本和批次標籤一併保存以便追溯。核對空容器皮重。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 膠結料比例基準：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 把礦料百分比當總重百分比會系統性多加膠結料，反向誤用則可能缺料。即使含量相同，不同骨材形狀和細粉也會改變工作性與體積孔隙。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a mineral-basis percentage as total-basis content systematically adds too much binder, while reversing the error underdoses it. Equal content also does not ensure equal workability or voids for different aggregates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 體積孔隙與連通性：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「體積孔隙與連通性」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

Void percentage alone cannot distinguish construction defects from sampling-induced pathways. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air voids and connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理論最大密度2500 kg/m³、實測體積密度2450 kg/m³，空隙率1−2450/2500=2%；非任何專案接受上限。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume theoretical maximum density 2500 kg/m³ and measured bulk density 2450 kg/m³. Air void content is two percent, not a project acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體積孔隙與連通性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Air voids and connectivity", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理論最大密度2500 kg/m³、實測體積密度2450 kg/m³，空隙率1−2450/2500=2%。
其他位置多鋪材料就能補償任何局部心牆寬度不足。
只要平均接觸壓力大於水壓，接頭就不可能存在漏流。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume theoretical maximum density 2500 kg/m³ and measured bulk density 2450 kg/m³.
Extra material elsewhere compensates for every local deficiency in core width.
Mean contact pressure above water pressure makes leakage through the connection impossible.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設理論最大密度2500 kg/m³、實測體積密度2450 kg/m³，空隙率1−2450/2500=2%；非任何專案接受上限。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume theoretical maximum density 2500 kg/m³ and measured bulk density 2450 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 體積孔隙與連通性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Air voids and connectivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「體積孔隙與連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air voids and connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method. Pair permeability tests with void imaging and determine whether whole-specimen density conceals a local interlift defect or connected path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以體積孔隙與連通性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air voids and connectivity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method. Pair permeability tests with void imaging and determine whether whole-specimen density conceals a local interlift defect or connected path.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少量連通孔隙可能比較多封閉孔隙更影響漏流，取芯損傷又可能製造人工裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small connected void fraction can transmit more flow than many isolated voids, and coring damage can create artificial cracks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method. Pair permeability tests with void imaging and determine whether whole-specimen density conceals a local interlift defect or connected path.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以體積孔隙與連通性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air voids and connectivity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method. Pair permeability tests with void imaging and determine whether whole-specimen density conceals a local interlift defect or connected path.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體積孔隙與連通性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air voids and connectivity"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。
連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method.
Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free.
quiz.explanation: 對同配比樣品核對理論與實測密度，記錄取芯位置、溫度和體積量法；將滲透試驗與孔隙影像配對，檢查局部層間缺陷是否被全試體平均密度掩蓋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check theoretical and measured densities for the same mixture, recording core position, temperature and volume method. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體積孔隙與連通性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air voids and connectivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「體積孔隙與連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air voids and connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少量連通孔隙可能比較多封閉孔隙更影響漏流，取芯損傷又可能製造人工裂縫。只看空隙百分比，無法分辨施工缺陷與取樣過程造成的通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small connected void fraction can transmit more flow than many isolated voids, and coring damage can create artificial cracks. Void percentage alone cannot distinguish construction defects from sampling-induced pathways. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看空隙百分比，無法分辨施工缺陷與取樣過程造成的通道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Void percentage alone cannot distinguish construction defects from sampling-induced pathways.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總孔隙率很低就能證明心牆不存在任何連通漏水通道。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low total void content proves that no connected leakage path exists in the core." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少量連通孔隙可能比較多封閉孔隙更影響漏流，取芯損傷又可能製造人工裂縫。只看空隙百分比，無法分辨施工缺陷與取樣過程造成的通道。
knowledge.textEn: A small connected void fraction can transmit more flow than many isolated voids, and coring damage can create artificial cracks. Void percentage alone cannot distinguish construction defects from sampling-induced pathways.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體積孔隙與連通性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air voids and connectivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
短時間試驗得到的瀝青模數可以直接代表所有長期載重。
少量連通孔隙可能比較多封閉孔隙更影響漏流，取芯損傷又可能製造人工裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions.
A small connected void fraction can transmit more flow than many isolated voids, and coring damage can create artificial cracks.
quiz.explanation: 少量連通孔隙可能比較多封閉孔隙更影響漏流，取芯損傷又可能製造人工裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small connected void fraction can transmit more flow than many isolated voids, and coring damage can create artificial cracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」與「熱收縮與相鄰材料」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Viscoelastic lag and loading time" and "Thermal contraction and neighboring materials": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏彈遲滯與載重時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Viscoelastic lag and loading time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Viscoelastic lag and loading time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瀝青混凝土的應變會隨載重時間與溫度發展，短時剛度不能直接代表長期變形。黏彈類比適合說明延遲反應，參數需由對應溫度和應力範圍試驗取得。 假設Kelvin-Voigt模型E=100 MPa、η=10⁹ Pa·s、恆應力0.1 MPa，時間常數10 s，t=20 s應變0.0008647；純教學小應變。 單一黏彈元件無法描述所有塑性與損傷，卸載殘餘應變可能超出模型。若把一個溫度下的模數永久固定，會錯估施工熱態與服役冷態的差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asphalt-concrete strain develops with loading duration and temperature, so short-term stiffness does not represent long-term movement. A viscoelastic analogy illustrates delayed response but needs parameters tested at relevant temperatures and stresses. Assume Kelvin-Voigt E=100 MPa, η=10⁹ Pa·s and constant stress 0.1 MPa. Time constant is ten seconds and strain at twenty seconds is 0.0008647, a small-strain teaching model. One viscoelastic element cannot describe every plastic or damage mechanism, and residual strain may exceed it. Fixing modulus from one temperature misrepresents differences between warm construction and cool service conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Viscoelastic lag and loading time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Kelvin-Voigt模型E=100 MPa、η=10⁹ Pa·s、恆應力0.1 MPa，時間常數10 s，t=20 s應變0.0008647；純教學小應變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Kelvin-Voigt E=100 MPa, η=10⁹ Pa·s and constant stress 0.1 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「短時間試驗得到的瀝青模數可以直接代表所有長期載重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Viscoelastic lag and loading time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏彈遲滯與載重時間
knowledge.text: 瀝青混凝土的應變會隨載重時間與溫度發展，短時剛度不能直接代表長期變形。黏彈類比適合說明延遲反應，參數需由對應溫度和應力範圍試驗取得。
knowledge.textEn: Asphalt-concrete strain develops with loading duration and temperature, so short-term stiffness does not represent long-term movement. A viscoelastic analogy illustrates delayed response but needs parameters tested at relevant temperatures and stresses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：短時間試驗得到的瀝青模數可以直接代表所有長期載重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Viscoelastic lag and loading time" is correct?
options: 瀝青混凝土的應變會隨載重時間與溫度發展，短時剛度不能直接代表長期變形。
短時間試驗得到的瀝青模數可以直接代表所有長期載重。
自由熱收縮量就是心牆接頭實際必然張開的寬度。
optionsEn: Asphalt-concrete strain develops with loading duration and temperature, so short-term stiffness does not represent long-term movement.
A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions.
Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection.
quiz.explanation: 瀝青混凝土的應變會隨載重時間與溫度發展，短時剛度不能直接代表長期變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Asphalt-concrete strain develops with loading duration and temperature, so short-term stiffness does not represent long-term movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 黏彈遲滯與載重時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Viscoelastic lag and loading time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Viscoelastic lag and loading time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Kelvin-Voigt模型E=100 MPa、η=10⁹ Pa·s、恆應力0.1 MPa，時間常數10 s，t=20 s應變0.0008647；純教學小應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Kelvin-Voigt E=100 MPa, η=10⁹ Pa·s and constant stress 0.1 MPa. Time constant is ten seconds and strain at twenty seconds is 0.0008647, a small-strain teaching model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多個載重持續時間量測蠕變和卸載回復，核對模型是否同時描述兩段；將試驗溫度、應變速率和圍壓寫在參數旁邊，另用未參與擬合的歷程驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure creep and unloading recovery over several durations and test whether one model fits both.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設Kelvin-Voigt模型E=100 MPa、η=10⁹ Pa·s、恆應力0.1 MPa，時間常數10 s，t=20 s應變0.0008647；純教學小應變。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume Kelvin-Voigt E=100 MPa, η=10⁹ Pa·s and constant stress 0.1 MPa. Time constant is ten seconds and strain at twenty seconds is 0.0008647, a small-strain teaching model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「黏彈遲滯與載重時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 以多個載重持續時間量測蠕變和卸載回復，核對模型是否同時描述兩段；將試驗溫度、應變速率和圍壓寫在參數旁邊，另用未參與擬合的歷程驗證。再查卸載回復曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure creep and unloading recovery over several durations and test whether one model fits both. steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Viscoelastic lag and loading time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一黏彈元件無法描述所有塑性與損傷，卸載殘餘應變可能超出模型。若把一個溫度下的模數永久固定，會錯估施工熱態與服役冷態的差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One viscoelastic element cannot describe every plastic or damage mechanism, and residual strain may exceed it. Fixing modulus from one temperature misrepresents differences between warm construction and cool service conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短時間試驗得到的瀝青模數可以直接代表所有長期載重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 熱收縮與相鄰材料：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and neighboring materials: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱收縮與相鄰材料」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal contraction and neighboring materials” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瀝青心牆冷卻時會收縮，而兩側過渡料限制其自由變形。變形相容與黏結同樣重要，不能只看心牆材料自身能承受多大拉應變。 假設有效長10 m、熱膨脹係數15×10⁻⁶/K、降溫20 K，自由收縮3 mm；材料係數為假設，不含黏彈鬆弛與拘束。 局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。若直接用彈性拘束公式跨越整個溫度範圍，可能誇大或低估真正的接縫需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱收縮與相鄰材料」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling contracts the asphalt core while transition material restrains free movement. Compatibility and bonding matter alongside the material tensile strain capacity, especially where geometry changes or the core meets concrete. Assume length 10 m, expansion coefficient 15×10⁻⁶/K and cooling twenty kelvin. Free contraction is 3 mm, with assumed coefficient and no viscoelastic relaxation or restraint. Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress. Applying one elastic restraint formula across the whole temperature range can either exaggerate or understate actual joint demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal contraction and neighboring materials” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效長10 m、熱膨脹係數15×10⁻⁶/K、降溫20 K，自由收縮3 mm；材料係數為假設，不含黏彈鬆弛與拘束。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume length 10 m, expansion coefficient 15×10⁻⁶/K and cooling twenty kelvin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由熱收縮量就是心牆接頭實際必然張開的寬度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱收縮與相鄰材料」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal contraction and neighboring materials”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

optionsEn: Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection.
Cooling contracts the asphalt core while transition material restrains free movement.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱收縮與相鄰材料」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效長10 m、熱膨脹係數15×10⁻⁶/K、降溫20 K，自由收縮3 mm；材料係數為假設，不含黏彈鬆弛與拘束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume length 10 m, expansion coefficient 15×10⁻⁶/K and cooling twenty kelvin. Free contraction is 3 mm, with assumed coefficient and no viscoelastic relaxation or restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄心牆與過渡料溫度和位移，以同時刻差值檢查相容；核對混合料熱性質試驗，再比較趾板接頭附近與壩中央區域的變形，確認自由收縮並未誤當實際張開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record core and transition temperatures and movements together and assess compatibility at matching times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal contraction and neighboring materials” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄心牆與過渡料溫度和位移，以同時刻差值檢查相容；核對混合料熱性質試驗，再比較趾板接頭附近與壩中央區域的變形，確認自由收縮並未誤當實際張開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record core and transition temperatures and movements together and assess compatibility at matching times. Check mixture thermal tests and compare plinth-adjacent and central zones, ensuring free contraction is not mistaken for actual joint opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以熱收縮與相鄰材料編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步記錄心牆與過渡料溫度和位移，以同時刻差值檢查相容；核對混合料熱性質試驗，再比較趾板接頭附近與壩中央區域的變形，確認自由收縮並未誤當實際張開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thermal contraction and neighboring materials, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record core and transition temperatures and movements together and assess compatibility at matching times. Check mixture thermal tests and compare plinth-adjacent and central zones, ensuring free contraction is not mistaken for actual joint opening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱收縮與相鄰材料」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal contraction and neighboring materials"?
options: 同步記錄心牆與過渡料溫度和位移，以同時刻差值檢查相容；核對混合料熱性質試驗，再比較趾板接頭附近與壩中央區域的變形，確認自由收縮並未誤當實際張開。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
按礦料重量和按總混合料重量表示的瀝青百分比完全相同。
optionsEn: Record core and transition temperatures and movements together and assess compatibility at matching times.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Bitumen percentages based on mineral mass and total mixture mass are identical.
