quiz.explanationEn: Record core and transition temperatures and movements together and assess compatibility at matching times. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱收縮與相鄰材料：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and neighboring materials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱收縮與相鄰材料」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal contraction and neighboring materials” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。若直接用彈性拘束公式跨越整個溫度範圍，可能誇大或低估真正的接縫需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress. Applying one elastic restraint formula across the whole temperature range can either exaggerate or understate actual joint demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若直接用彈性拘束公式跨越整個溫度範圍，可能誇大或低估真正的接縫需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Applying one elastic restraint formula across the whole temperature range can either exaggerate or understate actual joint demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由熱收縮量就是心牆接頭實際必然張開的寬度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。若直接用彈性拘束公式跨越整個溫度範圍，可能誇大或低估真正的接縫需求。
knowledge.textEn: Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress. Applying one elastic restraint formula across the whole temperature range can either exaggerate or understate actual joint demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱收縮與相鄰材料」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal contraction and neighboring materials" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。
其他位置多鋪材料就能補償任何局部心牆寬度不足。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress.
Extra material elsewhere compensates for every local deficiency in core width.
quiz.explanation: 局部快速冷卻可能產生集中拉伸，而高溫黏性又會讓應力鬆弛。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local rapid cooling concentrates tension, while warm viscous behavior relaxes stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄層供料與寬度」與「層間黏結與剪切」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lift supply and core width" and "Interlift bond and shear": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄層供料與寬度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lift supply and core width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄層供料與寬度」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lift supply and core width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆體積遠小於壩殼，但必須與過渡區同步上升，否則缺乏側向支承或造成施工等待。寬度連續性比每日總方量更能反映防滲屏障是否完整。 假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³；若寬度局部少0.05 m持續20 m，缺量0.25 m³，不能靠別處超寬抵銷。 材料側向擠入過渡料可使表面寬度看似足夠但有效核心變薄，局部冷料團也會破壞連續性。把整層平均寬度當最小厚度，會漏掉控制滲流的窄點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄層供料與寬度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core volume is small relative to the shells but must rise compatibly with transitions to preserve support and avoid waiting. Width continuity reveals sealing integrity better than daily total material output alone. Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³. A 0.05 m width deficit over 20 m loses 0.25 m³ and is not offset by excess elsewhere. Lateral intrusion into transition material can mask a thinner effective core, while cold clumps disrupt continuity. Treating mean width as minimum thickness misses narrow sections controlling seepage performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lift supply and core width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³；若寬度局部少0.05 m持續20 m，缺量0.25 m³，不能靠別處超寬抵銷。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「其他位置多鋪材料就能補償任何局部心牆寬度不足。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Extra material elsewhere compensates for every local deficiency in core width." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄層供料與寬度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lift supply and core width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄層供料與寬度
knowledge.text: 心牆體積遠小於壩殼，但必須與過渡區同步上升，否則缺乏側向支承或造成施工等待。寬度連續性比每日總方量更能反映防滲屏障是否完整。
knowledge.textEn: Core volume is small relative to the shells but must rise compatibly with transitions to preserve support and avoid waiting. Width continuity reveals sealing integrity better than daily total material output alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：其他位置多鋪材料就能補償任何局部心牆寬度不足。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Extra material elsewhere compensates for every local deficiency in core width. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄層供料與寬度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lift supply and core width" is correct?
options: 其他位置多鋪材料就能補償任何局部心牆寬度不足。
瀝青材料具有延性就能保證所有施工層面完全黏結。
心牆體積遠小於壩殼，但必須與過渡區同步上升，否則缺乏側向支承或造成施工等待。
optionsEn: Extra material elsewhere compensates for every local deficiency in core width.
Ductile asphalt material guarantees complete bonding at every construction interface.
Core volume is small relative to the shells but must rise compatibly with transitions to preserve support and avoid waiting.
quiz.explanation: 心牆體積遠小於壩殼，但必須與過渡區同步上升，否則缺乏側向支承或造成施工等待。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Core volume is small relative to the shells but must rise compatibly with transitions to preserve support and avoid waiting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄層供料與寬度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lift supply and core width: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄層供料與寬度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lift supply and core width” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³；若寬度局部少0.05 m持續20 m，缺量0.25 m³，不能靠別處超寬抵銷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³. A 0.05 m width deficit over 20 m loses 0.25 m³ and is not offset by excess elsewhere. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段量測壓實後心牆寬度與中心線，將進料和過渡區高度對照；用位置化方量查出局部窄段，並保存每層熱態與冷態量測差異，避免只依供料清單驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure compacted width and centerline by segment and compare delivery with transition height.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³；若寬度局部少0.05 m持續20 m，缺量0.25 m³，不能靠別處超寬抵銷。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³. A 0.05 m width deficit over 20 m loses 0.25 m³ and is not offset by excess elsewhere.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄層供料與寬度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lift supply and core width", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³。
相對位移除以任意過渡層厚度就能得到精確局部剪應變。
老化後模數提高就表示心牆密封能力與延性必定一起提高。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³.
Relative movement divided by any chosen transition thickness gives exact local shear strain.
An ageing-related modulus increase necessarily improves both core sealing and ductility.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一層長200 m、寬0.6 m、厚0.25 m，材料體積30 m³；若寬度局部少0.05 m持續20 m，缺量0.25 m³，不能靠別處超寬抵銷。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume lift length 200 m, width 0.6 m and thickness 0.25 m, giving 30 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄層供料與寬度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift supply and core width: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄層供料與寬度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lift supply and core width” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段量測壓實後心牆寬度與中心線，將進料和過渡區高度對照；用位置化方量查出局部窄段，並保存每層熱態與冷態量測差異，避免只依供料清單驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure compacted width and centerline by segment and compare delivery with transition height. Use spatial volume accounting to locate narrow sections, retaining warm and cooled dimensions rather than accepting the lift from delivery totals alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以薄層供料與寬度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐段量測壓實後心牆寬度與中心線，將進料和過渡區高度對照；用位置化方量查出局部窄段，並保存每層熱態與冷態量測差異，避免只依供料清單驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for lift supply and core width, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interlift bond and shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瀝青層之間的黏結受表面潔淨、熱歷程和壓實影響，整體材料延性不能補救未黏結界面。接縫試驗需保留載重方向與溫度條件。 假設接縫試體剪力峰值12 kN、面積0.02 m²，名義剪應力0.6 MPa；不含應力集中且只代表該溫度速率下試驗。 試體可能在完整材料先破壞而無法量得真正接縫能力，也可能因取芯熱損傷改變結果。若只報最大剪力不記錄破壞面，便無法判讀層間品質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層間黏結與剪切」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asphalt interlift bonding depends on cleanliness, thermal history and compaction. Bulk ductility cannot repair an unbonded interface, and joint tests must preserve loading direction and temperature conditions. Assume joint specimen peak shear 12 kN over 0.02 m². Nominal shear stress is 0.6 MPa, excluding concentration and applying only at the tested temperature and rate. Failure in intact material may prevent measuring joint capacity, while coring heat can alter results. Reporting peak force without the failure surface leaves the interlift quality interpretation incomplete and potentially misleading. 把跨層芯樣與同層完整樣配對試驗，記錄破壞是在界面還是材料內；核對表面污染和溫度紀錄，再以滲透與顯微觀察確認剪力合格沒有掩蓋局部未黏結區。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A short-duration asphalt modulus directly represents all long-term loading conditions.
Pair interface-crossing cores with intact specimens and record whether failure occurs at the joint or within material.
quiz.explanation: 把跨層芯樣與同層完整樣配對試驗，記錄破壞是在界面還是材料內；核對表面污染和溫度紀錄，再以滲透與顯微觀察確認剪力合格沒有掩蓋局部未黏結區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair interface-crossing cores with intact specimens and record whether failure occurs at the joint or within material. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 層間黏結與剪切：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interlift bond and shear: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「層間黏結與剪切」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interlift bond and shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試體可能在完整材料先破壞而無法量得真正接縫能力，也可能因取芯熱損傷改變結果。若只報最大剪力不記錄破壞面，便無法判讀層間品質。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Failure in intact material may prevent measuring joint capacity, while coring heat can alter results. Reporting peak force without the failure surface leaves the interlift quality interpretation incomplete and potentially misleading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只報最大剪力不記錄破壞面，便無法判讀層間品質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting peak force without the failure surface leaves the interlift quality interpretation incomplete and potentially misleading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「瀝青材料具有延性就能保證所有施工層面完全黏結。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ductile asphalt material guarantees complete bonding at every construction interface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試體可能在完整材料先破壞而無法量得真正接縫能力，也可能因取芯熱損傷改變結果。若只報最大剪力不記錄破壞面，便無法判讀層間品質。
knowledge.textEn: Failure in intact material may prevent measuring joint capacity, while coring heat can alter results. Reporting peak force without the failure surface leaves the interlift quality interpretation incomplete and potentially misleading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層間黏結與剪切」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interlift bond and shear" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 試體可能在完整材料先破壞而無法量得真正接縫能力，也可能因取芯熱損傷改變結果。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要平均接觸壓力大於水壓，接頭就不可能存在漏流。
optionsEn: Failure in intact material may prevent measuring joint capacity, while coring heat can alter results.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Mean contact pressure above water pressure makes leakage through the connection impossible.
quiz.explanation: 試體可能在完整材料先破壞而無法量得真正接縫能力，也可能因取芯熱損傷改變結果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Failure in intact material may prevent measuring joint capacity, while coring heat can alter results. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「趾板接觸與有效壓力」與「過渡區剪應變相容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Plinth contact and effective pressure" and "Transition-zone shear compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 趾板接觸與有效壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plinth contact and effective pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「趾板接觸與有效壓力」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plinth contact and effective pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆與混凝土趾板需要在變形下維持密封，接觸壓力和水壓之差影響張開傾向。幾何粗糙、黏結與黏彈行為使此差值只能作初步指標。 假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa；若變形降低接觸壓力100 kPa，差為−20 kPa，不直接判定必然失效。 接觸壓力下降可能只在小區域發生，平均土壓計會漏掉；黏結損傷也可在仍受壓時形成優先通道。單一壓差不能代表接頭完整的密封狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「趾板接觸與有效壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The core-plinth connection must remain sealed during deformation. Contact compression minus water pressure indicates opening tendency, but roughness, bond and viscoelastic behavior make it only a preliminary measure. Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa. A hundred-kPa reduction gives −20 kPa, without directly declaring inevitable failure. Loss of compression can be localized and missed by averaged pressure measurements, while damaged bond can create paths even under compression. One pressure difference cannot establish the complete sealing condition of the connection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plinth contact and effective pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa；若變形降低接觸壓力100 kPa，差為−20 kPa，不直接判定必然失效。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均接觸壓力大於水壓，接頭就不可能存在漏流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean contact pressure above water pressure makes leakage through the connection impossible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「趾板接觸與有效壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Plinth contact and effective pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 趾板接觸與有效壓力
knowledge.text: 心牆與混凝土趾板需要在變形下維持密封，接觸壓力和水壓之差影響張開傾向。幾何粗糙、黏結與黏彈行為使此差值只能作初步指標。
knowledge.textEn: The core-plinth connection must remain sealed during deformation. Contact compression minus water pressure indicates opening tendency, but roughness, bond and viscoelastic behavior make it only a preliminary measure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均接觸壓力大於水壓，接頭就不可能存在漏流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean contact pressure above water pressure makes leakage through the connection impossible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「趾板接觸與有效壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Plinth contact and effective pressure" is correct?
options: 只要平均接觸壓力大於水壓，接頭就不可能存在漏流。
心牆與混凝土趾板需要在變形下維持密封，接觸壓力和水壓之差影響張開傾向。
相對位移除以任意過渡層厚度就能得到精確局部剪應變。
optionsEn: Mean contact pressure above water pressure makes leakage through the connection impossible.
The core-plinth connection must remain sealed during deformation.
Relative movement divided by any chosen transition thickness gives exact local shear strain.
quiz.explanation: 心牆與混凝土趾板需要在變形下維持密封，接觸壓力和水壓之差影響張開傾向。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The core-plinth connection must remain sealed during deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 趾板接觸與有效壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plinth contact and effective pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「趾板接觸與有效壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plinth contact and effective pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa；若變形降低接觸壓力100 kPa，差為−20 kPa，不直接判定必然失效。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa. A hundred-kPa reduction gives −20 kPa, without directly declaring inevitable failure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa；若變形降低接觸壓力100 kPa，差為−20 kPa，不直接判定必然失效。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa. A hundred-kPa reduction gives −20 kPa, without directly declaring inevitable failure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「趾板接觸與有效壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Plinth contact and effective pressure", which statement holds?
options: 老化後模數提高就表示心牆密封能力與延性必定一起提高。
總孔隙率很低就能證明心牆不存在任何連通漏水通道。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa。
optionsEn: An ageing-related modulus increase necessarily improves both core sealing and ductility.
Low total void content proves that no connected leakage path exists in the core.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設總接觸壓力300 kPa、接面水壓220 kPa，差80 kPa；若變形降低接觸壓力100 kPa，差為−20 kPa，不直接判定必然失效。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume contact compression 300 kPa and interface water pressure 220 kPa, leaving eighty kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 趾板接觸與有效壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Plinth contact and effective pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「趾板接觸與有效壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plinth contact and effective pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。檢查接觸面水壓是否均勻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness. Use connection-specific tests across temperatures and shear paths instead of substituting generic asphalt specimens for the actual contact geometry. Check whether interface water pressure is spatially uniform. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以趾板接觸與有效壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。檢查接觸面水壓是否均勻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for plinth contact and effective pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness. Use connection-specific tests across temperatures and shear paths instead of substituting generic asphalt specimens for the actual contact geometry. Check whether interface water pressure is spatially uniform.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸壓力下降可能只在小區域發生，平均土壓計會漏掉；黏結損傷也可在仍受壓時形成優先通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of compression can be localized and missed by averaged pressure measurements, while damaged bond can create paths even under compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。檢查接觸面水壓是否均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness. Use connection-specific tests across temperatures and shear paths instead of substituting generic asphalt specimens for the actual contact geometry. Check whether interface water pressure is spatially uniform.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以趾板接觸與有效壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。檢查接觸面水壓是否均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for plinth contact and effective pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness. Use connection-specific tests across temperatures and shear paths instead of substituting generic asphalt specimens for the actual contact geometry. Check whether interface water pressure is spatially uniform.

quiz.question: 要驗證「趾板接觸與有效壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Plinth contact and effective pressure"?
options: 核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由熱收縮量就是心牆接頭實際必然張開的寬度。
optionsEn: Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection.
quiz.explanation: 核對接面位移、壓力和漏流在同一時段的關係，檢查儀器是否代表實際接觸區；利用接頭專屬試驗比較不同溫度和剪移路徑，避免以一般瀝青試體代替接面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare interface movement, pressure and leakage over the same period and verify instrument representativeness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 趾板接觸與有效壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plinth contact and effective pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「趾板接觸與有效壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plinth contact and effective pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.title: 過渡區剪應變相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transition-zone shear compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「過渡區剪應變相容」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transition-zone shear compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆和相鄰粗粒材料沉降不同，界面會傳遞剪力並形成局部剪應變。相對位移除以代表厚度只是幾何估算，真正變形可能集中在更薄區域。 假設相對位移4 mm分布於0.5 m厚區，工程剪應變γ=0.004/0.5=0.008，即0.8%；均勻剪切假設，非容許值。 把整個過渡層厚度當剪切帶會低估局部應變，反向只用極薄帶又可能過度保守。若沒有位移分布資料，不能把任選厚度的計算稱作實測材料應變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「過渡區剪應變相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Differential settlement between core and coarse transition material transfers shear. Relative displacement divided by representative thickness is only geometric; actual deformation may localize within a much thinner band. Assume relative movement 4 mm distributed across thickness 0.5 m. Engineering shear strain is 0.008, or 0.8 percent, under uniform shear and not an allowable value. Using full transition thickness as a shear band understates local strain, while an arbitrarily thin band may be overly conservative. Without a displacement profile, the selected-width calculation is not a measured material strain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transition-zone shear compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相對位移4 mm分布於0.5 m厚區，工程剪應變γ=0.004/0.5=0.008，即0.8%；均勻剪切假設，非容許值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume relative movement 4 mm distributed across thickness 0.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相對位移除以任意過渡層厚度就能得到精確局部剪應變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Relative movement divided by any chosen transition thickness gives exact local shear strain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

optionsEn: Relative movement divided by any chosen transition thickness gives exact local shear strain.
Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free.
Differential settlement between core and coarse transition material transfers shear.

steps.title: 過渡區剪應變相容：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相對位移4 mm分布於0.5 m厚區，工程剪應變γ=0.004/0.5=0.008，即0.8%；均勻剪切假設，非容許值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume relative movement 4 mm distributed across thickness 0.5 m. Engineering shear strain is 0.008, or 0.8 percent, under uniform shear and not an allowable value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設置跨界面多個位移點辨認變形分布，對照過渡料粒徑與心牆溫度；將平均剪應變和局部最大值分開，並用相同尺度的試驗檢查是否出現界面滑移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use several displacement points across the interface to resolve deformation, comparing transition grading and core temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 在「過渡區剪應變相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transition-zone shear compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。
把整個過渡層厚度當剪切帶會低估局部應變，反向只用極薄帶又可能過度保守。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free.
Using full transition thickness as a shear band understates local strain, while an arbitrarily thin band may be overly conservative.
quiz.explanation: 把整個過渡層厚度當剪切帶會低估局部應變，反向只用極薄帶又可能過度保守。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using full transition thickness as a shear band understates local strain, while an arbitrarily thin band may be overly conservative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「品質抽樣漏檢機率」與「材料老化與保留試樣」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling and missed defects" and "Material ageing and retained specimens": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 品質抽樣漏檢機率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling and missed defects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「品質抽樣漏檢機率」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling and missed defects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽樣能提供品質證據但不能證明每處完美，漏檢機率取決於缺陷分布與樣本獨立性。沿同一路徑取樣可能高度相關，不能用樣本數誇大信心。 假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。 連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。若檢測方法本身靈敏度不足，增加相同測試次數也可能無法發現指定缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「品質抽樣漏檢機率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling supplies evidence rather than proof of perfection. Miss probability depends on defect distribution and independence, while samples along one track can be highly correlated and overstate confidence. Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample. Twenty samples all miss defects with probability 0.95²⁰=0.35849, under uniform independence and not as a sampling-plan recommendation. Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects. Limited detection sensitivity may persist even after repeating the same test many times. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling and missed defects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「品質抽樣漏檢機率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling and missed defects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 品質抽樣漏檢機率
knowledge.text: 抽樣能提供品質證據但不能證明每處完美，漏檢機率取決於缺陷分布與樣本獨立性。沿同一路徑取樣可能高度相關，不能用樣本數誇大信心。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling supplies evidence rather than proof of perfection. Miss probability depends on defect distribution and independence, while samples along one track can be highly correlated and overstate confidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「品質抽樣漏檢機率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sampling and missed defects" is correct?
options: 抽樣能提供品質證據但不能證明每處完美，漏檢機率取決於缺陷分布與樣本獨立性。
連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。
老化後模數提高就表示心牆密封能力與延性必定一起提高。
optionsEn: Sampling supplies evidence rather than proof of perfection.
Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free.
An ageing-related modulus increase necessarily improves both core sealing and ductility.
quiz.explanation: 抽樣能提供品質證據但不能證明每處完美，漏檢機率取決於缺陷分布與樣本獨立性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling supplies evidence rather than proof of perfection. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 品質抽樣漏檢機率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling and missed defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「品質抽樣漏檢機率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling and missed defects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample. Twenty samples all miss defects with probability 0.95²⁰=0.35849, under uniform independence and not as a sampling-plan recommendation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample. Twenty samples all miss defects with probability 0.95²⁰=0.35849, under uniform independence and not as a sampling-plan recommendation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「品質抽樣漏檢機率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sampling and missed defects", which statement holds?
options: 總孔隙率很低就能證明心牆不存在任何連通漏水通道。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。
自由熱收縮量就是心牆接頭實際必然張開的寬度。
optionsEn: Low total void content proves that no connected leakage path exists in the core.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample.
Free thermal contraction is exactly the opening that must occur at the core connection.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每個獨立樣本遇缺陷機率0.05，取20個仍全未遇到的機率0.95²⁰=0.35849；僅獨立均勻假設，不是抽樣計畫建議。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent defect probability 0.05 per sample. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 品質抽樣漏檢機率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling and missed defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「品質抽樣漏檢機率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling and missed defects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。另畫空間聚集分布圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies. Analyze random sampling separately from targeted defect checks and explain how spatial correlation reduces the effective number of independent observations. Also map spatial clustering of possible defects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以品質抽樣漏檢機率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。另畫空間聚集分布圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sampling and missed defects, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies. Analyze random sampling separately from targeted defect checks and explain how spatial correlation reduces the effective number of independent observations. Also map spatial clustering of possible defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。另畫空間聚集分布圖。
knowledge.textEn: Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies. Analyze random sampling separately from targeted defect checks and explain how spatial correlation reduces the effective number of independent observations. Also map spatial clustering of possible defects.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以品質抽樣漏檢機率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。另畫空間聚集分布圖。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sampling and missed defects, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies. Analyze random sampling separately from targeted defect checks and explain how spatial correlation reduces the effective number of independent observations. Also map spatial clustering of possible defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「品質抽樣漏檢機率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling and missed defects"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
瀝青材料具有延性就能保證所有施工層面完全黏結。
把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Ductile asphalt material guarantees complete bonding at every construction interface.
Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies.
quiz.explanation: 把樣本分布畫到每層平面，核對是否涵蓋接縫、窄段和熱歷程異常區；將隨機樣本與針對性缺陷檢查分開統計，並說明空間相關會如何降低有效樣本數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map sample coverage on every lift and include joints, narrow sections and thermal anomalies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 品質抽樣漏檢機率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling and missed defects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「品質抽樣漏檢機率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling and missed defects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。若檢測方法本身靈敏度不足，增加相同測試次數也可能無法發現指定缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects. Limited detection sensitivity may persist even after repeating the same test many times. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若檢測方法本身靈敏度不足，增加相同測試次數也可能無法發現指定缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Limited detection sensitivity may persist even after repeating the same test many times.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「連續二十個樣本沒有缺陷就能證明整個心牆完全無缺陷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Twenty defect-free samples prove that the entire asphalt core is completely defect-free." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。若檢測方法本身靈敏度不足，增加相同測試次數也可能無法發現指定缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects. Limited detection sensitivity may persist even after repeating the same test many times.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「品質抽樣漏檢機率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling and missed defects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
老化後模數提高就表示心牆密封能力與延性必定一起提高。
optionsEn: Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An ageing-related modulus increase necessarily improves both core sealing and ductility.
quiz.explanation: 連續缺陷帶可被集中取樣完全避開，零缺陷樣本不等於零缺陷工程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clustered samples can entirely avoid a continuous defect band, so zero observed defects do not establish zero actual defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 材料老化與保留試樣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material ageing and retained specimens: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料老化與保留試樣」如何影響瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material ageing and retained specimens” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瀝青材料隨熱氧化與時間改變，硬化可能提高短時剛度卻降低延性。比較需使用相同試驗溫度和速率，不能把較高強度自動解讀為更好密封能力。 假設相同試驗條件下模數由120升到180 MPa，剛度比1.5；同時破壞應變由0.04降0.025，降低37.5%，不代表真實老化速率。 保留試樣的氧氣暴露可能與深埋心牆不同，不能直接把其老化年限當現地壽命。若只檢查峰值強度，延性降低與界面脆化可能被視為性能改善而漏判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料老化與保留試樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asphalt changes with thermal oxidation and time. Hardening can raise short-term stiffness while reducing ductility, requiring comparisons at equal temperature and rate rather than treating higher strength as automatically better sealing. Assume modulus rises from 120 to 180 MPa under matched tests, a ratio 1.5, while failure strain falls from 0.04 to 0.025, a 37.5 percent reduction, not an actual ageing rate. Retained specimens may see different oxygen exposure from a buried core, preventing direct conversion to service life. Peak strength alone can make reduced ductility and interface embrittlement appear to be improved performance. steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume modulus rises from 120 to 180 MPa under matched tests, a ratio 1.5, while failure strain falls from 0.04 to 0.025, a 37.5 percent reduction, not an actual ageing rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以保留試樣和取芯建立同條件比較，核對儲存環境、試驗溫度和載重速率；同時報告剛度、延性與滲透，並檢查差異來自材料老化還是不同取樣位置與壓實程度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare retained and field-cored specimens under matched conditions, checking storage, test temperature and loading rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以保留試樣和取芯建立同條件比較，核對儲存環境、試驗溫度和載重速率；同時報告剛度、延性與滲透，並檢查差異來自材料老化還是不同取樣位置與壓實程度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare retained and field-cored specimens under matched conditions, checking storage, test temperature and loading rate. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for material ageing and retained specimens, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare retained and field-cored specimens under matched conditions, checking storage, test temperature and loading rate. Report stiffness, ductility and permeability together and distinguish ageing from different sample locations or compaction levels in the dam.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保留試樣的氧氣暴露可能與深埋心牆不同，不能直接把其老化年限當現地壽命。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
