steps.title: 鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Borehole deviation and curtain continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Borehole deviation and curtain continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。僅看平均偏斜角，會漏掉局部曲折造成的最近或最遠間距。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target. Mean deviation angle misses local curvature controlling the closest and widest spacing between treatment paths. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：僅看平均偏斜角，會漏掉局部曲折造成的最近或最遠間距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean deviation angle misses local curvature controlling the closest and widest spacing between treatment paths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口間距完全符合設計就能保證深部帷幕一定連續。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct collar spacing guarantees a continuous curtain at every depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。僅看平均偏斜角，會漏掉局部曲折造成的最近或最遠間距。
knowledge.textEn: Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target. Mean deviation angle misses local curvature controlling the closest and widest spacing between treatment paths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鑽孔偏斜與帷幕連續」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Borehole deviation and curtain continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。
兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction.
Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target.
quiz.explanation: 兩孔朝相反方向偏移會在深部拉開大缺口，同向偏移則可能讓整排偏離目標。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Opposing deviations open deep gaps, while common-direction deviation shifts the row away from its target. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「序列孔耗量趨勢」與「獨立驗證與統計分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Successive-hole take trends" and "Independent verification and distributions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Successive-hole take trends: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「序列孔耗量趨勢」如何影響壩基帷幕灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Successive-hole take trends” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation curtain grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 逐次縮小孔距常用來觀察處理後剩餘可灌性，但耗量下降也可能受材料、壓力和孔段條件改變。趨勢必須在可比較條件下解讀，不能單獨作完成證明。 假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「序列孔耗量趨勢」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Successive spacing reduction can reveal remaining groutability, but declining take also reflects changed mixtures, pressures and stages. Trends require comparable conditions and cannot alone establish completion of a hydraulic barrier. Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Final take is eighty percent below initial, a trend indicator rather than an eighty-percent permeability reduction. Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Successive-hole take trends” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「序列孔耗量趨勢」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Successive-hole take trends”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢
knowledge.text: 逐次縮小孔距常用來觀察處理後剩餘可灌性，但耗量下降也可能受材料、壓力和孔段條件改變。趨勢必須在可比較條件下解讀，不能單獨作完成證明。
knowledge.textEn: Successive spacing reduction can reveal remaining groutability, but declining take also reflects changed mixtures, pressures and stages. Trends require comparable conditions and cannot alone establish completion of a hydraulic barrier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「序列孔耗量趨勢」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Successive-hole take trends" is correct?
options: 逐次縮小孔距常用來觀察處理後剩餘可灌性，但耗量下降也可能受材料、壓力和孔段條件改變。
後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。
驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。
optionsEn: Successive spacing reduction can reveal remaining groutability, but declining take also reflects changed mixtures, pressures and stages.
An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction.
A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 逐次縮小孔距常用來觀察處理後剩餘可灌性，但耗量下降也可能受材料、壓力和孔段條件改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Successive spacing reduction can reveal remaining groutability, but declining take also reflects changed mixtures, pressures and stages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Successive-hole take trends: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「序列孔耗量趨勢」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Successive-hole take trends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Final take is eighty percent below initial, a trend indicator rather than an eighty-percent permeability reduction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設可比較孔段的單位耗量由30降至12再到6 kg/m，最後相對初始下降80%；只是趨勢指標，不等同滲透率下降80%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Final take is eighty percent below initial, a trend indicator rather than an eighty-percent permeability reduction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「序列孔耗量趨勢」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Successive-hole take trends", which statement holds?
options: 只要岩體能透水，同一裂隙就必定能讓任何水泥漿通過。

泵端表壓可不經高程和地下水修正直接當成孔段有效壓力。
optionsEn: Any water-conducting fracture necessarily admits every cement grout mixture.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume comparable unit takes fall from 30 to 12 to 6 kg/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Successive-hole take trends: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「序列孔耗量趨勢」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Successive-hole take trends” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。分開比較不同材料批次的結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions. Use independent water tests or verification holes to determine whether low-take regions retain connected fractures not intersected by treatment. Compare different mixture batches separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以序列孔耗量趨勢編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。分開比較不同材料批次的結果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for successive-hole take trends, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions. Use independent water tests or verification holes to determine whether low-take regions retain connected fractures not intersected by treatment. Compare different mixture batches separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Successive-hole take trends"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
供漿總體積就是硬化後留在目標裂隙中的有效填充體積。
按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Total supplied grout equals the hardened effective volume retained in targeted fractures.
Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions.
quiz.explanation: 按相同地層、孔段長度和有效壓力分組比較耗量，核對材料濃度與停止條件；用獨立壓水或驗證孔檢查低耗量區仍否存在未被相交的連通裂隙。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Group takes by geology, stage length and effective pressure, checking mix concentration and stopping conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 序列孔耗量趨勢：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Successive-hole take trends: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「序列孔耗量趨勢」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Successive-hole take trends” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「後續孔耗漿量下降百分之八十就代表滲透率必定下降八成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An eighty-percent decline in later-hole take guarantees an eighty-percent permeability reduction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。只追求下降曲線會導致錯誤完工判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Pursuing a falling curve alone can therefore lead to an incorrect completion assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「序列孔耗量趨勢」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Successive-hole take trends" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。
optionsEn: Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 先前孔堵住入口會使後續孔吸漿少，卻可能留下更遠通道；濃漿用量的重量與稀漿體積也不可直接比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Earlier entrance blockage lowers later take while leaving distant paths, and dense-grout mass cannot directly compare with dilute-grout volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Independent verification and distributions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「獨立驗證與統計分布」如何影響壩基帷幕灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent verification and distributions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation curtain grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 帷幕驗證應以水力性能與空間覆蓋為主，不能只重用施工過程數據。裂隙岩體常有偏態分布，平均值會被少數高透水段支配，需保留位置。 假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。平均(1+1+2+3+20)/5=5.4 L/(min·m)，中位2 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數，異常高值不能因中位低而刪除。 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立驗證與統計分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Curtain verification prioritizes hydraulic performance and coverage rather than reusing process records. Fractured rock commonly has skewed results, so a few conductive stages dominate means and locations must remain visible. Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Mean (1+1+2+3+20)/5 is 5.4 L/(min·m) and median is 2 L/(min·m). These are not direct permeability coefficients; the high value cannot be discarded because the median is low. A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Independent verification and distributions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「獨立驗證與統計分布」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Independent verification and distributions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布
knowledge.text: 帷幕驗證應以水力性能與空間覆蓋為主，不能只重用施工過程數據。裂隙岩體常有偏態分布，平均值會被少數高透水段支配，需保留位置。
knowledge.textEn: Curtain verification prioritizes hydraulic performance and coverage rather than reusing process records. Fractured rock commonly has skewed results, so a few conductive stages dominate means and locations must remain visible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「獨立驗證與統計分布」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent verification and distributions" is correct?
options: 驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。
帷幕驗證應以水力性能與空間覆蓋為主，不能只重用施工過程數據。
水試反算的水力開度就是所有裂隙的實際幾何寬度。
optionsEn: A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored.
Curtain verification prioritizes hydraulic performance and coverage rather than reusing process records.
Water-test hydraulic aperture equals the actual geometric width of every fracture.
quiz.explanation: 帷幕驗證應以水力性能與空間覆蓋為主，不能只重用施工過程數據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Curtain verification prioritizes hydraulic performance and coverage rather than reusing process records. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent verification and distributions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立驗證與統計分布」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Independent verification and distributions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。平均(1+1+2+3+20)/5=5.4 L/(min·m)，中位2 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數，異常高值不能因中位低而刪除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Mean (1+1+2+3+20)/5 is 5.4 L/(min·m) and median is 2 L/(min·m). These are not direct permeability coefficients; the high value cannot be discarded because the median is low. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。平均(1+1+2+3+20)/5=5.4 L/(min·m)，中位2 L/(min·m)；非直接滲透係數，異常高值不能因中位低而刪除。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Mean (1+1+2+3+20)/5 is 5.4 L/(min·m) and median is 2 L/(min·m). These are not direct permeability coefficients; the high value cannot be discarded because the median is low.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「獨立驗證與統計分布」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Independent verification and distributions", which statement holds?
options: 漿液塑性黏度低就代表不需要壓力梯度也能無限滲入。
吸漿量突然增加就必定表示帷幕填充效果變得更好。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。
optionsEn: Low plastic viscosity means grout can penetrate indefinitely without a pressure gradient.
A sudden increase in grout take necessarily indicates improved curtain filling.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m).
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設五孔段在近似線性流況下，按1 MPa有效試壓標準化的單位孔長流量為1、1、2、3、20 L/(min·m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume five stage flows per unit length, linearly normalized to effective test pressure 1 MPa under approximately linear flow, are 1, 1, 2, 3 and 20 L/(min·m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent verification and distributions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立驗證與統計分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent verification and distributions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以獨立驗證與統計分布編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for independent verification and distributions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone.

knowledge.text: 以獨立驗證與統計分布編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for independent verification and distributions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Report mean, median and high-value locations, investigating geology and test integrity at extremes instead of declaring success from summary statistics alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「獨立驗證與統計分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent verification and distributions"?
options: 將驗證孔獨立於施工孔選址，繪出每孔段結果與不確定度；同時報平均、中位和高值位置，對高值回查地質連通及測試完整性，避免只用摘要統計宣布合格。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
標準化壓水值可不經幾何假設直接視為岩體滲透係數。
optionsEn: Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Normalized water-test flow directly equals rock permeability without geometric assumptions.

quiz.explanationEn: Locate verification holes independently from treatment holes and map stage results with uncertainty. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 獨立驗證與統計分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent verification and distributions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立驗證與統計分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent verification and distributions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「驗證結果中位數很低就能忽略少數高透水孔段。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low verification median allows highly permeable individual stages to be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。缺乏位置與原始曲線時，統計不能分辨真正缺口和儀器假象。
knowledge.textEn: A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Without location and raw curves, statistics cannot distinguish a real gap from an instrumentation artifact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「獨立驗證與統計分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent verification and distributions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。
水試反算的水力開度就是所有裂隙的實際幾何寬度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage.
Water-test hydraulic aperture equals the actual geometric width of every fracture.
quiz.explanation: 低中位值可能掩蓋穿越整個帷幕的單一高透水帶，而高值也可能是測試漏流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low median can hide one permeable band crossing the curtain, while a high value can reflect test leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 壩基排水廊道
summary: 本課以壩基排水廊道為入口，深入排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Dam-foundation drainage galleries as its entry point, this course examines gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 排水導度敏感度固定上游水頭50 m、出口10 m與入流導度0.002 m²/s，只將排出導度由0.008降為0.004 m²/s。節點穩態水頭H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout)由18升至23.333 m；排水導度減半並不令水頭翻倍。這是線性集總網路兩個穩態的比較，沒有描述堵塞後升壓的時間過程或三維裂隙分布。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and inflow conductance 0.002 m²/s fixed, reducing only outflow conductance from 0.008 to 0.004 m²/s. Steady node head H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout) rises from 18 to 23.333 m; halving drainage conductance does not double head. The linear lumped network compares two steady states, excluding transient pressurization and three-dimensional fractures.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水力阻力與廊道水頭」與「揚壓分布與合力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head" and "Uplift distribution and resultant": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力阻力與廊道水頭」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。岩體入流與排水出口共同決定節點水頭，出口淹沒會抬高整個系統的基準。 假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力阻力與廊道水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. It provides finite conductance toward a lower-head boundary, while rock inflow and outlet conditions jointly establish the internal node head and submerged outlets raise that reference. Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. Nonlinear fractures, transient storage and bypass paths can make a single-node model inadequate for locating the cause of deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭
knowledge.text: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。岩體入流與排水出口共同決定節點水頭，出口淹沒會抬高整個系統的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. It provides finite conductance toward a lower-head boundary, while rock inflow and outlet conditions jointly establish the internal node head and submerged outlets raise that reference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力阻力與廊道水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head" is correct?
options: 只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。
排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。
單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。
optionsEn: Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location.
Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero.
One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base.
quiz.explanation: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head", which statement holds?
options: 排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。
多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m。
optionsEn: Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水力阻力與廊道水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以水力阻力與廊道水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic resistance and gallery head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. Nonlinear fractures, transient storage and bypass paths can make a single-node model inadequate for locating the cause of deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 揚壓分布與合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Uplift distribution and resultant: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「揚壓分布與合力」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uplift distribution and resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 揚壓是沿底面的空間分布，排水位置的低壓點不能代表全底面。把量測頭換成壓力並積分，可以看出排水前後抗滑法向力的變化，但必須保留未量測區域的不確定性。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「揚壓分布與合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uplift is a spatial pressure distribution, not the low value at one drain. Converting measured heads to pressure and integrating reveals changes in sliding normal force while retaining uncertainty between and beyond measurement points. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m. Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uplift distribution and resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「揚壓分布與合力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Uplift distribution and resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 揚壓分布與合力

knowledge.textEn: Uplift is a spatial pressure distribution, not the low value at one drain. Converting measured heads to pressure and integrating reveals changes in sliding normal force while retaining uncertainty between and beyond measurement points.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「揚壓分布與合力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uplift distribution and resultant" is correct?
options: 單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。
排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。

optionsEn: One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base.
Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
Uplift is a spatial pressure distribution, not the low value at one drain.
quiz.explanation: 揚壓是沿底面的空間分布，排水位置的低壓點不能代表全底面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.titleEn: Uplift distribution and resultant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「揚壓分布與合力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uplift distribution and resultant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。若把不同高程儀器的原始壓力直接相連，還會把安裝高差誤認為真正的水頭梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Joining raw pressures from different elevations also confuses installation height with hydraulic gradient, producing an incorrect resultant despite apparently consistent readings.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「揚壓分布與合力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uplift distribution and resultant" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。
測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation.
quiz.explanation: 測點間可能有局部高透水裂隙，線性插值會低估壓力峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Conductive fractures between instruments can produce pressure peaks missed by linear interpolation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水孔間距與覆蓋」與「導水能力的趨勢比較」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drain spacing and coverage" and "Conductance trend comparison": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水孔間距與覆蓋」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drain spacing and coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。覆蓋概念可先做幾何篩選，再用水力回應驗證相互影響是否連續。 假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水孔間距與覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. Uniform collar spacing does not ensure uniform influence, so geometric coverage is preliminary screening that requires hydraulic response evidence to establish continuity. Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant. Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drain spacing and coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drain spacing and coverage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋
knowledge.text: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。覆蓋概念可先做幾何篩選，再用水力回應驗證相互影響是否連續。
knowledge.textEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. Uniform collar spacing does not ensure uniform influence, so geometric coverage is preliminary screening that requires hydraulic response evidence to establish continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水孔間距與覆蓋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drain spacing and coverage" is correct?
options: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。
排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。
排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。
optionsEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures.
Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
quiz.explanation: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drain spacing and coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drain spacing and coverage", which statement holds?
options: 多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
圓孔的三倍應力係數可直接套用到任何矩形廊道角隅。
optionsEn: Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m.
The circular-hole factor of three applies directly to every rectangular-gallery corner.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水孔間距與覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drain spacing and coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以排水孔間距與覆蓋編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain spacing and coverage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
knowledge.textEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以排水孔間距與覆蓋編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain spacing and coverage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水孔間距與覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drain spacing and coverage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個壓力感測器的誤差不論是否相關都可以一律平方和開根號。
以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation.
Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure.
quiz.explanation: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
