workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 自由熱收縮敏感度固定單塊長24 m與α=10⁻⁵/K，只將均勻降溫量由12增至18 K。ΔL=αLΔT由2.88增至4.32 mm，增加50%。比較保持自由收縮邊界；若塊體受到拘束，額外冷卻可能轉化為應力而非相同的位移，兩塊之間的接縫實際開度還取決於各自運動和接觸狀態。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For free-contraction sensitivity, hold block length at 24 m and α=10⁻⁵/K fixed, increasing only uniform cooling from 12 K to 18 K. ΔL=αLΔT rises from 2.88 to 4.32 mm, or 50%. The comparison retains free contraction; restraint may turn added cooling into stress rather than the same displacement, while actual joint aperture depends on both blocks and their contact state.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」與「分區接縫的體積平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" and "Compartment grout-volume balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。自由收縮估算只給幾何尺度，實際開縫還受基礎約束、相鄰塊體與非均勻溫度控制。 假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. Free contraction provides a geometric scale, while foundation restraint, neighboring blocks and nonuniform temperature determine actual aperture and its spatial distribution. Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cooling contraction and joint aperture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度
knowledge.text: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。自由收縮估算只給幾何尺度，實際開縫還受基礎約束、相鄰塊體與非均勻溫度控制。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. Free contraction provides a geometric scale, while foundation restraint, neighboring blocks and nonuniform temperature determine actual aperture and its spatial distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" is correct?
options: 用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。
供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
optionsEn: Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact.
Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
quiz.explanation: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cooling contraction and joint aperture", which statement holds?
options: 位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm。
optionsEn: Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以冷卻收縮與接縫開度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cooling contraction and joint aperture, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.

Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cooling contraction and joint aperture"?
options: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。
optionsEn: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
quiz.explanation: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。
knowledge.textEn: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。
供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction.
Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
quiz.explanation: 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區接縫的體積平衡」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment grout-volume balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。平均開度乘面積只是初估，止漿邊界、鍵槽和局部接觸會造成體積分布不均。 假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區接縫的體積平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. Mean aperture times area is only an estimate because seals, shear keys and localized contact create uneven available volume. Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compartment grout-volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區接縫的體積平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compartment grout-volume balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡
knowledge.text: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。平均開度乘面積只是初估，止漿邊界、鍵槽和局部接觸會造成體積分布不均。
knowledge.textEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. Mean aperture times area is only an estimate because seals, shear keys and localized contact create uneven available volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區接縫的體積平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compartment grout-volume balance" is correct?
options: 供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。
optionsEn: Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account.
quiz.explanation: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區接縫的體積平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment grout-volume balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區接縫的體積平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compartment grout-volume balance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³。
只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。
漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³.
Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區接縫的體積平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment grout-volume balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分區接縫的體積平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compartment grout-volume balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。

Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區接縫的體積平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compartment grout-volume balance"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
quiz.explanation: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區接縫的體積平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment grout-volume balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區接縫的體積平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compartment grout-volume balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage.
quiz.explanation: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殘留通道與立方敏感性」與「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Residual channels and cubic sensitivity" and "Grout-column head and compartment pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual channels and cubic sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「殘留通道與立方敏感性」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。封堵體積百分比與水力改善百分比沒有固定對應，連通路徑比平均孔隙更重要。 假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「殘留通道與立方敏感性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. Filled-volume percentage does not have a fixed relationship to hydraulic improvement; connectivity matters more than average void fraction. Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm. Ideal flow ratio is 0.03704, a 96.296-percent reduction for Newtonian laminar flow without bypass. Turbulence, roughness and pressure-induced opening violate the cubic idealization, while bypasses avoid treated regions. Treating the ideal reduction as a material guarantee misses the weakest connected segment that actually governs leakage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「殘留通道與立方敏感性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性
knowledge.text: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。封堵體積百分比與水力改善百分比沒有固定對應，連通路徑比平均孔隙更重要。
knowledge.textEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. Filled-volume percentage does not have a fixed relationship to hydraulic improvement; connectivity matters more than average void fraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘留通道與立方敏感性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual channels and cubic sensitivity" is correct?
options: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
optionsEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
quiz.explanation: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. The other options are common misconceptions.

quiz.question: 依「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout-column head and compartment pressure", which statement holds?
options: 漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout-column head and compartment pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout-column head and compartment pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以漿柱水頭與分區壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for grout-column head and compartment pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grout-column head and compartment pressure"?
options: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
optionsEn: Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
quiz.explanation: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout-column head and compartment pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout-column head and compartment pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。
knowledge.textEn: Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout-column head and compartment pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。
只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments.
Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
quiz.explanation: 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「析水與硬化後空隙」與「溫度與材料反應速率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bleeding and hardened voids" and "Temperature and reaction rate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 析水與硬化後空隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bleeding and hardened voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「析水與硬化後空隙」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bleeding and hardened voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌入時連續的漿體可能因析水、沉降與體積變化在上緣留下空隙。新拌材料體積並不等於硬化填充體積，分區上部尤其需要獨立證據而非只看出漿顏色。 假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。 小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。忽略拘束與水路會把最壞幾何空隙誤當實際缺陷，或相反漏掉局部空洞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「析水與硬化後空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initially continuous grout can leave upper voids through bleeding, settlement and volume change. Fresh volume is not hardened filled volume, and upper compartment regions require independent evidence rather than relying on the appearance of returns. Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Concentrated over an upper horizontal area 20 m², this corresponds to six millimetres of void, a geometric extreme. Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bleeding and hardened voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「析水與硬化後空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bleeding and hardened voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 析水與硬化後空隙
knowledge.text: 灌入時連續的漿體可能因析水、沉降與體積變化在上緣留下空隙。新拌材料體積並不等於硬化填充體積，分區上部尤其需要獨立證據而非只看出漿顏色。
knowledge.textEn: Initially continuous grout can leave upper voids through bleeding, settlement and volume change. Fresh volume is not hardened filled volume, and upper compartment regions require independent evidence rather than relying on the appearance of returns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「析水與硬化後空隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bleeding and hardened voids" is correct?
options: 只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。
溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。
灌入時連續的漿體可能因析水、沉降與體積變化在上緣留下空隙。
optionsEn: Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
Initially continuous grout can leave upper voids through bleeding, settlement and volume change.
quiz.explanation: 灌入時連續的漿體可能因析水、沉降與體積變化在上緣留下空隙。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initially continuous grout can leave upper voids through bleeding, settlement and volume change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 析水與硬化後空隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bleeding and hardened voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「析水與硬化後空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bleeding and hardened voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Concentrated over an upper horizontal area 20 m², this corresponds to six millimetres of void, a geometric extreme. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以現場同溫同齡期樣品量析水與沉降，記錄容器形狀對結果的影響；把分區頂部回流與後續接觸檢查對照，辨認自由水滯留、材料收縮和真正未充填的差別。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure bleeding and settlement in samples at matched temperature and age, recording container effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Concentrated over an upper horizontal area 20 m², this corresponds to six millimetres of void, a geometric extreme.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「析水與硬化後空隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bleeding and hardened voids", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³。
接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。
接縫超音波速度很高就足以證明其黏結強度和抗剪能力完全恢復。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water.
Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設新拌填充體積2.4 m³、自由析水比例5%，分離水量0.12 m³；若均集中在面積20 m²的上部水平面，等效空層6 mm，僅幾何極端示例。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume fresh fill 2.4 m³ and free bleeding five percent, producing 0.12 m³ water. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 析水與硬化後空隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bleeding and hardened voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「析水與硬化後空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bleeding and hardened voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.title: 析水與硬化後空隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bleeding and hardened voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「析水與硬化後空隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bleeding and hardened voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。忽略拘束與水路會把最壞幾何空隙誤當實際缺陷，或相反漏掉局部空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略拘束與水路會把最壞幾何空隙誤當實際缺陷，或相反漏掉局部空洞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Ignoring confinement and drainage can mistake an extreme geometric void for actual damage or overlook a localized unfilled pocket.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「析水與硬化後空隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bleeding and hardened voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。
小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels.
quiz.explanation: 小型量筒的析水比例不一定可直接放大到受限薄縫，泌水又可能沿通道外排。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cylinder bleeding does not scale directly to confined thin joints, and bleed water can leave through channels. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度與材料反應速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature and reaction rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度與材料反應速率」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temperature and reaction rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌漿材料的可用時間和強度發展受溫度影響，固定鐘錶時間不能代表相同反應程度。簡化反應速率可比較溫度敏感性，但實際配方、摻料與早期反應需要試驗校正。 假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。直接用理論倍率縮短施工等待時間，可能誤判材料可操作性與承載能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度與材料反應速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature changes grout working time and strength development, so equal clock time does not imply equal reaction progress. A simplified rate model compares sensitivity but requires calibration for mixture composition, admixtures and early-age reactions. Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Relative rate at 303.15 K versus 293.15 K is 1.718, an idealized comparison rather than a setting-time guarantee. Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness. Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temperature and reaction rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度與材料反應速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Temperature and reaction rate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度與材料反應速率
knowledge.text: 灌漿材料的可用時間和強度發展受溫度影響，固定鐘錶時間不能代表相同反應程度。簡化反應速率可比較溫度敏感性，但實際配方、摻料與早期反應需要試驗校正。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature changes grout working time and strength development, so equal clock time does not imply equal reaction progress. A simplified rate model compares sensitivity but requires calibration for mixture composition, admixtures and early-age reactions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度與材料反應速率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature and reaction rate" is correct?
options: 灌漿材料的可用時間和強度發展受溫度影響，固定鐘錶時間不能代表相同反應程度。
溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。
漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
optionsEn: Temperature changes grout working time and strength development, so equal clock time does not imply equal reaction progress.
A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿材料的可用時間和強度發展受溫度影響，固定鐘錶時間不能代表相同反應程度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature changes grout working time and strength development, so equal clock time does not imply equal reaction progress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度與材料反應速率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature and reaction rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫度與材料反應速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temperature and reaction rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Relative rate at 303.15 K versus 293.15 K is 1.718, an idealized comparison rather than a setting-time guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Relative rate at 303.15 K versus 293.15 K is 1.718, an idealized comparison rather than a setting-time guarantee.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度與材料反應速率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature and reaction rate", which statement holds?
options: 只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
optionsEn: One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K).
Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設表觀活化能40 kJ/mol，R=8.314 J/(mol·K)，以293.15 K為基準，303.15 K速率比exp[(40000/8.314)(1/293.15−1/303.15)]=1.718；非凝結時間保證。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume activation energy 40 kJ/mol and R=8.314 J/(mol·K). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度與材料反應速率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature and reaction rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度與材料反應速率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temperature and reaction rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。核對試體失水與現地差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以溫度與材料反應速率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。核對試體失水與現地差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for temperature and reaction rate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
