knowledge.textEn: Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以溫度與材料反應速率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。核對試體失水與現地差異。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for temperature and reaction rate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Test whether one activation energy fits several temperatures, retaining discrepancies caused by self-heating, moisture loss and shear history. Check specimen moisture loss against field conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度與材料反應速率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature and reaction rate"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age.
quiz.explanation: 量測混合桶、輸送末端與試體溫度，將流動度和強度資料對照等效齡期；用不同溫度試驗檢查單一活化能是否適用，並保留發熱、失水與剪切歷史造成的偏差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure temperatures at mixing, delivery and specimens and compare flowability and strength against equivalent age. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度與材料反應速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature and reaction rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫度與材料反應速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temperature and reaction rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。直接用理論倍率縮短施工等待時間，可能誤判材料可操作性與承載能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness. Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：直接用理論倍率縮短施工等待時間，可能誤判材料可操作性與承載能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。直接用理論倍率縮短施工等待時間，可能誤判材料可操作性與承載能力。
knowledge.textEn: Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness. Scaling waiting times directly by a theoretical ratio can misjudge workability and load-transfer capacity despite correct arithmetic.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度與材料反應速率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature and reaction rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
optionsEn: Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 材料反應不是全程單一速率，外加劑可改變誘導期，桶內發熱也會讓試體失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reaction does not follow one rate throughout; admixtures alter induction and self-heating changes sample representativeness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「填充層的法向柔度」與「封拱後的荷載分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Normal compliance of the filled layer" and "Load sharing after closure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 填充層的法向柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Normal compliance of the filled layer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「填充層的法向柔度」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal compliance of the filled layer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫傳力不只取決於漿材強度，也取決於厚度、接觸面積與閉合後的柔度。薄層線彈性估算可以比較變形量級，但局部未黏結、粗糙接觸與裂縫會讓有效剛度降低。 假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填充層的法向柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint load transfer depends on thickness, contact area and compliance as well as grout strength. A thin-layer elastic estimate compares movement scales, while debonding, rough contacts and cracks reduce the effective stiffness from the ideal value. Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Normal stiffness is 200 GN/m, giving five micrometres compression under 1 MN with full elastic contact. Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal compliance of the filled layer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「填充層的法向柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Normal compliance of the filled layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 填充層的法向柔度
knowledge.titleEn: Normal compliance of the filled layer
knowledge.text: 接縫傳力不只取決於漿材強度，也取決於厚度、接觸面積與閉合後的柔度。薄層線彈性估算可以比較變形量級，但局部未黏結、粗糙接觸與裂縫會讓有效剛度降低。
knowledge.textEn: Joint load transfer depends on thickness, contact area and compliance as well as grout strength. A thin-layer elastic estimate compares movement scales, while debonding, rough contacts and cracks reduce the effective stiffness from the ideal value.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「填充層的法向柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Normal compliance of the filled layer" is correct?
options: 漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
接縫傳力不只取決於漿材強度，也取決於厚度、接觸面積與閉合後的柔度。
接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。
optionsEn: Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
Joint load transfer depends on thickness, contact area and compliance as well as grout strength.
Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
quiz.explanation: 接縫傳力不只取決於漿材強度，也取決於厚度、接觸面積與閉合後的柔度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint load transfer depends on thickness, contact area and compliance as well as grout strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 填充層的法向柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Normal compliance of the filled layer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填充層的法向柔度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal compliance of the filled layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Normal stiffness is 200 GN/m, giving five micrometres compression under 1 MN with full elastic contact. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Normal stiffness is 200 GN/m, giving five micrometres compression under 1 MN with full elastic contact.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「填充層的法向柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Normal compliance of the filled layer", which statement holds?
options: 接縫超音波速度很高就足以證明其黏結強度和抗剪能力完全恢復。
供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m。
optionsEn: High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity.
Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效模數0.5 GPa、面積2 m²、厚5 mm，法向剛度EA/t=200 GN/m；壓力合力1 MN造成5 micrometres壓縮，完全接觸線彈性假設。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective modulus 0.5 GPa, area 2 m² and thickness 5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 填充層的法向柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal compliance of the filled layer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填充層的法向柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal compliance of the filled layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以填充層的法向柔度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for normal compliance of the filled layer, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以填充層的法向柔度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。檢查量測架本身的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for normal compliance of the filled layer, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Examine unloading loops, spatial variation and thermal drift to distinguish material compression from renewed contact between initially separated surfaces. Check deformation of the measurement frame itself.

quiz.question: 要驗證「填充層的法向柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Normal compliance of the filled layer"?
options: 以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
optionsEn: Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
quiz.explanation: 以可辨識小變形的量測配置比較載重和閉合曲線，先扣除設備與相鄰混凝土柔度；檢查卸載回線、空間分布和溫度漂移，判別材料壓縮是否混入接觸面重新貼合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure load and closure with sufficient small-displacement resolution, subtracting equipment and adjacent-concrete compliance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 填充層的法向柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Normal compliance of the filled layer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填充層的法向柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Normal compliance of the filled layer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。接觸閉合具有非線性，用高載階段的斜率回推低載狀態會低估早期變形。
knowledge.textEn: Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Contact closure is nonlinear, so extrapolating a high-load slope to the initial low-load regime underestimates early movement and conceals gaps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「填充層的法向柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Normal compliance of the filled layer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。
接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness.
Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
quiz.explanation: 若有效接觸面積低於幾何面積，平均應力與剛度估算都會失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective area below geometric area distorts both average stress and stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 封拱後的荷載分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load sharing after closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「封拱後的荷載分配」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load sharing after closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫填充使原本分開的塊體形成新的傳力路徑，施工先後和當時溫度會留下初始應力。平行剛度模型可示範共同位移的分擔，但不能取代三維拱壩的分階段分析。 假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「封拱後的荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filling joints creates load paths between previously separate blocks, while sequence and temperature establish initial stress. Parallel springs demonstrate compatible load sharing but do not replace staged three-dimensional analysis of an arch dam. Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Common displacement is 0.2 mm and forces are 6 and 4 MN, excluding initial gaps and prestress. A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load sharing after closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「封拱後的荷載分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load sharing after closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 封拱後的荷載分配
knowledge.text: 接縫填充使原本分開的塊體形成新的傳力路徑，施工先後和當時溫度會留下初始應力。平行剛度模型可示範共同位移的分擔，但不能取代三維拱壩的分階段分析。
knowledge.textEn: Filling joints creates load paths between previously separate blocks, while sequence and temperature establish initial stress. Parallel springs demonstrate compatible load sharing but do not replace staged three-dimensional analysis of an arch dam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「封拱後的荷載分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load sharing after closure" is correct?
options: 接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
接縫填充使原本分開的塊體形成新的傳力路徑，施工先後和當時溫度會留下初始應力。
optionsEn: Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
Filling joints creates load paths between previously separate blocks, while sequence and temperature establish initial stress.
quiz.explanation: 接縫填充使原本分開的塊體形成新的傳力路徑，施工先後和當時溫度會留下初始應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filling joints creates load paths between previously separate blocks, while sequence and temperature establish initial stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 封拱後的荷載分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load sharing after closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封拱後的荷載分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load sharing after closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Common displacement is 0.2 mm and forces are 6 and 4 MN, excluding initial gaps and prestress. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Common displacement is 0.2 mm and forces are 6 and 4 MN, excluding initial gaps and prestress.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「封拱後的荷載分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load sharing after closure", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN。
用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN.
Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩路徑剛度30及20 GN/m、共同承受10 MN，位移P/(k1+k2)=0.2 mm，分力6與4 MN；無初始間隙和預應力的線彈性示例。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel stiffnesses 30 and 20 GN/m sharing 10 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 封拱後的荷載分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load sharing after closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封拱後的荷載分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load sharing after closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以封拱後的荷載分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load sharing after closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以封拱後的荷載分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load sharing after closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Compare strain gauges and crest movement before and after closure to test whether observed changes match the predicted new load path.

quiz.question: 要驗證「封拱後的荷載分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load sharing after closure"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。
只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement.
Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
quiz.explanation: 在分階段模型中保存每步初始應變與接觸狀態，核對反力總和與共同位移；對照封拱前後應變計及壩頂位移，檢查量測變化是否與預測的新傳力路徑一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserve initial strains and contacts in staged analysis, checking reaction balance and compatible displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 封拱後的荷載分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load sharing after closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封拱後的荷載分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load sharing after closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫完成後的受力只取決於最終幾何，與施工順序和封拱溫度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Post-grouting forces depend only on final geometry, regardless of sequence or closure temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。只以最終幾何一次加載，會漏掉施工歷程造成的初始狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Loading only the final geometry misses the initial state created by the actual construction sequence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「封拱後的荷載分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load sharing after closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force.
quiz.explanation: 若一條路徑尚有間隙，荷載不會立即按兩個剛度分配；溫度或混凝土徐變也會重新分配內力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gapped path does not immediately share load in proportion to stiffness, and temperature or creep redistributes force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」與「波速檢測與接觸證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure decay and loss diagnosis" and "Wave velocity and contact evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure decay and loss diagnosis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure decay and loss diagnosis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封閉試驗中的壓力衰減同時受洩漏導度與系統可壓縮儲量控制。衰減快未必表示大裂縫，空氣泡、軟管和結構變形都會改變儲量，需先辨認量測系統。 假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。若不獨立量測其中一項，就存在多組參數都能符合相同曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure decay in a closed test depends on leakage conductance and compressible storage. Rapid decay does not uniquely identify a large crack, because entrained air, flexible hoses and structural deformation change the system response. Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Time constant is fifty seconds and half-life 34.657 seconds, with fixed boundaries and one storage compartment. Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure decay and loss diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure decay and loss diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識
knowledge.text: 封閉試驗中的壓力衰減同時受洩漏導度與系統可壓縮儲量控制。衰減快未必表示大裂縫，空氣泡、軟管和結構變形都會改變儲量，需先辨認量測系統。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure decay in a closed test depends on leakage conductance and compressible storage. Rapid decay does not uniquely identify a large crack, because entrained air, flexible hoses and structural deformation change the system response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure decay and loss diagnosis" is correct?
options: 封閉試驗中的壓力衰減同時受洩漏導度與系統可壓縮儲量控制。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
接縫超音波速度很高就足以證明其黏結強度和抗剪能力完全恢復。
optionsEn: Pressure decay in a closed test depends on leakage conductance and compressible storage.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity.
quiz.explanation: 封閉試驗中的壓力衰減同時受洩漏導度與系統可壓縮儲量控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure decay in a closed test depends on leakage conductance and compressible storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure decay and loss diagnosis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure decay and loss diagnosis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Time constant is fifty seconds and half-life 34.657 seconds, with fixed boundaries and one storage compartment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Time constant is fifty seconds and half-life 34.657 seconds, with fixed boundaries and one storage compartment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure decay and loss diagnosis", which statement holds?
options: 供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s。
位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
optionsEn: Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa).
Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性儲量C=0.0005 m³/kPa、漏失導度G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa)，時間常數C/G=50 s，半衰時間50ln2=34.657 s；固定邊界與單一儲量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear storage C=0.0005 m³/kPa and leakage conductance G=0.00001 m³/(s·kPa). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure decay and loss diagnosis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure decay and loss diagnosis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Compare flow balance and model residuals to determine whether one exponential adequately represents the observations. Measure valve leakage separately with the joint isolated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以壓力衰減與漏失辨識編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure decay and loss diagnosis, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Compare flow balance and model residuals to determine whether one exponential adequately represents the observations. Measure valve leakage separately with the joint isolated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Compare flow balance and model residuals to determine whether one exponential adequately represents the observations. Measure valve leakage separately with the joint isolated.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以壓力衰減與漏失辨識編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。另量閥件單獨封閉的漏率。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure decay and loss diagnosis, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Compare flow balance and model residuals to determine whether one exponential adequately represents the observations. Measure valve leakage separately with the joint isolated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure decay and loss diagnosis"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
溫度提高十度後，所有灌漿配方的凝結時間都會固定縮短一半。
先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A ten-degree temperature increase halves setting time for every grout mixture.
Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments.
quiz.explanation: 先用已知密閉容積校正設備儲量，記錄溫度、含氣與閥件漏失，再擬合多時段壓力曲線；比較流量收支與壓力模型殘差，確認單指數衰減是否足以描述資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate equipment storage with a known sealed volume and record temperature, entrained air and valve leakage before fitting pressure segments. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力衰減與漏失辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure decay and loss diagnosis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若不獨立量測其中一項，就存在多組參數都能符合相同曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。若不獨立量測其中一項，就存在多組參數都能符合相同曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Without independent measurement, multiple parameter combinations fit the same curve and do not uniquely establish joint tightness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力衰減與漏失辨識」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure decay and loss diagnosis" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
接縫超音波速度很高就足以證明其黏結強度和抗剪能力完全恢復。
optionsEn: Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity.
quiz.explanation: 壓力計漂移、閥漏與漿材凝結會產生非水力衰減，單一半衰時間無法分開導度和儲量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Gauge drift, valve leakage and setting introduce nonhydraulic decay, while one half-life cannot separate storage from conductance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 波速檢測與接觸證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave velocity and contact evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波速檢測與接觸證據」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave velocity and contact evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 彈性波走時可協助辨認不連續區，但波可能繞行裂縫，也受含水率與溫度影響。接縫黏結與抗剪傳力不能僅由高波速推定，需與幾何和力學證據交叉查核。 假設路徑2 m、完整材料波速4000 m/s，走時500 microseconds；接縫使走時增加20 microseconds，表觀速度2/0.00052=3846.15 m/s，非黏結強度換算。 首波拾取偏差可與小接縫延遲同量級，濕裂縫也可能傳波而不傳剪。將單一路徑速度直接換成全接縫黏結百分比，會把訊號品質與材料行為混為一談。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波速檢測與接觸證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elastic-wave travel time helps identify discontinuities, but waves can bypass cracks and respond to moisture and temperature. High apparent velocity alone does not establish bond or shear transfer, requiring geometric and mechanical corroboration. Assume a two-metre path at 4000 m/s, giving 500 microseconds. Added joint delay twenty microseconds reduces apparent velocity to 3846.15 m/s, without providing a bond-strength conversion. First-arrival picking error can rival the joint delay, and a wet crack may transmit waves without shear capacity. Converting one velocity into a whole-joint bonded percentage confuses signal quality with actual mechanical behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave velocity and contact evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設路徑2 m、完整材料波速4000 m/s，走時500 microseconds；接縫使走時增加20 microseconds，表觀速度2/0.00052=3846.15 m/s，非黏結強度換算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a two-metre path at 4000 m/s, giving 500 microseconds.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫超音波速度很高就足以證明其黏結強度和抗剪能力完全恢復。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波速檢測與接觸證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave velocity and contact evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波速檢測與接觸證據

knowledge.textEn: Elastic-wave travel time helps identify discontinuities, but waves can bypass cracks and respond to moisture and temperature. High apparent velocity alone does not establish bond or shear transfer, requiring geometric and mechanical corroboration.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波速檢測與接觸證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

彈性波走時可協助辨認不連續區，但波可能繞行裂縫，也受含水率與溫度影響。

optionsEn: High ultrasonic velocity alone proves full restoration of joint bond strength and shear capacity.
Elastic-wave travel time helps identify discontinuities, but waves can bypass cracks and respond to moisture and temperature.
Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
quiz.explanation: 彈性波走時可協助辨認不連續區，但波可能繞行裂縫，也受含水率與溫度影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 波速檢測與接觸證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wave velocity and contact evidence: quantitative estimate

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a two-metre path at 4000 m/s, giving 500 microseconds. Added joint delay twenty microseconds reduces apparent velocity to 3846.15 m/s, without providing a bond-strength conversion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat measurements with matched coupling, temperature and moisture, testing travel-time reciprocity in several directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「波速檢測與接觸證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wave velocity and contact evidence", which statement holds?

只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。

steps.instruction: 以相同耦合、溫度與含水狀態重複量測，對多方向走時做互易性檢查；把異常區與接縫開度、鑽孔觀察及載重反應對照，確認快波路徑沒有繞過待評估界面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波速檢測與接觸證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wave velocity and contact evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
首波拾取偏差可與小接縫延遲同量級，濕裂縫也可能傳波而不傳剪。
用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
First-arrival picking error can rival the joint delay, and a wet crack may transmit waves without shear capacity.
Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
quiz.explanation: 首波拾取偏差可與小接縫延遲同量級，濕裂縫也可能傳波而不傳剪。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: First-arrival picking error can rival the joint delay, and a wet crack may transmit waves without shear capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 大壩施工導流
summary: 本課以大壩施工導流為入口，深入施工導流的洪水暴露、過流能力與階段轉換。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using River diversion during dam construction as its entry point, this course examines diversion flood exposure, hydraulic capacity and construction transitions. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 導流渠糙率敏感度固定寬10 m、水深3 m、坡度0.001，因此A=30 m²與R=1.875 m不變，只將曼寧n由0.025增至0.030 s/m^(1/3)。Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n由57.701降至48.084 m³/s，約減少16.67%。這是指定水深下均勻流輸水能力的比較；若指定流量不變，應另解新水深，不能同時固定流量與水深。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold channel width 10 m, depth 3 m and slope 0.001 fixed, retaining A=30 m² and R=1.875 m, and increase only Manning n from 0.025 to 0.030 s/m^(1/3). Uniform-flow capacity Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n falls from 57.701 to 48.084 m³/s, approximately 16.67%. This compares capacity at prescribed depth; prescribing unchanged discharge instead requires solving for a new depth.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工期洪水暴露」與「明渠導流的過水能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction-period flood exposure" and "Open-channel diversion capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工期洪水暴露」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-period flood exposure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。短期工程仍可能遇到大洪水，且後果隨開挖、圍堰和永久壩體所處階段改變。 假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工期洪水暴露」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. Return period is not a guaranteed waiting time, and consequences change as excavation, cofferdams and permanent works pass through different construction stages. Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction-period flood exposure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工期洪水暴露」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction-period flood exposure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期洪水暴露
knowledge.text: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。短期工程仍可能遇到大洪水，且後果隨開挖、圍堰和永久壩體所處階段改變。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. Return period is not a guaranteed waiting time, and consequences change as excavation, cofferdams and permanent works pass through different construction stages.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期洪水暴露」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-period flood exposure" is correct?
options: 二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。
導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
optionsEn: A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution.
Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
quiz.explanation: 施工導流的風險與暴露時間及洪水季節分布有關，重現期不是保證多久才發生一次。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diversion risk depends on exposure duration and seasonal flood distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工期洪水暴露」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-period flood exposure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. At least one exceedance in three years has probability 0.142625, or 14.2625 percent, not a seasonal-window probability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期洪水暴露」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-period flood exposure", which statement holds?
options: 入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%。
optionsEn: Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設每年超越機率0.05、各年獨立且平穩，三年內至少一次超越1−(1−0.05)³=0.142625即14.2625%；不代表季節施工窗口機率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance probability 0.05 with independent stationary years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工期洪水暴露」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-period flood exposure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以施工期洪水暴露編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction-period flood exposure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以施工期洪水暴露編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。另列洪水樣本的季節涵蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for construction-period flood exposure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Check long-term trends and upstream regulation changes, recording stage exposure, peak uncertainty and inundation consequences in a traceable risk assessment. Document seasonal coverage of the flood sample separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期洪水暴露」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-period flood exposure"?
options: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。
optionsEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段對應水文資料期間，區分全年年最大值與特定月份事件；查核長期趨勢和上游調控變更，將每階段暴露、洪峰不確定度及淹水後果列成可追溯的風險表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match construction stages to hydrologic records, distinguishing annual maxima from events in selected months. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期洪水暴露：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-period flood exposure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工期洪水暴露」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-period flood exposure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。即使超越機率相同，不同階段的損失與恢復時間仍可能完全不同。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Equal exceedance probabilities can also correspond to very different losses and recovery times at different stages of construction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期洪水暴露」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-period flood exposure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把全年機率直接按月份等比例縮小會忽略季節集中，連續年份的氣候相關性也會破壞獨立假設。
導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence.
Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
