quiz.explanationEn: Dividing annual probability in proportion to months ignores seasonality, and climate persistence violates independence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 明渠導流的過水能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Open-channel diversion capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「明渠導流的過水能力」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Open-channel diversion capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。均勻流公式可初估穩定長渠，但入口、彎道和下游回水需要另行評估。 SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。 局部收縮或彎道可能先控制水位，堆料和漂流物又會降低有效斷面。若只增加平均水深來滿足公式流量，可能漏掉局部溢頂或岸坡沖蝕問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「明渠導流的過水能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. Uniform-flow relations estimate a long stable reach, while entrance effects, bends and downstream backwater require separate analysis. The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. A contraction or bend can control stage before the uniform reach does, while stored material and debris reduce effective area. Increasing assumed average depth to meet discharge can overlook local overtopping or bank erosion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Open-channel diversion capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「明渠導流的過水能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Open-channel diversion capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 明渠導流的過水能力
knowledge.text: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。均勻流公式可初估穩定長渠，但入口、彎道和下游回水需要另行評估。
knowledge.textEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. Uniform-flow relations estimate a long stable reach, while entrance effects, bends and downstream backwater require separate analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「明渠導流的過水能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Open-channel diversion capacity" is correct?
options: 導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。
optionsEn: Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone.
quiz.explanation: 明渠能力取決於斷面、水力半徑、坡度與粗糙度，不能只看開挖面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Open-channel capacity depends on section, hydraulic radius, slope and roughness, not excavated area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 明渠導流的過水能力：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Open-channel diversion capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：SI制曼寧係數n的單位為s/m^(1/3)。假設矩形渠寬10 m、水深3 m、曼寧n=0.025、坡度0.001，A=30 m²、R=30/16=1.875 m，Q=AR^(2/3)S^0.5/n=57.701 m³/s；均勻流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The SI Manning coefficient n has units s/m^(1/3). Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check measured bed and water-surface profiles for near-uniform flow, recording roughness and obstructions by reach.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Assume rectangular width 10 m, depth 3 m, Manning n=0.025 and slope 0.001. Area is 30 m² and radius 1.875 m, giving uniform-flow capacity approximately 57.701 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 用實測縱斷面和水面線確認是否接近均勻流，分段記錄粗糙度與阻水物；以不同尾水條件重算回水，並用流速量測核對斷面流量，不能將渠底坡直接當所有情境的能量坡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 滿流隧洞的沿程損失：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-flow tunnel friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導流隧洞在滿流與自由水面流之間可能轉換，水力邊界先於公式選擇。滿管沿程損失與速度平方成正比，糙率和局部缺陷會改變所需上下游能量差。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設滿流圓洞直徑6 m、長500 m、Darcy摩阻係數0.02、流量100 m³/s，v=3.537 m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=1.063 m；不含入口出口損失。 使用滿管公式卻忽略洞內自由水面和空氣囊會誤估能力，Darcy與Fanning係數混用又會差四倍。轉換流況可能出現脈動，平均能量線不能完全描述瞬間壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿流隧洞的沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion tunnels may transition between free-surface and pressurized flow, so boundary classification precedes equation choice. Full-flow friction scales with velocity squared, and roughness or defects change the required upstream-downstream energy difference. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume full circular diameter 6 m, length 500 m, Darcy factor 0.02 and discharge 100 m³/s. Velocity is 3.537 m/s and friction loss 1.063 m, excluding entrance and exit losses. Applying full-pipe relations despite free surfaces or air pockets misstates capacity, and confusing Darcy with Fanning factors introduces a factor of four. Flow transitions can pulsate, beyond what an average energy line describes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-flow tunnel friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume full circular diameter 6 m, length 500 m, Darcy factor 0.02 and discharge 100 m³/s. Velocity is 3.537 m/s and friction loss 1.063 m, excluding entrance and exit losses. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.explanationEn: Applying full-pipe relations despite free surfaces or air pockets misstates capacity, and confusing Darcy with Fanning factors introduces a factor of four. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Entrance loss and obstruction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口局部損失與堵塞」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Entrance loss and obstruction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 入口把河道動能重新分配到隧洞或渠道，局部損失不只由截面大小決定。漂流物改變收縮和有效面積，速度增加又會放大損失，形成非線性的能力下降。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設原入口流速3 m/s、損失係數K=0.5，局部損失Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；同流量下有效面積減20%，速度3.75 m/s，若K不變損失增56.25%。 漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。偏流造成單側壓力與沖刷，即使總流量尚可，也可能已影響入口結構或鄰近岸坡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口局部損失與堵塞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An entrance redistributes river flow into a tunnel or channel, with losses controlled by more than area. Debris changes contraction and effective opening, increasing velocity and amplifying losses nonlinearly as capacity declines. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume entrance velocity 3 m/s and loss coefficient 0.5, giving loss 0.2294 m. At constant discharge, twenty-percent area reduction raises velocity to 3.75 m/s and loss by 56.25 percent if K is unchanged. Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Entrance loss and obstruction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口局部損失與堵塞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Entrance loss and obstruction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞
knowledge.text: 入口把河道動能重新分配到隧洞或渠道，局部損失不只由截面大小決定。漂流物改變收縮和有效面積，速度增加又會放大損失，形成非線性的能力下降。
knowledge.textEn: An entrance redistributes river flow into a tunnel or channel, with losses controlled by more than area. Debris changes contraction and effective opening, increasing velocity and amplifying losses nonlinearly as capacity declines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入口局部損失與堵塞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Entrance loss and obstruction" is correct?
options: 入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。
入口把河道動能重新分配到隧洞或渠道，局部損失不只由截面大小決定。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
optionsEn: Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent.
An entrance redistributes river flow into a tunnel or channel, with losses controlled by more than area.
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.
quiz.explanation: 入口把河道動能重新分配到隧洞或渠道，局部損失不只由截面大小決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An entrance redistributes river flow into a tunnel or channel, with losses controlled by more than area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Entrance loss and obstruction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口局部損失與堵塞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Entrance loss and obstruction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設原入口流速3 m/s、損失係數K=0.5，局部損失Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；同流量下有效面積減20%，速度3.75 m/s，若K不變損失增56.25%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume entrance velocity 3 m/s and loss coefficient 0.5, giving loss 0.2294 m. At constant discharge, twenty-percent area reduction raises velocity to 3.75 m/s and loss by 56.25 percent if K is unchanged. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設原入口流速3 m/s、損失係數K=0.5，局部損失Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m；同流量下有效面積減20%，速度3.75 m/s，若K不變損失增56.25%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume entrance velocity 3 m/s and loss coefficient 0.5, giving loss 0.2294 m. At constant discharge, twenty-percent area reduction raises velocity to 3.75 m/s and loss by 56.25 percent if K is unchanged.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「入口局部損失與堵塞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Entrance loss and obstruction", which statement holds?
options: 截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged.
Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Entrance loss and obstruction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口局部損失與堵塞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Entrance loss and obstruction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以入口局部損失與堵塞編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for entrance loss and obstruction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以入口局部損失與堵塞編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。檢查堵塞圖樣是否改變旋渦位置。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for entrance loss and obstruction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Compare different blockage patterns rather than total area alone, identifying asymmetric flow, vortices and air entrainment. Check whether blockage patterns shift vortex locations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入口局部損失與堵塞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Entrance loss and obstruction"?
options: 以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
optionsEn: Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
quiz.explanation: 以入口上下游水位及局部流速重建能量差，記錄漂流物覆蓋比例和入流角度；用不同堵塞圖樣比較損失，而非只用總堵塞面積，確認是否出現偏流、旋渦與空氣捲入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct head loss from upstream and downstream levels and local velocity, recording debris coverage and approach angle. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 入口局部損失與堵塞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Entrance loss and obstruction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口局部損失與堵塞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Entrance loss and obstruction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。偏流造成單側壓力與沖刷，即使總流量尚可，也可能已影響入口結構或鄰近岸坡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偏流造成單側壓力與沖刷，即使總流量尚可，也可能已影響入口結構或鄰近岸坡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。偏流造成單側壓力與沖刷，即使總流量尚可，也可能已影響入口結構或鄰近岸坡。
knowledge.textEn: Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. Asymmetric flow creates one-sided pressure and scour even while total discharge appears adequate, affecting the entrance and adjacent banks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入口局部損失與堵塞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Entrance loss and obstruction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration.
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.
quiz.explanation: 漂流物會同時改變K與面積，固定係數估算可能低估實際損失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris changes both loss coefficient and area, so a fixed coefficient can understate deterioration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」與「收縮流與沖刷相似」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cofferdam base uplift" and "Contraction flow and scour similarity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cofferdam base uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cofferdam base uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰暫時擋水不代表可忽略滲流，基底孔壓會降低有效法向力並影響抗滑。簡化三角揚壓只適用所列邊界，排水、截水和分層地基會改變實際分布。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米堰長底寬12 m、上游水頭8 m、下游0 m且線性衰減，揚力0.5×9.81×8×12=470.88 kN/m；堰重900 kN/m則有效重429.12 kN/m。 停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。若將堰體自重全部當摩擦法向力，會高估可動用抗滑能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary cofferdams still experience seepage, and base pressure reduces effective normal force and sliding resistance. A triangular uplift diagram applies only to stated boundaries; drains, cutoffs and layered foundations alter the actual distribution. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume twelve-metre base, upstream head eight metres, zero downstream head and linear decline. Uplift is 470.88 kN/m; weight 900 kN/m leaves effective normal weight 429.12 kN/m before other forces. Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. Treating total cofferdam weight as frictional normal force overestimates resistance because uplift reduces effective contact loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cofferdam base uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cofferdam base uplift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用
knowledge.text: 圍堰暫時擋水不代表可忽略滲流，基底孔壓會降低有效法向力並影響抗滑。簡化三角揚壓只適用所列邊界，排水、截水和分層地基會改變實際分布。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary cofferdams still experience seepage, and base pressure reduces effective normal force and sliding resistance. A triangular uplift diagram applies only to stated boundaries; drains, cutoffs and layered foundations alter the actual distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cofferdam base uplift" is correct?
options: 圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
圍堰暫時擋水不代表可忽略滲流，基底孔壓會降低有效法向力並影響抗滑。
optionsEn: Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Temporary cofferdams still experience seepage, and base pressure reduces effective normal force and sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 圍堰暫時擋水不代表可忽略滲流，基底孔壓會降低有效法向力並影響抗滑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary cofferdams still experience seepage, and base pressure reduces effective normal force and sliding resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cofferdam base uplift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cofferdam base uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米堰長底寬12 m、上游水頭8 m、下游0 m且線性衰減，揚力0.5×9.81×8×12=470.88 kN/m；堰重900 kN/m則有效重429.12 kN/m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume twelve-metre base, upstream head eight metres, zero downstream head and linear decline. Uplift is 470.88 kN/m; weight 900 kN/m leaves effective normal weight 429.12 kN/m before other forces. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米堰長底寬12 m、上游水頭8 m、下游0 m且線性衰減，揚力0.5×9.81×8×12=470.88 kN/m；堰重900 kN/m則有效重429.12 kN/m。

Assume twelve-metre base, upstream head eight metres, zero downstream head and linear decline. Uplift is 470.88 kN/m; weight 900 kN/m leaves effective normal weight 429.12 kN/m before other forces.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。

Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume.
Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cofferdam base uplift: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cofferdam base uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes. Integrate measurements against the assumed triangle and assess exit gradient and turbidity separately so sliding and internal erosion are not treated as one mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以圍堰底部的揚壓作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cofferdam base uplift, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes. Integrate measurements against the assumed triangle and assess exit gradient and turbidity separately so sliding and internal erosion are not treated as one mechanism.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。

Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes. Integrate measurements against the assumed triangle and assess exit gradient and turbidity separately so sliding and internal erosion are not treated as one mechanism.

quiz.question: 要驗證「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cofferdam base uplift"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。
導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes.
Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
quiz.explanation: 沿基底和出口配置對應剖面的水頭觀測，核對尾水與抽排水位變化；把量測分布積分後與假設三角圖比較，另查出口梯度和濁度，避免把抗滑與內部侵蝕問題混為一項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe heads along the base and exit section, checking tailwater and pumping changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 圍堰底部的揚壓作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cofferdam base uplift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cofferdam base uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。若將堰體自重全部當摩擦法向力，會高估可動用抗滑能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. Treating total cofferdam weight as frictional normal force overestimates resistance because uplift reduces effective contact loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將堰體自重全部當摩擦法向力，會高估可動用抗滑能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating total cofferdam weight as frictional normal force overestimates resistance because uplift reduces effective contact loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。若將堰體自重全部當摩擦法向力，會高估可動用抗滑能力。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. Treating total cofferdam weight as frictional normal force overestimates resistance because uplift reduces effective contact loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「圍堰底部的揚壓作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cofferdam base uplift" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages.
quiz.explanation: 停抽後孔壓可能比外水位變動更快影響穩定，基底局部高壓也會被平均值掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure after pumping interruption can quickly change stability, and local high pressures disappear in averages. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contraction flow and scour similarity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收縮流與沖刷相似」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contraction flow and scour similarity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導流造成的急流與回流會重新分配河床剪力，水深弗勞德數只能描述重力慣性比例。沖刷還取決於顆粒、尾水與流況歷程，不能只憑一個無因次數直接推定深度。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設局部流速5 m/s、水深2 m，Fr=v/sqrt(gy)=1.129；教學自由水面尺度，未給粒徑與持續時間，因此不推算沖刷深度。 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。以某一瞬間無明顯變化判定穩定，可能忽略長時間淘刷或洪水退水期的破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收縮流與沖刷相似」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion-induced jets and recirculation redistribute bed stress. Depth Froude number describes inertia relative to gravity, while scour also depends on sediment, tailwater and duration and cannot be predicted from one dimensionless number alone. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume local velocity 5 m/s and depth 2 m. Froude number is 1.129 for a free-surface scale; sediment size and duration are unspecified, so scour depth is not inferred. Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge. Apparent short-term stability does not exclude cumulative erosion or failure during recession when support and hydraulic conditions change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contraction flow and scour similarity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收縮流與沖刷相似」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contraction flow and scour similarity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似
knowledge.text: 導流造成的急流與回流會重新分配河床剪力，水深弗勞德數只能描述重力慣性比例。沖刷還取決於顆粒、尾水與流況歷程，不能只憑一個無因次數直接推定深度。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion-induced jets and recirculation redistribute bed stress. Depth Froude number describes inertia relative to gravity, while scour also depends on sediment, tailwater and duration and cannot be predicted from one dimensionless number alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收縮流與沖刷相似」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contraction flow and scour similarity" is correct?
options: 導流造成的急流與回流會重新分配河床剪力，水深弗勞德數只能描述重力慣性比例。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
optionsEn: Diversion-induced jets and recirculation redistribute bed stress.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 導流造成的急流與回流會重新分配河床剪力，水深弗勞德數只能描述重力慣性比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diversion-induced jets and recirculation redistribute bed stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contraction flow and scour similarity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收縮流與沖刷相似」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contraction flow and scour similarity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設局部流速5 m/s、水深2 m，Fr=v/sqrt(gy)=1.129；教學自由水面尺度，未給粒徑與持續時間，因此不推算沖刷深度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume local velocity 5 m/s and depth 2 m. Froude number is 1.129 for a free-surface scale; sediment size and duration are unspecified, so scour depth is not inferred. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設局部流速5 m/s、水深2 m，Fr=v/sqrt(gy)=1.129；教學自由水面尺度，未給粒徑與持續時間，因此不推算沖刷深度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume local velocity 5 m/s and depth 2 m. Froude number is 1.129 for a free-surface scale; sediment size and duration are unspecified, so scour depth is not inferred.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收縮流與沖刷相似」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Contraction flow and scour similarity", which statement holds?
options: 基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
optionsEn: Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Contraction flow and scour similarity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收縮流與沖刷相似」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contraction flow and scour similarity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation. In models, document sediment and viscous scale effects beyond Froude similarity and examine whether protection edges become new scour concentration points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以收縮流與沖刷相似編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for contraction flow and scour similarity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation. In models, document sediment and viscous scale effects beyond Froude similarity and examine whether protection edges become new scour concentration points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。
knowledge.textEn: Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation. In models, document sediment and viscous scale effects beyond Froude similarity and examine whether protection edges become new scour concentration points.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for contraction flow and scour similarity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation. quiz.question: 要驗證「收縮流與沖刷相似」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Contraction flow and scour similarity"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation.
quiz.explanation: 將床面測量與流速、尾水時序對齊，分辨局部沖刷與整體河床下降；模型試驗除弗勞德相似外還需列粒徑與黏性尺度差異，查核護底邊緣是否成為新的沖刷集中點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align bed surveys with velocity and tailwater histories, separating local scour from general degradation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收縮流與沖刷相似：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contraction flow and scour similarity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收縮流與沖刷相似」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contraction flow and scour similarity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。以某一瞬間無明顯變化判定穩定，可能忽略長時間淘刷或洪水退水期的破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge. Apparent short-term stability does not exclude cumulative erosion or failure during recession when support and hydraulic conditions change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以某一瞬間無明顯變化判定穩定，可能忽略長時間淘刷或洪水退水期的破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Apparent short-term stability does not exclude cumulative erosion or failure during recession when support and hydraulic conditions change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。以某一瞬間無明顯變化判定穩定，可能忽略長時間淘刷或洪水退水期的破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge. Apparent short-term stability does not exclude cumulative erosion or failure during recession when support and hydraulic conditions change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收縮流與沖刷相似」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Contraction flow and scour similarity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
optionsEn: Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 平均斷面流速可能漏掉貼岸高速射流，護底本身又會把沖刷轉移到末端。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Section-average velocity misses bank-attached jets, while protection can shift scour to its downstream edge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「截流缺口的流速放大」與「洪峰暫存與水位上升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure-gap velocity amplification" and "Flood storage and stage rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 截流缺口的流速放大：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure-gap velocity amplification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「截流缺口的流速放大」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure-gap velocity amplification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 截流過程使剩餘缺口逐步縮小，局部流速和水面差會隨分流比例共同變動。固定流量除面積可示範敏感性，但實際河水可能轉入導流通道或上游暫存。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設瞬間缺口流量120 m³/s、水深4 m、寬由12降至8 m且分流暫不變，平均速度由2.5增至3.75 m/s；動能水頭由0.3186增至0.7167 m。 缺口縮窄也會抬高水頭並改變導流分配，流速未必按面積倒數持續上升。只使用上一階段的水深與流量，可能低估局部射流、床面變形和材料受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「截流缺口的流速放大」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Closure progressively narrows the remaining gap, changing velocity and head difference together with flow partition. Constant discharge divided by area illustrates sensitivity, while actual water may shift into diversion works or upstream storage. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume instantaneous gap flow 120 m³/s at depth four metres and width reducing from twelve to eight metres without repartition. Mean velocity rises from 2.5 to 3.75 m/s and velocity head from 0.3186 to 0.7167 m. Narrowing raises head and changes diversion partition, so velocity need not continue increasing inversely with area. Reusing previous-stage depth and flow can misrepresent local jets, bed changes and forces on closure materials. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closure-gap velocity amplification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「截流缺口的流速放大」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closure-gap velocity amplification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 截流缺口的流速放大
knowledge.text: 截流過程使剩餘缺口逐步縮小，局部流速和水面差會隨分流比例共同變動。固定流量除面積可示範敏感性，但實際河水可能轉入導流通道或上游暫存。
knowledge.textEn: Closure progressively narrows the remaining gap, changing velocity and head difference together with flow partition. Constant discharge divided by area illustrates sensitivity, while actual water may shift into diversion works or upstream storage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「截流缺口的流速放大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure-gap velocity amplification" is correct?
options: 截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
截流過程使剩餘缺口逐步縮小，局部流速和水面差會隨分流比例共同變動。

steps.title: 截流缺口的流速放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure-gap velocity amplification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「截流缺口的流速放大」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure-gap velocity amplification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設瞬間缺口流量120 m³/s、水深4 m、寬由12降至8 m且分流暫不變，平均速度由2.5增至3.75 m/s；動能水頭由0.3186增至0.7167 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume instantaneous gap flow 120 m³/s at depth four metres and width reducing from twelve to eight metres without repartition. Mean velocity rises from 2.5 to 3.75 m/s and velocity head from 0.3186 to 0.7167 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步測主河道、缺口和導流口流量以閉合分流收支，配對上游水位變化核對暫存；把各施工階段幾何輸入非恆定模型，檢查固定流量近似在哪些時段失效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure main-river, gap and diversion discharges simultaneously and compare upstream storage change to close partitioned flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 截流缺口的流速放大：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「截流缺口的流速放大」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure-gap velocity amplification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺口縮窄也會抬高水頭並改變導流分配，流速未必按面積倒數持續上升。只使用上一階段的水深與流量，可能低估局部射流、床面變形和材料受力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Narrowing raises head and changes diversion partition, so velocity need not continue increasing inversely with area. Reusing previous-stage depth and flow can misrepresent local jets, bed changes and forces on closure materials. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只使用上一階段的水深與流量，可能低估局部射流、床面變形和材料受力。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume.

steps.title: 洪峰暫存與水位上升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood storage and stage rise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪峰暫存與水位上升」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flood storage and stage rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導流設施的瞬時出流小於洪峰時，差額會累積在上游暫存區。容量檢核需積分整個超額歷線，不能只比較洪峰差，也不能假定所有可見河谷空間都可用於儲洪。 假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³；若有效面積120000 m²恆定，水位升1.8 m。 出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。洪水期間地形被沖淤改變也會改寫容量，不能把一次測量曲線當作永遠有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪峰暫存與水位上升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When diversion outflow falls below inflow, excess accumulates upstream. Storage checks integrate the full excess hydrograph rather than peak difference alone and cannot assume all visible valley space is available flood storage. Assume triangular excess flow lasting two hours and peaking at 60 m³/s. Required storage is 216000 m³; constant effective surface area 120000 m² gives stage rise 1.8 m, excluding changing outlet capacity. Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. Erosion and deposition can also alter storage during a flood, so one surveyed relation is not permanently valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flood storage and stage rise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³；若有效面積120000 m²恆定，水位升1.8 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular excess flow lasting two hours and peaking at 60 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪峰暫存與水位上升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flood storage and stage rise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 洪峰暫存與水位上升
knowledge.text: 導流設施的瞬時出流小於洪峰時，差額會累積在上游暫存區。容量檢核需積分整個超額歷線，不能只比較洪峰差，也不能假定所有可見河谷空間都可用於儲洪。
knowledge.textEn: When diversion outflow falls below inflow, excess accumulates upstream. Storage checks integrate the full excess hydrograph rather than peak difference alone and cannot assume all visible valley space is available flood storage.

knowledge.text: 誤解：洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪峰暫存與水位上升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood storage and stage rise" is correct?
options: 洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。
基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
導流設施的瞬時出流小於洪峰時，差額會累積在上游暫存區。
optionsEn: Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume.
Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
When diversion outflow falls below inflow, excess accumulates upstream.

steps.observation: 如何核對：用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³；若有效面積120000 m²恆定，水位升1.8 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular excess flow lasting two hours and peaking at 60 m³/s. Required storage is 216000 m³; constant effective surface area 120000 m² gives stage rise 1.8 m, excluding changing outlet capacity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪峰暫存與水位上升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flood storage and stage rise", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular excess flow lasting two hours and peaking at 60 m³/s.
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設超過導流能力的流量歷線為底寬2 h、峰值60 m³/s三角形，所需暫存0.5×7200×60=216000 m³；若有效面積120000 m²恆定，水位升1.8 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular excess flow lasting two hours and peaking at 60 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪峰暫存與水位上升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood storage and stage rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洪峰暫存與水位上升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flood storage and stage rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。比較線性與非線性庫容曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation. Overlay downstream backwater and vulnerable facilities on elevations, verifying that usable storage is not merely an unoccupied geometric volume. Compare linear and nonlinear stage-storage representations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以洪峰暫存與水位上升編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。比較線性與非線性庫容曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for flood storage and stage rise, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation. Overlay downstream backwater and vulnerable facilities on elevations, verifying that usable storage is not merely an unoccupied geometric volume. Compare linear and nonlinear stage-storage representations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。比較線性與非線性庫容曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation. Overlay downstream backwater and vulnerable facilities on elevations, verifying that usable storage is not merely an unoccupied geometric volume. Compare linear and nonlinear stage-storage representations.
