knowledge.text: 以洪峰暫存與水位上升編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。比較線性與非線性庫容曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for flood storage and stage rise, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation. Overlay downstream backwater and vulnerable facilities on elevations, verifying that usable storage is not merely an unoccupied geometric volume. Compare linear and nonlinear stage-storage representations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪峰暫存與水位上升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flood storage and stage rise"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation.
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.
quiz.explanation: 用連續方程逐時段核對入流、出流與水位容積曲線，改變時間步長檢查數值守恆；將下游回水與淹沒敏感設施疊入高程圖，確認可用暫存不是單純地形空間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check inflow, outflow and stage-storage through time and vary timestep to test numerical conservation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪峰暫存與水位上升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood storage and stage rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洪峰暫存與水位上升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flood storage and stage rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。洪水期間地形被沖淤改變也會改寫容量，不能把一次測量曲線當作永遠有效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. Erosion and deposition can also alter storage during a flood, so one surveyed relation is not permanently valid. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：洪水期間地形被沖淤改變也會改寫容量，不能把一次測量曲線當作永遠有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Erosion and deposition can also alter storage during a flood, so one surveyed relation is not permanently valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「洪峰流量減去導流能力的差值，就是洪水所需的暫存體積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Peak inflow minus diversion capacity directly equals the required flood-storage volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。洪水期間地形被沖淤改變也會改寫容量，不能把一次測量曲線當作永遠有效。
knowledge.textEn: Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. Erosion and deposition can also alter storage during a flood, so one surveyed relation is not permanently valid.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪峰暫存與水位上升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flood storage and stage rise" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative.
quiz.explanation: 出流能力通常隨水位上升改變，固定能力三角示例可能高估或低估暫存。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outflow capacity usually changes with stage, making the fixed-capacity triangle potentially conservative or unconservative. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基坑降水與滲流供給」與「導流切換與關鍵工期」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply" and "Diversion transitions and critical duration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation dewatering and seepage supply: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基坑降水與滲流供給」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圍堰內基坑降水會增加外側水體的水頭差，抽水需求可能隨開挖深度增加。達西估算提供連續介質量級，但岩體裂隙、各向異性與河床補注需要專門辨認。 假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基坑降水與滲流供給」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dewatering inside a cofferdam increases head difference from the river, so pumping demand can grow with excavation depth. Darcy estimates provide a continuum scale, while fractures, anisotropy and riverbed recharge require distinct evidence. Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres. One-dimensional steady Darcy flow is 0.003 m³/s or three litres per second, excluding concentrated fractures. Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基坑降水與滲流供給」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給
knowledge.text: 圍堰內基坑降水會增加外側水體的水頭差，抽水需求可能隨開挖深度增加。達西估算提供連續介質量級，但岩體裂隙、各向異性與河床補注需要專門辨認。
knowledge.textEn: Dewatering inside a cofferdam increases head difference from the river, so pumping demand can grow with excavation depth. Darcy estimates provide a continuum scale, while fractures, anisotropy and riverbed recharge require distinct evidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基坑降水與滲流供給」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply" is correct?
options: 圍堰內基坑降水會增加外側水體的水頭差，抽水需求可能隨開挖深度增加。
基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。
兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。
optionsEn: Dewatering inside a cofferdam increases head difference from the river, so pumping demand can grow with excavation depth.
Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation.
Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints.
quiz.explanation: 圍堰內基坑降水會增加外側水體的水頭差，抽水需求可能隨開挖深度增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dewatering inside a cofferdam increases head difference from the river, so pumping demand can grow with excavation depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation dewatering and seepage supply: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基坑降水與滲流供給」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres. One-dimensional steady Darcy flow is 0.003 m³/s or three litres per second, excluding concentrated fractures. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres. One-dimensional steady Darcy flow is 0.003 m³/s or three litres per second, excluding concentrated fractures.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基坑降水與滲流供給」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply", which statement holds?
options: 導流明渠只要開挖面積相同，就一定具有相同的過流能力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s。
入口有效面積減少百分之二十，水頭損失也一定只增加百分之二十。
optionsEn: Diversion channels with equal excavated area necessarily have identical flow capacity.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres.
Reducing entrance area by twenty percent always raises head loss by only twenty percent.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等效透水係數2×10⁻⁵ m/s、過流面積300 m²、水頭差10 m、路徑20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=0.003 m³/s即3 L/s；一維穩態且無集中裂隙。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equivalent permeability 2×10⁻⁵ m/s, area 300 m², head difference ten metres and path twenty metres. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation dewatering and seepage supply: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基坑降水與滲流供給」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。查核集水管是否混入地表逕流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge. Account separately for rainfall, process water and groundwater, recording turbidity to identify possible particle transport. Check surface-runoff entry into the collection system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以基坑降水與滲流供給編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。查核集水管是否混入地表逕流。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for excavation dewatering and seepage supply, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge. Account separately for rainfall, process water and groundwater, recording turbidity to identify possible particle transport. Check surface-runoff entry into the collection system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。查核集水管是否混入地表逕流。

quiz.question: 要驗證「基坑降水與滲流供給」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge.
quiz.explanation: 以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation dewatering and seepage supply: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基坑降水與滲流供給」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。
knowledge.textEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基坑降水與滲流供給」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。
optionsEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints.
quiz.explanation: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion transitions and critical duration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導流切換與關鍵工期」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion transitions and critical duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。關鍵路徑需表示真正的前置關係，並與可回復狀態和監測交接共同審查。 假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導流切換與關鍵工期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. Critical paths must represent actual dependencies and be reviewed with recoverable states and monitoring handover requirements. Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days. Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion transitions and critical duration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導流切換與關鍵工期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion transitions and critical duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期
knowledge.text: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。關鍵路徑需表示真正的前置關係，並與可回復狀態和監測交接共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. Critical paths must represent actual dependencies and be reviewed with recoverable states and monitoring handover requirements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導流切換與關鍵工期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion transitions and critical duration" is correct?
options: 兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。
導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
optionsEn: Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints.
Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season.
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
quiz.explanation: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion transitions and critical duration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導流切換與關鍵工期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion transitions and critical duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days.

quiz.question: 依「導流切換與關鍵工期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diversion transitions and critical duration", which statement holds?
options: 導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days。
optionsEn: Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。把共用設備占用列入排程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work. steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導流切換與關鍵工期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion transitions and critical duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導流切換與關鍵工期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically.
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.

title: 大型弧形閘門安裝
summary: 本課以以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門為主線，先用曲面水壓與水平力與曲面垂直分量界定水力與構造條件，再將吊索角度與張力、支臂長細與屈曲連結到同步行程與試運轉。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning through Curved pressure and horizontal force and Vertical pressure component, then connects Sling angle and tension and Arm slenderness and buckling to Synchronized travel and commissioning. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查曲面水壓與水平力：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN；再獨立檢查曲面垂直分量：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。敏感度：相同矩形投影寬度8m下，水深由6增至7m時水平靜水力由1412.64增至1922.76kN，增加36.11%；荷載按水深平方成長，不能用水位增加百分比直接放大全部構件反力。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 將核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Curved pressure and horizontal force: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. Independently examine Vertical pressure component: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. Sensitivity: for an8m-wide rectangular projection, raising depth from6 to7m increases horizontal hydrostatic force from1412.64 to1922.76kN, or36.11 percent. This quadratic change does not imply the same factor for every component reaction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Use the following independent check: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲面水壓與水平力」與「曲面垂直分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curved pressure and horizontal force" and "Vertical pressure component": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面水壓與水平力」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curved pressure and horizontal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。 驗證時應核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，並辨識以下失效情境：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面水壓與水平力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component follows the vertical projection, but weight, friction and eccentricity still create moments that depend on installed geometry. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curved pressure and horizontal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面水壓與水平力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curved pressure and horizontal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲面水壓與水平力
knowledge.text: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面水壓與水平力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Curved pressure and horizontal force" is correct?
options: 理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩
弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。
曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力
optionsEn: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment
Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion.
Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force
quiz.explanation: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面水壓與水平力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙鉸軸同軸量測」與「軸承摩擦與啟閉」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trunnion coaxiality surveying" and "Bearing friction and operation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trunnion coaxiality surveying: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙鉸軸同軸量測」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右鉸軸需要符合設計同軸與高程條件，偏差會使支臂扭曲並增加軸承摩擦。兩端高差除跨度只是小角度幾何示意，不代表完整三維同軸誤差；還需量測軸線方向、支座位置與溫度變化後的相對移動。 驗證時應以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙鉸軸同軸量測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Both trunnions must satisfy alignment and elevation requirements. Misalignment twists arms and raises bearing friction. End-height difference divided by span illustrates one small-angle component, not full three-dimensional coaxiality; also survey axis orientation, support positions and temperature-dependent relative movement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙鉸軸同軸量測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trunnion coaxiality surveying”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instructionEn: Rising friction can introduce additional bending into primarily compressed arms. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare motor current at breakaway and steady travel with bearing temperature rise. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Constant bearing reaction guarantees constant friction torque" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 吊索角度與張力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「吊索角度與張力」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sling angle and tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 門葉組裝吊運需依實際重心配置吊點，斜索張力會隨索角變小而增加。對稱兩索公式只適用靜態對稱分載，重心偏移、動態放大與吊具剛度需另列；教學幾何不能取代核准吊裝計畫與現場試吊觀測。 驗證時應以吊點荷重讀值核對分載並確認重心與吊索角度，並辨識以下失效情境：重心偏移可讓單側吊索超出對稱分載估計。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊索角度與張力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Assembly lifting requires pick points compatible with the actual center of mass. Sling tension increases as inclination becomes shallow. The symmetric two-sling equation assumes static equal sharing; eccentricity, dynamics and rigging stiffness require separate allowances and an approved lifting plan with observed load behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check sharing with pick-point load readings and confirm center of mass and sling angles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An offset center of mass can overload one sling relative to symmetric sharing. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sling angle and tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN.

steps.title: 吊索角度與張力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊索角度與張力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sling angle and tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: totalWeight=400 kN; two symmetric slings60 degrees above horizontal; eachTension=400/(2*sin(60 degrees))=230.940 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以吊點荷重讀值核對分載並確認重心與吊索角度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sharing with pick-point load readings and confirm center of mass and sling angles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。平均分載只能作帳務起點；灌漿空洞、預緊差異與裂縫會改變接觸及荷載路徑，須配合局部模型與檢測。 驗證時應核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載，並辨識以下失效情境：底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支座錨定與分載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. Eccentricity and plate flexibility generally make bolt forces unequal. Equal sharing is only a bookkeeping start; grout voids, preload variation and cracking alter contact and load paths and need local analysis and inspection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Local baseplate separation concentrates tension in a few anchors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support anchorage and load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support anchorage and load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支座錨定與分載
knowledge.text: 鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。平均分載只能作帳務起點；灌漿空洞、預緊差異與裂縫會改變接觸及荷載路徑，須配合局部模型與檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. Eccentricity and plate flexibility generally make bolt forces unequal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total tension divided by anchor count equals every anchor maximum Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支座錨定與分載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。
optionsEn: Total tension divided by anchor count equals every anchor maximum
More seal compression is always better and has no adverse effect
Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete.

quiz.explanationEn: Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支座錨定與分載：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支座錨定與分載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support anchorage and load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 支座錨定與分載：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支座錨定與分載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Local baseplate separation concentrates tension in a few anchors. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 支座錨定與分載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support anchorage and load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支座錨定與分載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support anchorage and load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local baseplate separation concentrates tension in a few anchors. Diagnose it by the following check: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

steps.title: 側封壓縮與摩擦：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「側封壓縮與摩擦」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Side-seal compression and friction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側封須在門葉運動範圍維持接觸，過少壓縮會漏水，過多則增加摩擦與磨耗。壓縮百分比是幾何量，不是接觸壓力的通用換算式；橡膠硬度、溫度與支承形狀需按供應商資料及實際接觸試驗確認。 驗證時應沿全行程量測封面接觸與啟閉阻力並定位滲漏，並辨識以下失效情境：偏斜門葉可使一側過壓縮而另一側失去密封。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側封壓縮與摩擦」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Side seals need contact throughout travel. Too little compression leaks, while too much raises friction and wear. Compression percentage is geometry rather than a universal contact-pressure law; elastomer hardness, temperature and support shape require supplier information and representative contact testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure seal contact and operating resistance throughout travel and locate leakage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A skewed gate can overcompress one seal while unloading the other. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Side-seal compression and friction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent.

Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側封壓縮與摩擦」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Side-seal compression and friction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏斜門葉可使一側過壓縮而另一側失去密封。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿全行程量測封面接觸與啟閉阻力並定位滲漏，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A skewed gate can overcompress one seal while unloading the other. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure seal contact and operating resistance throughout travel and locate leakage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水壓縮越多就必定越好且沒有代價」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More seal compression is always better and has no adverse effect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「同步行程與試運轉」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synchronized travel and commissioning” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙側啟閉機不同步會造成門葉扭轉與封面不均，試運轉需逐工況核對行程、負荷與停留位置。兩側位移差除跨距僅是小角度扭斜指標；最終判定還需軸承、支臂與密封反應，不能只依位置訊號相近。 驗證時應同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持，並辨識以下失效情境：位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「同步行程與試運轉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized drives skew the leaf and seals. Commissioning must compare travel, load and stopping positions across operating states. Differential travel divided by span is only a small-angle skew indicator; acceptance also requires bearing, arm and seal response rather than nearly equal position signals alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Synchronized travel and commissioning” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal side-position readings guarantee equal loads on both sides" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「同步行程與試運轉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Synchronized travel and commissioning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal side-position readings guarantee equal loads on both sides Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「同步行程與試運轉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同
雙側啟閉機不同步會造成門葉扭轉與封面不均，試運轉需逐工況核對行程、負荷與停留位置。

Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment

兩根吊索不論角度都各承受總重的一半

Two slings each carry half the weight regardless of angle

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「同步行程與試運轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Synchronized travel and commissioning” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「同步行程與試運轉」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Synchronized travel and commissioning"?
options: 同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
理想歐拉屈曲力就是現場支臂可直接承受荷載
optionsEn: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Ideal Euler load is the directly usable field capacity of the arm
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同步行程與試運轉」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Synchronized travel and commissioning” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Diagnose it by the following check: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal side-position readings guarantee equal loads on both sides" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Diagnose it by the following check: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同步行程與試運轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Synchronized travel and commissioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。
理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds.
Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment
quiz.explanation: 位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 升降式水閘門吊裝
summary: 本課以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為主線，先用矩形門葉靜水力與水壓中心與輪載界定水力與構造條件，再將上提力與水動力、鋼索彈性與行程連結到洩量率定與交接。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks through Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force and Pressure center and wheel reactions, then connects Hoisting force and hydraulic load and Rope elasticity and travel to Discharge rating and handover. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查矩形門葉靜水力：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN；再獨立檢查水壓中心與輪載：Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m。敏感度：輪載600kN不變而滾動阻力係數由0.01增為0.03，阻力由6增至18kN；此增量應連結實測輪軸狀態，不能把所有阻力都以同一固定係數涵蓋。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 將定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. Independently examine Pressure center and wheel reactions: Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m. Sensitivity: for a600kN wheel load, increasing the rolling-resistance coefficient from0.01 to0.03 raises resistance from6 to18kN. Relate this change to observed wheel conditions instead of assigning one coefficient to every resistance mechanism. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Use the following independent check: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「矩形門葉靜水力」與「水壓中心與輪載」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" and "Pressure center and wheel reactions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「矩形門葉靜水力」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。 驗證時應核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「矩形門葉靜水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case. With water on both sides or partial immersion, integrate each pressure field and obtain the net action instead of using full upstream load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「矩形門葉靜水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 矩形門葉靜水力
knowledge.text: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「矩形門葉靜水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" is correct?
options: 上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力
平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。
水壓合力一定作用在幾何中心深度
optionsEn: Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf
Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides.
The hydrostatic resultant always acts at geometric middepth
quiz.explanation: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「矩形門葉靜水力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements.

steps.instruction: 量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 水壓中心與輪載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure center and wheel reactions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水壓中心與輪載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure center and wheel reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 部分輪懸空會把原本均分的反力集中到接觸輪。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測輪組位置及接觸狀態並以力矩平衡核對反力，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unloaded wheel transfers its intended share to the wheels still in contact. Diagnose it by the following check: Survey wheel positions and contact and reconcile reactions through moment equilibrium. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水壓合力一定作用在幾何中心深度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The hydrostatic resultant always acts at geometric middepth" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
