quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力保持與量測誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure holding and measurement error"?
options: 核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任何粗糙接縫都完全遵守光滑平行板立方律
optionsEn: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every rough joint exactly follows the smooth parallel-plate cubic law
quiz.explanation: 核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力保持與量測誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure holding and measurement error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力保持與量測誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure holding and measurement error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力下降就必定表示相同量的水已漏出」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A pressure drop necessarily means a corresponding amount of water has leaked" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力保持與量測誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure holding and measurement error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。
附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage.
Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location
quiz.explanation: 溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 水庫排砂隧道
summary: 本課以以分流輸砂磨耗與下游銜接驗證排砂隧道為主線，先用分流比與庫區水量與懸砂質量通量界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降與行程時間、底板磨耗與厚度連結到水砂守恆與稽核。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection through Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow and Suspended sediment mass flux, then connects Settling and transit time and Invert abrasion and thickness to Water sediment conservation audit. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查分流比與庫區水量：incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40；再獨立檢查懸砂質量通量：bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s。敏感度：固定水量40m3/s時含砂質量濃度由3增至5kg/m3，輸砂率由120增至200kg/s，增加66.7%；並不表示相同百分比的河床載砂或磨耗，粗顆粒接觸需另分析。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。聚焦繞庫排砂而非任意沖刷壩基，輸砂與磨耗算例為分段簡化且需現地級配驗證。 將沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow: incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40. Independently examine Suspended sediment mass flux: bypassQ=40 m3/s; representativeSSC=3 kg/m3; suspendedFlux=40*3=120 kg/s. Sensitivity: at40m3/s, increasing mass concentration from3 to5kg/m3 raises suspended flux from120 to200kg/s, or66.7 percent. Bed load and abrasion do not necessarily increase by the same percentage because coarse-grain contact requires separate analysis. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. Use the following independent check: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分流比與庫區水量」與「懸砂質量通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow" and "Suspended sediment mass flux": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分流比與庫區水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分流比與庫區水量」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。水量分流比不等於泥砂分流比，因垂向與橫向濃度可能不均；應同時量測分流前後水量、懸砂與粗粒，避免只以閘門開度推估成效。 驗證時應同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流，並辨識以下失效情境：只看水量分流可能高估實際砂量攔截。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分流比與庫區水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream. Water diversion fraction is not sediment diversion fraction because concentration varies vertically and laterally. Measure water, suspended sediment and coarse material on both branches rather than inferring performance solely from gate position. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Water diversion alone can overstate sediment interception. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分流四成水就必定分走四成所有粒徑泥砂」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diverting forty percent of water diverts forty percent of every sediment size" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分流比與庫區水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分流比與庫區水量
knowledge.text: 繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。水量分流比不等於泥砂分流比，因垂向與橫向濃度可能不均；應同時量測分流前後水量、懸砂與粗粒，避免只以閘門開度推估成效。
knowledge.textEn: A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream. Water diversion fraction is not sediment diversion fraction because concentration varies vertically and laterally.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分流四成水就必定分走四成所有粒徑泥砂 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diverting forty percent of water diverts forty percent of every sediment size Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分流比與庫區水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow" is correct?
options: 分流四成水就必定分走四成所有粒徑泥砂
繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。
一瓶表層水樣能代表全部懸砂與床載
optionsEn: Diverting forty percent of water diverts forty percent of every sediment size
A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream.
One surface sample represents all suspended sediment and bed load
quiz.explanation: 繞庫隧道在上游分流含砂洪水，將部分水砂送至壩下而減少進庫沉積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A bypass diverts sediment-laden inflow upstream of the reservoir and reconnects downstream. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分流比與庫區水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分流比與庫區水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion ratio and reservoir inflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: incomingQ=100 m3/s; bypassQ=40 m3/s; waterDiversionFraction=40/100=0.40. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測主河與分流口水砂並核對庫區剩餘入流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure water and sediment simultaneously in both branches and reconcile residual reservoir inflow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「事件輸砂與效率」與「隧道自由水面輸送」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Event mass and bypass efficiency" and "Free-surface tunnel conveyance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 事件輸砂與效率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Event mass and bypass efficiency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「事件輸砂與效率」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Event mass and bypass efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 繞庫成效應按洪水事件積分輸砂質量，再與同事件進砂相比。只取峰值濃度乘總水量可能偏差很大，因濃度峰與流量峰未必同步；事件前後暫存砂量也應列入，才能區分真正繞庫與短期堆積。 驗證時應以同時間窗積分各支流水砂通量並調查分流前池淤積，並辨識以下失效情境：漏算分流前池暫存會把滯留砂誤當成功繞庫。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「事件輸砂與效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Evaluate bypass efficiency from event-integrated sediment mass relative to the same incoming event. Peak concentration times total water can be biased because peaks need not coincide. Include temporary storage changes to distinguish successful bypass from sediment merely retained near the intake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate branch fluxes over one window and survey intake-pool storage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring intake-pool storage misclassifies retained sediment as successful bypass. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Event mass and bypass efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：eventIncomingSediment=30000 t; measuredBypassedSediment=21000 t; eventEfficiency=21000/30000*100=70 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: eventIncomingSediment=30000 t; measuredBypassedSediment=21000 t; eventEfficiency=21000/30000*100=70 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洪峰瞬間效率就等於整場事件效率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Efficiency at the flood peak equals efficiency for the entire event" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「事件輸砂與效率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Event mass and bypass efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instructionEn: High-speed conveyance can reduce deposition, but free-surface and pressurized boundaries must be distinguished. Calculate mean velocity from actual wetted area rather than the excavated section. Aeration, bends and clearance above the flow also affect stable sediment transport and require separate checks. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check depth, velocity and aerated thickness along the tunnel and confirm free-surface clearance. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-surface tunnel conveyance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對沿程水深速度與含氣厚度並確認未碰頂滿流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. Diagnose it by the following check: Check depth, velocity and aerated thickness along the tunnel and confirm free-surface clearance. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隧道自由水面輸送」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-surface tunnel conveyance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用。
靜水沉降距離就等於高速隧道實際淤積厚度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure.
Still-water settling distance equals actual deposit thickness in a fast tunnel
quiz.explanation: 誤用開挖面積會低估流速與局部磨耗作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using excavation area understates velocity and local abrasion exposure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉降與行程時間」與「床面剪力與啟動」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settling and transit time" and "Bed shear and entrainment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉降與行程時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settling and transit time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉降與行程時間」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settling and transit time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。靜水沉降距離只示範兩種時間尺度，不能預測高速隧道的實際沉積；仍需粒徑分級及近床濃度觀測。 驗證時應比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉降與行程時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment. A still-water settling distance compares time scales but does not predict deposition in a turbulent bypass tunnel. Size fractions and near-bed observations remain necessary to establish transport behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settling and transit time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜水沉降距離就等於高速隧道實際淤積厚度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Still-water settling distance equals actual deposit thickness in a fast tunnel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉降與行程時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Settling and transit time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉降與行程時間
knowledge.text: 泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。靜水沉降距離只示範兩種時間尺度，不能預測高速隧道的實際沉積；仍需粒徑分級及近床濃度觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment. A still-water settling distance compares time scales but does not predict deposition in a turbulent bypass tunnel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靜水沉降距離就等於高速隧道實際淤積厚度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Still-water settling distance equals actual deposit thickness in a fast tunnel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉降與行程時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Settling and transit time" is correct?
options: 靜水沉降距離就等於高速隧道實際淤積厚度
單一希爾茲臨界值適用所有坡度與級配
泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。
optionsEn: Still-water settling distance equals actual deposit thickness in a fast tunnel
One critical Shields value applies to every slope and gradation
Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment.
quiz.explanation: 泥砂能否在輸送中沉降取決於沉速與停留時間，同時受紊流懸浮與床面再啟動影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposition depends on settling speed and residence time together with turbulent suspension and reentrainment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉降與行程時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settling and transit time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉降與行程時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settling and transit time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉降與行程時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Every sediment-budget residual represents unmeasured bed erosion
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: L=1200 m; meanV=8 m/s; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.01 m/s; settlingDistance=0.01*(1200/8)=1.50 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉降與行程時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Settling and transit time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉降與行程時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settling and transit time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較各粒徑沉速與流行時間並量測近床濃度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare size-specific settling speeds with transit time and measure near-bed concentration. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring turbulent suspension turns settling distance into a false deposition thickness. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略紊流再懸浮會把靜水沉降距離誤當實際淤厚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.title: 床面剪力與啟動：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bed shear and entrainment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「床面剪力與啟動」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bed shear and entrainment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。示意希爾茲數不能直接指定一個普遍啟動門檻；應以現地粒料與適用實驗比較，並分辨掃流與懸浮。 驗證時應核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「床面剪力與啟動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight. Roughness, hiding, slope and gradation alter the critical value, so an illustrative number does not establish a universal entrainment threshold. Compare representative sediment with suitable experiments and distinguish bed load from suspension. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bed shear and entrainment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：bedShear=20 Pa; sedimentDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; d=0.010 m; Shields=20/((2650-1000)*9.81*0.010)=0.123560。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: bedShear=20 Pa; sedimentDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; d=0.010 m; Shields=20/((2650-1000)*9.81*0.010)=0.123560.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一希爾茲臨界值適用所有坡度與級配」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One critical Shields value applies to every slope and gradation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「床面剪力與啟動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bed shear and entrainment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 床面剪力與啟動
knowledge.text: 床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。示意希爾茲數不能直接指定一個普遍啟動門檻；應以現地粒料與適用實驗比較，並分辨掃流與懸浮。
knowledge.textEn: A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight. Roughness, hiding, slope and gradation alter the critical value, so an illustrative number does not establish a universal entrainment threshold.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一希爾茲臨界值適用所有坡度與級配 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One critical Shields value applies to every slope and gradation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「床面剪力與啟動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bed shear and entrainment" is correct?
options: 床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。
單一希爾茲臨界值適用所有坡度與級配
歷史平均磨耗率保證未來每小時都相同
optionsEn: A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight.
One critical Shields value applies to every slope and gradation
Historical mean abrasion rate guarantees identical loss every future hour
quiz.explanation: 床面剪力與顆粒水下重量的比值可作啟動條件尺度，但粗糙、遮蔽、坡度與級配會改變臨界值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Shields parameter compares bed shear with submerged particle weight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 床面剪力與啟動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bed shear and entrainment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「床面剪力與啟動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bed shear and entrainment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：bedShear=20 Pa; sedimentDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; d=0.010 m; Shields=20/((2650-1000)*9.81*0.010)=0.123560。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: bedShear=20 Pa; sedimentDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; d=0.010 m; Shields=20/((2650-1000)*9.81*0.010)=0.123560. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：bedShear=20 Pa; sedimentDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; d=0.010 m; Shields=20/((2650-1000)*9.81*0.010)=0.123560。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 床面剪力與啟動：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bed shear and entrainment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「床面剪力與啟動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bed shear and entrainment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Address this scenario: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. steps.title: 床面剪力與啟動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bed shear and entrainment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「床面剪力與啟動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bed shear and entrainment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一希爾茲臨界值適用所有坡度與級配」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One critical Shields value applies to every slope and gradation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略粗粒遮蔽可能高估細粒實際輸移能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對床面剪力估法與粒徑級配並觀察顆粒啟動，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring hiding by coarse particles can overestimate transport of sheltered fines. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the shear estimate and gradation and observe particle entrainment. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「底板磨耗與厚度」與「出口混合與濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Invert abrasion and thickness" and "Outlet mixing and concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 底板磨耗與厚度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert abrasion and thickness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底板磨耗與厚度」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert abrasion and thickness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粗粒高速接觸底板會產生磨耗，其分布與流束集中、彎道及施工接縫有關。兩次測量差除以期間只給過去平均耗損率，不能自動預報未來壽命；材料改變、事件強度與裸露鋼筋都可能使速率改變。 驗證時應用固定基準重測磨耗圖並按流量與粒徑分組運轉時數，並辨識以下失效情境：用低含砂年度平均率外推高含砂洪水會低估損傷。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底板磨耗與厚度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-speed coarse particles abrade the invert, especially where jets, bends or joints concentrate contact. Survey difference divided by elapsed exposure gives a past average, not a future life prediction. Material changes, event intensity and reinforcement exposure can alter the rate after the observation period. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Repeat abrasion surveys on a fixed datum and group exposure by discharge and grain size. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extrapolating a low-sediment average into a coarse flood understates damage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert abrasion and thickness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outlet mixing and concentration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：bypassQ=40 m3/s at3 kg/m3; riverQ=60 m3/s at0.2 kg/m3; fullyMixedSSC=(40*3+60*0.2)/100=1.32 kg/m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: bypassQ=40 m3/s at3 kg/m3; riverQ=60 m3/s at0.2 kg/m3; fullyMixedSSC=(40*3+60*0.2)/100=1.32 kg/m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 出口混合與濃度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outlet mixing and concentration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口混合與濃度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outlet mixing and concentration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 出口混合與濃度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outlet mixing and concentration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出口混合與濃度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outlet mixing and concentration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. Diagnose it by the following check: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩股水濃度可以不管流量直接取平均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two stream concentrations can be averaged without considering their discharges" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿下游多斷面採樣並比較橫向混合與沉降變化，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Sample several downstream sections and compare lateral mixing and settling. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出口混合與濃度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outlet mixing and concentration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The water-discharge peak and sediment-concentration peak always coincide
Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet.
quiz.explanation: 立即套完全混合會低估出口附近局部濃度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Immediate complete-mixing assumptions understate concentration near the outlet. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分流時機與濃度峰」與「水砂守恆與稽核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diversion timing and sediment peaks" and "Water sediment conservation audit": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分流時機與濃度峰：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「分流時機與濃度峰」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion timing and sediment peaks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水的含砂峰可能早於或晚於水量峰，分流時機決定可攔截的砂量與所用水量。用分段質量積分比較時窗能示範取捨，但不構成即時操作指令；實際調度還需洪水安全、下游限制與設備狀態共同核准。 驗證時應對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，並辨識以下失效情境：以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分流時機與濃度峰」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment peaks can precede or follow discharge peaks, making diversion timing important. Piecewise mass integration compares windows and water use but is not a real-time operating instruction. Actual decisions combine flood safety, downstream constraints and equipment state through the approved operating framework. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion timing and sediment peaks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Two hypothetical intervals:120 kg/s for1800 s and50 kg/s for1800 s; transportedMass=(120+50)*1800/1000=306 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Two hypothetical intervals:120 kg/s for1800 s and50 kg/s for1800 s; transportedMass=(120+50)*1800/1000=306 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水量洪峰與含砂濃度峰永遠同時發生」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The water-discharge peak and sediment-concentration peak always coincide" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分流時機與濃度峰」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion timing and sediment peaks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分流時機與濃度峰

knowledge.textEn: Sediment peaks can precede or follow discharge peaks, making diversion timing important. Piecewise mass integration compares windows and water use but is not a real-time operating instruction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水量洪峰與含砂濃度峰永遠同時發生 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The water-discharge peak and sediment-concentration peak always coincide Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 分流時機與濃度峰：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分流時機與濃度峰」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion timing and sediment peaks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分流時機與濃度峰：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diversion timing and sediment peaks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分流時機與濃度峰」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion timing and sediment peaks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。診斷時應採取以下查核：對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. Diagnose it by the following check: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水量洪峰與含砂濃度峰永遠同時發生」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The water-discharge peak and sediment-concentration peak always coincide" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以洪峰時間取代含砂峰會錯失高濃度時段。診斷時應採取以下查核：對齊水量與濃度時序並量化提前或延後時窗的差異，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using the water peak as the sediment peak can miss concentrated inflow. Diagnose it by the following check: Align discharge and concentration histories and compare earlier and later windows. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 水砂守恆與稽核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water sediment conservation audit: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水砂守恆與稽核」如何影響水庫排砂隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water sediment conservation audit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir sediment-bypass tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完整排砂評估應讓進砂、出砂與庫內暫存閉合，並將量測不確定度與未量床載分開列出。殘差不是自動等於未量侵蝕，採樣偏差與測深基準也可能造成差額；需要以獨立地形與質量觀測交叉核算。 驗證時應用獨立測深與乾密度估算庫存變化再比對通量帳，並辨識以下失效情境：把所有殘差都歸於侵蝕會掩蓋採樣或密度錯誤。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水砂守恆與稽核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A complete assessment reconciles incoming, outgoing and stored sediment while separating uncertainty and unmeasured bed load. A residual is not automatically erosion; sampling bias and survey datums can also create imbalance. Cross-check mass records against independent bed surveys and consistent dry-density assumptions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Estimate storage change from independent bathymetry and dry density and compare flux records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assigning every residual to erosion conceals sampling or density errors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water sediment conservation audit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：incomingDryMass=1000 t; bypassed=650 t; otherOutflow=100 t; measuredStorageIncrease=230 t; residual=1000-650-100-230=20 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: incomingDryMass=1000 t; bypassed=650 t; otherOutflow=100 t; measuredStorageIncrease=230 t; residual=1000-650-100-230=20 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水砂帳殘差一定全部代表未量到的河床侵蝕」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every sediment-budget residual represents unmeasured bed erosion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水砂守恆與稽核」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water sediment conservation audit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水砂守恆與稽核

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水砂守恆與稽核」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water sediment conservation audit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：incomingDryMass=1000 t; bypassed=650 t; otherOutflow=100 t; measuredStorageIncrease=230 t; residual=1000-650-100-230=20 t。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: incomingDryMass=1000 t; bypassed=650 t; otherOutflow=100 t; measuredStorageIncrease=230 t; residual=1000-650-100-230=20 t. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立測深與乾密度估算庫存變化再比對通量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate storage change from independent bathymetry and dry density and compare flux records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水砂守恆與稽核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water sediment conservation audit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水砂守恆與稽核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water sediment conservation audit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有殘差都歸於侵蝕會掩蓋採樣或密度錯誤。診斷時應採取以下查核：用獨立測深與乾密度估算庫存變化再比對通量帳，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning every residual to erosion conceals sampling or density errors. Diagnose it by the following check: Estimate storage change from independent bathymetry and dry density and compare flux records. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水砂帳殘差一定全部代表未量到的河床侵蝕」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every sediment-budget residual represents unmeasured bed erosion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水砂守恆與稽核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water sediment conservation audit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Assigning every residual to erosion conceals sampling or density errors.

title: 水庫異重流排砂
summary: 本課以以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流為主線，先用懸浮濃度與混合密度與約化重力與浮力界定水力與構造條件，再將沉降時間與粒徑、底孔捕捉與排出連結到底流質量帳與殘留。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture through Suspension concentration and mixture density and Reduced gravity and buoyancy, then connects Settling time and particle size and Low-outlet capture and export to Current mass budget and residual storage. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查懸浮濃度與混合密度：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3；再獨立檢查約化重力與浮力：g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2。敏感度：水與顆粒密度不變時，體積濃度由0.005增至0.010使密度差與約化重力加倍；固定流深下重力速度尺度增加平方根2倍，並非速度必然加倍。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 將先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Suspension concentration and mixture density: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. Independently examine Reduced gravity and buoyancy: g=9.81 m/s2; currentDensity=1016.5 kg/m3; ambientDensity=1000 kg/m3; reducedG=9.81*(1016.5-1000)/1000=0.161865 m/s2. Sensitivity: at fixed water and grain densities, raising volume concentration from0.005 to0.010 doubles density excess and reduced gravity. At fixed layer depth the gravity-velocity scale rises bysqrt(2), not by a factor of2. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. Use the following independent check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸浮濃度與混合密度」與「約化重力與浮力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suspension concentration and mixture density" and "Reduced gravity and buoyancy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspension concentration and mixture density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。 驗證時應同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略冷暖水密度差會誤判含砂流的浮沉方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「懸浮濃度與混合密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion. Measure both ambient and incoming water before inferring plunging behavior. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring thermal density contrast can misidentify whether sediment-laden inflow rises or sinks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspension concentration and mixture density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspension concentration and mixture density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度
knowledge.text: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。體積濃度不同於每立方公尺混合水的乾砂質量濃度，換算須使用顆粒密度；判斷下潛前應同步量測清水背景與含砂水。
knowledge.textEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. Volume fraction differs from dry sediment mass per mixture volume and requires grain density for conversion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸浮濃度與混合密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Suspension concentration and mixture density" is correct?
options: 只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重
含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。
約化重力是一旦決定就不會沿程改變的常數
optionsEn: Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water
Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density.
Reduced gravity cannot change along the current once initially specified
quiz.explanation: 含砂水因顆粒增加體積平均密度而可能沿庫底前進，但鹽度與溫度分層也會改變背景密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Suspended particles raise mixture density and can drive a bottom current, while temperature and salinity alter ambient density. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸浮濃度與混合密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suspension concentration and mixture density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸浮濃度與混合密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suspension concentration and mixture density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSediment=2650 kg/m3; volumeFraction=0.01; rhoMix=(1-0.01)*1000+0.01*2650=1016.5 kg/m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步採樣顆粒濃度水溫與背景密度並核對濃度定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sediment concentration, temperature and ambient density together and state concentration definitions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「約化重力與浮力」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 約化重力以密度差相對背景密度縮放重力，表達異重流的浮力驅動尺度。分母選用哪個參考密度須一致，小密度差近似不能任意延伸至高濃度泥流；密度差沿程因捲吸與沉降變化，因此不是固定材料常數。 驗證時應沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差，並辨識以下失效情境：把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「約化重力與浮力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess. Use a consistent reference density and do not extend a small-density-difference approximation to dense debris flows. Entrainment and settling change the excess along the route, so reduced gravity is a changing flow property rather than a material constant. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced gravity cannot change along the current once initially specified" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「約化重力與浮力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Reduced gravity scales gravitational acceleration by relative density excess. Use a consistent reference density and do not extend a small-density-difference approximation to dense debris flows.

steps.title: 約化重力與浮力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reduced gravity and buoyancy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「約化重力與浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reduced gravity and buoyancy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿庫底量測密度剖面並比較入流與壩前密度差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把入口約化重力固定套全庫會忽略捲吸稀釋」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure density profiles along the bed and compare excess at inflow and near the dam. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: Using inlet reduced gravity throughout the reservoir ignores entrainment dilution.
