stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度福祿數與流態」與「前緣行程與時窗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Densimetric Froude number and regime" and "Front travel and timing window": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度福祿數與流態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number and regime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度福祿數與流態」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Densimetric Froude number and regime” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度福祿數比較流速與層內重力波尺度，有助整理潛入與底流工況。流層厚度須由密度或濃度剖面定義，不能直接用水庫總深；真實前緣與非均勻分層不一定符合均勻兩層模型，需要以觀測檢查。 驗證時應用密度剖面界定流層厚度並量測流速與前緣位置，並辨識以下失效情境：把全庫深當流層厚度會低估密度福祿數。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度福祿數與流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Densimetric Froude number compares current speed with an internal gravity-wave scale. Define layer thickness from density or concentration profiles rather than total reservoir depth. A real head and nonuniform stratification can depart from the uniform two-layer model, requiring observations before interpreting the number. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Define layer depth from density profiles and measure speed and front position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using total reservoir depth as current thickness understates densimetric Froude number. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Densimetric Froude number and regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=0.50 m/s; reducedG=0.16 m/s2; layerDepth=2 m; FrD=0.50/sqrt(0.16*2)=0.883883。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=0.50 m/s; reducedG=0.16 m/s2; layerDepth=2 m; FrD=0.50/sqrt(0.16*2)=0.883883.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「異重流厚度一定等於整個水庫的水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度福祿數與流態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Densimetric Froude number and regime”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度福祿數與流態
knowledge.text: 密度福祿數比較流速與層內重力波尺度，有助整理潛入與底流工況。流層厚度須由密度或濃度剖面定義，不能直接用水庫總深；真實前緣與非均勻分層不一定符合均勻兩層模型，需要以觀測檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Densimetric Froude number compares current speed with an internal gravity-wave scale. Define layer thickness from density or concentration profiles rather than total reservoir depth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：異重流厚度一定等於整個水庫的水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度福祿數與流態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

單一平均前緣速度就能精確決定開門時間
optionsEn: Densimetric Froude number compares current speed with an internal gravity-wave scale.
Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: V=0.50 m/s; reducedG=0.16 m/s2; layerDepth=2 m; FrD=0.50/sqrt(0.16*2)=0.883883. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 底流前緣抵達壩前的時間受沿程坡度、捲吸及沉降改變，平均速度只提供第一輪時窗估算。它不是即時開門指令，實際需靠沿庫監測更新；應區分前緣速度與流層內平均速度，兩者不可直接互換。 驗證時應以多站濁度及密度到時比對前緣速度並更新抵達區間，並辨識以下失效情境：沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「前緣行程與時窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Front arrival depends on slope, entrainment and settling along the route. A mean-speed estimate supplies an initial time window rather than an operating command. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare arrival times at multiple turbidity and density stations and update the arrival interval. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Front travel and timing window” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 前緣行程與時窗：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「前緣行程與時窗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Front travel and timing window” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。診斷時應採取以下查核：以多站濁度及密度到時比對前緣速度並更新抵達區間，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare arrival times at multiple turbidity and density stations and update the arrival interval. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一平均前緣速度就能精確決定開門時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One mean front speed determines the exact gate-opening time" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。診斷時應採取以下查核：以多站濁度及密度到時比對前緣速度並更新抵達區間，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare arrival times at multiple turbidity and density stations and update the arrival interval. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「前緣行程與時窗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Front travel and timing window" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。
所有粒徑泥砂都能用同一個沉降速度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift.
Every sediment size can use the same settling velocity
quiz.explanation: 沿程速度改變會使固定時速外推偏離實際到達。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing speed along the route makes constant-speed arrival forecasts drift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉降時間與粒徑」與「捲吸稀釋與濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settling time and particle size" and "Entrainment dilution and concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉降時間與粒徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settling time and particle size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉降時間與粒徑」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settling time and particle size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 顆粒沉降會降低底流密度並改變可排出的粒徑組成，沉速受粒徑、形狀、絮凝及濃度影響。指定沉速的距離時間比只表示靜水尺度，紊流再懸浮會延長停留；不同粒徑不能共用一個沉速來預測全部排砂效率。 驗證時應採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面，並辨識以下失效情境：用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉降時間與粒徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settling reduces density and changes the size distribution available for venting. Speed depends on size, shape, flocculation and concentration. Depth divided by prescribed settling speed is a still-water scale; turbulence can extend suspension, and one settling speed cannot represent the efficiency for all fractions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settling time and particle size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有粒徑泥砂都能用同一個沉降速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every sediment size can use the same settling velocity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉降時間與粒徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Settling time and particle size”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉降時間與粒徑
knowledge.text: 顆粒沉降會降低底流密度並改變可排出的粒徑組成，沉速受粒徑、形狀、絮凝及濃度影響。指定沉速的距離時間比只表示靜水尺度，紊流再懸浮會延長停留；不同粒徑不能共用一個沉速來預測全部排砂效率。
knowledge.textEn: Settling reduces density and changes the size distribution available for venting. Speed depends on size, shape, flocculation and concentration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有粒徑泥砂都能用同一個沉降速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every sediment size can use the same settling velocity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉降時間與粒徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Settling time and particle size" is correct?
options: 所有粒徑泥砂都能用同一個沉降速度
濃度沒有下降就證明底流沒有捲吸清水
顆粒沉降會降低底流密度並改變可排出的粒徑組成，沉速受粒徑、形狀、絮凝及濃度影響。
optionsEn: Every sediment size can use the same settling velocity
Unchanged concentration proves that the current entrains no clear water
Settling reduces density and changes the size distribution available for venting.
quiz.explanation: 顆粒沉降會降低底流密度並改變可排出的粒徑組成，沉速受粒徑、形狀、絮凝及濃度影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Settling reduces density and changes the size distribution available for venting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉降時間與粒徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settling time and particle size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉降時間與粒徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settling time and particle size” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉降時間與粒徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Settling time and particle size", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。
所有排砂效率百分比不需看分母就可互相比較
質量差額可以直接指出沉積物的精確位置
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min.
Every venting-efficiency percentage is comparable without inspecting its denominator
A mass-budget residual directly identifies the exact deposit location
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: LayerThickness=3 m; prescribedSettlingSpeed=0.002 m/s; stillWaterSettlingTime=3/0.002/60=25 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉降時間與粒徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Settling time and particle size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉降時間與粒徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settling time and particle size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 採取分級粒徑與沉降試驗並比較沿程濃度剖面。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用單一細粒沉速代表粗砂會高估粗粒到壩比例」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using a fine-particle speed for coarse sand overestimates coarse arrival at the dam. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉降時間與粒徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Settling time and particle size"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

quiz.explanationEn: Test settling by size fraction and compare concentration profiles along the route. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 捲吸稀釋與濃度：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 底流捲吸上層清水會增加水量並降低濃度，在無沉降與再侵蝕的短段可用泥砂質量守恆估算。此式不是實際捲吸率模型，捲吸量須另有依據；若床面供砂或沉降顯著，就要補上來源與匯項。 驗證時應以沿程流量與濃度同步量測核對質量是否守恆，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略床面再侵蝕會把濃度維持誤解為完全沒有捲吸。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「捲吸稀釋與濃度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Entrainment increases water volume and dilutes concentration. Over a short reach without deposition or erosion, sediment conservation estimates the resulting concentration. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure flow and concentration along the reach to check sediment mass conservation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring bed erosion can make sustained concentration look like absent entrainment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Entrainment dilution and concentration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有排砂效率百分比不需看分母就可互相比較 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every venting-efficiency percentage is comparable without inspecting its denominator Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「事件排砂效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

排砂效率須明定分母是入庫總砂、抵達壩前底流砂或可捕捉粒徑砂，否則不同研究數值不可比較。
optionsEn: Every venting-efficiency percentage is comparable without inspecting its denominator
An acceptable mixed oxygen average means every downstream location is identical
Define whether efficiency uses total incoming sediment, sediment reaching the dam or a capturable size fraction.

quiz.explanationEn: Define whether efficiency uses total incoming sediment, sediment reaching the dam or a capturable size fraction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 事件排砂效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Event venting efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件排砂效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Event venting efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Same-event arrivingCurrentSediment=900 t; exportedThroughOutlet=540 t; arrivalBasedEfficiency=540/900*100=60 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Same-event arrivingCurrentSediment=900 t; exportedThroughOutlet=540 t; arrivalBasedEfficiency=540/900*100=60 percent. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 事件排砂效率：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件排砂效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用入庫砂與到壩砂分母會產生無意義的效率比較」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用入庫砂與到壩砂分母會產生無意義的效率比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 事件排砂效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Event venting efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件排砂效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Event venting efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用入庫砂與到壩砂分母會產生無意義的效率比較。診斷時應採取以下查核：先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons. Diagnose it by the following check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有排砂效率百分比不需看分母就可互相比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every venting-efficiency percentage is comparable without inspecting its denominator" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混用入庫砂與到壩砂分母會產生無意義的效率比較。診斷時應採取以下查核：先聲明分母範圍再核對進出砂積分與延後排出量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons. Diagnose it by the following check: State the denominator scope and reconcile integrated arrival, export and delayed release. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「事件排砂效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

Mixing reservoir-inflow and dam-arrival denominators creates meaningless efficiency comparisons.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「下游混合與溶氧」與「底流質量帳與殘留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 下游混合與溶氧：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下游混合與溶氧」如何影響水庫異重流排砂的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Density-current venting for reservoir sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底層水可能具有不同溶氧與溫度，排砂成效不能只用移除砂量衡量。瞬時完全混合可估保守水質盤點，但曝氣、耗氧與化學反應會改變下游值；實際應觀測近場與遠場，不能把混合平均當各位置都達標。 驗證時應沿下游斷面量測溶氧與溫度並比較混合前後變化，並辨識以下失效情境：只量遠場平均會漏掉出口附近低氧帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游混合與溶氧」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom water can differ in oxygen and temperature, so exported sediment is not the only outcome. Instantaneous complete mixing gives a bookkeeping estimate, while reaeration, demand and reactions alter downstream conditions. Observe near and far fields rather than treating the average as compliance everywhere. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure oxygen and temperature across downstream sections before and after mixing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A far-field average can miss a low-oxygen plume near the outlet. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：No reaction: releaseQ=10 m3/s atDO=2 mg/L; riverQ=30 m3/s atDO=8 mg/L; mixedDO=(10*2+30*8)/40=6.5 mg/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: No reaction: releaseQ=10 m3/s atDO=2 mg/L; riverQ=30 m3/s atDO=8 mg/L; mixedDO=(10*2+30*8)/40=6.5 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混合平均溶氧合適就代表所有下游位置相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable mixed oxygen average means every downstream location is identical" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游混合與溶氧」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Downstream mixing and dissolved oxygen”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

options: 異重流厚度一定等於整個水庫的水深
所有粒徑泥砂都能用同一個沉降速度
原創教學假設：incomingMass=1200 t; vented=650 t; otherExport=100 t; remainingNetStorage=1200-650-100=450 t。
optionsEn: Density-current thickness always equals total reservoir depth
Every sediment size can use the same settling velocity
Original teaching assumptions: incomingMass=1200 t; vented=650 t; otherExport=100 t; remainingNetStorage=1200-650-100=450 t.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：incomingMass=1200 t; vented=650 t; otherExport=100 t; remainingNetStorage=1200-650-100=450 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: incomingMass=1200 t; vented=650 t; otherExport=100 t; remainingNetStorage=1200-650-100=450 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 底流質量帳與殘留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Current mass budget and residual storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底流質量帳與殘留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Current mass budget and residual storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「底流質量帳與殘留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Current mass budget and residual storage"?
options: 以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
底孔開越大就保證每立方公尺排水含砂越高
optionsEn: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A wider outlet guarantees more sediment in every cubic metre released
quiz.explanation: 以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 底流質量帳與殘留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Current mass budget and residual storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「底流質量帳與殘留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Current mass budget and residual storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。診斷時應採取以下查核：以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「質量差額可以直接指出沉積物的精確位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mass-budget residual directly identifies the exact deposit location" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。診斷時應採取以下查核：以事件前後測深及乾密度核對差額並標記未量輸送，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the residual against before-and-after bathymetry and dry density and flag unmeasured transport. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「底流質量帳與殘留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Current mass budget and residual storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。
只要有泥砂就保證入流一定比任何庫水更重
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition.
Any sediment load guarantees inflow denser than all reservoir water
quiz.explanation: 將差額全部放在壩前會忽略沿庫分布沉積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning all residual sediment to the dam front ignores distributed deposition. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
